	public class ComboBoxToggleButtonVisibleConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length == 2)
			{
				bool flag = (bool)values[0];
				if (!(bool)values[1])
				{
					return Visibility.Hidden;
				}
				if (flag)

namespace AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Template

	public class CATemplateHelper
	{
		private static IUnityContainer UnityContainer;

		public static void ExportTemplate(IUnityContainer unityContainer, string productVersion, string configOptionKey, string sectionKey, string fileName)
		{
			UnityContainer = unityContainer;
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			XmlWriterSettings settings = new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				Indent = true,
				IndentChars = "\t",
				ConformanceLevel = ConformanceLevel.Auto,
				OmitXmlDeclaration = false
			};
			using XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(fileName, settings);
			xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("CATemplate");
			xmlWriter.WriteStartAttribute("Version");
			xmlWriter.WriteValue(productVersion);
			xmlWriter.WriteEndAttribute();
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(configOptionKey, sectionKey);
			if (simSectionData is CATraySectionData)
			{
				xmlWriter.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				xmlWriter.WriteValue("Tray");
				xmlWriter.WriteEndAttribute();
				ExportTraySectionData(simSectionData as CATraySectionData, xmlWriter);
			}
			else if (simSectionData is CAPackingSectionData)
			{
				xmlWriter.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				xmlWriter.WriteValue("Packing");
				xmlWriter.WriteEndAttribute();
				ExportPackingSectionData(simSectionData as CAPackingSectionData, xmlWriter);
			}
		}

		private static void ExportTraySectionData(CATraySectionData traySectionData, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			if (traySectionData.IsCustomTray ?? false)
			{
				ExportCustomTraySectionData(traySectionData as CACustomTraySectionData, writer);
				return;
			}
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("TrayType");
			writer.WriteValue(traySectionData.GetInternalType().ToString());
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("Mode");
			writer.WriteValue(traySectionData.CalculationMode.ToString());
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("IsDefaultType");
			writer.WriteValue(traySectionData.IsDefaultType);
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartElement("TrayLayout");
			bool flag = false;
			switch (traySectionData.GetInternalType())
			{
			case InternalsTypeEnum.Sieve:
			{
				CASieveTraySectionData obj = traySectionData as CASieveTraySectionData;
				flag = obj.IsMDTray.Value;
				ExportSieveTraySectionData(obj, writer);
				break;
			}
			case InternalsTypeEnum.Bubble_Cap:
				ExportBubleCapTraySectionData(traySectionData as CABubbleCapTraySection, writer);
				break;
			case InternalsTypeEnum.Glitsch_Ballast:
				ExportGlitschBallastTraySectionData(traySectionData as CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection, writer);
				break;
			case InternalsTypeEnum.Koch_Flexitray:
				ExportKochFlexitrayTraySectionData(traySectionData as CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection, writer);
				break;
			case InternalsTypeEnum.Nutter_Float_Valve:
				ExportNutterFloatValveBallastTraySectionData(traySectionData as CANutterFloatValveTraySection, writer);
				break;
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteStartElement("Properties");
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.Diameter, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TraySpacing, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.NumberofPasses, writer);
			if (!flag)
			{
				WriteBooleanData("PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays", traySectionData.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays, writer);
				WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTraysIntValue, writer);
				WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackENAB, writer);
				WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackType, writer);
				WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackDimensionWF, writer);
				WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackDimensionSF, writer);
				WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackDimensionA, writer);
				WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackDimensionB, writer);
				WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SweptBackDimensionS, writer);
				WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex, writer);
				WriteCADowncomerVariable(traySectionData.Downcomers, writer);
			}
			WriteCAWeirsVariable(traySectionData.Weirs, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.DeckThicknessRealValue, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.DeckThicknessIntEnum, writer);
			WriteBooleanData("AreaUnderDCAsBubblingArea", traySectionData.AreaUnderDCAsBubblingArea, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.AreaUnderDCAsBubblingAreaIntValue, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaximumPressureDrop, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaximumFractionalEntrainment, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaxDowncomerBackup, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaxPercentJetFlood, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.WeirLoadMaximum, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.WeirLoadMinimum, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SystemFoamingFactor, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.AerationFactorMultiplier, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.OverdesignFactor, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.WeepCalculationMethod, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethod, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.FloodingCalculationMethod, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.WarningStatusLimit, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.PercentJetFloodForDesign, writer);
			WriteBooleanData("OverideDowncomerFrothDensity", traySectionData.OverideDowncomerFrothDensity, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.DowncomerFrothDensity, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.DowncomerDesignBasis, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SectionEfficiency, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.OldCorrelation, writer);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void ExportCustomTraySectionData(CACustomTraySectionData traySectionData, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("TrayType");
			writer.WriteValue(traySectionData.GetInternalType().ToString());
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("Mode");
			writer.WriteValue(traySectionData.CalculationMode.ToString());
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("IsDefaultType");
			writer.WriteValue(traySectionData.IsDefaultType);
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartElement("TrayLayout");
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.TrayOpenType, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.OpenAreaRatio, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.ActiveAreaRatio, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.LiqExitAreaRatio, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.TotalWeirLength, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.DCAreaRatio, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.TotalDCHeight, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.HasDC, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.ClearLiqHeight, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.ConstantBeforeLiqReynoldsNumber, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.PowerOfLiqReynoldsNumber, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveNumbers, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveThickness, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveMaterial, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveLift, writer);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteStartElement("Properties");
			WriteDiameterForCustomTray(traySectionData.Diameter, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TraySpacing, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.DeckThicknessRealValue, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.DeckThicknessIntEnum, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.Weirs[0].Height, writer, "WeirHeight");
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaxPercentJetFlood, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.DowncomerDesignBasis, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaximumPressureDrop, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.PercentJetFloodForDesign, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaxDowncomerBackup, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.MaximumFractionalEntrainment, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.WeirLoadMaximum, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.WeirLoadMinimum, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.WarningStatusLimit, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SystemFoamingFactor, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.AerationFactorMultiplier, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.OverdesignFactor, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.SectionEfficiency, writer);
			WriteBooleanData("OverideDowncomerFrothDensity", traySectionData.OverideDowncomerFrothDensity, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.DowncomerFrothDensity, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.DryDPMultiplier, writer);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void ExportValveTrayLayout(ValveTrayLayout trayLayout, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(trayLayout.ValveMaterial, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(trayLayout.ValveLift, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(trayLayout.ValveThickness, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(trayLayout.NumberOfValves, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(trayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea, writer);
		}

		private static void ExportBubleCapTraySectionData(CABubbleCapTraySection traySectionData, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			BubbleCap bubbleCap = traySectionData.TrayLayout.BubbleCap;
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(bubbleCap.Diameter, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(bubbleCap.SkirtHeight, writer);
			WriteIntData("CapsDensityNumberSpec", bubbleCap.CapsDensityNumberSpec, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(bubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(bubbleCap.NumberOfCaps, writer);
		}

		private static void ExportSieveTraySectionData(CASieveTraySectionData traySectionData, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.HoleDiameter, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(traySectionData.TrayLayout.NumberOfHoles, writer);
			WriteIntData("HoleAreaNumberSpec", traySectionData.TrayLayout.HoleAreaNumberSpec, writer);
			if (traySectionData.IsMDTray.Value)
			{
				WriteCAMDDowncomerVariable(traySectionData, writer);
			}
		}

		private static void ExportPackingSectionData(CAPackingSectionData packingSectionData, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("TrayType");
			writer.WriteValue(packingSectionData.PackingType.EnumString.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("IsDefaultType");
			writer.WriteValue(packingSectionData.IsDefaultType);
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartElement("Properties");
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.Diameter, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariableWithEnumString(packingSectionData.PackingType, writer);
			if (!packingSectionData.PackingVendor.IsEmpty())
			{
				WriteStringData("PackingVendor", packingSectionData.PackingVendor.EnumString.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), writer);
			}
			if (!packingSectionData.PackingMaterial.IsEmpty())
			{
				WriteStringData("PackingMaterial", packingSectionData.PackingMaterial.EnumString.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), writer);
			}
			if (!packingSectionData.PackingDimension.IsEmpty())
			{
				WriteStringData("PackingDimension", packingSectionData.PackingDimension.EnumString.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), writer);
			}
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.PackingSize, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.PackingFactor, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.HETP, writer);
			WriteIntData("PackHeightType", (int)packingSectionData.PackHeightType, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.PackingHeight, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.CapacityFactorFlooding, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.SystemFoamingFactor, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.OverDesignFactor, writer);
			WriteCAIntegerVariable(packingSectionData.PressureDropMethod, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.JetFloodingLimit, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.StichlmairSurfaceArea, writer);

			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.MaximumLiquidFlowRatePerArea, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.PressureDropAtFlood, writer);
			WriteCARealVariable(packingSectionData.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight, writer);

		}

		private static void WriteCAIntegerVariable(CAIntegerVariable variable, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			if (!variable.IsEmpty() && variable.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
				writer.WriteValue(variable.PropertyName);
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				writer.WriteValue("Integer");
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteValue(variable.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCAIntegerVariableWithEnumString(CAIntegerVariable variable, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			if (!variable.IsEmpty() && variable.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
				writer.WriteValue(variable.PropertyName);
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				writer.WriteValue("Integer");
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteValue(variable.EnumString.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCARealVariable(CARealVariable variable, XmlWriter writer, string propName = null)
		{
			if (!variable.IsEmpty() && variable.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
				writer.WriteValue((propName != null) ? propName : variable.PropertyName);
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("QuantityType");
				writer.WriteValue(variable.QuantityType.ToString());
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				writer.WriteValue("Real");
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteValue(variable.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteDiameterForCustomTray(CARealVariable variable, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			if (!variable.IsEmpty())
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
				writer.WriteValue(variable.PropertyName);
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("QuantityType");
				writer.WriteValue(variable.QuantityType.ToString());
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				writer.WriteValue("Real");
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteValue(variable.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCAStringVariable(StringCAVariable variable, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			if (!variable.IsEmpty() && variable.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
				writer.WriteValue(variable.PropertyName);
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
				writer.WriteValue("String");
				writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				writer.WriteValue(variable.Value);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void WriteCAWeirsVariable(IEnumerable<CAWeir> weirs, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			if (weirs.FirstOrDefault((CAWeir p) => p.Height.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || p.Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || p.PicketingFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input) == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
			writer.WriteValue("Weirs");
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
			writer.WriteValue("Weirs");
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			foreach (CAWeir weir in weirs)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("CAWeir");
				if (!weir.Height.IsEmpty() && weir.Height.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("Height");
					writer.WriteValue(weir.Height.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				if (!weir.Width.IsEmpty() && weir.Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("Width");
					writer.WriteValue(weir.Width.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				if (!weir.PicketingFraction.IsEmpty() && weir.PicketingFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("PicketingFraction");
					writer.WriteValue(weir.PicketingFraction.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void WriteCADowncomerVariable(IEnumerable<CADowncomer> downcomers, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			CADowncomer cADowncomer = downcomers.FirstOrDefault((CADowncomer p) => p.TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || p.BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || p.StraightHeight.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || p.Clearence.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input);
			bool flag = downcomers.ToArray()[2] is OffCenterDowncomer && (downcomers.ToArray()[2] as OffCenterDowncomer).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input;
			if (cADowncomer == null && !flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			writer.WriteStartElement("Property");
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("Name");
			writer.WriteValue("Downcomer");
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			writer.WriteStartAttribute("Type");
			writer.WriteValue("Downcomer");
			writer.WriteEndAttribute();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (CADowncomer downcomer in downcomers)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("CADowncomer");
				if (!downcomer.Clearence.IsEmpty() && downcomer.Clearence.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("Clearence");
					writer.WriteValue(downcomer.Clearence.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				if (!downcomer.TopWidth.IsEmpty() && downcomer.TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("TopWidth");
					writer.WriteValue(downcomer.TopWidth.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				if (!downcomer.BottomWidth.IsEmpty() && downcomer.BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("BottomWidth");
					writer.WriteValue(downcomer.BottomWidth.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				if (!downcomer.StraightHeight.IsEmpty() && downcomer.StraightHeight.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("StraightHeight");
					writer.WriteValue(downcomer.StraightHeight.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				if (num == 2 && downcomer is OffCenterDowncomer offCenterDowncomer && offCenterDowncomer.OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					writer.WriteStartAttribute("OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter");
					writer.WriteValue(offCenterDowncomer.OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
					writer.WriteEndAttribute();
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				num++;
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static string GetInternalTypeFromTemplate(string fileName)
		{
			string text = "Tray";
			using XmlTextReader xmlTextReader = new XmlTextReader(fileName);
			xmlTextReader.ReadToFollowing("CATemplate");
			text = xmlTextReader.GetAttribute("Type");
			xmlTextReader.Close();
			return text;
		}

		public static bool ImportTemplate(IUnityContainer unityContainer, string productVersion, string configOptionKey, string sectionKey, string fileName)
		{
			UnityContainer = unityContainer;
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionDataBase = null;
			using (XmlTextReader xmlTextReader = new XmlTextReader(fileName))
			{
				xmlTextReader.ReadToFollowing("CATemplate");
				if (!IsVersionCompatible(xmlTextReader.GetAttribute("Version"), productVersion))
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ImportTemplate__SavedWithAHigherVersion, Resources.ImportTemplateDialog_Title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
					xmlTextReader.Close();
					return false;
				}
				string attribute = xmlTextReader.GetAttribute("Type");
				if (attribute == "Packing")
				{
					simSectionDataBase = ReadPackingSectionTemplate(unityContainer, xmlTextReader);
				}
				else if (attribute == "Tray")
				{
					simSectionDataBase = ReadTraySectionTemplate(unityContainer, xmlTextReader);
				}
				xmlTextReader.Close();
			}
			if (simSectionDataBase != null)
			{
				return simulatorCADataProvider.WriteTemplateData(simSectionDataBase, configOptionKey, sectionKey);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static CATraySectionData ReadTraySectionTemplate(IUnityContainer unityContainer, XmlTextReader reader)
		{
			CATraySectionData cATraySectionData = null;
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute("Mode");
			string attribute2 = reader.GetAttribute("IsDefaultType");
			switch (reader.GetAttribute("TrayType"))
			{
			case "Bubble_Cap":
				cATraySectionData = new CABubbleCapTraySection(unityContainer);
				ReadBubbleCapTrayLayout(cATraySectionData as CABubbleCapTraySection, reader);
				break;
			case "Sieve":
				cATraySectionData = new CASieveTraySectionData(unityContainer);
				ReadSieveTrayLayout(cATraySectionData as CASieveTraySectionData, reader);
				break;
			case "Glitsch_Ballast":
				cATraySectionData = new CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection(unityContainer);
				ReadGlitschBallastTrayLayout(cATraySectionData as CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection, reader);
				break;
			case "Koch_Flexitray":
				cATraySectionData = new CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection(unityContainer);
				ReadKochFlexitrayTrayLayout(cATraySectionData as CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection, reader);
				break;
			case "Nutter_Float_Valve":
				cATraySectionData = new CANutterFloatValveTraySection(unityContainer);
				ReadNutterFloatValveTrayLayout(cATraySectionData as CANutterFloatValveTraySection, reader);
				break;
			case "CustomTray":
				cATraySectionData = new CACustomTraySectionData(unityContainer);
				ReadCustomTrayLayout(cATraySectionData as CACustomTraySectionData, reader);
				break;
			}
			if (attribute == "Rating")
			{
				cATraySectionData.CalculationMode = CalculationMode.Rating;
			}
			else
			{
				cATraySectionData.CalculationMode = CalculationMode.Sizing;
			}
			bool result = false;
			if (bool.TryParse(attribute2, out result))
			{
				cATraySectionData.IsDefaultType = result;
			}
			if (cATraySectionData != null && reader.ReadToFollowing("Properties"))
			{
				while (reader.ReadToFollowing("Property"))
				{
					string value = ((reader.GetAttribute("Type") == "Real") ? reader.GetAttribute("QuantityType") : null);
					string attribute3 = reader.GetAttribute("Name");
					string text = reader.ReadString();
					double result2;
					int result11;
					bool result15;
					switch (attribute3)
					{
					case "Diameter":
						if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
						{
							cATraySectionData.Diameter.Value = result2;
							if (Enum.TryParse<QuantityTypeEnum>(value, out var result24))
							{
								cATraySectionData.Diameter.QuantityType = result24;
							}
							cATraySectionData.Diameter.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
						}
						break;
					case "TraySpacing":
						if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
						{
							cATraySectionData.TraySpacing.Value = result2;
							if (Enum.TryParse<QuantityTypeEnum>(value, out var result27))
							{
								cATraySectionData.TraySpacing.QuantityType = result27;
							}
							cATraySectionData.TraySpacing.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
						}
						break;
					case "NumberofPasses":
						if (int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result11))
						{
							cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value = result11;
							cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
						}
						break;
					case "PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays":
						if (bool.TryParse(text, out result15))
						{
							cATraySectionData.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays = result15;
						}
						break;
					case "PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTraysIntValue":
						if (int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result11))
						{
							cATraySectionData.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTraysIntValue.Value = result11;
							cATraySectionData.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTraysIntValue.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
						}
						break;
					case "Weirs":
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < cATraySectionData.Weirs.Count; j++)
						{
							CAWeir cAWeir = cATraySectionData.Weirs[j];
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("Width"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cAWeir.Width.Value = result2;
								cAWeir.Width.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("Height"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cAWeir.Height.Value = result2;
								cAWeir.Height.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("PicketingFraction"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cAWeir.PicketingFraction.Value = result2;
								cAWeir.PicketingFraction.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (j < cATraySectionData.Weirs.Count - 1)
							{
								reader.ReadToFollowing("CAWeir");
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					case "Downcomer":
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < cATraySectionData.Downcomers.Count; i++)
						{
							CADowncomer cADowncomer = cATraySectionData.Downcomers[i];
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("Clearence"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cADowncomer.Clearence.Value = result2;
								cADowncomer.Clearence.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("TopWidth"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cADowncomer.TopWidth.Value = result2;
								cADowncomer.TopWidth.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("BottomWidth"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cADowncomer.BottomWidth.Value = result2;
								cADowncomer.BottomWidth.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("StraightHeight"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								cADowncomer.StraightHeight.Value = result2;
								cADowncomer.StraightHeight.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (i == 2 && double.TryParse(reader.GetAttribute("OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter"), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result2))
							{
								(cADowncomer as OffCenterDowncomer).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = result2;
								(cADowncomer as OffCenterDowncomer).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
							}
							if (i < cATraySectionData.Downcomers.Count - 1)
							{
								reader.ReadToFollowing("CADowncomer");
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					case "SweptBackENAB":
						if (int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result11))
						{
							cATraySectionData.SweptBackENAB.Value = result11;
							cATraySectionData.SweptBackENAB.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
						}
						break;
					case "SweptBackType":
						if (int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result11))
						{
							cATraySectionData.SweptBackType.Value = result11;
							cATraySectionData.SweptBackType.VariableStatus = VariableStatusEnum.Input;
						}
						break;
					case "SweptBackDimensionWF":

		private static bool IsVersionCompatible(string templateVersion, string applicationVersion)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(templateVersion) && double.TryParse(templateVersion, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result) && double.TryParse(applicationVersion, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result2) && result <= result2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

	public class ExportTemplateDialog : Window, IComponentConnector
	{
		private string _optionKey;

		private string _selectedSectionKey;

		private IEnumerable<string> _sectionNames;

		private string _productVersion;

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider _simulatorCADataProvider;

		private IList<CASectionRange> _sectionRanges;

		private IUnityContainer _unityContainer;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox cboSection;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.TextBox txtFileName;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnBrowse;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnExport;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public ExportTemplateDialog(IUnityContainer container, string configOptionKey, string productVersion, string selectedSectionKey = null)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			_unityContainer = container;
			_optionKey = configOptionKey;
			_productVersion = productVersion;
			_simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			_sectionRanges = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_optionKey);
			_sectionNames = _sectionRanges.Select((CASectionRange p) => p.SectionName);
			_selectedSectionKey = selectedSectionKey;
			if (_unityContainer != null)
			{
				IShellApplication val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (val != null)
				{
					base.Owner = Window.GetWindow(val.ActiveWindow as DependencyObject);
				}
			}
			base.Loaded += ExportTemplateDialog_Loaded;
			base.Activated += ReportDialog_Activated;
		}

		private void ReportDialog_Activated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Keyboard.Focus(this);
		}

		private void ExportTemplateDialog_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_sectionNames != null)
			{
				cboSection.ItemsSource = _sectionNames;
			}
			CASectionRange cASectionRange = _sectionRanges.FirstOrDefault((CASectionRange p) => p.SectionKey == _selectedSectionKey);
			if (cASectionRange != null)
			{
				cboSection.SelectedItem = cASectionRange.SectionName;
			}
			else
			{
				cboSection.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			btnExport.IsEnabled = false;
		}

		private void btnBrowse_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new System.Windows.Forms.SaveFileDialog();
			saveFileDialog.Filter = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_TemplateFileFilter;
			saveFileDialog.Title = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_SaveTemplate;
			saveFileDialog.CheckPathExists = true;
			saveFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			saveFileDialog.FileName = cboSection.SelectedItem.ToString();
			if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.OK)
			{
				txtFileName.Text = saveFileDialog.FileName;
				btnExport.IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void btnExport_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = txtFileName.Text.Trim();
			if (!System.IO.Path.GetExtension(text).Equals(".xml", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_InvalidFileName, base.Title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
				return;
			}
			CASectionRange cASectionRange = _sectionRanges.FirstOrDefault((CASectionRange p) => p.SectionName == cboSection.SelectedItem.ToString());
			if (cASectionRange != null)
			{
				CATemplateHelper.ExportTemplate(_unityContainer, _productVersion, _optionKey, cASectionRange.SectionKey, text);
			}
			Close();
		}

		private void txtFileName_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(txtFileName.Text))
			{
				btnExport.IsEnabled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				btnExport.IsEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsValidPath(string path)
		{
			return new Regex("^((([a-zA-Z]:)|(\\))(((\\{1})[^\\]([^/:*?\"|\\]*))+)[\\])$").IsMatch(path);
		}

	public class ImportTemplateDialog : Window, IComponentConnector
	{
		private string _optionKey;

		private string _selectedSectionKey;

		private IEnumerable<string> _sectionNames;

		private string _productVersion;

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider _simulatorCADataProvider;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnBrowse;

		public ImportTemplateDialog(IUnityContainer container, string optionKey, string productVersion, string selectedSectionKey = null)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			_unityContainer = container;
			_optionKey = optionKey;
			_productVersion = productVersion;
			_simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			_sectionRanges = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_optionKey);
			if (_sectionRanges != null)
			{
				_sectionNames = _sectionRanges.Select((CASectionRange p) => p.SectionName);
			}
			_selectedSectionKey = selectedSectionKey;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedSectionKey))
			{
				rbImportToSection.IsChecked = true;
			}
			if (_sectionRanges != null && _sectionRanges.Count() > 0)
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("IsChecked"),
					ElementName = "rbImportToSection"
				};
				System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox checkBox = new System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox
				{
					Content = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ImportTemplateDialog_SelectAll,
					Margin = new Thickness(7.0, 0.0, 14.0, 7.0)
				};
				checkBox.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
				checkBox.Click += CbSelectAll_Clicked;
				sectionsPanel.Children.Add(checkBox);
				int num = 0;
				foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange in _sectionRanges)
				{
					System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox checkBox2 = new System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox
					{
						Content = sectionRange.SectionName,
						Margin = new Thickness(7.0, 0.0, 14.0, 7.0)
					};
					if (_selectedSectionKey == sectionRange.SectionKey)
					{
						checkBox2.IsChecked = true;
						num++;
					}
					checkBox2.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
					checkBox2.Click += CheckBox_Clicked;
					sectionsPanel.Children.Add(checkBox2);
				}
				if (sectionsPanel.Children.Count == 2 && num == 1)
				{
					checkBox.IsChecked = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rbImportToSection.IsEnabled = false;
			}
			if (_unityContainer != null)
			{
				IShellApplication val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (val != null)
				{
					base.Owner = Window.GetWindow(val.ActiveWindow as DependencyObject);
				}
			}
			base.Loaded += ImportTemplateDialog_Loaded;
			base.Activated += ReportDialog_Activated;
		}

		private void ReportDialog_Activated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Keyboard.Focus(this);
		}

		private void CheckBox_Clicked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox { IsChecked: var isChecked }))
			{
				return;
			}
			_ = isChecked ?? false;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 1; i < sectionsPanel.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((sectionsPanel.Children[i] as System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox).IsChecked ?? false)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			bool flag = num == sectionsPanel.Children.Count - 1;
			System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox checkBox2 = sectionsPanel.Children[0] as System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox;
			if (checkBox2.IsChecked != flag)
			{
				checkBox2.IsChecked = flag;
			}
		}

		private void CbSelectAll_Clicked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox { IsChecked: var isChecked }))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = isChecked ?? false;
			foreach (object child in sectionsPanel.Children)
			{
				if (child is System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox { IsChecked: var isChecked2 } checkBox2 && (isChecked2 ?? false) != flag)
				{
					checkBox2.IsChecked = flag;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ImportTemplateDialog_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			btnImport.IsEnabled = false;
		}

		private void btnBrowse_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.Filter = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_TemplateFileFilter;
			openFileDialog.Title = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_OpenTemplate;
			openFileDialog.CheckPathExists = true;
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() == System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.OK)
			{
				txtTemplateFileName.Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
				btnImport.IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void txtTemplateFileName_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(txtTemplateFileName.Text))
			{
				btnImport.IsEnabled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				btnImport.IsEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedSectionNames()
		{
			if (sectionsPanel.Children.Count <= 1)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < sectionsPanel.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sectionsPanel.Children[i] is System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox { IsChecked: var isChecked } checkBox && (isChecked ?? false) && !checkBox.Content.ToString().Equals(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ImportTemplateDialog_SelectAll))
				{
					yield return checkBox.Content.ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		private void btnImport_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = txtTemplateFileName.Text.Trim();
			if (!System.IO.Path.GetExtension(text).Equals(".xml", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_InvalidFileName, base.Title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
				return;
			}
			if (!File.Exists(text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ImportTemplateDialog_FileNotExist, base.Title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				string internalTypeFromTemplate = CATemplateHelper.GetInternalTypeFromTemplate(text);
				IEnumerable<string> selectedSectionNames = null;
				string createdId;
				if (rbImportToSection.IsChecked ?? false)
				{
					selectedSectionNames = GetSelectedSectionNames();
					if (selectedSectionNames != null && selectedSectionNames.Count() > 0)
					{
						IEnumerable<CASectionRange> source = _sectionRanges.Where((CASectionRange p) => selectedSectionNames.Contains(p.SectionName));
						IEnumerable<CASectionRange> enumerable = null;
						enumerable = ((!internalTypeFromTemplate.Equals("Packing", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) ? source.Where((CASectionRange p) => p.StageType == StageType.PackRating || p.StageType == StageType.PackSizing) : source.Where((CASectionRange p) => p.StageType == StageType.TrayRating || p.StageType == StageType.TraySizing));
						if (enumerable != null && enumerable.Count() > 0)
						{
							if (System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_DifferentInternalType, base.Title, MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation) != System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.Yes)
							{
								return;
							}
							foreach (CASectionRange item in enumerable)
							{
								_simulatorCADataProvider.ChangeInternalType(_optionKey, item.SectionKey, internalTypeFromTemplate);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (_simulatorCADataProvider.CreateNewSection(_optionKey, internalTypeFromTemplate, out createdId))
				{
					selectedSectionNames = new List<string> { createdId };
				}
				if (selectedSectionNames == null || selectedSectionNames.Count() == 0)
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ImportTemplateDialog_NoSectionChecked, base.Title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
					return;
				}
				foreach (string sectionName in selectedSectionNames)
				{
					CASectionRange cASectionRange = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_optionKey).FirstOrDefault((CASectionRange p) => p.SectionName == sectionName);
					if (cASectionRange != null)
					{
						CATemplateHelper.ImportTemplate(_unityContainer, _productVersion, _optionKey, cASectionRange.SectionKey, text);
					}
				}
				base.DialogResult = true;
				Close();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ExportTemplateDialog_InvalidFileName, base.Title, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]

		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces;component/template/importtemplatedialog.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)

			case 1:

				break;

				btnImport.Click += btnImport_Click;
				break;
			default:

				break;
			}
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsScreen_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject ancestorFromType = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)(object)this, typeof(PaneToolWindow), true);
			PaneToolWindow val = (PaneToolWindow)(object)((ancestorFromType is PaneToolWindow) ? ancestorFromType : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).SizeChanged += PaneToolWindow_SizeChanged;
			double width = ((FrameworkElement)this).ActualWidth;
			double height = ((FrameworkElement)this).ActualHeight;
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).Height = height;
				((FrameworkElement)this).Width = width;
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					isfreezensize = true;
				}, DispatcherPriority.SystemIdle);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}

		private void PaneToolWindow_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)

				((FrameworkElement)this).Height = double.NaN;
				((FrameworkElement)this).Width = double.NaN;
				((FrameworkElement)((sender is PaneToolWindow) ? sender : null)).SizeChanged -= PaneToolWindow_SizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void _HydraulicPlotsViewModel_RefreshPlotByRunFinished(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RestoreRibbonState(_hpState, runFinished: true);
			_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.RefreshPlotByRunFinished -= _HydraulicPlotsViewModel_RefreshPlotByRunFinished;
		}

		private void RestoreRibbonState(HydraulicPlotsScreenState hpState, bool runFinished)
		{
			if (hpState == null || !((ScreenState)hpState).IsRestoreFromSavedLayout)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (runFinished)
				{
					HydraulicRibbonVM.SetSavedAxisRange(hpState.MinXAxis, hpState.MaxXAxis, hpState.MinYAxis, hpState.MaxYAxis);
					HydraulicRibbonVM.SetSavedAxisScale(hpState.XAxisScale, hpState.YAxisScale);
					HydraulicRibbonVM.IsXAxisOriginAt0 = hpState.IsXAxisOriginAt0;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.IsYAxisOriginAt0 = hpState.IsYAxisOriginAt0;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.Scaling = hpState.Scaling;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.FontType = hpState.FontType;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(hpState.LabelsFont))
					{
						HydraulicRibbonVM.LabelsFont = hpState.LabelsFont;
					}
					HydraulicRibbonVM.LabelsFontSize = hpState.LabelsFontSize;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.IsDrawAllCurves = hpState.IsDrawAllCurves;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.IsShadeEnabled = hpState.IsShadeEnabled;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.IsShadeDiagram = hpState.IsShadeDiagram;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.IsLabelCurves = hpState.IsLabelCurves;
					if (hpState.CurrentStageNumber > 0 && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
					{
						_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage = hpState.CurrentStageNumber;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HydraulicRibbonVM.LiquidBasis = hpState.LiquidBasis;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.VaporBasis = hpState.VaporBasis;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.PackiliquidBasis = hpState.PackiliquidBasis;
					HydraulicRibbonVM.PackingVaporBasis = hpState.PackingVaporBasis;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public override ScreenState SaveState()
		{
			HydraulicPlotsScreenState hydraulicPlotsScreenState = new HydraulicPlotsScreenState();
			if (HydraulicRibbonVM != null)
			{
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.FontType = HydraulicRibbonVM.FontType;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.LabelsFont = HydraulicRibbonVM.LabelsFont;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.LabelsFontSize = HydraulicRibbonVM.LabelsFontSize;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.IsDrawAllCurves = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsDrawAllCurves;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.IsShadeEnabled = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsShadeEnabled;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.IsShadeDiagram = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsShadeDiagram;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.IsLabelCurves = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsLabelCurves;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.Scaling = HydraulicRibbonVM.Scaling;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.LiquidBasis = HydraulicRibbonVM.LiquidBasis;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.VaporBasis = HydraulicRibbonVM.VaporBasis;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.MinXAxis = HydraulicRibbonVM.XMinCol;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.MaxXAxis = HydraulicRibbonVM.XMaxCol;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.MinYAxis = HydraulicRibbonVM.YMinCol;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.MaxYAxis = HydraulicRibbonVM.YMaxCol;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.XAxisScale = HydraulicRibbonVM.XAxisScale;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.YAxisScale = HydraulicRibbonVM.YAxisScale;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.IsXAxisOriginAt0 = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsXAxisOriginAt0;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.IsYAxisOriginAt0 = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsYAxisOriginAt0;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.PackingVaporBasis = HydraulicRibbonVM.PackingVaporBasis;
				hydraulicPlotsScreenState.PackiliquidBasis = HydraulicRibbonVM.PackiliquidBasis;
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
				{
					hydraulicPlotsScreenState.CurrentStageNumber = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage;
				}
			}
			return (ScreenState)(object)hydraulicPlotsScreenState;

		private void HydraulicPlotsScreen_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (loadingGrid.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				double num = e.NewSize.Height - secSpliter.ActualHeight - ((Grid)secSpliter.Parent).RowDefinitions[0].MinHeight;
				((Grid)secSpliter.Parent).RowDefinitions[2].MaxHeight = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				((Grid)secSpliter.Parent).RowDefinitions[2].Height = new GridLength(0.0);
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LegendVisual != null)
			{
				CALegendVisual legendVisual = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LegendVisual;
				if (canvas.Children.Contains((UIElement)(object)legendVisual))
				{
					legendVisual.GraphArea = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, canvas.ActualWidth, canvas.ActualHeight);
				}
				if (((PlotCanvasBase)legendVisual).RenderArea.X + ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Width > canvas.ActualWidth)
				{
					((PlotCanvasBase)legendVisual).RenderArea = new Rect(canvas.ActualWidth - ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Width - 20.0, ((PlotCanvasBase)legendVisual).RenderArea.Y, ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Width, ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Height);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ShowLegendCallback(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as HydraulicPlotsScreen).DoShowLegendCallback((bool)e.NewValue);
		}

		private void DoShowLegendCallback(bool showLenged)
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LegendVisual != null)
			{
				if (showLenged)
				{
					CALegendVisual legendVisual = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LegendVisual;
					canvas.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LegendVisual);
					legendVisual.GraphArea = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, canvas.ActualWidth, canvas.ActualHeight);
					((PlotCanvasBase)legendVisual).RenderArea = new Rect(canvas.ActualWidth - ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Width - 20.0, 20.0, ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Width, ((FrameworkElement)(object)legendVisual).Height);
				}
				else
				{
					canvas.Children.Remove((UIElement)(object)_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LegendVisual);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Keyboard.Modifiers.HasFlag(ModifierKeys.Control))
			{
				if (e.Delta > 0)
				{
					((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom = ((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom * 1.25;
				}
				else
				{
					((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom = ((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom * 0.8;
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnPreviewMouseWheel(e);
		}

		protected void ApplyZoomFactor(double zoomFactor)
		{
			if (!(canvas.LayoutTransform is ScaleTransform scaleTransform))
			{
				canvas.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(zoomFactor, zoomFactor);
				return;
			}
			double scaleX = (scaleTransform.ScaleY = zoomFactor);
			scaleTransform.ScaleX = scaleX;
		}

		protected override void OnZoomChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			ApplyZoomFactor(newValue);
			((ScreenContentControl)this).OnZoomChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

	{

			_YMin = ymin;

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{

			{
				return false;

			if (!XMin.Equals(axesOptions.XMin))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!YMin.Equals(axesOptions.YMin))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!YMax.Equals(axesOptions.YMax))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

			double obj = 0.0;
			if (!XMax.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!XMin.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!YMin.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!YMax.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		private string GetFormatDisplayValue(double val, int qtint)
		{

			if (num == 1E+35 || num < 0.0)

				return string.Empty;

	public class CACarouselSelector : Selector
	{
		public delegate void OnLeft();

		public delegate void OnRight();

		public bool _BtriggeredSelf;

		public OnLeft onLeft { get; set; }

		public OnRight onRight { get; set; }

		public CACarouselSelector()
		{
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(CACarouselSelector), SimpleStabilityDiagram.ClickEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(SDButton_Click));
			base.KeyDown += CACarouselSelector_KeyDown;
			base.KeyUp += CACarouselSelector_KeyUp;
			onLeft = delegate
			{
				CACarouselViewModel cACarouselViewModel = base.DataContext as CACarouselViewModel;
				if (cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV != cACarouselViewModel.CarouselItemViewModelCollection.First())
				{
					cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV = cACarouselViewModel.CarouselItemViewModelCollection[cACarouselViewModel.GetIndexOfSelectedItemSV() - 1];
				}
			};
			onRight = delegate
			{
				CACarouselViewModel cACarouselViewModel = base.DataContext as CACarouselViewModel;
				if (cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV != cACarouselViewModel.CarouselItemViewModelCollection.Last())
				{
					cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV = cACarouselViewModel.CarouselItemViewModelCollection[cACarouselViewModel.GetIndexOfSelectedItemSV() + 1];
				}
			};
		}

		private void CACarouselSelector_KeyUp(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void CACarouselSelector_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.F1)
			{
				e.Handled = false;
				return;
			}
			e.Handled = true;
			if (e.Key == Key.Left && onLeft != null)
			{
				if (base.SelectedIndex > 0)
				{
					base.SelectedIndex--;
				}
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Right && onRight != null && base.SelectedIndex < base.Items.Count - 1)
			{
				base.SelectedIndex++;
			}
		}

		private static void SDButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SimpleStabilityDiagram simpleStabilityDiagram = e.OriginalSource as SimpleStabilityDiagram;
			CACarouselSelector cACarouselSelector = sender as CACarouselSelector;
			if (cACarouselSelector.DataContext is CACarouselViewModel cACarouselViewModel && cACarouselSelector != null && simpleStabilityDiagram.DataContext is CarouselItemViewModel carouselItemViewModel && cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV != null && cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV.StageNumber != carouselItemViewModel.StageNumber)
			{
				cACarouselSelector._BtriggeredSelf = true;
				if (cACarouselSelector.Name == "selectorPlotsWarnings")
				{
					cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSVWarning = simpleStabilityDiagram.DataContext as CarouselItemViewModel;
				}
				else
				{
					cACarouselViewModel.SelectedItemSV = simpleStabilityDiagram.DataContext as CarouselItemViewModel;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (CarouselItemViewModel removedItem in e.RemovedItems)
			{
				removedItem.IsChecked = false;
			}
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			if (!_BtriggeredSelf)
			{
				ScrollToItem();
			}
			_BtriggeredSelf = false;
		}

		private void ScrollToItem()
		{
			ScrollViewer parentScrollViewer = GetParentScrollViewer(this);
			CACarouselViewModel cACarouselViewModel = base.DataContext as CACarouselViewModel;
			if (parentScrollViewer != null && cACarouselViewModel != null && cACarouselViewModel.HydraulicPlotsData != null)
			{
				int num = cACarouselViewModel.GetIndexOfSelectedItemSV() - 2;
				if (base.Name == "selectorPlotsWarnings")
				{
					num = cACarouselViewModel.GetIndexOfSelectedItemSVWarning() - 2;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					double offset = cACarouselViewModel.SimpSDSizeTotal * (double)num;
					parentScrollViewer.ScrollToHome();
					parentScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(offset);
				}
				else
				{
					parentScrollViewer.ScrollToHome();
				}
			}
		}

		private ScrollViewer GetParentScrollViewer(DependencyObject component)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(component);
			if (parent is ScrollViewer)
			{
				return parent as ScrollViewer;
			}
			return GetParentScrollViewer(parent);
		}
	}
	public class CACarouselViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged, IColumnPerformancePlot
	{
		private HydraulicPlotsViewData _HydraulicPlotsData;

		private string _sOptKey;

		private IColumnAnalyzerModel iCAModel;

		internal static double SimpSDMarginSize = 3.0;

		internal static double SimpSDSize = 130.0;

		private double _ScrollViewWidth = double.NaN;

		protected ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData _RibbonData;

		private ObservableCollection<CarouselItemViewModel> _CarouselItemViewModelCollection = new ObservableCollection<CarouselItemViewModel>();

		private CarouselItemViewModel _SelectedItemSV;

		private ObservableCollection<CarouselItemViewModel> _WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection = new ObservableCollection<CarouselItemViewModel>();

		private CarouselItemViewModel _SelectedItemSVWarning;

		public HydraulicPlotsViewData HydraulicPlotsData => _HydraulicPlotsData;

		public double SimpSDSizeTotal => SimpSDSize + SimpSDMarginSize * 2.0;

		public double ScrollViewWidth => _ScrollViewWidth;

		public double ScrollViewPanelWidth
		{
			set
			{
				_ScrollViewWidth = value - 60.0;
				OnPropertyChanged("ScrollViewWidth");
			}
		}

		public double ScrollViewHeight => SimpSDSizeTotal + 35.0;

		public double CarouseViewMinHeight => ScrollViewHeight + 5.0;

		public double CarouseViewMinWidth => SimpSDSizeTotal * 5.0 + 30.0;

		internal ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData RibbonData => _RibbonData;

		public ObservableCollection<CarouselItemViewModel> CarouselItemViewModelCollection
		{
			get
			{
				return _CarouselItemViewModelCollection;
			}
			set
			{
				_CarouselItemViewModelCollection = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("CarouselItemViewModelCollection");
			}
		}

		public CarouselItemViewModel SelectedItemSV
		{
			get
			{
				return _SelectedItemSV;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_SelectedItemSV != value)
				{
					_SelectedItemSV = value;
					_SelectedItemSV.IsChecked = true;
					_HydraulicPlotsData.CurrentStage = _SelectedItemSV.StageNumber;
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectedItemSV");
				}
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<CarouselItemViewModel> WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection
		{
			get
			{
				return _WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection;
			}
			set
			{
				_WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection");
			}
		}

		public CarouselItemViewModel SelectedItemSVWarning
		{
			get
			{
				return _SelectedItemSVWarning;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_SelectedItemSVWarning != value)
				{
					_SelectedItemSVWarning = value;
					if (_SelectedItemSVWarning != null)
					{
						_SelectedItemSVWarning.IsChecked = true;
						_HydraulicPlotsData.CurrentStage = _SelectedItemSVWarning.StageNumber;
					}
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectedItemSVWarning");
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public CACarouselViewModel(IUnityContainer container, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsdata, string sOptkey)
		{
			_RibbonData = new ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData(this);
			_sOptKey = sOptkey;
			if (hydraulicPlotsdata == null || hydraulicPlotsdata.SectionsRange == null || hydraulicPlotsdata.SectionsRange.Count == 0 || container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			iCAModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			_HydraulicPlotsData = hydraulicPlotsdata;
			_HydraulicPlotsData.RefreshEvent += HydraulicPlotsData_RefreshEvent;
			_HydraulicPlotsData.CurrentStageChangedEvent += HydraulicPlotsData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
			CarouselItemViewModel carouselItemViewModel = null;
			foreach (CAStageForPlot item in _HydraulicPlotsData.StagesForPlot)
			{
				CarouselItemViewModel carouselItemViewModel2 = new CarouselItemViewModel(container, item.StageNumber, item.SectionInfo, hydraulicPlotsdata, _sOptKey, _RibbonData);
				_CarouselItemViewModelCollection.Add(carouselItemViewModel2);
				if (hydraulicPlotsdata.CurrentStage == item.StageNumber)
				{
					carouselItemViewModel = carouselItemViewModel2;
				}
			}
			if (carouselItemViewModel != null)
			{
				SelectedItemSV = carouselItemViewModel;
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedItemSV = _CarouselItemViewModelCollection[0];
			}
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsData_RefreshEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoSomeRefresh();
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsData_CurrentStageChangedEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoSomeRefresh();
		}

		private void DoSomeRefresh()
		{
			if (_SelectedItemSV != null && _HydraulicPlotsData != null && _SelectedItemSV.StageNumber == _HydraulicPlotsData.CurrentStage)
			{
				_SelectedItemSVWarning = null;
				if (WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection.IndexOf(_SelectedItemSV) != -1)
				{
					_SelectedItemSVWarning = _SelectedItemSV;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("SelectedItemSVWarning");
				return;
			}
			foreach (CarouselItemViewModel item in CarouselItemViewModelCollection)
			{
				if (item.StageNumber == _HydraulicPlotsData.CurrentStage)
				{
					_SelectedItemSV = item;
					_SelectedItemSV.IsChecked = true;
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectedItemSV");
					_SelectedItemSVWarning = null;
					if (WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection.IndexOf(_SelectedItemSV) != -1)
					{
						_SelectedItemSVWarning = _SelectedItemSV;
					}
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectedItemSVWarning");
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public int GetIndexOfSelectedItemSVWarning()
		{
			return WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection.IndexOf(SelectedItemSVWarning);
		}

		public int GetIndexOfSelectedItemSV()
		{
			return CarouselItemViewModelCollection.IndexOf(SelectedItemSV);
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionResultDataBase> sectionsResultDatum in _HydraulicPlotsData.SectionsResultData)
			{
				int value = sectionsResultDatum.Value.StartStageNumber.Value;
				int value2 = sectionsResultDatum.Value.EndtStageNumber.Value;
				foreach (CarouselItemViewModel item in _CarouselItemViewModelCollection)
				{
					if (item.StageNumber < value || item.StageNumber > value2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<CAMessage> sectionMessages = iCAModel.GetSectionMessages(item.OptionKey, item.SectionKey);
					if (sectionMessages != null)
					{
						List<CAMessage> list = new List<CAMessage>();
						foreach (CAMessage item2 in sectionMessages)
						{
							if (item2.StageNumber == item.StageNumber)
							{
								list.Add(item2);
							}
						}
						item.Messages = list;
					}
					item.Refresh();
				}
			}
			WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection.Clear();
			foreach (CarouselItemViewModel item3 in _CarouselItemViewModelCollection)
			{
				if (item3.OperatingStatus != OperatingStatus.Normal)
				{
					WarningCarouselItemViewModelCollection.Add(item3);
				}
			}
			if (_SelectedItemSV != null && _SelectedItemSV.StageNumber == _HydraulicPlotsData.CurrentStage && !_SelectedItemSV.IsChecked)
			{
				_SelectedItemSV.IsChecked = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{

	public class CALegendVisual : PlotCanvasBase
	{
		private bool _mouseCaptured;

		private bool _isDragging;

		private System.Windows.Point _mousePos;

		private LinearGradientBrush _backGroudBrush;

		public bool IsFloating { get; set; }

		public Rect GraphArea { get; set; }

		public CALegendVisual()
		{
			((UIElement)this).MouseEnter += LegendVisual_MouseEnter;
			((UIElement)this).MouseLeave += LegendVisual_MouseLeave;
			((UIElement)this).MouseLeftButtonDown += LegendVisual_MouseLeftButtonDown;
			((UIElement)this).MouseLeftButtonUp += LegendVisual_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			((UIElement)this).MouseMove += LegendVisual_MouseMove;
			_backGroudBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(new GradientStopCollection
			{
				new GradientStop((System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#10FFD27F"), 1.0),
				new GradientStop((System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3e3e3b00"), 0.9),
				new GradientStop((System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3e3e3b00"), 0.1),
				new GradientStop((System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#4e3e3b23"), 0.0)
			}, new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0));
			((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)this).Background = _backGroudBrush;
		}

		private void LegendVisual_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsFloating && _isDragging)
			{
				if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
				{
					System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(((FrameworkElement)this).Parent as UIElement);
					double x = Math.Min(Math.Max(GraphArea.Left, ((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea.Left + position.X - _mousePos.X), GraphArea.Right - ((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea.Width);
					double y = Math.Min(Math.Max(GraphArea.Top, ((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea.Top + position.Y - _mousePos.Y), GraphArea.Bottom - ((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea.Height);
					((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea = new Rect(x, y, ((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea.Width, ((PlotCanvasBase)this).RenderArea.Height);
					_mousePos = position;
				}
				else
				{
					_isDragging = false;
					((UIElement)this).ReleaseMouseCapture();
					_mouseCaptured = false;
					((FrameworkElement)this).Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LegendVisual_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsFloating && _isDragging)
			{
				_isDragging = false;
				((UIElement)this).ReleaseMouseCapture();
				_mouseCaptured = false;
				((FrameworkElement)this).Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void LegendVisual_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsFloating)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).Cursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollAll;
				_mouseCaptured = ((UIElement)this).CaptureMouse();
				_isDragging = true;
				_mousePos = e.GetPosition(((FrameworkElement)this).Parent as UIElement);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void LegendVisual_MouseLeave(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsFloating)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)this).Background = _backGroudBrush;
			}
		}

		private void LegendVisual_MouseEnter(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsFloating)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)this).Background = AspenCommonResources.Instance.AspenMouseOverOverlayBrush;
			}
		}
	}

	public class DiagramHelper
	{
		public static System.Drawing.Image GetImageRenderTargetBitmap(RenderTargetBitmap renderImage)
		{
			BmpBitmapEncoder bmpBitmapEncoder = new BmpBitmapEncoder();
			bmpBitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderImage));
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			bmpBitmapEncoder.Save(memoryStream);
			Bitmap result = new Bitmap(memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Close();
			memoryStream.Dispose();
			return result;
		}

		public static RenderTargetBitmap GetSelfBitMapSource(object source, TextBlock txb)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 96.0;
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = source as RenderTargetBitmap;
			if (renderTargetBitmap == null)
			{
				if (!(source is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = 8.0;
				num2 = PresentationSource.FromVisual(txb).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.M11 * 96.0;
				System.Windows.Size renderSize = frameworkElement.RenderSize;
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
				{
					Width = renderSize.Width,
					Height = renderSize.Height,
					Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White
				};
				rectangle.Measure(renderSize);
				rectangle.Arrange(new Rect(renderSize));
				renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)renderSize.Width, (int)renderSize.Height, num2, num2, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
				frameworkElement.Measure(renderSize);
				frameworkElement.Arrange(new Rect(renderSize));
				renderTargetBitmap.Render(rectangle);
				renderTargetBitmap.Render(frameworkElement);
			}
			double num3 = renderTargetBitmap.Width;
			double height = renderTargetBitmap.Height;
			double num4 = 4.0;
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
			{
				Typeface typeface = new Typeface(txb.FontFamily, txb.FontStyle, txb.FontWeight, txb.FontStretch);
				string[] array = txb.Text.Split('\n');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(array[i].Trim('\r'), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, txb.FlowDirection, typeface, txb.FontSize, txb.Foreground);
					drawingContext.DrawText(formattedText, new System.Windows.Point(Math.Abs(num3 / 2.0 - formattedText.Width / 2.0), num4));
					num4 += formattedText.Height;
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, formattedText.Width + Math.Abs(num3 / 2.0 - formattedText.Width / 2.0));
				}
				drawingContext.DrawImage(renderTargetBitmap, new Rect(num3 / 2.0 - renderTargetBitmap.Width / 2.0, num4 + num, renderTargetBitmap.Width, height));
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(num3, height + num4 + num);
			System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle2 = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
			{
				Width = size.Width,
				Height = size.Height,
				Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White
			};
			rectangle2.Measure(size);
			rectangle2.Arrange(new Rect(size));
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap2 = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height, num2, num2, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
			renderTargetBitmap2.Render(rectangle2);
			renderTargetBitmap2.Render(drawingVisual);
			return renderTargetBitmap2;
		}

		public static void CopyDiagramToClipboard(FrameworkElement UI)
		{
			if (UI != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size renderSize = UI.RenderSize;
				double num = PresentationSource.FromVisual(UI).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.M11 * 96.0;
				RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)renderSize.Width, (int)renderSize.Height, num, num, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
				{
					Width = renderSize.Width,
					Height = renderSize.Height,
					Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White
				};
				rectangle.Measure(renderSize);
				rectangle.Arrange(new Rect(renderSize));
				renderTargetBitmap.Render(rectangle);
				UI.Measure(renderSize);
				UI.Arrange(new Rect(renderSize));
				renderTargetBitmap.Render(UI);
				System.Windows.Clipboard.SetImage(renderTargetBitmap);
			}
		}
	}

		{

		private void UpdateDowncomerLoadBarChart()
		{
			if (!(base.DataContext is DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel { Graph: not null } downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel) || ((ICollection<IDataSeries>)downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.Graph.DataSeriesCollection).Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ViewModel = downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel;
			if (downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.Graph != null && (downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.StageType == StageType.TrayRating || downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.StageType == StageType.TraySizing))
			{
				if (base.ActualWidth > 0.0)
				{
					downcomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateAnnotationPosition(190.0 / base.ActualWidth, 190.0 / base.ActualHeight);
				}
				if (_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.Plot.Frames.Count < 1)
				{
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.Plot.CreateFrame(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), DowncomerLoadBarChart.GraphLayout);
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.DragMode = (MouseDragMode)1;
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.PlotBorder = 0.0;
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.ContextMenuItems = (ContextMenuItems)3;
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.GraphZoom += Plot_GraphZoom;
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.GetContextActions += Plot_GetContextActions;
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.TrackMode = (MouseTrackMode)1;
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.PointTrack += DowncomerLoadingPlotCtrl_PointTrack;
				}
				else
				{
					_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.Plot.Frames[0].GraphLayout = DowncomerLoadBarChart.GraphLayout;
				}
				_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.Refresh();
			}
		}

		private void Plot_GetContextActions(object sender, GetActionsEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions).Count; i++)
			{
				ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i];
				if (val.Id == "copy" && val.Subitems != null && ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems).Count > 0)
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val2 = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems)[0];
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HeaderCopyPlot, val2.Id, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)CopyPlot);
				}
				if (val.Id == "print" && val.Subitems != null && ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems).Count > 0)
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val3 = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems)[0];
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HeaderPrintPlot, val3.Id, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)printPlot);
				}
			}
		}

		private void printPlot(object sender, DoActionEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog printDialog = new System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog();
			bool? flag = printDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				RenderTargetBitmap selfBitMapSource = DiagramHelper.GetSelfBitMapSource(_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.RenderPlotToBitmap((int)((FrameworkElement)(object)_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualWidth, (int)((FrameworkElement)(object)_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualHeight), _currentStageTextBlock);
				if (selfBitMapSource != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Controls.Image visual = new System.Windows.Controls.Image
					{
						Source = selfBitMapSource,
						Width = base.ActualWidth,
						Height = base.ActualHeight
					};
					printDialog.PrintVisual(visual, ViewModel.Title);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CopyPlot(object sender, DoActionEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			double actualWidth = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualWidth;
			double actualHeight = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualHeight;
			RenderTargetBitmap selfBitMapSource = DiagramHelper.GetSelfBitMapSource(_downcomerLoadingPlotCtrl.RenderPlotToBitmap((int)actualWidth, (int)actualHeight), _currentStageTextBlock);
			if (selfBitMapSource != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Clipboard.SetImage(selfBitMapSource);
			}
		}

		public void OnClosed()
		{
			if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_hydraulicPlotsViewData.RefreshEvent -= HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent;
				_hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent -= HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
			}
		}

		private void PlotGraph()
		{
			TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.GetSecResultOfCurrentStage() as TraySectionResultData;
			_stageType = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType;
			if ((_stageType == StageType.TrayRating || _stageType == StageType.TraySizing) && traySectionResultData != null)
			{
				if (traySectionResultData.IsMDTray)
				{
					Plot(traySectionResultData, new string[3]
					{
						Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Longest,
						Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Median,
						Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Shortest
					});
				}
				else if (traySectionResultData.IsCustomTray)
				{
					Plot(traySectionResultData, new string[1] { Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Average });
				}
				else
				{
					Plot(traySectionResultData, new string[3]
					{
						Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Side,
						Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Center,
						Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Off_Center
					});
				}
			}
			else if (_stageType == StageType.None)
			{
				StatusTextBlockVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				StatusText = $"{Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Stage} {_hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage.ToString()} {Resources.ColumnAnalysisReport_NotIncludesInAnySectionsNoData}";
				PlotCtrlVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				PlotCtrlVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void Plot(TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData)
		{
		}

		private void Plot(TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData, string[] labelsArray)
		{
			//IL_0325: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
