		private void PlotVerticalBar(Graph graph, List<double> data, List<double> percentage, List<string> labels)
		{
			tooltipDictionary.Clear();
			IGraphAxis axis = graph.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
			IDataSeries obj = graph.NewDataSeries();
			obj.LineWidth = 1.0;
			obj.FillBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.CornflowerBlue);
			obj.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotSeriesVisualElements)4, true);
			obj.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotSeriesVisualElements)16, false);
			IPlotDataSource dataSource = obj.DataSource;
			IPlotDataStore val = (IPlotDataStore)(object)((dataSource is IPlotDataStore) ? dataSource : null);
			val.DataSourceType = (PlotDataSourceType)2;
			val.AddPoint((object)"", (object)0);
			val.AddPoint((object)"", (object)0);
			for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				val.AddPoint((object)labels[i], (object)0);
				val.AddPoint((object)labels[i], (object)data[i]);
				tooltipDictionary["\t= " + labels[i] + "\n\t= " + data[i].ToString(axis.DataLabelFormatString)] = labels[i] + ": " + data[i].ToString(axis.DataLabelFormatString) + Environment.NewLine + "(" + percentage[i].ToString("p") + ")";
			}
			val.AddPoint((object)" ", (object)0);
			val.AddPoint((object)" ", (object)0);
			labels.Insert(0, "");
			labels.Add(" ");
			axis.LabelValues = labels;
		}

		private void GetDowncomerLoadingRange(IDictionary<int, CARealVariable> sourceDic, ref double min, ref double max)
		{
			if (sourceDic == null || sourceDic.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CARealVariable> item in sourceDic)
			{
				double value = item.Value.Value;
				if (!double.IsInfinity(value) && !double.IsNaN(value) && !double.IsNegativeInfinity(value) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(value) && value != 1E+35)
				{
					if (value < min)
					{
						min = value;
					}
					if (value > max)
					{
						max = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetDowncomerLoadingRange(IList<IDataPoint> sourceList, ref double min, ref double max)
		{
			if (sourceList == null || sourceList.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IDataPoint source in sourceList)
			{
				if (double.TryParse(source.Y.ToString(), out var result) && !double.IsInfinity(result) && !double.IsNaN(result) && !double.IsNegativeInfinity(result) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(result) && result != 1E+35)
				{
					if (result < min)
					{
						min = result;
					}
					if (result > max)
					{
						max = result;
					}
				}
			}
		}

	public class HydraulicPlotsRibbonAddin : IShellRibbonAddIn
	{
		private readonly IUnityContainer _unityContainer;

		public static readonly string HydraulicPlotsRibbonTabKey = "HydraulicPlotsRibbonTabKey";

		public HydraulicPlotsRibbonAddin(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			if (unityContainer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unityContainer");
			}
			_unityContainer = unityContainer;
		}

		public void AddContentToRibbon(IShellMainWindow window, XamRibbon ribbon)
		{
			ResolveAddContextualTabGroup<HydraulicPlotsRibbon>(ribbon, HydraulicPlotsRibbonTabKey);
		}

		private void ResolveAddContextualTabGroup<T>(XamRibbon ribbon, string key) where T : ContextualTabGroup
		{
			T val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<T>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			((ContextualTabGroup)val).Key = key;
			((Collection<ContextualTabGroup>)(object)ribbon.ContextualTabGroups).Add((ContextualTabGroup)(object)val);
		}
	}

		public HydraulicPlotsViewModel(IUnityContainer container, HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject screenSubject, SectionView sectionView, SectionViewInfo sectionViewInfo, HydraulicPlotsScreen screen)
		{
			if (container == null || screenSubject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_screen = screen;
			_Container = container;
			_ScreenSubject = screenSubject;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(screenSubject.ColumnOptionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			_ColumnOptionKey = screenSubject.ColumnOptionKey;
			_ColumnKey = screenSubject.ColumnKey;
			((CompositePresentationEvent<CAResultUpdateEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<CAResultUpdateEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<CAResultUpdateEventArgs>)OnCAResultUpdated);
			_ColumnAnalyzerModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) as ColumnAnalyzerModel;
			_ColumnAnalyzerModel.RegisterPlotScreen(_ColumnKey, screenSubject.ColumnOptionKey);
			if (_screen.HpState != null && ((ScreenState)_screen.HpState).IsRestoreFromSavedLayout)
			{
				CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(screenSubject.ColumnOptionKey);
				if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null)
				{
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis = (LiquidBasisEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(LiquidBasisEnum), _screen.HpState.LiquidBasis);
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis = (VapordBasisEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(VapordBasisEnum), _screen.HpState.VaporBasis);
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingLiquidBasis = (PackingLiquidBasisEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(PackingLiquidBasisEnum), _screen.HpState.PackiliquidBasis);
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingVaporBasis = (PackingVapordBasisEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(PackingVapordBasisEnum), _screen.HpState.PackingVaporBasis);
				}
			}
			_ColumnAnalyzerModel.RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent += _ColumnAnalyzerModel_RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent;
			SectionView = sectionView;
			SectionViewInfo = sectionViewInfo;
			InitializeVMData();
			RunAllSectionsForPlot();
			HydraulicRibbonVM = new HydraulicRibbonViewModel(this, screenSubject.ForReport);
		}

		private void _ColumnAnalyzerModel_RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent(RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg args)
		{
			if (args.IsOptionKeyChanged)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.ConfigOptionKey) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.OldConfigOptionKey) && _ColumnKey.Equals(args.OldColumnKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture) && _ColumnOptionKey.Equals(args.OldConfigOptionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
				{
					CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(args.OldConfigOptionKey);
					_ColumnAnalyzerModel.UnRegisterPlotScreen(_ColumnKey, args.OldConfigOptionKey);
					_ColumnOptionKey = args.ConfigOptionKey;
					_ColumnKey = args.ColumnKey;
					_ScreenSubject.ColumnOptionKey = args.ConfigOptionKey;
					_ScreenSubject.ColumnKey = args.ColumnKey;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.PlotScreenHeader))
					{
						ScreenHeader = args.PlotScreenHeader;
						_ScreenSubject.SuggestedScreenTitle = ScreenHeader;
					}
					_ColumnAnalyzerModel.RegisterPlotScreen(args.ColumnKey, args.ConfigOptionKey);
					if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null)
					{
						CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis2 = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(args.ConfigOptionKey);
						cAHydraulicFlowBasis2.SDLiquidBasis = cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis;
						cAHydraulicFlowBasis2.SDVaporBasis = cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis;
						cAHydraulicFlowBasis2.PackingLiquidBasis = cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingLiquidBasis;
						cAHydraulicFlowBasis2.PackingVaporBasis = cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingVaporBasis;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (args.RefreshEnum == CARefreshEnum.GlobalUnitSetChanged)
			{
				RefreshPlotWhenUnitSetChanged();
			}
			else if (args.RefreshEnum == CARefreshEnum.SectionStatusChangeToIncomplete)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.SectionKey) && HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionKeys != null && HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionKeys.Contains(args.SectionKey))
				{
					UpdatePlotWithAllExistingSectionResults(args.ConfigOptionKey);
				}
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.ConfigOptionKey) && _ColumnOptionKey.Equals(args.ConfigOptionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				UpdatePlotWithAllExistingSectionResults(args.ConfigOptionKey);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePlotWithAllExistingSectionResults(string sConfigOptionKey, List<string> overLappedSections = null)
		{
			if (!_ColumnOptionKey.Equals(sConfigOptionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				return;
			}
			ReinitializePlot();
			List<string> list = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSectionsKeys(_ColumnOptionKey) as List<string>;
			if (overLappedSections == null)
			{
				overLappedSections = GetOverLappedSections();
			}
			if (list == null || list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (overLappedSections != null && overLappedSections.Count > 0 && overLappedSections.Contains(list[i]))
				{
					continue;
				}
				CASectionResultDataBase resultData = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetResultData(sConfigOptionKey, list[i]);
				if (resultData != null)
				{
					CAResultUpdateEventArgs e = new CAResultUpdateEventArgs(sConfigOptionKey, list[i], resultData);
					e.IsOld = true;
					e.IsUserSubroutine = false;
					_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdateResultData(e);
					if (e.CAResultData is CAPackingSectionResults)
					{
						_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdatePackingBasis(((CAPackingSectionResults)e.CAResultData).PackingDiagramSectionData, HydraulicRibbonVM.PackingliquidBasisEnum, HydraulicRibbonVM.PackingVaporBasisEnum);
					}
					else
					{
						_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged();
					}
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Refresh(runFinihsedRefresh: true);
				if (_CarouselViewModel != null)
				{
					_CarouselViewModel.Refresh();
				}
				if (this.RefreshPlotByRunFinished != null)
				{
					this.RefreshPlotByRunFinished(this, new EventArgs());
				}
				return;
			}
			if (_DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel != null)
			{
				_DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.RefreshGraph();
			}
			if (_WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel != null)
			{
				_WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel.RefreshGraph();
			}
			if (_SectionViewViewModel != null)
			{
				_SectionViewViewModel.Refresh();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeVMData(IList<CASectionRange> secRange = null)
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(_ColumnOptionKey);
			List<string> list = null;
			try
			{
				list = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsKeys(_ColumnOptionKey) as List<string>;
				if (secRange == null)
				{
					secRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_ColumnOptionKey);
					if (columnInternalsData != null)
					{
						AppendEmptySections(secRange, columnInternalsData.StartStageNumber, columnInternalsData.EndStageNumber);
					}
				}
				InitializeControlData(columnInternalsData, list, secRange);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private bool IsSectionRangeChanged(IList<CASectionRange> previousRanges, IList<CASectionRange> secRange, List<string> deletedSec, List<string> addeddSec)
		{
			if (previousRanges == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			if (secRange.Count != previousRanges.Count)
			{
				result = true;
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < previousRanges.Count; i++)
				{
					if (secRange[i].StartStageNumber != previousRanges[i].StartStageNumber || secRange[i].EndStageNumber != previousRanges[i].EndStageNumber || !secRange[i].SectionKey.Equals(previousRanges[i].SectionKey) || secRange[i].StageType != previousRanges[i].StageType)
					{
						result = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (deletedSec != null && addeddSec != null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				for (int j = 0; j < secRange.Count; j++)
				{
					dictionary.Add(secRange[j].SectionKey, secRange[j].SectionKey);
				}
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				for (int k = 0; k < previousRanges.Count; k++)
				{
					dictionary2.Add(previousRanges[k].SectionKey, previousRanges[k].SectionKey);
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < previousRanges.Count; l++)
				{
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(previousRanges[l].SectionKey))
					{
						deletedSec.Add(previousRanges[l].SectionKey);
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < secRange.Count; m++)
				{
					if (!dictionary2.ContainsKey(secRange[m].SectionKey))
					{
						addeddSec.Add(secRange[m].SectionKey);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void RunAllSectionsForPlot()
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (!ContiansTrayOrPackSection(simulatorCADataProvider))
			{
				Refresh();
				IsHydraulicPlotsScreenEnabled = false;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				IsHydraulicPlotsScreenEnabled = true;
				if (simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(_ColumnOptionKey) == null || _ColumnAnalyzerModel == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsKeys(_ColumnOptionKey) as List<string>;
				if (_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun == null || _AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < _AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Count; i++)
				{
					_ColumnAnalyzerModel.RegisterSection(_ColumnKey, _ColumnOptionKey, _AllSectionsKeysNeedRun[i]);
				}
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				foreach (string item in _AllSectionsKeysNeedRun)
				{
					simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaults(_ColumnOptionKey, item, RunOption.No);
					if (!_ColumnAnalyzerModel.Run(_ColumnOptionKey, item, forceCalcPlot: true))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				foreach (string item2 in list)
				{
					_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Remove(item2);
				}
				_isAllSectionsNeedRun = true;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool ContiansTrayOrPackSection(ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider)
		{
			if (simulatorCADataProvider == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_ColumnOptionKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_ColumnOptionKey);
			if (sectionsRange == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (CASectionRange item in sectionsRange)
			{
				if (item.StageType == StageType.TrayRating || item.StageType == StageType.PackRating || item.StageType == StageType.TraySizing || item.StageType == StageType.PackSizing)
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void UpdateTrayLquidBasis(LiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis)
		{
			if (_ColumnAnalyzerModel != null)
			{
				CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(_ColumnOptionKey);
				if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null && cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis != liquidBasis)
				{
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis = liquidBasis;
					RunAllSectionsForPlot();
				}
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.SetLiquidBasis(liquidBasis);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateTrayVaporBasis(VapordBasisEnum vapordBasis)
		{
			if (_ColumnAnalyzerModel != null)
			{
				CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(_ColumnOptionKey);
				if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null && cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis != vapordBasis)
				{
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis = vapordBasis;
					RunAllSectionsForPlot();
				}
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.SetVaporBasis(vapordBasis);
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePackingLquidBasis(PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis)
		{
			if (_ColumnAnalyzerModel != null)
			{
				CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(_ColumnOptionKey);
				if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null && cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingLiquidBasis != liquidBasis)
				{
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingLiquidBasis = liquidBasis;
				}
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.SetPackingLiquidBasis(liquidBasis))
			{
				Refresh();
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePackingVaporBasis(PackingVapordBasisEnum vapordBasis)
		{
			if (_ColumnAnalyzerModel != null)
			{
				CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = _ColumnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(_ColumnOptionKey);
				if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null && cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingVaporBasis != vapordBasis)
				{
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingVaporBasis = vapordBasis;
				}
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.SetPackingVaporBasis(vapordBasis))
			{
				Refresh();
			}
		}

		private void AppendEmptySections(IList<CASectionRange> secRange, int colStartStage, int colEndStage)
		{
			if (secRange == null || secRange.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			new List<CASectionRange>();
			IList<CASectionRange> list = new List<CASectionRange>();
			for (int i = 0; i < secRange.Count; i++)
			{
				if (secRange[i].EndStageNumber < secRange[i].StartStageNumber || secRange[i].EndStageNumber == 0 || secRange[i].StartStageNumber == 0)
				{
					list.Add(secRange[i]);
				}
			}
			foreach (CASectionRange item in list)
			{
				secRange.Remove(item);
			}
			Dictionary<int, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, bool>();
			for (int j = colStartStage; j <= colEndStage; j++)
			{
				dictionary.Add(j, value: false);
			}
			foreach (CASectionRange item2 in secRange)
			{
				for (int k = item2.StartStageNumber; k <= item2.EndStageNumber; k++)
				{
					dictionary[k] = true;
				}
			}
			int num = 1;
			for (int l = colStartStage; l <= colEndStage; l++)
			{
				if (dictionary[l])
				{
					continue;
				}
				string empty = string.Empty;
				string sectionKey = "Empty" + num;
				num++;
				CASectionRange cASectionRange = new CASectionRange(sectionKey, empty);
				secRange.Add(cASectionRange);
				cASectionRange.StageType = StageType.None;
				cASectionRange.StartStageNumber = l;
				cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = cASectionRange.StartStageNumber;
				for (int m = l + 1; m <= colEndStage; m++)
				{
					if (dictionary[m])
					{
						cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = m - 1;
						l = m;
						break;
					}
					if (m == colEndStage && !dictionary[m])
					{
						cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = m;
						l = m;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeControlData(ColumnInternalsData colOptionData, List<string> sectons, IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange)
		{
			if (sectons != null && sectons.Count != 0 && sectionsRange != null && sectionsRange.Count != 0)
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData == null)
				{
					_HydraulicPlotsViewData = new HydraulicPlotsViewData(_Container, _ColumnOptionKey);
					_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent += _HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
				}
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.ClearResults();
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdateHydraulicPlotsViewData(colOptionData, sectons, sectionsRange, SectionViewInfo, savedCurrentStageNumber);
				UnregisterCompoentsVMEvents();
				if (_ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
				{
					_ = _ColPerformanceDiagramVM.ShowLegned;
					_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.ShowLegned = false;
				}
				ColPerformanceDiagramVM = new PerformanceDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, isReporting: false, _ColumnOptionKey);
				DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel = new DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, isReporting: false);
				WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel = new WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, isReporting: false);
				CarouselViewModel = new CACarouselViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, _ColumnOptionKey);
				SectionViewViewModel = new SectionViewViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, isReporting: false, SectionView);
				if (HydraulicRibbonVM != null)
				{
					HydraulicRibbonVM.Scaling = 0;
					ColPerformanceDiagramVM.RibbonData.IsDrawAllCurves = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsDrawAllCurves;
					ColPerformanceDiagramVM.RibbonData.IsShadeDiagram = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsShadeDiagram;
					ColPerformanceDiagramVM.RibbonData.ShowLabel = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsLabelCurves;
					CarouselViewModel.RibbonData.IsDrawAllCurves = HydraulicRibbonVM.IsDrawAllCurves;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnregisterCompoentsVMEvents()
		{
			if (_ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
			{
				_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.OnClosed();
			}
			if (_DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel != null)
			{
				_DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.OnClosed();
			}
			if (_WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel != null)
			{
				_WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel.OnClosed();
			}
			if (_CarouselViewModel != null)
			{
				_CarouselViewModel.OnClosed();
			}
			if (_SectionViewViewModel != null)
			{
				_SectionViewViewModel.OnClosed();
			}
		}

		private void _HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateLoadingPlotsVisibility();
			savedCurrentStageNumber = _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage;
		}

		private void OnCAResultUpdated(CAResultUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData == null || args == null || !_ColumnOptionKey.Equals(args.ConfigOptionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture) || (!args.IsUserSubroutine && (args.CAResultData == null || (args.CAResultData is TraySectionResultData && !(args.CAResultData as TraySectionResultData).ContainsPlotData))))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsRange != null)
			{
				ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(_ColumnOptionKey);
				IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_ColumnOptionKey);
				AppendEmptySections(sectionsRange, columnInternalsData.StartStageNumber, columnInternalsData.EndStageNumber);
				if (args.IsUserSubroutine)
				{
					foreach (CASectionRange item in sectionsRange)
					{
						if (item.SectionKey.Equals(args.SectionKey))
						{
							if (item.StageType == StageType.TrayRating)
							{
								item.StageType = StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine;
								break;
							}
							if (item.StageType == StageType.TraySizing)
							{
								item.StageType = StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
				bool flag = IsSectionRangeChanged(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsRange.Values.ToList(), sectionsRange, list, list2);
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsResultData != null)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionResultDataBase> sectionsResultDatum in _HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsResultData)
					{
						if (sectionsResultDatum.Value.SectionKey.Equals(args.SectionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							if (args.IsUserSubroutine)
							{
								_ColumnAnalyzerModel.UnregisterSection(_ColumnKey, _ColumnOptionKey, args.SectionKey);
							}
							else if (sectionsResultDatum.Value.StartStageNumber.Value != args.CAResultData.StartStageNumber.Value || sectionsResultDatum.Value.EndtStageNumber.Value != args.CAResultData.EndtStageNumber.Value)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				List<string> overLappedSections = GetOverLappedSections();
				if (overLappedSections != null && overLappedSections.Count > 0 && overLappedSections.Contains(args.SectionKey) && _isAllSectionsNeedRun)
				{
					foreach (string item2 in overLappedSections)
					{
						if (_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Contains(item2))
						{
							_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Remove(item2);
						}
						if (_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Count == 0)
						{
							_isAllSectionsNeedRun = false;
							_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun = null;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				bool flag2 = IsFeedProuductsChanged(_ColumnOptionKey);
				if (flag)
				{
					foreach (string key in list2)
					{
						if (sectionsRange.Where((CASectionRange o) => o.SectionKey.Equals(key, StringComparison.InvariantCulture)).First().StageType != StageType.None)
						{
							_ColumnAnalyzerModel.RegisterSection(_ColumnKey, _ColumnOptionKey, key);
						}
					}
					foreach (string item3 in list)
					{
						_ColumnAnalyzerModel.UnregisterSection(_ColumnKey, _ColumnOptionKey, item3);
					}
					InitializeVMData(sectionsRange);
					UpdatePlotWithAllExistingSectionResults(_ColumnOptionKey, overLappedSections);
				}
				else if (flag2 && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.Feeds != null)
				{
					InitializeVMData(sectionsRange);
					UpdatePlotWithAllExistingSectionResults(_ColumnOptionKey, overLappedSections);
				}
				else if (overLappedSections != null && overLappedSections.Count > 0 && overLappedSections.Contains(args.SectionKey))
				{
					InitializeVMData(sectionsRange);
					UpdatePlotWithAllExistingSectionResults(_ColumnOptionKey, overLappedSections);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateResultData(args);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateResultData(args);
			}
		}

		private bool IsFeedProuductsChanged(string columnKey)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (_Container == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetColumnInternalsData(columnKey);
			if (columnInternalsData != null && columnInternalsData.Feeds != null)
			{
				if (columnInternalsData.Feeds.Count == 0 || columnInternalsData.Feeds.Count != _HydraulicPlotsViewData.Feeds.Count)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < columnInternalsData.Feeds.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!columnInternalsData.Feeds[i].Name.Equals(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.Feeds[i].Name) || !columnInternalsData.Feeds[i].Stage.Equals(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.Feeds[i].Stage))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag && columnInternalsData != null && columnInternalsData.Products != null)
			{
				if (columnInternalsData.Products.Count == 0 || columnInternalsData.Products.Count != _HydraulicPlotsViewData.Products.Count)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < columnInternalsData.Products.Count; j++)
					{
						if (!columnInternalsData.Products[j].Name.Equals(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.Products[j].Name) || !columnInternalsData.Products[j].Stage.Equals(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.Products[j].Stage))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void UpdateResultData(CAResultUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!_ColumnOptionKey.Equals(args.ConfigOptionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCulture) || _HydraulicPlotsViewData == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionKeys == null || !_HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionKeys.Contains(args.SectionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdateResultData(args);
			if (args.CAResultData is CAPackingSectionResults)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdatePackingBasis(((CAPackingSectionResults)args.CAResultData).PackingDiagramSectionData, HydraulicRibbonVM.PackingliquidBasisEnum, HydraulicRibbonVM.PackingVaporBasisEnum);
			}
			else
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged();
			}
			if (_isAllSectionsNeedRun)
			{
				if (_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Contains(args.SectionKey))
				{
					_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Remove(args.SectionKey);
				}
				if (_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun.Count == 0)
				{
					_isAllSectionsNeedRun = false;
					_AllSectionsKeysNeedRun = null;
				}
			}
			if (!_isAllSectionsNeedRun)
			{
				Refresh(runFinihsedRefresh: true);
				if (_CarouselViewModel != null)
				{
					_CarouselViewModel.Refresh();
				}
				if (this.RefreshPlotByRunFinished != null)
				{
					this.RefreshPlotByRunFinished(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		public void RefreshPlotWhenUnitSetChanged()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged())
			{
				if (_ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
				{
					_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.ClearAllPlotOriginalLimitsStored();
				}
				Refresh();
				if (_CarouselViewModel != null)
				{
					_CarouselViewModel.Refresh();
				}
				if (this.RefreshPlotByRunFinished != null)
				{
					this.RefreshPlotByRunFinished(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		private void Refresh(bool runFinihsedRefresh = false)
		{
			if (_ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
			{
				_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.Refresh(runFinihsedRefresh);
				_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.ShowLegned = HydraulicPlotsViewData.ShowHydraulicLegend;
				_DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.RefreshGraph();
				_WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel.RefreshGraph();
				if (_SectionViewViewModel != null)
				{
					_SectionViewViewModel.Refresh();
				}
				UpdateLoadingPlotsVisibility();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLoadingPlotsVisibility()
		{
			if (HydraulicPlotsViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRating || HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizing)
			{
				if (HydraulicPlotsViewData.GetSecResultOfCurrentStage() is TraySectionResultData { IsCustomTray: not false, IsCustomTrayHasDC: false })
				{
					LoadingPlotsVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else
				{
					LoadingPlotsVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				LoadingPlotsVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public void ReinitializePlot()
		{
			InitializeVMData();
		}

		public void UnregisterEvent()
		{
			_ColumnAnalyzerModel.UnRegisterPlotScreen(_ColumnKey, _ColumnOptionKey);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<CAResultUpdateEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<CAResultUpdateEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<CAResultUpdateEventArgs>)OnCAResultUpdated);
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent -= _HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
			}
			UnregisterCompoentsVMEvents();
			_ColumnAnalyzerModel.RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent -= _ColumnAnalyzerModel_RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent;
		}

		private void NotifyPropertyChanged(string info)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(info));
			}
		}

		private List<string> GetOverLappedSections()
		{
			List<CASectionRange> list = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSectionsRange(_ColumnOptionKey) as List<CASectionRange>;
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			if (list == null || list.Count < 2)
			{
				return list2;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (list[i].StartStageNumber == 0 || list[i].EndStageNumber == 0 || list[i].StartStageNumber > list[i].EndStageNumber)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					if (j != i && ((list[i].StartStageNumber <= list[j].StartStageNumber && list[i].EndStageNumber >= list[j].StartStageNumber) || (list[i].StartStageNumber <= list[j].EndStageNumber && list[i].EndStageNumber >= list[j].EndStageNumber)))
					{
						list2.Add(list[i].SectionKey);
					}
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}
	}

				ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (simulatorCADataProvider != null)
				{
					return simulatorCADataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(QuantityTypeVapor);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public string UnitLableLiquid
		{
			get
			{
				ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (simulatorCADataProvider != null)
				{
					return simulatorCADataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(QuantityTypeLiquid);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public string ConfigOptionKey { get; set; }

		internal event EventHandler RefreshEvent;

		internal event EventHandler CurrentStageChangedEvent;

		public CASectionRange GetCASectionRange(int stageNumber)
		{
			CASectionRange result = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionRange> item in SectionsRange)
			{
				if (stageNumber >= item.Value.StartStageNumber && stageNumber <= item.Value.EndStageNumber)
				{
					result = item.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int GetDisplayStageNumber(int stageNumber)
		{
			if (_IsTopDownNumbering)
			{
				return stageNumber;
			}
			return StartStage + EndStage - stageNumber;
		}

		public int GetInternalStageNumber(int stageNumber)
		{
			if (!_IsTopDownNumbering)
			{
				return StartStage + EndStage - stageNumber;
			}
			return stageNumber;
		}

		internal HydraulicPlotsViewData(IUnityContainer container, string sConfigOptionKey)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_Container = container;
			ConfigOptionKey = sConfigOptionKey;
			if (UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) is ColumnAnalyzerModel columnAnalyzerModel)
			{
				CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = columnAnalyzerModel.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(sConfigOptionKey);
				if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis == null)
				{
					cAHydraulicFlowBasis = new CAHydraulicFlowBasis();
				}
				SetLiquidBasis(cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis);
				SetVaporBasis(cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeStageSectionInfo()
		{
			StagesForPlot = new List<CAStageForPlot>();
			for (int i = StartStage; i <= EndStage; i++)
			{
				CAStageForPlot cAStageForPlot = new CAStageForPlot();
				cAStageForPlot.StageNumber = i;
				StagesForPlot.Add(cAStageForPlot);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionRange> item in SectionsRange)
				{
					if (cAStageForPlot.StageNumber >= item.Value.StartStageNumber && cAStageForPlot.StageNumber <= item.Value.EndStageNumber)
					{
						cAStageForPlot.SectionInfo = item.Value;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearResults()
		{
			if (_AllTrayDiagramData != null)
			{
				_AllTrayDiagramData.Clear();
			}
			if (_SectionsResultData != null)
			{
				_SectionsResultData.Clear();
			}
			if (_TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus != null)
			{
				_TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus.Clear();
			}
			if (_SectionsRange != null)
			{
				_SectionsRange.Clear();
			}
			if (Feeds != null)
			{
				Feeds.Clear();
			}
			if (Products != null)
			{
				Products.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateHydraulicPlotsViewData(ColumnInternalsData colOptionData, List<string> sectons, IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange, SectionViewInfo sectionViewInfo, int savedStageNumber)
		{
			if (colOptionData == null || sectons == null || sectons.Count == 0 || sectionsRange == null || sectionsRange.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_SectionNames = sectons;
			_FullColumnName = colOptionData.FullColumnName;
			_IsTopDownNumbering = colOptionData.IsTopDownNumbering;
			_SectionsRange = new Dictionary<string, CASectionRange>();
			foreach (CASectionRange item in sectionsRange)
			{
				_SectionsRange.Add(item.SectionKey, item);
			}
			_StartStage = colOptionData.StartStageNumber;
			if (savedStageNumber >= _StartStage)
			{
				_CurrentStage = savedStageNumber;
			}
			else
			{
				_CurrentStage = _StartStage;
			}
			_Endtage = colOptionData.EndStageNumber;
			SectionViewInfo = sectionViewInfo;
			_feeds = colOptionData.Feeds;
			_products = colOptionData.Products;
			Volatile.Read(ref this.RefreshEvent)?.Invoke(this, new EventArgs());
			InitializeStageSectionInfo();
		}

		internal void UpdateResultData(CAResultUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args.CAResultData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.CAResultData is TraySectionResultData)
			{
				TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = args.CAResultData as TraySectionResultData;
				if (!_SectionNames.Contains(args.SectionKey))
				{
					return;
				}
				_SectionsResultData[args.SectionKey] = traySectionResultData;
				foreach (DiagramTray tray in traySectionResultData.DiagramSectionData.Trays)
				{
					_AllTrayDiagramData[tray.StageNumber] = tray;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, OperatingStatus> item in GetOperatingPointStatus(traySectionResultData.DiagramSectionData))
				{
					_TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[item.Key] = item.Value;
				}
				ConvertDiagramDataValuesToCurrentUnitSet(args.SectionKey);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(args.CAResultData is CAPackingSectionResults))
				{
					return;
				}
				CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = args.CAResultData as CAPackingSectionResults;
				if (!_SectionNames.Contains(args.SectionKey))
				{
					return;
				}
				_SectionsResultData[args.SectionKey] = cAPackingSectionResults;
				foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
				{
					_AllTrayDiagramData[packingStageDiagram.StageNumber] = packingStageDiagram;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, OperatingStatus> item2 in SetPackingOperatingStatus(cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData))
				{
					_TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[item2.Key] = item2.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<int, OperatingStatus> GetOperatingPointStatus(DiagramSectionData diagramSectionData)
		{
			Dictionary<int, OperatingStatus> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, OperatingStatus>();
			foreach (DiagramTray tray in diagramSectionData.Trays)
			{
				dictionary.Add(tray.StageNumber, tray.ReturnData.OperatingStatus);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private Dictionary<int, OperatingStatus> SetPackingOperatingStatus(PackingDiagramSectionData packingDiagramSectionData)
		{
			Dictionary<int, OperatingStatus> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, OperatingStatus>();
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in packingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				dictionary.Add(packingStageDiagram.StageNumber, packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.OperatingStatus);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		internal CASectionResultDataBase GetSecResultOfCurrentStage()
		{
			CASectionResultDataBase result = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionResultDataBase> sectionsResultDatum in _SectionsResultData)
			{
				if (CurrentStage >= sectionsResultDatum.Value.StartStageNumber.Value && CurrentStage <= sectionsResultDatum.Value.EndtStageNumber.Value)
				{
					result = sectionsResultDatum.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void SetLiquidBasis(LiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis)
		{
			QuantityTypeLiquid = VariableHelper.GetLiquidBasis(liquidBasis);
			TrayLiquidBasis = liquidBasis;
		}

		internal void SetVaporBasis(VapordBasisEnum vapordBasis)
		{
			QuantityTypeVapor = VariableHelper.GetVaporBasis(vapordBasis);
			TrayVapordBasis = vapordBasis;
		}

		internal bool SetPackingLiquidBasis(PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis)
		{
			PackingLiquidBasisEnum packingLiquidBasisEnum = VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasisEnum(PackingQuantityTypeLiquid);
			PackingVapordBasisEnum packingVaporBasisEnum = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasisEnum(PackingQuantityTypeVapor);
			bool result = DoConvertPackingBasis(packingLiquidBasisEnum, liquidBasis, packingVaporBasisEnum, packingVaporBasisEnum);
			PackingQuantityTypeLiquid = VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasis(liquidBasis);
			UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged();
			return result;
		}

		internal bool SetPackingVaporBasis(PackingVapordBasisEnum vapordBasis)
		{
			PackingVapordBasisEnum packingVaporBasisEnum = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasisEnum(PackingQuantityTypeVapor);
			PackingLiquidBasisEnum packingLiquidBasisEnum = VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasisEnum(PackingQuantityTypeLiquid);
			bool result = DoConvertPackingBasis(packingLiquidBasisEnum, packingLiquidBasisEnum, packingVaporBasisEnum, vapordBasis);
			PackingQuantityTypeVapor = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasis(vapordBasis);
			UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged();
			return result;
		}

		internal void UpdatePackingBasis(PackingDiagramSectionData dsecdata, PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis, PackingVapordBasisEnum vapordBasis)
		{
			PackingVapordBasisEnum packingVaporBasisEnum = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasisEnum(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass);
			PackingLiquidBasisEnum packingLiquidBasisEnum = VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasisEnum(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass);
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (packingLiquidBasisEnum != liquidBasis || packingVaporBasisEnum != vapordBasis)
			{
				if (dsecdata.LiquidUnit == simulatorCADataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasis(liquidBasis)) && dsecdata.VaporUnit == simulatorCADataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasis(vapordBasis)))
				{
					return;
				}
				ConvertPackingSectionDiagramDataUnitBackToSI(simulatorCADataProvider, dsecdata, VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasis(packingLiquidBasisEnum), VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasis(packingVaporBasisEnum));
			}
			ConvertPackingBasis(simulatorCADataProvider, dsecdata, packingLiquidBasisEnum, liquidBasis, packingVaporBasisEnum, vapordBasis, needConvertToSI: false);
			PackingQuantityTypeVapor = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasis(vapordBasis);
			UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged();
		}

		private void ConvertDiagramDataValuesToCurrentUnitSet(string sectionKey)
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (SectionsResultData == null || SectionsResultData.Count == 0 || simulatorCADataProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionResultDataBase> sectionsResultDatum in SectionsResultData)
			{
				if (sectionsResultDatum.Value.SectionKey.Equals(sectionKey))
				{
					DiagramSectionData diagramSectionData = ((TraySectionResultData)sectionsResultDatum.Value).DiagramSectionData;
					ConvertTraySectionDiagramDataUnit(simulatorCADataProvider, diagramSectionData);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ConvertTraySectionDiagramDataUnit(ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider, DiagramSectionData dsecdata)
		{
			if (dsecdata.LiquidUnit.Equals(UnitLableLiquid) && dsecdata.VaporUnit.Equals(UnitLableVapor))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = 1.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			num = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(QuantityTypeLiquid, 1.0, dsecdata.LiquidUnit, UnitLableLiquid);
			dsecdata.LiquidUnit = UnitLableLiquid;
			num2 = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(QuantityTypeVapor, 1.0, dsecdata.VaporUnit, UnitLableVapor);
			dsecdata.VaporUnit = UnitLableVapor;
			foreach (DiagramTray tray in dsecdata.Trays)
			{
				tray.ConvertValueToCurrentUnitSet(num, num2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ConvertPackingSectionDiagramDataUnit(ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider, PackingDiagramSectionData dsecdata)
		{
			string packPressureDropUnit = PackPressureDropUnit;
			if (dsecdata.LiquidUnit.Equals(PackUnitLableLiquid) && dsecdata.VaporUnit.Equals(PackUnitLableVapor) && dsecdata.PressureDropUnit.Equals(packPressureDropUnit))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = 1.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			double num3 = 1.0;
			num = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(PackingQuantityTypeLiquid, 1.0, dsecdata.LiquidUnit, PackUnitLableLiquid);
			dsecdata.LiquidUnit = PackUnitLableLiquid;
			num2 = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(PackingQuantityTypeVapor, 1.0, dsecdata.VaporUnit, PackUnitLableVapor);
			dsecdata.VaporUnit = PackUnitLableVapor;
			num3 = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.PressureDropDivideHeight, 1.0, dsecdata.PressureDropUnit, packPressureDropUnit);
			dsecdata.PressureDropUnit = packPressureDropUnit;
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in dsecdata.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				packingStageDiagram.ConvertValueToCurrentUnitSet(num, num2, num3);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool UpdatePlotDataWhenUnitChanged()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (SectionsResultData == null || SectionsResultData.Count == 0 || simulatorCADataProvider == null)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionResultDataBase> sectionsResultDatum in SectionsResultData)
			{
				if (sectionsResultDatum.Value is TraySectionResultData)
				{
					DiagramSectionData diagramSectionData = ((TraySectionResultData)sectionsResultDatum.Value).DiagramSectionData;
					bool flag2 = ConvertTraySectionDiagramDataUnit(simulatorCADataProvider, diagramSectionData);
					if (!flag && flag2)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (sectionsResultDatum.Value is CAPackingSectionResults)
				{
					PackingDiagramSectionData packingDiagramSectionData = ((CAPackingSectionResults)sectionsResultDatum.Value).PackingDiagramSectionData;
					bool flag3 = ConvertPackingSectionDiagramDataUnit(simulatorCADataProvider, packingDiagramSectionData);
					if (!flag && flag3)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool DoConvertPackingBasis(PackingLiquidBasisEnum lquidPre, PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidNew, PackingVapordBasisEnum vaporPre, PackingVapordBasisEnum vaporNew)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (SectionsResultData == null || SectionsResultData.Count == 0 || simulatorCADataProvider == null)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CASectionResultDataBase> sectionsResultDatum in SectionsResultData)
			{
				if (sectionsResultDatum.Value is CAPackingSectionResults)
				{
					PackingDiagramSectionData packingDiagramSectionData = ((CAPackingSectionResults)sectionsResultDatum.Value).PackingDiagramSectionData;
					bool flag2 = ConvertPackingBasis(simulatorCADataProvider, packingDiagramSectionData, lquidPre, liquidNew, vaporPre, vaporNew);
					if (!flag && flag2)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool ConvertPackingBasis(ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider, PackingDiagramSectionData dsecdata, PackingLiquidBasisEnum lquidPre, PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidNew, PackingVapordBasisEnum vaporPre, PackingVapordBasisEnum vaporNew, bool needConvertToSI = true)
		{
			if (lquidPre == liquidNew && vaporPre == vaporNew)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (needConvertToSI)
			{
				ConvertPackingSectionDiagramDataUnitBackToSI(simulatorCADataProvider, dsecdata, PackingQuantityTypeLiquid, PackingQuantityTypeVapor);
			}
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in dsecdata.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				double lquidCoef = 1.0;
				double vaporCoef = 1.0;
				if (lquidPre != liquidNew)
				{
					switch (lquidPre)
					{
					case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
						switch (liquidNew)
						{
						case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidVolume:
							lquidCoef = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.CLLiquidSuperficialVelocity:
							lquidCoef = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidVolume:
						switch (liquidNew)
						{
						case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
							lquidCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.CLLiquidSuperficialVelocity:
							lquidCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.CLLiquidSuperficialVelocity:
						switch (liquidNew)
						{
						case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidVolume:
							lquidCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingLiquidBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
							lquidCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (vaporPre != vaporNew)
				{
					switch (vaporPre)
					{
					case PackingVapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
						switch (vaporNew)
						{
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporVolume:
							vaporCoef = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.CsDensityCorrectedVaporSuperficialVelocity:
							vaporCoef = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporArea:
							vaporCoef = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToFsPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporVolume:
						switch (vaporNew)
						{
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.CsDensityCorrectedVaporSuperficialVelocity:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporArea:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToFsPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					case PackingVapordBasisEnum.CsDensityCorrectedVaporSuperficialVelocity:
						switch (vaporNew)
						{
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporVolume:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporArea:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToFsPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporArea:
						switch (vaporNew)
						{
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToFsPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporVolume:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToFsPerAreaCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef;
							break;
						case PackingVapordBasisEnum.CsDensityCorrectedVaporSuperficialVelocity:
							vaporCoef = 1.0 / packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToFsPerAreaCoef * packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef;
							break;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				packingStageDiagram.ConvertValueToCurrentBasis(lquidCoef, vaporCoef);
			}
			QuantityTypeEnum packingVaporBasis = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasis(vaporNew);
			QuantityTypeEnum packingLiquidBasis = VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasis(liquidNew);
			string sIUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(packingLiquidBasis);
			string sIUnit2 = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(packingVaporBasis);
			dsecdata.LiquidUnit = sIUnit;
			dsecdata.VaporUnit = sIUnit2;
			return true;
		}

		private bool ConvertPackingSectionDiagramDataUnitBackToSI(ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider, PackingDiagramSectionData dsecdata, QuantityTypeEnum liquidQuantityType, QuantityTypeEnum vaporQuantityType)
		{
			if (simulatorCADataProvider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string sIUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(liquidQuantityType);
			string sIUnit2 = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(vaporQuantityType);
			string sIUnit3 = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.PressureDropDivideHeight);
			if (dsecdata.LiquidUnit.Equals(sIUnit) && dsecdata.VaporUnit.Equals(sIUnit2) && dsecdata.PressureDropUnit.Equals(sIUnit3))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = 1.0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			double num3 = 1.0;
			num = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(liquidQuantityType, 1.0, dsecdata.LiquidUnit, sIUnit);
			dsecdata.LiquidUnit = sIUnit;
			num2 = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(vaporQuantityType, 1.0, dsecdata.VaporUnit, sIUnit2);
			dsecdata.VaporUnit = sIUnit2;
			num3 = simulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.PressureDropDivideHeight, 1.0, dsecdata.PressureDropUnit, sIUnit3);
			dsecdata.PressureDropUnit = sIUnit3;
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in dsecdata.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				packingStageDiagram.ConvertValueToCurrentUnitSet(num, num2, num3);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class PackingDiagramViewModelBase : PackingDiagramAnalyzer
	{
		protected bool _LabelCurves;

		protected IDataSeries _EnclosedSeries;

		protected PackingPlotReturnData.PackingEnclosedAreaLines _ExclosedData;

		protected List<GraphAnnotation> curveAnnotationList = new List<GraphAnnotation>();

		protected HydraulicPlotsViewData _HydraulicPlotsViewData;

		private void SetLabelPositioin(List<double> valL, PackingLineType lineType, ref int positionPoint)
		{
			switch (lineType)
			{
			case PackingLineType.PressureDrop:
			case PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit:
			case PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit:
			{
				int num = (int)((double)positionPoint * 0.8);
				if (num > 0 && valL[num] - valL[valL.Count - 1] / 10.0 > 0.0)
				{
					positionPoint = num;
				}
				break;
			}
			case PackingLineType.ConstantVL:
				positionPoint = valL.Count - 1;
				break;
			}
			if (lineType != PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity || _ExclosedData.ConstantLine == null || _ExclosedData.ConstantLine.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = valL[0] - valL[valL.Count - 1];
			double num3 = _ExclosedData.ConstantLine.Last().y - valL[0];
			if (!(num3 > valL[0]) || !(num3 < valL[valL.Count - 1]))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num4 = num3 / num2;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			num5 = ((!(num4 < 0.4)) ? (num2 * 0.2 + valL[0]) : (num2 * 0.7 + valL[0]));
			double num6 = num2;
			for (int i = 0; i < valL.Count; i++)
			{
				double num7 = Math.Abs(num5 - valL[i]);
				if (num7 < num6)
				{
					num6 = num7;
					positionPoint = i;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override string GetFormatedValueWithUnit(double value, QuantityTypeEnum qt)
		{
			if (qt == QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				if (value < 0.01 || value > 1000.0)
				{
					return string.Format(" {0} {1} ", value.ToString("e2"), _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackPressureDropUnit);
				}
				return string.Format(" {0} {1} ", value.ToString("f2"), _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackPressureDropUnit);
			}
			return value.ToString("f6");
		}

		private AxesOptions GetMaxAxisValue(bool isAllLines)
		{
			AxesOptions axesOptions = new AxesOptions();
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list3 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list4 = new List<double>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, DiagramBase> allTrayDiagramDatum in _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData)
			{
				if (allTrayDiagramDatum.Value is PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram)
				{
					AxesOptions plotRangeData = GetPlotRangeData(packingStageDiagram, isAllLines);
					list.Add(plotRangeData.XMin);
					list2.Add(plotRangeData.YMin);
					list3.Add(plotRangeData.XMax);
					list4.Add(plotRangeData.YMax);
					AxesOptions axesOptions2 = new AxesOptions();
					axesOptions2.XMin = plotRangeData.XMin * 0.95;
					axesOptions2.YMin = plotRangeData.YMin * 0.95;
					axesOptions2.XMax = plotRangeData.XMax * 1.05;
					axesOptions2.YMax = plotRangeData.YMax * 1.05;
					if (axesOptions2.XMin < 0.0)
					{
						axesOptions2.XMin = 0.0;
					}
					if (axesOptions2.YMin < 0.0)
					{
						axesOptions2.YMin = 0.0;
					}
					_OriginalRange.Add(packingStageDiagram.StageNumber, axesOptions2);
				}
			}
			double num = FoundRangeList(list, toFindMax: true);
			double num2 = FoundRangeList(list2, toFindMax: true);
			double num3 = FoundRangeList(list3, toFindMax: true);
			double num4 = FoundRangeList(list4, toFindMax: true);
			double num5 = (num - num3) * 0.05;
			double num6 = (num2 - num4) * 0.05;
			axesOptions.XMax = num + num5;
			axesOptions.YMax = num2 + num6;
			if (num3 < 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 0.0;
			}
			if (num4 < 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 0.0;
			}
			axesOptions.XMin = num3;
			axesOptions.YMin = num4;
			return axesOptions;
		}

		protected double FoundRangeList(List<double> soure, bool toFindMax)
		{
			return AttpsrHelper.FoundRangeList(soure, 0, soure.Count - 1, toFindMax);
		}

		protected void SetPlotAxis(AxesOptions axesRange, bool isAutoScaling = true)
		{
			if (axesRange != null && !axesRange.IsZero())
			{
				IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
				IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
				axis.ZoomReset();
				axis2.ZoomReset();
				axis.Scaling = (PlotAxisScaling)0;
				axis2.Scaling = (PlotAxisScaling)0;
				if (axis2.AxisAnnotator is LogarithmicAxisAnnotator)
				{
					axis2.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.LogXMin, axesRange.LogXMax, false);
				}
				else
				{
					axis2.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.XMin, axesRange.XMax, false);
				}
				if (axis.AxisAnnotator is LogarithmicAxisAnnotator)
				{
					axis.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.LogYMin, axesRange.LogYMax, false);
				}
				else
				{
					axis.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.YMin, axesRange.YMax, false);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public event EventHandler PlotUpdatedEvent;

		public PackingDiagramViewModel(IUnityContainer container, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewModel, bool isReporting, string columnOptionKey, Graph plotGraph)
			: base(hydraulicPlotsViewModel)
		{

				_PlotGraphSource = plotGraph;
				_LabelCurves = true;
				_ShadeDiagram = true;
				_ColumnOptionKey = columnOptionKey;
			}
		}

		public void Refresh(ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData ribbonData)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (PackingDiagramData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				InitializePlotGraph(bEnclosed: false, empty, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackUnitLableLiquid, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackUnitLableVapor, ribbonData.XAxisScale, ribbonData.YAxisScale);
				base.PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)4, false);
				base.PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)2, true);
				base.PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)1, true);
				base.PlotGraphSource.AxesStyle = (PlotAxesStyle)0;
				UnregistCanvasChangedForLabel();
				_PressureGraphAnnotation.Clear();
				_PressureGraphAnnotationAngle.Clear();
				_isAnnotationSzieChagnedRegisteredForPD = false;
				_ExclosedData = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData.EnclosedAreaLines;
				_plotDataRegion = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData.PlotDataRegionData;
				if (ribbonData.IsDrawAllCurves)
				{
					PlotPackingLines(_ExclosedData, empty, ribbonData.ShowLabel, _plotDataRegion);
				}
				else
				{
					PlotEclosedPackingLines(_ExclosedData, empty, ribbonData.ShowLabel, _plotDataRegion);
				}
				if (this.PlotUpdatedEvent != null)
				{
					this.PlotUpdatedEvent(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void AddLabelAlongCurve(string lableName, PackingLineType linetype, int positionPoint, List<double> valL, List<double> valY)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			GraphAnnotation val = new GraphAnnotation((IGraph)(object)_PlotGraphSource);
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
			textBlock.Text = lableName;
			textBlock.ToolTip = lableName;
			textBlock.IsHitTestVisible = true;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = _plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft - _plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft;
			double num3 = valL[positionPoint];
			double num4 = valY[positionPoint] + 0.045 * num2;
			if (linetype == PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit || linetype == PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit || linetype == PackingLineType.PressureDrop || linetype == PackingLineType.ConstantVL)
			{
				double num5 = 0.001;
				num4 = valY[positionPoint] - num5 * num2;
				textBlock.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
			}
			if (linetype == PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate || linetype == PackingLineType.MaximumLiquidRate || linetype == PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit || linetype == PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit || linetype == PackingLineType.PressureDrop)
			{
				num = GetAngle(lableName, linetype, positionPoint, valL, valY);
				textBlock.Loaded += newLable_Loaded;
				Guid key = Guid.NewGuid();
				if (linetype == PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit || linetype == PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit || linetype == PackingLineType.PressureDrop)
				{
					_PressureGraphAnnotation.Add(key, val);
					_PressureGraphAnnotationAngle.Add(key, num);
				}
			}
			double num6 = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumLiquidFlow - PackingDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumLiquidFlow;
			switch (linetype)
			{
			case PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate:
				num3 = valL[0] - num6 * 0.02;
				break;
			case PackingLineType.MaximumLiquidRate:
				num3 = valL[0] + num6 * 0.02;
				break;
			default:
				if (linetype == PackingLineType.MaximumLiquidRate)
				{
					num3 = 1.04 * Math.Abs(valL[0] - valL[valL.Count - 1]) / 2.0;
				}
				break;
			}
			textBlock.Tag = num;
			val.SetPosition((object)num3, (object)num4, (PlotAxisID)1, (PlotAxisID)4);
			((PlotCanvasBase)val.Content).AddChild((UIElement)textBlock, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			val.ZOrder = (AnnotationZOrder)3;
			val.ContentAnchor = (GraphElementPosition)16;
			val.Visible = true;
			curveAnnotationList.Add(val);
			((ICollection<IGraphAnnotation>)_PlotGraphSource.AnnotationCollection).Add((IGraphAnnotation)(object)val);
		}

		private void newLable_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = sender as TextBlock;
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(textBlock);
			GraphAnnotationVisual val = (GraphAnnotationVisual)(object)((parent is GraphAnnotationVisual) ? parent : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)val).RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
				DependencyObject parent2 = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)(object)val);
				PlotCanvasBase val2 = (PlotCanvasBase)(object)((parent2 is PlotCanvasBase) ? parent2 : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					if (!_isAnnotationSzieChagnedRegisteredForPD)
					{
						((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).SizeChanged += canvaspane_SizeChanged;
						_isAnnotationSzieChagnedRegisteredForPD = true;
					}
					double angle = CalculatePanelAngle(((UIElement)(object)val2).RenderSize, (double)textBlock.Tag);
					((UIElement)(object)val).RenderTransform = new RotateTransform(angle);
				}
			}
			textBlock.Loaded -= newLable_Loaded;
		}

		private void UnregistCanvasChangedForLabel()
		{
			if ((_PlotGraphSource == null && _PressureGraphAnnotation == null) || _PressureGraphAnnotation.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Guid, GraphAnnotation> item in _PressureGraphAnnotation)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(item.Value.Visual);
				PlotCanvasBase val = (PlotCanvasBase)(object)((parent is PlotCanvasBase) ? parent : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val).SizeChanged -= canvaspane_SizeChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private void canvaspane_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Guid, GraphAnnotation> item in _PressureGraphAnnotation)
			{
				if (item.Value.Visual != null && _PressureGraphAnnotationAngle.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					item.Value.Visual.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
					double angle = CalculatePanelAngle(e.NewSize, _PressureGraphAnnotationAngle[item.Key]);
					item.Value.Visual.RenderTransform = new RotateTransform(angle);
				}
			}
		}

		private double CalculatePanelAngle(System.Windows.Size panelSize, double originalAngle)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (originalAngle == -90.0)
			{
				return originalAngle;
			}
			IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
			IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
			double num = 1.0;
			double num2 = axis.DataRange.Maximum.Value - axis.DataRange.Minimum.Value;
			double num3 = axis2.DataRange.Maximum.Value - axis2.DataRange.Minimum.Value;
			if (num3 > 0.0 && num2 > 0.0)
			{
				num = panelSize.Height / num3 / (panelSize.Width / num2);
			}
			return num * originalAngle;
		}

		private double GetAngle(string lableName, PackingLineType linetype, int positionPoint, List<double> valL, List<double> valY)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			double num = 2.0;
			if (linetype == PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate || linetype == PackingLineType.MaximumLiquidRate)
			{
				result = -90.0;
			}
			else
			{
				positionPoint -= 2;
				if (positionPoint < 0)
				{
					positionPoint = 0;
				}
				if (positionPoint < valY.Count - 1)
				{
					int num2 = positionPoint - 2;
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 = 0;
					}
					int num3 = (int)(num * (double)valY.Count / 20.0) - 1;
					if (num3 < 2)
					{
						num3 = 2;
					}
					int num4;
					for (num4 = positionPoint + num3; num4 > valY.Count - 1; num4--)
					{
					}
					if (num4 <= num2)
					{
						num2 -= num3;
						if (num2 < 0)
						{
							num2 = 0;
						}
					}
					if (num4 > num2)
					{
						result = 0.0 - AttpsrHelper.GetAngle(new PairDouble(valL[num4], valY[num4]), new PairDouble(valL[num2], valY[num2]));
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class SimplePackingDiagramViewModel : PackingDiagramViewModelBase
	{
		protected class LineData
		{
			internal List<double> ValL;

			internal List<double> ValY;

			internal PackingLineType LineType;

			internal bool BShowLegend;

			internal bool BShowLabel;

			internal string SpetialLegendName;

			internal LineData(List<double> valL, List<double> valY, PackingLineType lineType, bool bShowLegend, bool bShowLabel, string spetialLegendName)
			{
				ValL = new List<double>();
				ValY = new List<double>();
				foreach (double item in valL)
				{
					ValL.Add(item);
				}
				foreach (double item2 in valY)
				{
					ValY.Add(item2);
				}
				LineType = lineType;
				BShowLegend = bShowLegend;
				BShowLabel = bShowLabel;
				SpetialLegendName = spetialLegendName;
			}
		}

		private int _StageNumber = -1;

		private string _SectionKey = string.Empty;

		private List<LineData> pressureLines = new List<LineData>();

		internal override PackingStageDiagram PackingDiagramData
		{
			get
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData.ContainsKey(_StageNumber))
				{
					return _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[_StageNumber] as PackingStageDiagram;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public SimplePackingDiagramViewModel(IUnityContainer container, Graph graph, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewModel, int stageNumber, string sectinKey)
			: base(hydraulicPlotsViewModel)
		{
			_PlotGraphSource = graph;
			_StageNumber = stageNumber;
			InitGraphData();
		}

		private void InitGraphData()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_PlotGraphSource == null)
			{
				_PlotGraphSource = new Graph();
			}
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)4, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.LegendPosition = (GraphElementPosition)0;
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)2, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)1, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)64, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)32, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)16, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.AxesStyle = (PlotAxesStyle)0;
		}

		public void Refresh(ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (PackingDiagramData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				InitializePlotGraph(bEnclosed: false, empty, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackUnitLableLiquid, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackUnitLableVapor, columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.XAxisScale, columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.YAxisScale);
				_ExclosedData = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData.EnclosedAreaLines;
				PackingPlotReturnData.PlotDataRegion plotDataRegionData = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData.PlotDataRegionData;
				if (columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.IsDrawAllCurves)
				{
					PlotPackingLines(_ExclosedData, empty, bShowLabel: false, plotDataRegionData);
				}
				else
				{
					PlotEclosedPackingLines(_ExclosedData, empty, bShowLabel: false, plotDataRegionData);
				}
				DrawPressureLines();
				AxesOptions plotRangeData = GetPlotRangeData(PackingDiagramData, columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.IsDrawAllCurves);
				SetPlotAxis(plotRangeData);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void PlotLine(List<double> valL, List<double> valY, PackingLineType lineType, bool bShowLegend, bool bShowLabel, string spetialLegendName)
		{
			if (lineType == PackingLineType.PressureDrop || lineType == PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit || lineType == PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit)
			{
				pressureLines.Add(new LineData(valL, valY, lineType, bShowLegend, bShowLabel, spetialLegendName));
			}
			else
			{
				base.PlotLine(valL, valY, lineType, bShowLegend, bShowLabel, spetialLegendName);
			}
		}

		private void DrawPressureLines()
		{
			int num = 5;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			List<LineData> list = new List<LineData>();
			if (pressureLines.Count <= num)
			{
				foreach (LineData pressureLine in pressureLines)
				{
					base.PlotLine(pressureLine.ValL, pressureLine.ValY, pressureLine.LineType, pressureLine.BShowLegend, pressureLine.BShowLabel, pressureLine.SpetialLegendName);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (LineData pressureLine2 in pressureLines)
				{
					if (pressureLine2.LineType == PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit)
					{
						base.PlotLine(pressureLine2.ValL, pressureLine2.ValY, pressureLine2.LineType, pressureLine2.BShowLegend, pressureLine2.BShowLabel, pressureLine2.SpetialLegendName);
						if (!flag)
						{
							num2++;
						}
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (pressureLine2.LineType == PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit)
					{
						base.PlotLine(pressureLine2.ValL, pressureLine2.ValY, pressureLine2.LineType, pressureLine2.BShowLegend, pressureLine2.BShowLabel, pressureLine2.SpetialLegendName);
						num2++;
					}
					if (pressureLine2.LineType == PackingLineType.PressureDrop)
					{
						list.Add(pressureLine2);
					}
				}
				List<LineData> list2 = new List<LineData>();
				if (!flag)
				{
					list2.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
					list.Remove(list[list.Count - 1]);
					num2++;
				}
				int num3 = list.Count / (num - num2);
				int num4 = 0;
				int num5 = 0;
				if (num3 > 1)
				{
					num4 = 1;
					num5 = (int)((double)num3 / 2.0 + 0.6);
				}
				while (num2 < num)
				{
					int num6 = list.Count - 1 - num3 * num4 + num5;
					if (num6 >= 0)
					{
						list2.Add(list[num6]);
					}
					num2++;
					num4++;
				}
				foreach (LineData item in list2)
				{
					base.PlotLine(item.ValL, item.ValY, item.LineType, item.BShowLegend, item.BShowLabel, item.SpetialLegendName);
				}
			}
			pressureLines.Clear();
		}
	}
