		public event EventHandler PlotUpdatedEvent;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public PerformanceDiagramViewModel(IUnityContainer container, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewModel, bool isReporting, string columnOptionKey)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (hydraulicPlotsViewModel == null || container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (container != null)
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo != null)
				{
					_ApplicationType = hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType;
				}
			}
			_PlotGraphSource = new Graph();
			_Container = container;
			_IsReporting = isReporting;
			_ColumnOptionKey = columnOptionKey;
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData = hydraulicPlotsViewModel;
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData.RefreshEvent += HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent;
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent += HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
			System.Windows.Media.FontFamily titleFontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(Settings.Default.FontFamily);
			System.Windows.Media.FontFamily titleFontFamily2 = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(Settings.Default.FontFamily);
			_PlotGraphSource.GraphLayout.TitleFontFamily = titleFontFamily;
			IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
			IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
			axis.TitleFontFamily = titleFontFamily2;
			axis2.TitleFontFamily = titleFontFamily2;
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			Refresh(runFinihsedRefresh: false);
		}

		public void Refresh(bool runFinihsedRefresh = false)
		{
			if (runFinihsedRefresh)
			{
				_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.Clear();
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizing)
			{
				if (PlotVisibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					PlotVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					TextVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				_ = string.Empty;
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.GetSecResultOfCurrentStage() == null)
				{
					SetNoDefinedStageAndPackingStageStatus();
					NotifyPropertyChanged("DisplayStageString");
					return;
				}
				if (_StabilityDiagramViewModel == null)
				{
					_StabilityDiagramViewModel = new StabilityDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, _IsReporting, _ColumnOptionKey, _PlotGraphSource);
					_StabilityDiagramViewModel.PlotUpdatedEvent += PublishPlotUpdatedEvent;
				}
				_StabilityDiagramViewModel.Refresh(RibbonData);
				SetPlotAxis(null);
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackSizing)
			{
				if (PlotVisibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					PlotVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					TextVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				_ = string.Empty;
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackingDiagramData == null)
				{
					SetNoDefinedStageAndPackingStageStatus();
					NotifyPropertyChanged("DisplayStageString");
					return;
				}
				if (_PackingDiagramViewModel == null)
				{
					_PackingDiagramViewModel = new PackingDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, _IsReporting, _ColumnOptionKey, _PlotGraphSource);
					_PackingDiagramViewModel.PlotUpdatedEvent += PublishPlotUpdatedEvent;
				}
				_PackingDiagramViewModel.Refresh(RibbonData);
				SetPlotAxis(null);
			}
			else
			{
				SetNoDefinedStageAndPackingStageStatus();
			}
			_preStageType = _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType;
			NotifyPropertyChanged("DisplayStageString");
			UpdateLegend();
			List<CAMessage> list = new List<CAMessage>();
			List<CAMessage> sectionMessages = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSectionMessages(_ColumnOptionKey, CurrentSectionKey);
			if (sectionMessages == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CAMessage item in sectionMessages)
			{
				if (item.StageNumber == CurrentStage)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			Messages = list;
		}

		private void PublishPlotUpdatedEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PlotUpdatedEvent != null)
			{
				this.PlotUpdatedEvent(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void SetNoDefinedStageAndPackingStageStatus()
		{
			TextVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
			PlotVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.None)
			{
				NoHydroPlotReasonText = string.Format(Resources.NoPlotMessageSDNoStage, CurrentStage.ToString());
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine)
			{
				NoHydroPlotReasonText = Resources.NoPlot_TraySubroutine;
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine)
			{
				NoHydroPlotReasonText = Resources.NoPlot_PackingSubroutine;
			}
		}

		public void SetAxesfontFamily(System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily)
		{
			if (_PlotGraphSource != null)
			{
				IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
				IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
				axis.TitleFontFamily = fontFamily;
				axis2.TitleFontFamily = fontFamily;
				if (this.PlotUpdatedEvent != null)
				{
					this.PlotUpdatedEvent(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		private AxesOptions GetCurrentStageAxesOptions()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizing)
			{
				if (_StabilityDiagramViewModel == null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.GetSecResultOfCurrentStage() != null)
				{
					_StabilityDiagramViewModel = new StabilityDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, _IsReporting, _ColumnOptionKey, _PlotGraphSource);
					_StabilityDiagramViewModel.PlotUpdatedEvent += PublishPlotUpdatedEvent;
				}
			}
			else if ((_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackSizing) && _PackingDiagramViewModel == null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackingDiagramData != null)
			{
				_PackingDiagramViewModel = new PackingDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, _IsReporting, _ColumnOptionKey, _PlotGraphSource);
				_PackingDiagramViewModel.PlotUpdatedEvent += PublishPlotUpdatedEvent;
			}
			if (_PackingDiagramViewModel == null && _StabilityDiagramViewModel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AxesOptions axesOptions = null;
			if (_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.ContainsKey(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage))
			{
				axesOptions = _AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored[_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage];
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackingDiagramData != null && _PackingDiagramViewModel != null)
			{
				axesOptions = _PackingDiagramViewModel.GetPlotRangeData(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackingDiagramData, RibbonData.IsDrawAllCurves);
				_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.Add(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage, axesOptions);
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData != null && _StabilityDiagramViewModel != null)
			{
				axesOptions = _StabilityDiagramViewModel.GetStageAxesOptions(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData, RibbonData.IsDrawAllCurves);
				_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.Add(_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage, axesOptions);
			}
			return axesOptions;
		}

		private AxesOptions GeMaximumStageAxesOptions()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_PackingDiagramViewModel == null && _StabilityDiagramViewModel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AxesOptions axesOptions = null;
			AxesOptions axesOptions2 = new AxesOptions();
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list3 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list4 = new List<double>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, DiagramBase> allTrayDiagramDatum in _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData)
			{
				if (_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.ContainsKey(allTrayDiagramDatum.Key))
				{
					axesOptions = _AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored[allTrayDiagramDatum.Key];
				}
				else if (allTrayDiagramDatum.Value is PackingStageDiagram && _PackingDiagramViewModel != null)
				{
					axesOptions = _PackingDiagramViewModel.GetPlotRangeData(allTrayDiagramDatum.Value as PackingStageDiagram, RibbonData.IsDrawAllCurves);
					_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.Add(allTrayDiagramDatum.Key, axesOptions);
				}
				else if (allTrayDiagramDatum.Value is DiagramTray && _StabilityDiagramViewModel != null)
				{
					axesOptions = _StabilityDiagramViewModel.GetStageAxesOptions(allTrayDiagramDatum.Value as DiagramTray, RibbonData.IsDrawAllCurves);
					_AllPlotOriginalLimitsStored.Add(allTrayDiagramDatum.Key, axesOptions);
				}
				list.Add(axesOptions.XMax);
				list2.Add(axesOptions.YMax);
				list3.Add(axesOptions.XMin);
				list4.Add(axesOptions.YMin);
			}
			double num = FoundRangeList(list, toFindMax: true);
			double num2 = FoundRangeList(list2, toFindMax: true);
			double num3 = FoundRangeList(list3, toFindMax: true);
			double num4 = FoundRangeList(list4, toFindMax: true);
			double num5 = (num - num3) * 0.05;
			double num6 = (num2 - num4) * 0.05;
			axesOptions2.XMax = num + num5;
			axesOptions2.YMax = num2 + num6;
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 0.0;
			}
			if (num4 > 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 0.0;
			}
			axesOptions2.XMin = num3;
			axesOptions2.YMin = num4;
			return axesOptions2;
		}

		private double FoundRangeList(List<double> soure, bool toFindMax)
		{
			return AttpsrHelper.FoundRangeList(soure, 0, soure.Count - 1, toFindMax);
		}

		private void SetPlotAxis(AxesOptions axesRange)
		{
			if (_IsAutoScaling)
			{
				axesRange = CurrentStageAxesDataRange;
			}
			else if (axesRange == null)
			{
				axesRange = RibbonAxesRange;
			}
			if (axesRange != null && !axesRange.IsZero())
			{
				IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
				IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
				axis.ZoomReset();
				axis2.ZoomReset();
				axis.Scaling = (PlotAxisScaling)0;
				axis2.Scaling = (PlotAxisScaling)0;
				if (_IsAutoScaling && _xScale == AxisScale.Log)
				{
					axis2.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.LogXMin, axesRange.LogXMax, false);
				}
				else
				{
					axis2.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.XMin, axesRange.XMax, false);
				}
				if (_IsAutoScaling && _yScale == AxisScale.Log)
				{
					axis.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.LogYMin, axesRange.LogYMax, false);
				}
				else
				{
					axis.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.YMin, axesRange.YMax, false);
				}
			}
			if (this.PlotUpdatedEvent != null)
			{
				this.PlotUpdatedEvent(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private bool CanDoLeftStageCommand(object arg)
		{
			return _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage > _HydraulicPlotsViewData.StartStage;
		}

		private void DoLeftStageCommand(object obj)
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage > _HydraulicPlotsViewData.StartStage)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage--;
			}
		}

		private bool CanDoRightStageCommand(object arg)
		{
			return _HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage < _HydraulicPlotsViewData.EndStage;
		}

		private void DoRightStageCommand(object obj)
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage < _HydraulicPlotsViewData.EndStage)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage++;
			}
		}

		{

		public double GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(CARealVariable sourceVariable)
		{
			if (_simulatorCADataProvider == null)
			{
				_simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
			if (_applicationType == ApplicationType.Uninitialized)
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				_applicationType = hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType;
			}
			return sourceVariable.GetDisplayValue(_simulatorCADataProvider, _applicationType);
		}

		public double YDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo != null && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayEndStage.HasValue && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage.HasValue)
				{
					_yDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayEndStage.Value - _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage.Value + 1;
					SectionViewInfoHasValue = true;
				}
				else if ((_hydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo != null && !_hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayEndStage.HasValue && !_hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage.HasValue) || (_hydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo == null))
				{
					_yDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.EndStage - _hydraulicPlotsViewData.StartStage + 1;
					SectionViewInfoHasValue = false;
				}
				return _yDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage;
			}
			set
			{
				_yDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage = value;
				NotifyPropertyChanged("YDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage");
			}
		}

		public SectionViewViewModel(IUnityContainer container, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewData, bool isReporting, SectionView sectionView)
		{
			_hydraulicPlotsViewData = hydraulicPlotsViewData;
			_container = container;
			IsTopDownOrdering = (_isTopDownOrdering = hydraulicPlotsViewData.IsTopDownNumbering);
			_sectionView = sectionView;
			MaxStagesInOnePage = (int)YDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage;
			UpdateDisplayStages();
			_viewportMargin = 2;
			_hydraulicPlotsViewData.RefreshEvent += HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent;
			_hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent += HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
			UpdateSectionViewImageButtons();
			MinLimitedStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.StartStage;
			MaxLimitedStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.EndStage;
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged("StageOnShow");
		}

		private void SectionViewRibbonVMFontChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		public void OnClosed()
		{
			if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_hydraulicPlotsViewData.RefreshEvent -= HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent;
				_hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent -= HydraulicPlotsViewData_CurrentStageChangedEvent;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDisplayStages()
		{
			if (SectionViewInfoHasValue)
			{
				if (IsTopDownNumbering)
				{
					_displayStartStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage.Value;
					_displayEndStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayEndStage.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					_displayStartStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage.Value;
					_displayEndStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionViewInfo.DisplayEndStage.Value;
				}
			}
			else if (IsTopDownNumbering)
			{
				_displayStartStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.StartStage;
				_displayEndStage = _displayStartStage + MaxStagesInOnePage - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				_displayEndStage = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.EndStage;
				_displayStartStage = _displayEndStage - MaxStagesInOnePage + 1;
			}
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData == null || _hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData == null || _hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData.Count == 0)
			{
				Clear();
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				FillData();
				SectionView._plotCtrl_2D.Refresh();
				SectionView._plotCtrl_2D_Liquid.Refresh();
				FillDataFor3DCtrl();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		private void Clear()
		{
			if (StageStatusDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				StageStatusDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (RectangleDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				RectangleDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (OperationalPointDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				OperationalPointDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (RectangleDataList_Liquid.Count > 0)
			{
				RectangleDataList_Liquid.Clear();
			}
			if (OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Count > 0)
			{
				OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Clear();
			}
			_xMin = 0.0;
			_xMax = 0.0;
			_xMin_Liquid = 0.0;
			_xMax_Liquid = 0.0;
			UpdateXDataRange();
			YDataMax = 0.0;
			YDataMin = 0.0;
			if (StagesForPlot != null)
			{
				StagesForPlot.Clear();
			}
			SectionView._plotCtrl_2D.Refresh();
			SectionView._plotCtrl_2D_Liquid.Refresh();
			ColumnVisualizationControl plotCtrl_3D = SectionView._plotCtrl_3D;
			if (plotCtrl_3D != null)
			{
				plotCtrl_3D.ClearSections();
				plotCtrl_3D.FeedStages.Clear();
				plotCtrl_3D.ProductStages.Clear();
				plotCtrl_3D.NormalStages.Clear();
				plotCtrl_3D.WarningStages.Clear();
				plotCtrl_3D.ErrorStages.Clear();
				plotCtrl_3D.InvalidateUI();
			}
		}

		public void FillData()
		{
			if (RectangleDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				RectangleDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (StageStatusDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				StageStatusDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (OperationalPointDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				OperationalPointDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (RectangleDataList_Liquid.Count > 0)
			{
				RectangleDataList_Liquid.Clear();
			}
			if (OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Count > 0)
			{
				OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Clear();
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			int num5 = 0;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, DiagramBase> allTrayDiagramDatum in _hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData)
			{
				int internalStageNumber = allTrayDiagramDatum.Key;
				OperatingStatus operatingStatus = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[internalStageNumber];
				int displayStageNumber = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.GetDisplayStageNumber(internalStageNumber);
				CAStageForPlot cAStageForPlot = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.StagesForPlot.FirstOrDefault((CAStageForPlot x) => x.StageNumber == internalStageNumber);
				StagesForPlot = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.StagesForPlot;
				StageStatusData item = operatingStatus switch
				{
					OperatingStatus.Normal => new StageStatusData(internalStageNumber, StageStatus.Normal), 
					OperatingStatus.Warning => new StageStatusData(internalStageNumber, StageStatus.Warning), 
					OperatingStatus.Error => new StageStatusData(internalStageNumber, StageStatus.Error), 
					_ => new StageStatusData(internalStageNumber, StageStatus.Normal), 
				};
				StageStatusDataList.Add(item);
				string parentName = cAStageForPlot?.SectionInfo.SectionName;
				if (allTrayDiagramDatum.Value is PackingStageDiagram)
				{
					if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData.IsTopDownNumbering)
					{
						double operationPointY = ((PackingStageDiagram)allTrayDiagramDatum.Value).ReturnData.OperationPointY;
						OperationalPointData item2 = new OperationalPointData(operationPointY, internalStageNumber, parentName);
						OperationalPointDataList.Add(item2);
						double operationPointX = ((PackingStageDiagram)allTrayDiagramDatum.Value).ReturnData.OperationPointX;
						OperationalPointData item3 = new OperationalPointData(operationPointX, internalStageNumber, parentName);
						OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Add(item3);
						if (num5 == 0)
						{
							num = operationPointY;
							num3 = operationPointX;
						}
						if (operationPointY < num)
						{
							num = operationPointY;
						}
						if (operationPointY > num2)
						{
							num2 = operationPointY;
						}
						if (operationPointX < num3)
						{
							num3 = operationPointX;
						}
						if (operationPointX > num4)
						{
							num4 = operationPointX;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						double operationPointY2 = ((PackingStageDiagram)allTrayDiagramDatum.Value).ReturnData.OperationPointY;
						OperationalPointData item4 = new OperationalPointData(operationPointY2, displayStageNumber, parentName);
						OperationalPointDataList.Add(item4);
						double operationPointX2 = ((PackingStageDiagram)allTrayDiagramDatum.Value).ReturnData.OperationPointX;
						OperationalPointData item5 = new OperationalPointData(operationPointX2, displayStageNumber, parentName);
						OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Add(item5);
						if (operationPointY2 < num)
						{
							num = operationPointY2;
						}
						if (operationPointY2 > num2)
						{
							num2 = operationPointY2;
						}
						if (operationPointX2 < num3)
						{
							num3 = operationPointX2;
						}
						if (operationPointX2 > num4)
						{
							num4 = operationPointX2;
						}
					}
					if (((PackingStageDiagram)_hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[internalStageNumber]).ReturnData.UpperVaporLimit.HasValue && ((PackingStageDiagram)_hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[internalStageNumber]).ReturnData.LowerVaporLimit.HasValue)
					{
						double value = ((PackingStageDiagram)_hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[internalStageNumber]).ReturnData.UpperVaporLimit.Value;
						double value2 = ((PackingStageDiagram)_hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[internalStageNumber]).ReturnData.LowerVaporLimit.Value;
						RectangleData item6 = operatingStatus switch
						{
							OperatingStatus.Normal => new RectangleData(value2, value, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Normal, parentName), 
							OperatingStatus.Error => new RectangleData(value2, value, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Error, parentName), 
							OperatingStatus.Warning => new RectangleData(value2, value, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Warning, parentName), 
							_ => new RectangleData(value2, value, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Normal, parentName), 
						};
						RectangleDataList.Add(item6);
						double value3 = ((PackingStageDiagram)_hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[internalStageNumber]).ReturnData.UpperLiquidLimit.Value;
						double value4 = ((PackingStageDiagram)_hydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[internalStageNumber]).ReturnData.LowerLiquidLimit.Value;
						_ = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[internalStageNumber];
						RectangleData item7 = operatingStatus switch
						{
							OperatingStatus.Normal => new RectangleData(value4, value3, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Normal, parentName), 
							OperatingStatus.Error => new RectangleData(value4, value3, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Error, parentName), 
							OperatingStatus.Warning => new RectangleData(value4, value3, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Warning, parentName), 
							_ => new RectangleData(value4, value3, displayStageNumber, StageStatus.Normal, parentName), 
						};
						RectangleDataList_Liquid.Add(item7);
						if (!(value >= 1E+34) && !double.IsInfinity(value) && !double.IsNaN(value) && !(value2 >= 1E+34) && !double.IsInfinity(value2) && !double.IsNaN(value2))
						{
							if (num > value2)
							{
								num = value2;
							}
							if (num2 < value)
							{
								num2 = value;
							}
							if (!(value3 >= 1E+34) && !double.IsInfinity(value3) && !double.IsNaN(value3) && !(value4 >= 1E+34) && !double.IsInfinity(value4) && !double.IsNaN(value4))
							{
								if (num3 > value4)
								{
									num3 = value4;
								}
								if (num4 < value3)
								{
									num4 = value3;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData.IsTopDownNumbering)
					{
						double num6 = ((DiagramTray)allTrayDiagramDatum.Value).ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1];
						OperationalPointData item8 = new OperationalPointData(num6, internalStageNumber, parentName);
						OperationalPointDataList.Add(item8);
						double num7 = ((DiagramTray)allTrayDiagramDatum.Value).ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0];
						OperationalPointData item9 = new OperationalPointData(num7, internalStageNumber, parentName);
						OperationalPointDataList_Liquid.Add(item9);
						if (num5 == 0)
						{
							num = num6;
							num3 = num7;
						}
						if (num6 < num)

		private void FillDataFor3DCtrl()
		{
			ColumnVisualizationControl plotCtrl_3D = SectionView._plotCtrl_3D;
			if (plotCtrl_3D == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			plotCtrl_3D.ClearSections();
			plotCtrl_3D.FeedStages.Clear();
			plotCtrl_3D.ProductStages.Clear();
			plotCtrl_3D.NormalStages.Clear();
			plotCtrl_3D.WarningStages.Clear();
			plotCtrl_3D.ErrorStages.Clear();
			if (HydraulicPlotsViewData != null && HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsRange != null)
			{
				List<Tuple<string, int, int, double>> list = new List<Tuple<string, int, int, double>>();
				foreach (string key in HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsRange.Keys)
				{
					CASectionRange cASectionRange = HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsRange[key];
					double item = 0.0;
					if (HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsResultData.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						CARealVariable diameter = HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsResultData[key].Diameter;
						if (diameter != null)
						{
							item = diameter.Value;
						}
					}
					list.Add(new Tuple<string, int, int, double>(cASectionRange.SectionName, cASectionRange.StartStageNumber, cASectionRange.EndStageNumber, item));
				}
				plotCtrl_3D.AddSections(list);
			}
			foreach (CAStream feed in Feeds)
			{
				if (!plotCtrl_3D.FeedStages.ContainsKey(feed.Stage.Value))
				{
					plotCtrl_3D.FeedStages.Add(feed.Stage.Value, feed.Name.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (CAStream product in Products)
			{
				if (!plotCtrl_3D.ProductStages.ContainsKey(product.Stage.Value))
				{
					plotCtrl_3D.ProductStages.Add(product.Stage.Value, product.Name.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, OperatingStatus> item2 in _hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus)
			{
				switch (item2.Value)
				{
				case OperatingStatus.Normal:
					plotCtrl_3D.NormalStages.Add(item2.Key);
					break;
				case OperatingStatus.Error:
					plotCtrl_3D.ErrorStages.Add(item2.Key);
					break;
				case OperatingStatus.Warning:
					plotCtrl_3D.WarningStages.Add(item2.Key);
					break;
				}
			}
			plotCtrl_3D.InvalidateUI();
		}

		internal static void FindChildren<T>(List<T> results, DependencyObject startNode) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(startNode);
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(startNode, i);
				if (child.GetType().Equals(typeof(T)) || child.GetType().IsSubclassOf(typeof(T)))
				{
					T item = (T)child;
					results.Add(item);
				}
				FindChildren(results, child);
			}
		}

		public void PrintVisualTree(DependencyObject startNode)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(startNode) <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Queue<DependencyObject> queue = new Queue<DependencyObject>();
			queue.Enqueue(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(startNode, 0));
			int num = 1;
			while (queue.Count > 0)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = queue.Dequeue();
				for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(dependencyObject); i++)
				{
					queue.Enqueue(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, i));
					num++;
				}
				dependencyObject.GetType().Equals(typeof(PlotCanvasBase));
			}
		}

		private DependencyObject GetPlotCanvasBaseNode(DependencyObject startNode, double excludedWidth)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(startNode) > 0)
			{
				Queue<DependencyObject> queue = new Queue<DependencyObject>();
				queue.Enqueue(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(startNode, 0));
				int num = 1;
				while (queue.Count > 0)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = queue.Dequeue();
					if (dependencyObject.GetType().Equals(typeof(PlotCanvasBase)) && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(dependencyObject) == 0 && ((FrameworkElement)((dependencyObject is PlotCanvasBase) ? dependencyObject : null)).ActualWidth < excludedWidth)
					{
						return dependencyObject;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(dependencyObject); i++)
					{
						queue.Enqueue(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, i));
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void PrintPlotCanvasBaseNodeActualWidth(DependencyObject startNode)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(startNode) <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Queue<DependencyObject> queue = new Queue<DependencyObject>();
			queue.Enqueue(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(startNode, 0));
			int num = 1;
			while (queue.Count > 0)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = queue.Dequeue();
				dependencyObject.GetType().Equals(typeof(PlotCanvasBase));
				for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(dependencyObject); i++)
				{
					queue.Enqueue(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, i));
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateXDataRange()
		{
			if (_xMax == _xMin)
			{
				XDataMax = _xMax * 1.1;
				XDataMin = _xMin * 0.9;
			}
			else
			{
				XDataMax = _xMax + (_xMax - _xMin) * 0.1;
				double num = _xMin - (_xMax - _xMin) * 0.1;
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				XDataMin = num;
			}
			if (_xMax_Liquid == _xMin_Liquid)
			{
				XDataMax_Liquid = _xMax_Liquid * 1.1;
				XDataMin_Liquid = _xMin_Liquid * 0.9;
				return;
			}
			XDataMax_Liquid = _xMax_Liquid + (_xMax_Liquid - _xMin_Liquid) * 0.1;
			double num2 = _xMin_Liquid - (_xMax_Liquid - _xMin_Liquid) * 0.1;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			XDataMin_Liquid = num2;
		}

		private void UpdateSectionViewImageButtons()
		{
			if (_sectionViewSelectedDiagramIndex == 1 || _sectionViewSelectedDiagramIndex == 2)
			{
				Is2DSectionViewDiagram_Buttons = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				Is2DSectionViewDiagram_Buttons = Visibility.Hidden;
			}
		}

	public class ColumnAxisMapCallback : IAxisMapCallback
	{
		private bool _isUpdownDirection;

		private int _trayNumberTotal;

		public ColumnAxisMapCallback(bool isUpdownDirection, int trayNumberTotal)
		{
			_isUpdownDirection = isUpdownDirection;
			_trayNumberTotal = trayNumberTotal;
		}

		public double AxisLinearMapCallback(IGraphAxis axis, object point, out bool isValid)
		{
			isValid = true;
			double num = double.Parse(point.ToString());
			if (_isUpdownDirection)
			{
				num = (double)_trayNumberTotal - num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public object AxisLinearUnmapCallback(IGraphAxis axis, double point, out bool isValid)
		{
			isValid = true;
			double num = point;
			if (_isUpdownDirection)
			{
				num = (double)_trayNumberTotal - num;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class ColumnAxisLabelCallback : IAxisLabelCallback
	{
		private SectionViewViewModel _sectionViewViewModel;

		public ColumnAxisLabelCallback(SectionViewViewModel sectionViewViewModel)
		{
			_sectionViewViewModel = sectionViewViewModel;
		}

		public void AxisLabelCallback(IGraphAxis axis, object labelValue, ref string labelText, ref object position, ref bool valid)
		{
			double result;
			if (labelValue.ToString().Contains('.'))
			{
				labelText = string.Empty;
			}
			else if (double.TryParse(labelValue.ToString(), out result))
			{
				int num = (int)result;
				if ((double)num == (double)_sectionViewViewModel.ActualStartStage - 0.5)
				{
					labelText = string.Empty;
				}
				else if ((double)num == (double)_sectionViewViewModel.ActualEndStage + 0.5)
				{
					labelText = string.Empty;
				}
				else if (_sectionViewViewModel.IsTopDownOrdering)
				{
					labelText = GetDisplayStageNumber(num).ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetDisplayStageNumber(int stageNumber)
		{
			if (_sectionViewViewModel.IsTopDownNumbering)
			{
				return _sectionViewViewModel.ActualStartStage + _sectionViewViewModel.ActualEndStage - stageNumber;
			}
			return stageNumber;
		}

		public void AxisLabelRangeCallback(IGraphAxis axis, ref object minView, ref object maxView, ref object minExtent, ref object maxExtent, ref int gridLineSteps)
		{
		}
	}

		{
			GetVisiableState();
			ScrollViewer parentScrollViewer = GetParentScrollViewer(this);
			if (parentScrollViewer != null)
			{
				parentScrollViewer.ScrollChanged += ScrollViewerObj_ScrollChanged;
			}
		}

		{
			GetVisiableState();
		}

		private void svButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ClickEvent, this));
		}

		private ScrollViewer GetParentScrollViewer(DependencyObject component)
		{
			if (component == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(component);
			if (parent is ScrollViewer)
			{
				return parent as ScrollViewer;
			}
			return GetParentScrollViewer(parent);
		}

		private void GetVisiableState()
		{
			ScrollViewer parentScrollViewer = GetParentScrollViewer(this);
			if (parentScrollViewer != null)
			{
				Rect rect = TransformToAncestor(parentScrollViewer).TransformBounds(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), base.RenderSize));
				if (Rect.Intersect(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), parentScrollViewer.RenderSize), rect) == Rect.Empty)
				{
					IsInScroolVisiableRegion = false;
				}
				else
				{
					IsInScroolVisiableRegion = true;
				}
			}
		}

				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

				break;
			case 2:

				break;

				break;
			case 4:
				popTooltip = (Popup)target;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		public ImageSource WarningImage
		{
			get
			{
				ImageSource result = null;
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus.ContainsKey(StageNumber))
				{
					if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[StageNumber] == OperatingStatus.Error)
					{
						result = CAImageResources.Error48;

					else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[StageNumber] == OperatingStatus.Warning)

				}

		private bool CanDoTooltip_Command(object arg)
		{
			if (Messages == null || Messages.Count() < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		{

		}

		private void OnCAPopup(CAPopupEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args.OptionKey != _sOptKey || args.SectionKey != _sSectionKey || args.StageNumber != StageNumber)
			{
				TooltipShow = false;
			}
		}

		public CarouselItemViewModel(IUnityContainer container, int stageNumber, CASectionRange secInfor, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsData, string sOptKey, ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData ribbonData)
		{
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (container == null || secInfor == null || hydraulicPlotsData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_container = container;
			_RibbonData = ribbonData;
			_sOptKey = sOptKey;
			_sSectionKey = secInfor.SectionKey;
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData = hydraulicPlotsData;
			if (_container != null)
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo != null)
				{
					_ApplicationType = hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType;
				}
			}
			_PlotGraphSource = new Graph();
			StageNumber = stageNumber;
			SectionName = secInfor.SectionName;
			if (stageNumber == secInfor.StartStageNumber)
			{
				IsStartStage = true;
			}
			else if (stageNumber == secInfor.EndStageNumber)
			{
				IsEndStage = true;
			}
			StageType = secInfor.StageType;
			InitBrush();
		}

		private void InitBrush()
		{
			new TextBlock();
			_BorderVisualBackgroundNone = new ImageBrush(CAImageResources.CarouselNoData);
			_BorderVisualBackgroundSubroutine = new ImageBrush(CAImageResources.CarouselNoData);
		}

		internal void Refresh()
		{
			_BorderVisualBackgroundTray = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
			_IsDataReady = true;
			DispatchUpdateSD(forceUpdate: true);
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus.ContainsKey(StageNumber))
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[StageNumber] == OperatingStatus.Error || _HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[StageNumber] == OperatingStatus.Warning)
				{
					WarningVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					WarningVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				_OperatingStatus = _HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayOperatingPointRegionStatus[StageNumber];
			}
			if (Messages == null || Messages.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CAMessage message in Messages)
			{
				message.UpdateMessage();
			}
		}

		private void DispatchUpdateSD(bool forceUpdate)
		{
			if (!forceUpdate && _BorderVisualBackgroundTray != System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White)
			{
				return;
			}
			forceUpdate = forceUpdate || _PlotView == null || _forceUpdateFailed;
			if (_IsDataReady && _IsInScroolVisiableRegion && forceUpdate)
			{
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdatePlotBrush();
				});
				_forceUpdateFailed = false;
			}
			else if (_IsDataReady && !_IsInScroolVisiableRegion && forceUpdate)
			{
				_forceUpdateFailed = true;
			}
		}

		private string GetStageTypeString()
		{
			switch (StageType)
			{
			case StageType.PackSizing:
			case StageType.PackRating:
			case StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine:
			case StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine:
				return Resources.Carousel_Packing;
			case StageType.TraySizing:
			case StageType.TrayRating:
			case StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine:
			case StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine:
				return Resources.Carousel_Tray;
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePlotBrush()
		{
			if (StageType == StageType.TrayRating || StageType == StageType.PackRating || StageType == StageType.TraySizing || StageType == StageType.PackSizing)
			{
				if (StageType == StageType.TrayRating || StageType == StageType.TraySizing)
				{
					SimpleStabilityDiagramVM.Refresh(_RibbonData);
				}
				else if (StageType == StageType.PackRating || StageType == StageType.PackSizing)
				{
					SimplePackingDiagramViewModelVM.Refresh(_RibbonData);
				}
				if (_PlotView == null)
				{
					CreatePlot();
				}
				_PlotView.Refresh();
				BitmapCacheBrush bitmapCacheBrush = new BitmapCacheBrush((Visual)(object)_PlotView);
				if (StageType == StageType.TrayRating || StageType == StageType.TraySizing)
				{
					_BorderVisualBackgroundTray = bitmapCacheBrush;
				}
				else if (StageType == StageType.PackRating || StageType == StageType.PackSizing)
				{
					_BorderVisualBackgroundPacking = bitmapCacheBrush;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("BorderVisualBackground");
			}
		}

		private void CreatePlot()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			_PlotView = new PlotCtrl();
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)_PlotView).Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)_PlotView).Width = 100.0;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)_PlotView).Height = 100.0;
			IPlot plot = _PlotView.Plot;
			if (plot.Frames.Count > 0)
			{
				plot.DeleteFrame(plot.Frames[0]);
			}
			_PlotView.Plot.CreateFrame(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), _PlotGraphSource.GraphLayout);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	public class EnumTipMsgTypeToImageSourceConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ImageSource imageSource = CAImageResources.GetImageSource("Messages16.ico");
			try
			{
				switch ((MessageType)value)
				{
				case MessageType.Error:
					imageSource = CAImageResources.GetImageSource("StatusError16.ico");
					break;
				case MessageType.Warning:
					imageSource = CAImageResources.GetImageSource("Warning32x32.ico");
					break;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return imageSource;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class ColumnPerformanceDiagram : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private PerformanceDiagramViewModel _VM;

		private PlotCtrl _PlotView;

		internal ColumnPerformanceDiagram stabilityDiagram;

		internal Grid grid;

		internal TextBlock stageNumber;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button legend;

		internal Grid plotGrid;

		internal Popup popTooltip;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public ColumnPerformanceDiagram()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.DataContextChanged += StabilityDiagram_DataContextChanged;
		}

		private void StabilityDiagram_DataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DataContext == null || !(base.DataContext is PerformanceDiagramViewModel))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_VM != null)
			{
				_VM.PlotUpdatedEvent -= VM_PlotUpdatedEvent;
				if (_PlotView != null)
				{
					_PlotView.Plot.ClearFrames();
					if (((UIElement)(object)_PlotView).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
					{
						((UIElement)(object)_PlotView).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
				}
			}
			_VM = base.DataContext as PerformanceDiagramViewModel;
			_VM.PlotUpdatedEvent += VM_PlotUpdatedEvent;
			Plot();
		}

		private void VM_PlotUpdatedEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_VM.PlotGraphSource != null && ((ICollection<IDataSeries>)_VM.PlotGraphSource.DataSeriesCollection).Count > 0)
			{
				if (_PlotView != null && ((UIElement)(object)_PlotView).Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)_PlotView).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (_PlotView == null)
				{
					Plot();
				}
				else if (_PlotView.Plot.Frames == null || _PlotView.Plot.Frames.Count == 0)
				{
					_PlotView.Plot.CreateFrame(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), _VM.PlotGraphSource.GraphLayout);
				}
				else
				{
					_PlotView.Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		public PlotCtrl GetPlot()
		{
			return _PlotView;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Image GetPlotImage(float ratio)
		{
			UpdateLayout();
			return DiagramHelper.GetImageRenderTargetBitmap(_PlotView.RenderPlotToBitmap((int)((FrameworkElement)(object)_PlotView).Width, (int)((FrameworkElement)(object)_PlotView).Height));
		}

		private void plot_GetContextActions(object sender, GetActionsEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			string text = "messages";
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions).Count; i++)
			{
				ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i];
				if (val.Id == "copy" && val.Subitems != null && ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems).Count > 0)
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val2 = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems)[1];
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HeaderCopyPlot, val2.Id, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)CopyPlot);
				}
				if (val.Id == "print" && val.Subitems != null && ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems).Count > 0)
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val3 = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems)[0];
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HeaderPrintPlot, val3.Id, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)printPlot);
				}
				if (((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Id == "resetZoom")
				{
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ResetZoomItem, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Id, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Handler);
				}
				if (((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Id == "scooters")
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val4 = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ScooterItem, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Id, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Handler);
					if (((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems).Count == 4)
					{
						((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val4.Subitems).Add(new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.AddVScooterItem, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[0].Id, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[0].Handler, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[0].Enabled));
						((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val4.Subitems).Add(new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.AddHScooterItem, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[1].Id, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[1].Handler, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[1].Enabled));
						((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val4.Subitems).Add(new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.DeleteSelectedScooterItem, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[2].Id, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[2].Handler, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[2].Enabled));
						((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val4.Subitems).Add(new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.DeleteAllScootersItem, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[3].Id, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[3].Handler, ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i].Subitems)[3].Enabled));
					}
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = val4;
				}
				if (val.Id == text)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> item = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.Plot_RMG_Msg, text, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)Messages_Click, _VM.hasMessages);
				((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions).Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void printPlot(object sender, DoActionEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog printDialog = new System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog();
			bool? flag = printDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				PrintQueue printQueue = printDialog.PrintQueue;
				VisualBrush visualBrush = new VisualBrush(this);
				visualBrush.Stretch = Stretch.Uniform;
				DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
				using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
				{
					drawingContext.DrawRectangle(visualBrush, null, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.RenderSize.Width, base.RenderSize.Height));
				}
				printDialog.PrintVisual(PerformTransform(drawingVisual, printQueue, drawingVisual.ContentBounds.Width, drawingVisual.ContentBounds.Height, Stretch.Uniform), "");
			}
		}

		private static Visual PerformTransform(Visual v, PrintQueue pq, double width, double height, Stretch stretch)
		{
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
			double num = 96.0;
			double num2 = 96.0;
			PrintTicket userPrintTicket = pq.UserPrintTicket;
			double value = userPrintTicket.PageMediaSize.Width.Value;
			double value2 = userPrintTicket.PageMediaSize.Height.Value;
			double num3 = (value - num * 2.0) / width;
			double num4 = (value2 - num2 * 2.0) / height;
			switch (stretch)
			{
			case Stretch.None:
				num3 = 1.0;
				num4 = 1.0;
				break;
			case Stretch.Uniform:
				num3 = (num4 = Math.Min(num3, num4));
				break;
			case Stretch.UniformToFill:
				num3 = (num4 = Math.Max(num3, num4));
				break;
			}
			containerVisual.Children.Add(v);
			containerVisual.Transform = new MatrixTransform(num3, 0.0, 0.0, num4, num, num2);
			return containerVisual;
		}

			}
		}

			if (selfBitMapSource != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Clipboard.SetImage(selfBitMapSource);
			}
		}

		private void Plot()
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_VM.PlotGraphSource != null && ((ICollection<IDataSeries>)_VM.PlotGraphSource.DataSeriesCollection).Count >= 1)
			{
				_PlotView = new PlotCtrl();
				((FrameworkElement)(object)_PlotView).Width = double.NaN;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)_PlotView).Height = double.NaN;
				((UIElement)(object)_PlotView).SnapsToDevicePixels = true;
				plotGrid.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)_PlotView);
				if (_PlotView.Plot.Frames.Count < 1)
				{
					_VM.PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)4, false);
					_VM.PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)2, true);
					_VM.PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)1, true);
					_VM.PlotGraphSource.AxesStyle = (PlotAxesStyle)0;
					_PlotView.Plot.CreateFrame(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), _VM.PlotGraphSource.GraphLayout);
					_PlotView.ContextMenuItems = (ContextMenuItems)23;
					_PlotView.GetContextActions += plot_GetContextActions;
					_PlotView.PointTrack += _PlotView_PointTrack;
				}
				legend.ToolTip = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HP_ShowLegend;
				_PlotView.Refresh();
			}
		}

		}

		public System.Drawing.Image GetPlotImage(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			UpdateLayout();
			RenderTargetBitmap renderImage = _PlotView.RenderPlotToBitmap((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height);
			return GetImageRenderTargetBitmap(renderImage);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Image GetImageRenderTargetBitmap(RenderTargetBitmap renderImage)
		{
			PngBitmapEncoder pngBitmapEncoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
			pngBitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderImage));
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			pngBitmapEncoder.Save(stream);
			return new Bitmap(stream);
		}

		public string LabelsFont
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontType switch
				{
					FontSetType.AxisLabel => _axisLabelsFont, 
					FontSetType.Title => _titleFont, 
					FontSetType.Legend => _legendFont, 
					_ => _axisLabelsFont, 
				};
			}
			set
			{
				System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(value);
				switch (_fontType)
				{
				case FontSetType.AxisLabel:
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.SetAxesfontFamily(fontFamily);
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.SectionViewViewModel.FontFamily = value;
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateFontFamily(value);
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateFontFamily(value);
					_axisLabelsFont = value;
					break;
				case FontSetType.Title:
					_titleFont = value;
					break;
				case FontSetType.Legend:
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.LegendFont = value;
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.UpdateLegend();
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.DowncomerLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateLegendFont(fontFamily);
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateLegendFont(fontFamily);
					_legendFont = value;
					break;
				default:
					_axisLabelsFont = value;
					break;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("LabelsFont");
			}
		}

		public int LabelsFontSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontType switch
				{
					FontSetType.AxisLabel => _axisLabelsFontSize, 
					FontSetType.Title => _titleFontSize, 
					FontSetType.Legend => _legendFontSize, 
					_ => _axisLabelsFontSize, 
				};
			}
			set
			{
				switch (_fontType)
				{
				case FontSetType.AxisLabel:
					_axisLabelsFontSize = value;
					break;
				case FontSetType.Title:
					_titleFontSize = value;
					break;
				case FontSetType.Legend:
					_legendFontSize = value;
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.LegendFontSize = _legendFontSize;
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.UpdateLegend();
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateLegendSize(_legendFontSize);
					break;
				default:
					_axisLabelsFontSize = value;
					break;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("LabelsFontSize");
			}
		}

		public int Scaling
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaling;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == 0)
				{
					if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
					{
						_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.SetIsAutoScaling(null, isAutoScaling: true);
					}
					_scaling = value;
					RefreshData();
				}
				else
				{
					_scaling = value;
					if (IsXAxisOriginAt0 && XAxisScale != 1)
					{
						_XMinCol = 0.0;
						OnPropertyChanged("MinXAxis");
					}
					if (IsYAxisOriginAt0 && YAxisScale != 1)
					{
						_YMinCol = 0.0;
						OnPropertyChanged("MinYAxis");
					}
					if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
					{
						AxesOptions axesRange = new AxesOptions(_XMinCol, _XMaxCol, _YMinCol, _YMaxCol);
						_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.SetIsAutoScaling(axesRange, isAutoScaling: false);
					}
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("Scaling");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsMinXEnable");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsMinYEnable");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsRangeEnable");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsXAxisOriginAt0Enable");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsYAxisOriginAt0Enable");
			}
		}

		public string MinXAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return FormatSignificantFigure(_XMinCol, _AxisSignificantFigure);
			}
			set
			{
				if (double.TryParse(value, out var result))
				{
					if (result == _XMinCol)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (XAxisScale == 1)
					{
						if (result <= 0.0)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (result < 1E-08)
						{
							result = 1E-08;
						}
					}
					if (result < _XMaxCol && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
					{
						AxesOptions largestAxesOptions = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LargestAxesOptions;
						if (largestAxesOptions != null && result <= largestAxesOptions.XMax)
						{
							_XMinCol = result;
						}
					}
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("MinXAxis");
				SetSetPlotAxisRange();
			}
		}

		public string MinYAxis
		{
			get
			{
				return FormatSignificantFigure(_YMinCol, _AxisSignificantFigure);
			}
			set
			{
				if (double.TryParse(value, out var result))
				{
					if (result == _YMinCol)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (YAxisScale == 1)
					{
						if (result <= 0.0)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (result < 1E-08)
						{
							result = 1E-08;
						}
					}
					if (result < _YMaxCol && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
					{
						AxesOptions largestAxesOptions = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.LargestAxesOptions;
						if (largestAxesOptions != null && result <= largestAxesOptions.YMax)

			}
		}

		public bool IsHydrualicPlot
		{
			get
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData != null && (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizing || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackSizing))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsMinXEnable
		{
			get
			{
				if (Scaling == 0)
				{
					_IsMinXEnable = false;

					_IsMinXEnable = true;

				_IsMinXEnable = _IsMinXEnable && (!IsXAxisOriginAt0 || XAxisScale == 1);
				return _IsMinXEnable;
			}

		public HydraulicRibbonViewModel(HydraulicPlotsViewModel hydraulicPlotsViewModel, bool forReport)
		{
			if (hydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && hydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel = hydraulicPlotsViewModel;
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.RefreshPlotByRunFinished += _HydraulicPlotsViewModel_RefreshPlotByRunFinished;
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageChangedEvent += HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent;
				RefreshData();
				_forReport = forReport;
			}
		}

		private void _HydraulicPlotsViewModel_RefreshPlotByRunFinished(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetAxisScale();
			RefreshData();
			SetSetPlotAxisRange();
		}

		private void HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetAxisScale();
			if (Scaling == 0)
			{
				RefreshData();
				SetSetPlotAxisRange();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateScalingVisibility();
			}
		}

		public void OnClosing()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.RefreshPlotByRunFinished -= _HydraulicPlotsViewModel_RefreshPlotByRunFinished;
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.RefreshEvent -= HydraulicPlotsViewData_RefreshEvent;
				if (!_forReport)
				{
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.UpdatePackingLquidBasis(PackingLiquidBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass);
					_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.UpdatePackingVaporBasis(PackingVapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetPackingLiquidAndVaporBasis(PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis, PackingVapordBasisEnum vaporBasis)
		{
			_PackiliquidBasis = liquidBasis;
			_PackingVaporBasis = vaporBasis;
		}

		public void RefreshData()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel == null || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateScalingVisibility();
			if (Scaling == 0 && (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizing || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackSizing) && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange != null)
			{
				if (XAxisScale == 1)
				{
					_XMinCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.LogXMin;
					_XMaxCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.LogXMax;
				}
				else
				{
					_XMinCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.XMin;
					_XMaxCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.XMax;
				}
				if (YAxisScale == 1)
				{
					_YMinCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.LogYMin;
					_YMaxCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.LogYMax;
				}
				else
				{
					_YMinCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.YMin;
					_YMaxCol = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange.YMax;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("MinYAxis");
				OnPropertyChanged("MaxYAxis");
				OnPropertyChanged("MaxXAxis");
				OnPropertyChanged("MinXAxis");
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScalingVisibility()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.PackSizing)
				{
					PackingBasisVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					TrayBasisVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					IsShadeEnabled = false;
				}
				else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TrayRating || _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType == StageType.TraySizing)
				{
					PackingBasisVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					TrayBasisVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					IsShadeEnabled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetSetPlotAxisRange()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(_XMinCol) && !double.IsNaN(_XMaxCol) && !double.IsNaN(_YMinCol) && !double.IsNaN(_YMaxCol) && _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
			{
				AxesOptions axesRange = new AxesOptions(_XMinCol, _XMaxCol, _YMinCol, _YMaxCol);
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.UpdatePlotAxisRange(axesRange);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSavedAxisRange(double xMin, double xMax, double yMin, double yMax)
		{
			_XMinCol = xMin;
			_XMaxCol = xMax;
			_YMinCol = yMin;
			_YMaxCol = yMax;
			OnPropertyChanged("MinYAxis");
			OnPropertyChanged("MaxYAxis");
			OnPropertyChanged("MaxXAxis");
			OnPropertyChanged("MinXAxis");
		}

		private void SetAxisScale()
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM != null)
			{
				AxisScale axisScale = (AxisScale)Enum.ToObject(typeof(AxisScale), XAxisScale);
				AxisScale axisScale2 = (AxisScale)Enum.ToObject(typeof(AxisScale), YAxisScale);
				if (axisScale == AxisScale.Log && _XMinCol <= 0.0)
				{
					_XMinCol = 1E-08;
					OnPropertyChanged("MinXAxis");
				}
				if (axisScale2 == AxisScale.Log && _YMinCol <= 0.0)
				{
					_YMinCol = 1E-08;
					OnPropertyChanged("MinYAxis");
				}
				SetAnnotationPosition();
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.SetAxisScale(axisScale, axisScale2);
				_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.CarouselViewModel.RibbonData.SetAxisScale(axisScale, axisScale2);
			}
		}

		private void SetAnnotationPosition()
		{
			//IL_00c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (IGraphAnnotation item in (IEnumerable<IGraphAnnotation>)_HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.PlotGraphSource.AnnotationCollection)
			{
				foreach (object child in ((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)item.Content).Children)
				{
					if (child is TextBlock textBlock && textBlock.Text == Resources.HyPlotLabel_Packing_MinimumLiquidRate)
					{
						AxesOptions currentStageAxesDataRange = _HydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.CurrentStageAxesDataRange;
						if (currentStageAxesDataRange != null)
						{
							double num = ((XAxisScale != 1) ? (currentStageAxesDataRange.XMin + 0.02 * (currentStageAxesDataRange.XMax - currentStageAxesDataRange.XMin)) : (currentStageAxesDataRange.LogXMin * 1.1));
							object obj = num;
							RAnnotationPositionInfo positionInfo = item.PositionInfo;
							item.SetPosition(obj, ((RAnnotationPositionInfo)(ref positionInfo)).YValue, (PlotAxisID)1, (PlotAxisID)4);
						}
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetSavedAxisScale(short xScale, short yScale)
		{
			xAxisScale = xScale;
			yAxisScale = yScale;
			OnPropertyChanged("XAxisScale");
			OnPropertyChanged("YAxisScale");
			SetAxisScale();
		}

		private void Col_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetSetPlotAxisRange();
		}

		public void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private string FormatSignificantFigure(double d, int significantFigure)
		{
			if (d.ToString().Replace(".", "").Count() <= 6)
			{
				return d.ToString();
			}
			double value = VariableHelper.ConvertSignificantFigure(d, significantFigure);
			if (Math.Abs(value) >= Math.Pow(10.0, significantFigure))
			{
				return value.ToString(_AxisFormatString);
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}

	public class StabilityDiagramViewModel : StabilityDiagramVMBase

		public StabilityDiagramViewModel(IUnityContainer container, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewModel, bool isReporting, string columnOptionKey, Graph plotGraph)
			: base(hydraulicPlotsViewModel)
		{
			if (hydraulicPlotsViewModel != null && container != null)
			{
				_PlotGraphSource = plotGraph;
				_LabelCurves = true;
				_ColumnOptionKey = columnOptionKey;
				iCAModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			}
		}

		private void InitRibbonSetting()
		{
			_PlotGraphSource.GraphLayout.TitlePointSize = _legendFontSize;
			IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
			IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
			string unitLableLiquid = _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableLiquid;
			string unitLableVapor = _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableVapor;
			string title = string.Empty;
			string title2 = string.Empty;
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayLiquidBasis == LiquidBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass)
			{
				title = Resources.LiquidMassFlow + " (" + unitLableLiquid + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayLiquidBasis == LiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidVolume)
			{
				title = Resources.LiquidVolumnFlow + " (" + unitLableLiquid + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayLiquidBasis == LiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidMassFluxTArea)
			{
				title = Resources.FlowBasisLiquidMassFluxTAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableLiquid + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayLiquidBasis == LiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidVolumeTArea)
			{
				title = Resources.FlowBasisLiquidVolumeTAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableLiquid + ")";
			}
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass)
			{
				title2 = Resources.VaporMassFlow + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporVolume)
			{
				title2 = Resources.VaporVolumnFlow + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporBArea)
			{
				title2 = Resources.FlowBasisVaporBAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporNetArea)
			{
				title2 = Resources.FlowBasisVaporNetAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporArea)
			{
				title2 = Resources.FlowBasisVaporAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporCSBArea)
			{
				title2 = Resources.FlowBasisVaporCSBAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			else if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayVapordBasis == VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporCSNetArea)
			{
				title2 = Resources.FlowBasisVaporCSNetAreaUpper + " (" + unitLableVapor + ")";
			}
			axis2.Title = title;
			axis.Title = title2;
		}

		public void Refresh(ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData ribbonData)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			TrayDiagramData.OperatingData.OperatingPoint.X = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0];
			TrayDiagramData.OperatingData.OperatingPoint.Y = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1];
			string percentMaxDCBackup = ((TraySectionResultData)TrayResultData).MaxDowncomerBackupLimit.Value.ToString();
			string percentJetFlood = ((TraySectionResultData)TrayResultData).MaxPercentJetFloodLimit.Value.ToString();
			_DiagramLineLabelAndColor.ResetLabel(percentMaxDCBackup, percentJetFlood);
			InitializePlotGraph(bEnclosed: false, empty, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableLiquid, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableVapor, ribbonData.XAxisScale, ribbonData.YAxisScale);
			if (!ribbonData.IsDrawAllCurves)
			{
				PlotEnclosedArea(empty, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableLiquid, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableVapor);
			}
			else
			{
				PlotOriginalCurves(empty, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableLiquid, _HydraulicPlotsViewData.UnitLableVapor);
			}
			FillEnclosedArea(ribbonData.IsShadeDiagram);
			updateCurveLabelVisibility(ribbonData.ShowLabel);
			PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)4, false);
			PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)2, true);
			PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)1, true);
			PlotGraphSource.AxesStyle = (PlotAxesStyle)0;
			SetFontFamilityAndSize();
			InitRibbonSetting();
			if (this.PlotUpdatedEvent != null)
			{
				this.PlotUpdatedEvent(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		public void updateCurveLabelVisibility(bool bShow)
		{
			_LabelCurves = bShow;
			foreach (GraphAnnotation curveAnnotation in curveAnnotationList)
			{
				curveAnnotation.Visible = bShow;
			}
		}

		public void SetFontFamilityAndSize()
		{
		}

		protected override void PlotLine(List<double> valL, List<double> valY, OrigialLineName origialLineName, bool bShowLegend)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string lableName = base.DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLabelString(origialLineName);
			System.Windows.Media.Color lineColor = base.DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLineColor(origialLineName);
			LineStyle trayLineStyle = base.DiagramLineLabelAndColor.GetTrayLineStyle(origialLineName);
			PlotLineSub(valL, valY, lableName, lineColor, bShowLegend, 1, trayLineStyle);
		}

		public void ResetAddTextPosition(object sender, PlotTrackEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = (double)e.GetAxisValue((PlotAxisID)1);
			double num2 = (double)e.GetAxisValue((PlotAxisID)4);
			IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
			double num3 = axis.LinearRange.Maximum.Value - axis.LinearRange.Minimum.Value;
			IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
			double num4 = axis2.LinearRange.Maximum.Value - axis2.LinearRange.Minimum.Value;
			num3 /= 100.0;
			num4 /= 100.0;
			if (!(num >= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0] - num3) || !(num <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0] + num3) || !(num2 >= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1] - num4) || !(num2 <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1] + num4))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<CAMessage> sectionMessages = iCAModel.GetSectionMessages(_ColumnOptionKey, TrayResultData.SectionKey);
			if (sectionMessages == null || sectionMessages.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<CAMessage> list = new List<CAMessage>();
			foreach (CAMessage item in sectionMessages)
			{
				if (item.StageNumber == CurrentStage)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = "";
			foreach (CAMessage item2 in list)
			{
				text += item2.MessageDetail;
				text += "\r\n";
			}
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
				e.Text = text;
			}
		}
	}

		private System.Windows.Point GetOperatingLineLabelPostion(System.Windows.Point lineStartPoint, System.Windows.Point lineEndPoint, System.Windows.Point operatingPoint)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			System.Windows.Point result2 = new System.Windows.Point
			{
				X = (lineEndPoint.X - lineStartPoint.X) / 2.0 + lineStartPoint.X,
				Y = (lineEndPoint.Y - lineStartPoint.Y) / 2.0 + lineStartPoint.Y
			};
			if (operatingPoint.Y >= result2.Y)
			{
				result.X = (result2.X - lineStartPoint.X) / 2.0 + lineStartPoint.X;
				result.Y = (result2.Y - lineStartPoint.Y) / 2.0 + lineStartPoint.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(operatingPoint.Y < result2.Y))
				{
					return result2;
				}
				result.X = (lineEndPoint.X - result2.X) / 2.0 + result2.X;
				result.Y = (lineEndPoint.Y - result2.Y) / 2.0 + result2.Y;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal AxesOptions GetStageAxesOptions(DiagramTray trayData, bool isOriginalLines = true)
		{
			AxesOptions axesOptions = new AxesOptions();
			_ = trayData.ReturnData;
			List<double> list = null;
			List<double> list2 = null;
			if (isOriginalLines)
			{
				list = GetAllLinesTrayRangeData(trayData, toFindMax: true);
				list2 = GetAllLinesTrayRangeData(trayData, toFindMax: false);
			}
			else
			{
				list = GetEnclosedTrayRangeData(trayData, toFindMax: true);
				list2 = GetEnclosedTrayRangeData(trayData, toFindMax: false);
			}
			axesOptions.XMin = list2[0] * 0.95;
			axesOptions.YMin = list2[1] * 0.95;
			axesOptions.XMax = list[0] * 1.05;
			axesOptions.YMax = list[1] * 1.05;
			double num = axesOptions.XMax - axesOptions.XMin;
			if (num != 0.0 && axesOptions.XMin / num < 0.95)
			{
				axesOptions.LogXMin = axesOptions.XMin * 0.8;
				axesOptions.XMin -= num * 0.04;
				if (axesOptions.XMin < 0.0)
				{
					axesOptions.XMin = 0.0;
				}
			}
			double num2 = axesOptions.YMax - axesOptions.YMin;
			if (num2 != 0.0 && axesOptions.YMin / num2 < 0.95)
			{
				axesOptions.LogYMin = axesOptions.YMin * 0.8;
				axesOptions.YMin -= num2 * 0.04;
				if (axesOptions.YMin < 0.0)
				{
					axesOptions.YMin = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (axesOptions.XMax < trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0])
			{
				axesOptions.XMax = trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0] * 1.05;
			}
			if (axesOptions.YMax < trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1])
			{
				axesOptions.YMax = trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1] * 1.05;
			}
			if (axesOptions.XMin > trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0])
			{
				axesOptions.XMin = trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0];
			}
			if (axesOptions.YMin > trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1])
			{
				axesOptions.YMin = trayData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1];
			}
			axesOptions.LogXMax = axesOptions.XMax * 1.1;
			axesOptions.LogYMax = axesOptions.YMax * 1.1;
			return axesOptions;
		}

				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(info));
			}
		}

		protected void SimplifyData(int ratio)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			new List<IDataSeries>();
			foreach (IDataSeries item in ((IEnumerable<IDataSeries>)_PlotGraphSource.DataSeriesCollection).ToList())
			{
				IPlotDataSource dataSource = item.DataSource;
				DataStore val = (DataStore)(object)((dataSource is DataStore) ? dataSource : null);
				DataStore val2 = new DataStore();
				int num = ((List<IDataPoint>)(object)val).Count / ratio;
				if (((List<IDataPoint>)(object)val).Count > 10)
				{
					val2.Add(val[0]);
					int num2;
					for (num2 = 0; num2 < ((List<IDataPoint>)(object)val).Count - 1; num2++)
					{
						val2.Add(val[num2]);
						num2 += num;
					}
					val2.Add(val[((List<IDataPoint>)(object)val).Count - 1]);
				}
				else
				{
					val2 = val;
				}
				item.DataSource = (IPlotDataSource)(object)val2;
			}
		}
