	public class SimpleStabilityDiagramVM : StabilityDiagramVMBase
	{
		private int _StageNumber = -1;

		private string _SectionKey = string.Empty;

		protected override CASectionResultDataBase TrayResultData
		{
			get
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsResultData.ContainsKey(_SectionKey))
				{
					return _HydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsResultData[_SectionKey];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override DiagramTray TrayDiagramData
		{
			get
			{
				if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData.ContainsKey(_StageNumber))
				{
					return _HydraulicPlotsViewData.AllTrayDiagramData[_StageNumber] as DiagramTray;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public SimpleStabilityDiagramVM(IUnityContainer container, Graph graph, HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewModel, int stageNumber, string sectinKey)
			: base(hydraulicPlotsViewModel)
		{
			_StageNumber = stageNumber;
			_SectionKey = sectinKey;
			_PlotGraphSource = graph;
			InitGraphData();
		}

		public void InitGraphData()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_PlotGraphSource == null)
			{
				_PlotGraphSource = new Graph();
			}
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)4, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.LegendPosition = (GraphElementPosition)0;
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)2, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)1, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)64, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)32, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.Axes.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotAxisVisualElements)16, false);
			_PlotGraphSource.AxesStyle = (PlotAxesStyle)0;
		}

		public void Refresh(ColumnPerformancePlotRibbonData columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel)
		{
			if (TrayResultData == null || TrayDiagramData == null || columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				InitializePlotGraph(bEnclosed: false, string.Empty, string.Empty, string.Empty, columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.XAxisScale, columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.YAxisScale);
				if (!columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.IsDrawAllCurves)
				{
					PlotEnclosedArea(string.Empty, string.Empty, string.Empty);
				}
				else
				{
					PlotOriginalCurves(string.Empty, string.Empty, string.Empty);
				}
				SimplifyData(30);
				AxesOptions stageAxesOptions = GetStageAxesOptions(TrayDiagramData, columnPerformancePlotRibbonViewModel.IsDrawAllCurves);
				SetPlotAxis(stageAxesOptions);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void SetPlotAxis(AxesOptions axesRange)
		{
			if (axesRange != null && !axesRange.IsZero())
			{
				IGraphAxis axis = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)4);
				IGraphAxis axis2 = _PlotGraphSource.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
				axis.ZoomReset();
				axis2.ZoomReset();
				axis.Scaling = (PlotAxisScaling)0;
				axis2.Scaling = (PlotAxisScaling)0;
				if (axis2.AxisAnnotator is LogarithmicAxisAnnotator)
				{
					axis2.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.LogXMin, axesRange.LogXMax, false);
				}
				else
				{
					axis2.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.XMin, axesRange.XMax, false);
				}
				if (axis.AxisAnnotator is LogarithmicAxisAnnotator)
				{
					axis.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.LogYMin, axesRange.LogYMax, false);
				}
				else
				{
					axis.DataRange.SetAbsolute(axesRange.YMin, axesRange.YMax, false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PlotLine(List<double> valL, List<double> valY, OrigialLineName origialLineName, bool bShowLegend)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Media.Color lineColor = base.DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLineColor(origialLineName);
			LineStyle trayLineStyle = base.DiagramLineLabelAndColor.GetTrayLineStyle(origialLineName);
			PlotLineSub(valL, valY, origialLineName.ToString(), lineColor, bShowLegend, 30, trayLineStyle);
		}
	}

		private void PlotGraph()
		{
			_traySectionResultData = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.GetSecResultOfCurrentStage() as TraySectionResultData;
			_stageType = _hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStageType;
			if ((_stageType == StageType.TrayRating || _stageType == StageType.TraySizing) && _traySectionResultData != null)
			{
				if (_traySectionResultData.IsMDTray)
				{
					Plot(_traySectionResultData, new string[1] { Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Average });
					return;
				}
				if (_traySectionResultData.IsCustomTray)
				{
					Plot(_traySectionResultData, new string[1] { Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Average });
					return;
				}
				Plot(_traySectionResultData, new string[4]
				{
					Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Side,
					Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Center,
					Resources.ColumnAnslysis_OCIn,
					Resources.ColumnAnslysis_OCOut
				});
			}
			else if (_stageType == StageType.None)
			{
				StatusTextBlockVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				StatusText = $"{Resources.ColumnAnslysis_Stage} {_hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage.ToString()} {Resources.ColumnAnalysisReport_NotIncludesInAnySectionsNoData}";
				PlotCtrlVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				PlotCtrlVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void Plot(TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData, string[] labelsArray)
		{
			//IL_0246: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_024b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0252: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_025b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PlotCtrlVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
			string title = $"{Resources.ColumnAnslysis_WeirLoading} ({Resources.CA_Stage} {_hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage})" + Environment.NewLine + _simulatorCADataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.WeirLoad);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			if (traySectionResultData.IsMDTray)
			{
				if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MD_WeirLoading[1].NullableValue.HasValue && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MD_WeirLoading[1].NullableValue.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(_plotsHelper.GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(_hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MD_WeirLoading[1]));
					list2.Add(labelsArray[0]);
				}
			}
			else if (traySectionResultData.IsCustomTray)
			{
				if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeirLoading[1].NullableValue.HasValue && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeirLoading[1].NullableValue.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(_plotsHelper.GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(_hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeirLoading[1]));
					list2.Add(labelsArray[0]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < 5; i++)
				{
					if (_hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeirLoading[i].NullableValue.HasValue && _hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeirLoading[i].NullableValue.HasValue)
					{
						list.Add(_plotsHelper.GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(_hydraulicPlotsViewData.TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeirLoading[i]));
						list2.Add(labelsArray[i - 1]);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == list2.Count)
			{
				Graph graph = new Graph
				{
					BarLayout = (BarChartLayout)2,
					AxesStyle = (PlotAxesStyle)1
				};
				Title = title;
				PlotAxes(graph);
				PlotVerticalBar(graph, list, list2);
				PlotHorizontalLine(graph, 0.0, 1.0, Colors.Black, (LineStyle)1);
				PlotHorizontalLine(graph, maxDisplay = _plotsHelper.GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(_traySectionResultData.WeirLoadMaximum), 2.0, Colors.Purple, (LineStyle)1);
				double displayValueForRealVariable = _plotsHelper.GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(_traySectionResultData.WeirLoadMinimum);
				PlotHorizontalLine(graph, displayValueForRealVariable, 2.0, Colors.Purple, (LineStyle)1);
				Graph = graph;
			}
		}

		private void PlotVerticalBar(Graph graph, List<double> data, List<string> labels)
		{
			tooltipDictionary.Clear();
			IGraphAxis axis = graph.Axes.GetAxis((PlotAxisID)1);
			IDataSeries obj = graph.NewDataSeries();
			obj.LineWidth = 1.0;
			obj.FillBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.CornflowerBlue);
			obj.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotSeriesVisualElements)4, true);
			obj.SetVisualElementVisibility((PlotSeriesVisualElements)16, false);
			IPlotDataSource dataSource = obj.DataSource;
			IPlotDataStore val = (IPlotDataStore)(object)((dataSource is IPlotDataStore) ? dataSource : null);
			val.DataSourceType = (PlotDataSourceType)2;
			val.AddPoint((object)"", (object)0);
			val.AddPoint((object)"", (object)0);
			for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				val.AddPoint((object)labels[i], (object)0);
				val.AddPoint((object)labels[i], (object)data[i]);
				tooltipDictionary["\t= " + labels[i] + "\n\t= " + data[i].ToString(axis.DataLabelFormatString)] = labels[i] + ": " + data[i].ToString(axis.DataLabelFormatString);
			}
			val.AddPoint((object)" ", (object)0);
			val.AddPoint((object)" ", (object)0);
			labels.Insert(0, "");
			labels.Add(" ");
			axis.LabelValues = labels;
		}

		public void UpdateAnnotationPosition(double xratio, double yRatio)
		{
			if (_traySectionResultData != null && !(maxDisplay <= 0.0))
			{
				if (xratio <= 0.85 || _traySectionResultData.NumberofPasses.Value <= 2)
				{
					Graph.Axes.AxesFontScaling = 1.0;
				}
				else
				{
					Graph.Axes.AxesFontScaling = 0.75;
				}
				double num = -12.0;
				double num2 = 1.05;
				num2 = maxDisplay / 15.0 * yRatio;
				double annotation_XRight = 95.0 + 2.0 * xratio;
				double annotation_XLeft = num * xratio;
				InitalizeMinMaxLabels(annotation_XRight, annotation_XLeft, num2);
			}
		}

		private void InitalizeMinMaxLabels(double annotation_XRight, double annotation_XLeft, double annotationYOffSet)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00d0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_017c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0183: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0208: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_020f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_traySectionResultData != null && _plotsHelper != null)
			{
				((ICollection<IGraphAnnotation>)Graph.AnnotationCollection).Clear();
				graphAnnotationDic.Clear();
				CARealVariable weirLoadMaximum = _traySectionResultData.WeirLoadMaximum;

				TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock

					Text = Resources.CA_Max,

				};

				val.SetPosition((object)annotation_XRight, (object)(displayValueForRealVariable + annotationYOffSet), (PlotAxisID)2, (PlotAxisID)4);
				IGraphAnnotation val2 = (IGraphAnnotation)new GraphAnnotation((IGraph)(object)Graph);
				((ICollection<IGraphAnnotation>)Graph.AnnotationCollection).Add(val2);
				graphAnnotationDic.Add(AnnotaitonWeir.maxValue, new Tuple<IGraphAnnotation, double>(val2, displayValueForRealVariable));
				TextBlock textBlock2 = new TextBlock
				{
					Text = displayValueForRealVariable.ToString("0.000"),
					Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White
				};
				((PlotCanvasBase)val2.Content).AddChild((UIElement)textBlock2, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
				val2.SetPosition((object)annotation_XLeft, (object)(displayValueForRealVariable + annotationYOffSet), (PlotAxisID)2, (PlotAxisID)4);
				weirLoadMaximum = _traySectionResultData.WeirLoadMinimum;
				displayValueForRealVariable = _plotsHelper.GetDisplayValueForRealVariable(weirLoadMaximum);
				IGraphAnnotation val3 = (IGraphAnnotation)new GraphAnnotation((IGraph)(object)Graph);

				graphAnnotationDic.Add(AnnotaitonWeir.min, new Tuple<IGraphAnnotation, double>(val3, displayValueForRealVariable));
				TextBlock textBlock3 = new TextBlock

					Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White
				};

				val3.SetPosition((object)annotation_XRight, (object)(displayValueForRealVariable + annotationYOffSet), (PlotAxisID)2, (PlotAxisID)4);

		{
			if (base.DataContext is WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel { Graph: not null } weirLoadingDiagramViewModel && ((ICollection<IDataSeries>)weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.Graph.DataSeriesCollection).Count != 0 && e.NewSize.Width > 0.0)
			{
				weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateAnnotationPosition(190.0 / e.NewSize.Width, 190.0 / e.NewSize.Height);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateWeirLoadBarChart()
		{
			if (!(base.DataContext is WeirLoadingDiagramViewModel { Graph: not null } weirLoadingDiagramViewModel) || ((ICollection<IDataSeries>)weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.Graph.DataSeriesCollection).Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ViewModel = weirLoadingDiagramViewModel;
			if (weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.Graph == null || (weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.StageType != StageType.TrayRating && weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.StageType != StageType.TraySizing))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.ActualWidth > 0.0)
			{
				weirLoadingDiagramViewModel.UpdateAnnotationPosition(190.0 / base.ActualWidth, 190.0 / base.ActualHeight);
			}
			if (_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.Plot.Frames.Count < 1)
			{
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.Plot.CreateFrame(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), WeirLoadBarChart.GraphLayout);
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.DragMode = (MouseDragMode)0;
				try
				{
					_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.PlotBorder = 0.0;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.GetContextActions += Plot_GetContextActions;
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.ContextMenuItems = (ContextMenuItems)3;
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.GraphZoom += Plot_GraphZoom;
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.TrackMode = (MouseTrackMode)1;
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.PointTrack += WeirLoadingPlotCtrl_PointTrack;
			}
			else
			{
				_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.Plot.Frames[0].GraphLayout = WeirLoadBarChart.GraphLayout;
			}
			_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.Refresh();
		}

		}

		private void Plot_GetContextActions(object sender, GetActionsEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions).Count; i++)
			{
				ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i];
				if (val.Id == "copy" && val.Subitems != null && ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems).Count > 0)
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val2 = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems)[0];
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HeaderCopyPlot, val2.Id, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)CopyPlot);
				}
				if (val.Id == "print" && val.Subitems != null && ((ICollection<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems).Count > 0)
				{
					ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs> val3 = ((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)val.Subitems)[0];
					((IList<ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>>)e.Actions)[i] = new ActionMenu<PlotClickEventArgs>(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.HeaderPrintPlot, val3.Id, (DoActionEventHandler<PlotClickEventArgs>)printPlot);
				}
			}
		}

		private void printPlot(object sender, DoActionEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog printDialog = new System.Windows.Controls.PrintDialog();
			bool? flag = printDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				RenderTargetBitmap selfBitMapSource = DiagramHelper.GetSelfBitMapSource(_weirLoadingPlotCtrl.RenderPlotToBitmap((int)((FrameworkElement)(object)_weirLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualWidth, (int)((FrameworkElement)(object)_weirLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualHeight), _currentStageTextBlock);

				{

					{
						Source = selfBitMapSource,
						Width = base.ActualWidth,
						Height = base.ActualHeight
					};
					printDialog.PrintVisual(visual, ViewModel.Title);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CopyPlot(object sender, DoActionEventArgs<PlotClickEventArgs> e)
		{
			double actualWidth = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_weirLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualWidth;
			double actualHeight = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_weirLoadingPlotCtrl).ActualHeight;

			}
		}

		public PdfReporter(IUnityContainer container, string columnId, string optionId, IList<CASectionRange> sectionRanges)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnId))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter columnId cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(optionId))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter optionId cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			_container = container;
			_columnId = columnId;
			_optionId = optionId;
			_sectionRanges = sectionRanges;
		}

		public bool DoReport(ReportSettings settings)
		{
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (settings == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("settings");
			}
			Microsoft.Win32.SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new Microsoft.Win32.SaveFileDialog();
			saveFileDialog.Filter = "PDF file(*.pdf)|*.pdf";
			saveFileDialog.FileName = settings.Header.Replace(" : ", "_");
			Window owner = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow as Window;
			bool? flag = saveFileDialog.ShowDialog(owner);
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(saveFileDialog.FileName))
			{
				try
				{
					Mouse.OverrideCursor = System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Wait;
					Report report = new Report();
					bool result = false;
					using (IReportDataProvider rdp = CreateDataProvider())
					{
						_headerSequence = 0;
						_subHeaderSequence = 0;
						_secondSubHeaderSequence = 0;
						CreateFirstPage(report, settings);
						CreateContentPage(report, settings);
						CreateDataPages(report, settings, rdp);
						result = PublishReport(report, saveFileDialog.FileName, rdp);
					}
					Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
					return result;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IReportDataProvider CreateDataProvider()
		{
			IReportDataProvider reportDataProvider = UnityContainerHelper.TryResolve<IReportDataProvider>(_container);
			if (reportDataProvider == null)
			{
				reportDataProvider = new CommonReportDataProvider(_container);
			}
			return reportDataProvider;
		}

		private void CreateContentPage(Report report, ReportSettings settings)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
			{
				report.Bookmarks.AddLevel(true);
			}
			ISection obj = report.AddSection();
			obj.PageSize = PageSizes.A4;
			obj.PageMargins.All = 35f;
			IText obj2 = obj.AddText();
			obj2.Style = TextStyle_BlueLarge;
			obj2.Margins.Top = 10f;
			obj2.Margins.Bottom = 15f;
			obj2.AddContent(Resources.Report_ContentsPageHeader);
			obj2.Alignment.Horizontal = (Alignment)1;
			ITOC val = obj.AddTOC();
			for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
			{
				ILevel obj3 = val.AddLevel();
				obj3.Indents.Right = 20f;
				obj3.Indents.Bottom = 5f;
				obj3.Style = TextStyle_Normal;
				obj3.Leader = (LeaderFormat)1;
			}
		}

		private void CreateDataPages(Report report, ReportSettings settings, IReportDataProvider rdp)
		{
			ISection section = report.AddSection();
			InitializeWithSettings(section, settings);
			PrintSectionHeader(section, settings);
			PrintSectionFooter(section, settings);
			PrintSectionBody(section, settings, rdp);
		}

		private void PrintSectionBody(ISection section, ReportSettings settings, IReportDataProvider rdp)
		{
			//IL_08e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_08f1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_08fd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0907: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!settings.IncludesProfiles && !settings.IncludesColumnInternalsSummary && !settings.IncludesGeometry && !settings.IncludesDPCM && !settings.IncludesResultsSummary && !settings.IncludesByTrayStageResults && !settings.IncludesOperatingPlots)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = rdp.GetColumnInternalsData(_optionId);
			if (settings.IncludesColumnInternalsSummary)
			{
				IColumnAnalyzerModel columnAnalyzerModel = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (columnAnalyzerModel != null)
				{
					CAColumnInternalResults columnInternalLevelResultData = columnAnalyzerModel.GetColumnInternalLevelResultData(_optionId);
					if (columnInternalLevelResultData != null)
					{
						AppendHeadingText(section, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults);
						string header = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_Summary, _optionId);
						PrintDataTable(section, settings, header, rdp.GetColumnHydraulicResultsSummary(columnInternalLevelResultData, settings.CalculatePressureDropAcrossSump), insertPageBreak: false);
						string header2 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_Sections, _optionId);
						PrintDataTable(section, settings, header2, rdp.GetColumnHydraulicResultsSections(columnInternalLevelResultData, columnInternalsData), insertPageBreak: false, 10, 45.0);
					}
				}
				section.AddPageBreak();
				AppendHeadingText(section, ReportResources.Report_FeedDrawSummary);
				PrintDataTable(section, settings, ReportResources.Report_FeedDrawSummary, rdp.GetFeedDrawSummary(columnInternalsData), insertPageBreak: false);
			}
			if (!settings.IncludesProfiles && !settings.IncludesGeometry && !settings.IncludesDPCM && !settings.IncludesResultsSummary && !settings.IncludesByTrayStageResults && !settings.IncludesOperatingPlots)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<string> sectionIds = rdp.GetSectionIds(_optionId);
			if (sectionIds != null && sectionIds.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionIds.Count; i++)
			{
				string sectionId = sectionIds[i];
				SimSectionDataBase sectionInputData = rdp.GetSectionInputData(_optionId, sectionId);
				if (sectionInputData == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				CASectionRange cASectionRange = ((_sectionRanges == null) ? null : _sectionRanges.FirstOrDefault((CASectionRange p) => p.SectionKey == sectionId));
				bool flag = sectionInputData.GetType() == typeof(CATraySectionData) || sectionInputData.GetType().IsSubclassOf(typeof(CATraySectionData));
				bool flag2 = false;
				bool flag3 = false;
				ColumnAnalyzerModel columnAnalyzerModel2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ColumnAnalyzerModel>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				CASectionResultDataBase resultData = columnAnalyzerModel2.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetResultData(_optionId, sectionId);
				if (resultData == null)
				{
					columnAnalyzerModel2.Run(_optionId, sectionId);
					resultData = columnAnalyzerModel2.ColumnInternalRegistered.GetResultData(_optionId, sectionId);
				}
				SectionContext sectionContext = new SectionContext(_columnId, _optionId, sectionId, columnInternalsData, sectionInputData, resultData);
				if (flag)
				{
					flag2 = (resultData as TraySectionResultData).IsMDTray;
					flag3 = (resultData as TraySectionResultData).IsCustomTray;
				}
				section.AddPageBreak();
				string name = sectionInputData.Name;
				AppendHeadingText(section, name);
				bool flag4 = false;
				bool flag5 = false;
				if (flag)
				{
					CAIntegerVariable floodingCalculationMethod = (sectionContext.SectionInput as CATraySectionData).FloodingCalculationMethod;
					if (floodingCalculationMethod != null && floodingCalculationMethod.GetEnumStringValue() == FloodingCalculationMethodSieveEnum.User.ToString())
					{
						flag5 = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CAIntegerVariable pressureDropMethod = (sectionContext.SectionInput as CAPackingSectionData).PressureDropMethod;
					if (pressureDropMethod != null && pressureDropMethod.GetEnumStringValue() == PackPressureDropCalculationMethodEnum.User.ToString())
					{
						flag5 = true;
					}
				}
				if (settings.IncludesGeometry && !flag5)
				{
					if (flag)
					{

						string header6 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Data_Section_Geometry_Panels, name);

								}
								else if (!flag6.Value)
								{
									string header8 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_SweptBackWeirs, name);
									PrintDataTable(section, settings, header8, rdp.GetSectionTraySweptBackWeirs(sectionContext), insertPageBreak: false);
								}
							}

					}
					else
					{

				}

				{
					if (flag4)
					{
						section.AddPageBreak();
					}

					string header11 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Data_Section_Results_SummaryHeader_1, name);

					if (flag)
					{
						string header12 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Data_Section_Results_SummaryHeader_2, name);
						PrintDataTable(section, settings, header12, rdp.GetSectionTrayResultsSummaryLimitingConditions(sectionContext, columnInternalsData, flag5), insertPageBreak: false);
					}
					string header13 = string.Format("Messages Summary", name);
					PrintDataTable(section, settings, header13, rdp.GetSectionMessagesSummary(sectionContext), insertPageBreak: false);
					flag4 = true;
				}
				StageType stageType = cASectionRange?.StageType ?? StageType.None;
				if (settings.IncludesByTrayStageResults)
				{
					if (flag4)
					{
						section.AddPageBreak();
					}
					AppendSubHeadingText(section, flag ? ReportResources.Report_Data_ByTray : ReportResources.Report_Data_ByStage);
					AppendSecondSubHeadingText(section, ReportResources.Report_Data_Hydraulic_Header);
					string header14 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Data_Hydraulic_Table_Header, name);
					if (flag2)
					{
						PrintDataTable(section, settings, header14, rdp.GetSectionMDTrayHydraulicDetails(sectionContext), insertPageBreak: false, 6, 50.0);
					}
					else
					{
						PrintDataTable(section, settings, header14, flag ? rdp.GetSectionTrayHydraulicDetails(sectionContext, stageType) : rdp.GetSectionPackingHydraulicDetails(sectionContext, stageType), insertPageBreak: false, flag ? 6 : 6, 45.0);
					}
					section.AddPageBreak();
					AppendSecondSubHeadingText(section, ReportResources.Report_Data_State_Conditions_Header);
					string header15 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Data_State_Conditions_Table_Header, name);
					PrintDataTable(section, settings, header15, flag ? rdp.GetSectionTrayStateConditions(sectionContext, stageType) : rdp.GetSectionPackingStateConditions(sectionContext), insertPageBreak: false, 8);
					section.AddPageBreak();
					AppendSecondSubHeadingText(section, ReportResources.Report_Data_Physical_Properties_Header);
					string header16 = string.Format(ReportResources.Report_Data_Physical_Properties_Table_Header, name);
					Dictionary<string, Width> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Width>();
					dictionary[ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Results_Stage] = (Width)new RelativeWidth(15f);
					dictionary[ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Detail_Stage] = (Width)new RelativeWidth(15f);
					PrintDataTable(section, settings, header16, flag ? rdp.GetSectionTrayPhysicalProperties(sectionContext) : rdp.GetSectionPackingPhysicalProperties(sectionContext), insertPageBreak: false, 8, 45.0, dictionary);
					flag4 = true;
				}
				if (!settings.IncludesOperatingPlots || stageType == StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine || stageType == StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine || stageType == StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine || stageType == StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					section.AddPageBreak();
				}
				AppendSubHeadingText(section, ReportResources.Report_Data_StabilityDiagrams_Header);
				IEnumerable<System.Drawing.Image> stabilityDiagrams = rdp.GetStabilityDiagrams(sectionContext);
				if (stabilityDiagrams == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag7 = false;
				foreach (System.Drawing.Image item in stabilityDiagrams)
				{
					if (flag7)
					{
						section.AddPageBreak();
					}
					PrintImage(section, settings, item);
					flag7 = true;
				}
			}
			if (settings.IncludesProfiles)
			{
				PrintColumnProfile(section, settings, rdp, columnInternalsData);
			}
		}

		private void PrintColumnProfile(ISection section, ReportSettings settings, IReportDataProvider rdp, ColumnInternalsData columnData)
		{
			AppendHeadingText(section, Resources.Report_Data_ColumnProfile_Header);
			string header = string.Format(Resources.Report_Data_ColumnProfile_TableHeader, columnData.FullColumnName);
			PrintDataTable(section, settings, header, rdp.GetColumnProfileData(columnData), insertPageBreak: false);
		}

		private bool PrintDataTable(ISection section, ReportSettings settings, string header, DataTable table, bool insertPageBreak, int? maxColumnsAllowed = null, double? columnHeaderHeight = null, Dictionary<string, Width> widths = null)
		{
			if (table == null || table.Columns.Count == 0 || table.Rows.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (insertPageBreak)
			{
				section.AddPageBreak();
			}
			int num = (maxColumnsAllowed.HasValue ? maxColumnsAllowed.Value : 6);
			if (table.Columns.Count <= num)
			{
				PrintDataTable(section, settings, header, table, 0, maxColumnsAllowed, columnHeaderHeight, widths);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)(table.Columns.Count - 1) / (double)(num - 1));
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						section.AddText().AddLineBreak();
					}
					string header2 = $"{header} ({i + 1})";
					PrintDataTable(section, settings, header2, table, i, maxColumnsAllowed, columnHeaderHeight, widths);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PrintDataTable(ISection section, ReportSettings settings, string header, DataTable table, int index, int? maxColumnsAllowed = null, double? columnHeaderHeight = null, Dictionary<string, Width> widths = null)
		{
			//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00fc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0106: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ef: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_02d0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02da: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_02dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02e7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0202: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0222: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_022c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0249: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0253: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0370: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_037a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0283: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_028d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0270: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_027a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0393: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_039d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int num = (maxColumnsAllowed.HasValue ? maxColumnsAllowed.Value : 6);
			IText obj = section.AddText();
			obj.Style = TextStyle_Normal;
			obj.Alignment = TextAlignment.Center;
			obj.AddContent(header);
			List<DataColumn> list = new List<DataColumn>();
			list.Add(table.Columns[0]);
			for (int i = 0; i < num - 1; i++)
			{
				if (index * (num - 1) + i + 1 < table.Columns.Count)
				{
					list.Add(table.Columns[index * (num - 1) + i + 1]);
				}
			}
			IGrid val = section.AddGrid();
			val.Borders = new Borders(Pens.Black);
			val.Margins.Top = 5f;
			val.Margins.Bottom = 5f;
			if (columnHeaderHeight.HasValue)
			{
				val.Header.Height = (Height)new FixedHeight((float)columnHeaderHeight.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				val.Header.Height = (Height)new FixedHeight(35f);
			}
			val.Header.Repeat = true;
			Color val2 = (settings.BlackAndWhiteTables ? Colors.White : DefaultTableHeaderColor);
			Color val3 = (settings.BlackAndWhiteTables ? Colors.White : DefaultTableGridColor);
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				DataColumn dataColumn = list[j];
				IGridColumn val4 = val.AddColumn();
				if (widths != null && widths.ContainsKey(dataColumn.Caption))
				{
					val4.Width = widths[dataColumn.Caption];
				}
				else if (j == 0)
				{
					if (string.Equals(dataColumn.Caption, Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						val4.Width = (Width)new RelativeWidth(40f);
					}
					else
					{
						val4.Width = (Width)new RelativeWidth(20f);
					}
				}
				else if (string.Equals(dataColumn.Caption, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_StartStage, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(dataColumn.Caption, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_EndStage, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					val4.Width = (Width)new FixedWidth(40f);
				}
				else if (string.Equals(dataColumn.Caption, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TrayOrPackingType, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					val4.Width = (Width)new RelativeWidth(36f);
				}
				else if (string.Equals(dataColumn.Caption, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_SectionPD, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					val4.Width = (Width)new RelativeWidth(33f);
				}
				else if (string.Equals(dataColumn.Caption, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_LimitingStage, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					val4.Width = (Width)new FixedWidth(42f);
				}
				else
				{
					val4.Width = (Width)new RelativeWidth(30f);
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				DataColumn dataColumn2 = list[k];
				IGridCell val5 = val.Header.AddCell();
				val5.Alignment.Vertical = (Alignment)5;
				val5.Borders = new Borders(Pens.Black);
				val5.Background = new Background(val2);
				AddNormalTextIntoCell(val5, dataColumn2.Caption, TextAlignment.Center);
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < table.Rows.Count; l++)
			{
				DataRow dataRow = table.Rows[l];
				IGridRow val6 = val.AddRow();
				bool flag = (l + 1) % 2 == 0;
				for (int m = 0; m < list.Count; m++)
				{
					DataColumn column = list[m];
					object obj2 = dataRow[column];
					IGridCell val7 = val6.AddCell();
					val7.Alignment.Vertical = (Alignment)5;
					val7.Borders = new Borders(Pens.Black);
					val7.Paddings.All = 5f;
					if (flag)
					{
						val7.Background = new Background(val3);
					}
					TextAlignment alignment = TextAlignment.Left;
					string text = ((obj2 == null) ? string.Empty : obj2.ToString());
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && double.TryParse(text, out var _))
					{
						alignment = TextAlignment.Right;
					}
					if (obj2 is Image)
					{
						AddImageIntoCell(val7, (Image)((obj2 is Image) ? obj2 : null));
					}
					else
					{
						AddNormalTextIntoCell(val7, (obj2 == null) ? string.Empty : obj2.ToString(), alignment);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrintImage(ISection section, ReportSettings settings, System.Drawing.Image image)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Image val = new Image(image);
			IImage obj = section.AddImage(val);
			val.Preferences.Converter = (ImageConverter)(object)ImageConverters.RGB;
			val.Preferences.Compressor = (ImageCompressor)(object)ImageCompressors.Flate;
			float num = (float)val.Width * 0.75f;
			obj.Margins.Left = (section.PageSize.Width - section.PageMargins.Left - section.PageMargins.Right - num - 20f) / 2f;
		}

		public void AppendHeadingText(ISection section, string text)
		{
			_headerSequence++;
			_subHeaderSequence = 0;
			_secondSubHeaderSequence = 0;
			IText obj = section.AddText();
			obj.Heading = (TextHeading)1;
			obj.AddContent($"{_headerSequence}. {text}", TextStyle_Normal);
		}

		public void AppendSubHeadingText(ISection section, string text)
		{
			_subHeaderSequence++;
			IText obj = section.AddText();
			obj.Heading = (TextHeading)2;
			obj.AddContent($"{_headerSequence}.{_subHeaderSequence}. {text}", TextStyle_Normal_SubHeader);
		}

		public void AppendSecondSubHeadingText(ISection section, string text)
		{
			_secondSubHeaderSequence++;
			IText obj = section.AddText();
			obj.Heading = (TextHeading)3;
			obj.AddContent($"{_headerSequence}.{_subHeaderSequence}.{_secondSubHeaderSequence}. {text}", TextStyle_Normal_SecondSubHeader);
		}

		private void AddImageIntoCell(IGridCell cell, Image img)
		{
			if (img != null)
			{
				IImage obj = cell.AddImage(img);
				cell.Alignment.Horizontal = (Alignment)1;
				cell.Alignment.Vertical = (Alignment)5;
				obj.KeepRatio = true;
			}
		}

		private void AddNormalTextIntoCell(IGridCell cell, string text, TextAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				IText val = cell.AddText();
				val.Style = TextStyle_Normal;
				val.Alignment = alignment;
				text = text.Trim();
				int num = text.IndexOf('\n');
				if (num > 0)
				{
					string text2 = text.Substring(0, num).Trim();
					string text3 = text.Substring(num + 1).Trim();
					val.AddContent(text2);
					val.AddLineBreak();
					val.AddContent(text3);
				}
				else
				{
					val.AddContent(text);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool PublishReport(Report report, string filePath, IReportDataProvider rdp)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				report.Publish(filePath, (FileFormat)0);
				flag = true;
			}
			catch (IOException ex)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, "Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
			}
			if (flag && rdp.ShouldOpenFileAfterReport)
			{
				Process.Start(filePath);
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	public class CommonReportDataProvider : IReportDataProvider, IDisposable
	{
		private class HydraulicTableColumnData
		{
			private readonly UnitsHelper _unitsHelper;

			private readonly List<string> _cellTextsList = new List<string>();

			private ReadOnlyCollection<string> _cellTexts;

			public ReadOnlyCollection<string> CellTexts
			{
				get
				{
					if (_cellTexts == null)
					{
						_cellTexts = new ReadOnlyCollection<string>(_cellTextsList);
					}
					return _cellTexts;
				}
			}

			public string Header { get; private set; }

			public string Units { get; private set; }

			public bool HasData => CellTexts.Count > 0;

			public HydraulicTableColumnData(string header, UnitsHelper unitsHelper)
			{
				Header = header;
				_unitsHelper = unitsHelper;
			}

			public void AppendCellText(CARealVariable variable)
			{
				if (variable != null && !double.IsNaN(variable.Value) && variable.Value < 1E+35)
				{
					_cellTextsList.Add(_unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(variable));
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Units) && variable.QuantityType != QuantityTypeEnum.None)
					{
						Units = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayUnits(variable.QuantityType);
					}
				}
			}

			public void AppendCellText(CAIntegerVariable variable)
			{
				if (variable != null && !double.IsNaN(variable.Value) && (double)variable.Value > 0.0)
				{
					_cellTextsList.Add(variable.Value.ToString());
				}
			}

			public void AppendCellText(string text)
			{
				_cellTextsList.Add(text);
			}
		}

		private class StabilityDiagramProducer
		{
			private readonly CommonReportDataProvider _rdpb;

			private static readonly System.Windows.Size DefaultDiagramSize = new System.Windows.Size(600.0, 600.0);

			private static readonly System.Windows.Size DefaultScreenSize = new System.Windows.Size(1024.0, 768.0);

			private ColumnInternalsData _columnData;

			private HydraulicPlotsScreen _plotsScreen;

			public StabilityDiagramProducer(CommonReportDataProvider rdpb)
			{
				_rdpb = rdpb;
			}

			public IEnumerable<System.Drawing.Image> GetStabilityDiagrams(SectionContext context)
			{
				if (_columnData != context.ColumnData)
				{
					Initialize(context.ColumnId, context.OptionId, context.SectionId, context.ColumnData);
					_columnData = context.ColumnData;
				}
				CASectionRange value = null;
				HydraulicPlotsViewModel hydraulicPlotsViewModel = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_plotsScreen).DataContext as HydraulicPlotsViewModel;
				HydraulicPlotsViewData hydraulicPlotsViewData = hydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData;
				if (hydraulicPlotsViewData.SectionsRange.TryGetValue(context.SectionId, out value))
				{
					hydraulicPlotsViewModel.ColPerformanceDiagramVM.Refresh();
					List<System.Drawing.Image> list = new List<System.Drawing.Image>();
					int num = Math.Min(value.StartStageNumber, value.EndStageNumber);
					int num2 = Math.Max(value.StartStageNumber, value.EndStageNumber);
					for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						hydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage = i;
						System.Drawing.Image item = CreateImageFromElement(CreateStabilityDiagramImageElement(), DefaultDiagramSize);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					return list;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private FrameworkElement CreateStabilityDiagramImageElement()
			{
				UpdateScreenLayout();
				return new Border
				{
					Width = DefaultDiagramSize.Width,
					Height = DefaultDiagramSize.Height,
					Background = new VisualBrush(_plotsScreen.stabilityDiagram)
				};
			}

			private void Initialize(string columnId, string optionId, string sectionId, ColumnInternalsData columnData)
			{
				HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject hydraulicPlotsScreenSubject = new HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject
				{
					ColumnKey = columnId,
					ColumnOptionKey = optionId,
					ForReport = true
				};
				_plotsScreen = HydraulicPlotsScreenFactory.Default.CreateScreen(_rdpb._unityContainer, (ScreenSubject)(object)hydraulicPlotsScreenSubject, null) as HydraulicPlotsScreen;
				if (((FrameworkElement)(object)_plotsScreen).DataContext is HydraulicPlotsViewModel hydraulicPlotsViewModel)
				{
					PackingLiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis = PackingLiquidBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass;
					PackingVapordBasisEnum packingVapordBasisEnum = PackingVapordBasisEnum.HydraulicPlotsRibbon_Mass;
					CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = (UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(_rdpb._unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) as ColumnAnalyzerModel).ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(hydraulicPlotsScreenSubject.ColumnOptionKey);
					if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis != null)
					{
						liquidBasis = cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingLiquidBasis;
						packingVapordBasisEnum = cAHydraulicFlowBasis.PackingVaporBasis;
					}
					hydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicRibbonVM.SetPackingLiquidAndVaporBasis(liquidBasis, packingVapordBasisEnum);
					if (hydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
					{
						hydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackingQuantityTypeLiquid = VariableHelper.GetPackingLiquidBasis(liquidBasis);
						hydraulicPlotsViewModel.HydraulicPlotsViewData.PackingQuantityTypeVapor = VariableHelper.GetPackingVaporBasis(packingVapordBasisEnum);
					}
				}
				((DispatcherObject)(object)_plotsScreen).Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{
				}, DispatcherPriority.DataBind);
			}

			private void UpdateScreenLayout()
			{
				((UIElement)(object)_plotsScreen).Measure(DefaultScreenSize);
				((UIElement)(object)_plotsScreen).Arrange(new Rect(DefaultScreenSize));
				((UIElement)(object)_plotsScreen).UpdateLayout();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				if (_plotsScreen != null)
				{
					((ScreenContentControl)_plotsScreen).RaiseClosing(new CancelEventArgs());
					((ScreenContentControl)_plotsScreen).RaiseClosed(EventArgs.Empty);
					_plotsScreen = null;
				}
				_columnData = null;
			}
		}

		private class UnitsHelper
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string> _siUnits = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string>();

			private readonly Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string> _displayUnits = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string>();

			private readonly CommonReportDataProvider _rdpb;

			public UnitsHelper(CommonReportDataProvider rdpb)
			{
				_rdpb = rdpb;
			}

			public string GetDisplayUnits(QuantityTypeEnum qt)
			{
				string value = null;
				if (qt != QuantityTypeEnum.None && !_displayUnits.TryGetValue(qt, out value))
				{
					value = _rdpb.SimulatorDataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(qt);
					_displayUnits.Add(qt, value);
				}
				return value;
			}

			public string GetSIUnits(QuantityTypeEnum qt)
			{
				string value = null;
				if (qt != QuantityTypeEnum.None && !_siUnits.TryGetValue(qt, out value))
				{
					value = _rdpb.SimulatorDataProvider.GetSIUnit(qt);
					_siUnits.Add(qt, value);
				}
				return value;
			}

			public string GetDisplayText(CARealVariable variable)
			{
				if (variable != null)
				{
					return GetDisplayText(variable.Value, variable.QuantityType);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			public string GetDisplayText(CARealVariable variable, QuantityTypeEnum qt)
			{
				if (variable != null)
				{
					return GetDisplayText(variable.Value, qt);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			public string GetDisplayText(double siValue, QuantityTypeEnum qt)
			{
				if (VariableHelper.IsEmpty(siValue))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (qt != QuantityTypeEnum.None)
				{
					string displayUnits = GetDisplayUnits(qt);
					string sIUnits = GetSIUnits(qt);
					double num = _rdpb.SimulatorDataProvider.ConvertUnit(qt, siValue, sIUnits, displayUnits);
					if (_rdpb._unityContainer != null)
					{
						IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_rdpb._unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
						if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
						{
							VariableFormat variableFormat = _rdpb.SimulatorDataProvider.GetVariableFormat(qt);
							if (variableFormat != null)
							{
								if (variableFormat.VariableFormatType == VariableFormatType.Exponential)
								{
									return num.ToString("E" + variableFormat.SignificantFigures);
								}
								if (variableFormat.VariableFormatType == VariableFormatType.FixedDecimalPoint)
								{
									return num.ToString("F" + variableFormat.SignificantFigures);
								}
								if (variableFormat.VariableFormatType == VariableFormatType.SignificantFigures)
								{
									return num.ToString("G" + variableFormat.SignificantFigures);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return num.ToString("G6");
				}
				return siValue.ToString("G6");
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_siUnits.Clear();
				_displayUnits.Clear();
			}
		}

		private readonly IUnityContainer _unityContainer;

		private readonly StabilityDiagramProducer _sdp;

		private readonly UnitsHelper _unitsHelper;

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider _simulatorDataProvider;

		public virtual bool ShouldOpenFileAfterReport => true;

		public CommonReportDataProvider(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			if (unityContainer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unityContainer");
			}
			_unityContainer = unityContainer;
			_sdp = new StabilityDiagramProducer(this);
			_unitsHelper = new UnitsHelper(this);
		}

		public CASectionResultDataBase GetSectionResultData(string optionId, string sectionId, bool isTrayed)
		{
			try
			{
				if (isTrayed)
				{
					return SimulatorDataProvider.GetTraySectionResultData(optionId, sectionId);
				}
				return SimulatorDataProvider.GetPackingSectionResultData(optionId, sectionId);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public virtual DataTable GetColumnProfileData(ColumnInternalsData columnData)
		{
			if (columnData == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("columnData");
			}
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			if (columnData != null)
			{
				InitializeProfileTableColumns(dataTable);
				foreach (CAStage stage in columnData.Stages)
				{
					DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
					dataRow[0] = stage.StageNum.Value;
					dataRow[1] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.TemperatureLiquid);
					dataRow[2] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.TemperatureVapor);
					dataRow[3] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.MassFlowLiquid);
					dataRow[4] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.MassFlowVapor);
					dataRow[5] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.VolumeFlowLiquid);
					dataRow[6] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.VolumeFlowVapor);
					dataRow[7] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.MoleWeightLiquid);
					dataRow[8] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.MoleWeightVapor);
					dataRow[9] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.DensityLiquid);
					dataRow[10] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.DensityVapor);
					dataRow[11] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.ViscosityLiquid);
					dataRow[12] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.ViscosityVapor);
					dataRow[13] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(stage.SurfaceTension);
					dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private void InitializeProfileTableColumns(DataTable table)
		{
			table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Profile_CH_Stage);
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidTemperature, QuantityTypeEnum.Temperature));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporTemperature, QuantityTypeEnum.Temperature));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidMassFlow, QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporMassFlow, QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidVolumnFlow, QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateVol));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporVolumnFlow, QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateVol));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidMoleWeight, QuantityTypeEnum.MW));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporMoleWeight, QuantityTypeEnum.MW));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidDensity, QuantityTypeEnum.Density));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporDensity, QuantityTypeEnum.Density));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidViscosity, QuantityTypeEnum.ViscosityDynamic));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporViscosity, QuantityTypeEnum.ViscosityDynamic));
			table.Columns.Add(GenerateColumnHeader(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_SurfaceTension, QuantityTypeEnum.SurfaceTension));
		}

		public virtual DataTable GetSectionDPCM(SectionContext context)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
			dataTable.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Value);
			dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
			if (context.SectionInput is CATraySectionData cATraySectionData)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				CACustomTraySectionData cACustomTraySectionData = cATraySectionData as CACustomTraySectionData;
				if (cACustomTraySectionData != null && cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout != null && cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.HasDC.Value != 1)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (cACustomTraySectionData != null && cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout != null)
				{
					_ = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.TrayOpenType.Value;
				}
				InternalsTypeEnum internalType = cATraySectionData.InternalType;
				if (!flag && cATraySectionData.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_PercentJetFlood, cATraySectionData.PercentJetFloodForDesign);
				}
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus && cATraySectionData.PercentJetFloodLimit.IsEnabled)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_LimitJetFlood, cATraySectionData.PercentJetFloodLimit);
				}
				if (!flag && cATraySectionData.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_MinimumDCAreaPercent, cATraySectionData.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea);
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_DowncomerDesignBasis, cATraySectionData.DowncomerDesignBasis);
				}
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_MaximumPressureDrop, cATraySectionData.MaximumPressureDrop);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_MaxPercentJetFlood, cATraySectionData.MaxPercentJetFlood);
				if (!flag)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_MaxDowncomerBackup, cATraySectionData.MaxDowncomerBackup);
				}
				if (internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Bubble_Cap || internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Sieve)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_MaximumFractionalEntrainment, cATraySectionData.MaximumFractionalEntrainment);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_WeirLoadMinimum, cATraySectionData.WeirLoadMinimum);
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_WeirLoadMaximum, cATraySectionData.WeirLoadMaximum);
				}
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_Warning_status, cATraySectionData.WarningStatusLimit.Value * 100.0);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_SystemFoamingFactor, cATraySectionData.SystemFoamingFactor);
				if (!flag)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_AerationFactorMultiplier, cATraySectionData.AerationFactorMultiplier);
				}
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_OverDesignFactor, cATraySectionData.OverdesignFactor);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_OverallSectionEfficiency, cATraySectionData.SectionEfficiency);
				if (cATraySectionData.OverideDowncomerFrothDensity)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Override_froth_density, cATraySectionData.DowncomerFrothDensity);
				}
				if (internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Sieve)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_WeepCalculationMethod, GetEnumText<WeepCalculationMethodEnum>(cATraySectionData.WeepCalculationMethod.Value));
				}
				if (internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Bubble_Cap || internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Sieve)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_FloodingCalculationMethod, GetEnumText<FloodingCalculationMethodSieveEnum>(cATraySectionData.FloodingCalculationMethod.Value));
				}
				if (internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Bubble_Cap || internalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Sieve)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_CH_MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethod, GetEnumText<MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethodEnum>(cATraySectionData.MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethod.Value));
				}
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_DryPressureDropMultiplier, cATraySectionData.DryDPMultiplier);
			}
			else if (context.SectionInput is CAPackingSectionData cAPackingSectionData)
			{
				if (cAPackingSectionData.PackCapacityOption == PackCapacityOptionEnum.ApproachToMaxCapacity)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_FAMC, cAPackingSectionData.FloodingApproachToMaxCapacity);
				}
				else
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_factor, cAPackingSectionData.DesignCapacityFactor);
				}
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_factorAtFlooding, cAPackingSectionData.CapacityFactorFlooding);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_FoamingFactor, cAPackingSectionData.SystemFoamingFactor);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_OverDesign, cAPackingSectionData.OverDesignFactor);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_MinLiquidFlow, cAPackingSectionData.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_PD, cAPackingSectionData.PressureDropAtFlood);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_AllowablePD, cAPackingSectionData.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_MinPD, cAPackingSectionData.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_Curves, cAPackingSectionData.NumberOfCurves);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_StatusLimit, cAPackingSectionData.WarningStatusToLimit);
				if (!cAPackingSectionData.PressureDropMethod.IsEmpty())
				{
					if (cAPackingSectionData.PressureDropMethod.EnumString.Equals(PackPressureDropCalculationMethodEnum.User.ToString(), StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_PDCM, cAPackingSectionData.PressureDropMethod);
					}
					else if (!(cAPackingSectionData.PackingVendor.EnumString == "RASCHIG") && !(cAPackingSectionData.PackingVendor.EnumString == "SULZER"))
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_DPCM_Packing_PDCM, cAPackingSectionData.PressureDropMethod);
					}
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private static double GetSectionTotalHeight(CATraySectionData sd)
		{
			return sd.TraySpacing.Value * (double)(Math.Abs(sd.EndingStage.Value - sd.StartStage.Value) + 1);
		}

		private static double GetSectionTotalPressureDrop(TraySectionResultData result)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (result != null && result.HydraulicResults != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in result.HydraulicResults)
				{
					num += hydraulicResult.Value.TotalPressureDrop.Value;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double GetSectionTotalResidenceTime(TraySectionResultData result)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (result != null && result.HydraulicResults != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in result.HydraulicResults)
				{
					if (hydraulicResult.Value.AverageDCResidenceTime.Value < 1E+35)
					{
						num += hydraulicResult.Value.AverageDCResidenceTime.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static int? FindTrayNumberWithMaxJetFlood(CATraySectionData sd, TraySectionResultData result)
		{
			if (result != null && result.DiagramSectionData != null && result.DiagramSectionData.Trays != null && result.DiagramSectionData.Trays.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				int num2 = Math.Min(sd.StartStage.Value, sd.EndingStage.Value);
				List<DiagramTray> trays = result.DiagramSectionData.Trays;
				int value = num2;
				for (int i = 0; i < trays.Count; i++)
				{
					DiagramTray diagramTray = trays[i];
					if (diagramTray != null && diagramTray.ReturnData != null && diagramTray.ReturnData.SummaryInfo != null && diagramTray.ReturnData.SummaryInfo.Count > 64)
					{
						double num3 = trays[i].ReturnData.SummaryInfo[64];
						if (double.IsNaN(num))
						{
							num = num3;
							value = num2 + i;
						}
						else if (num3 > num)
						{
							num = num3;
							value = num2 + i;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static int? FindTrayNumberWidthMaxDCBackup(CATraySectionData sd, TraySectionResultData result)
		{
			if (result != null && result.DiagramSectionData != null && result.DiagramSectionData.Trays != null && result.DiagramSectionData.Trays.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				int num2 = Math.Min(sd.StartStage.Value, sd.EndingStage.Value);
				List<DiagramTray> trays = result.DiagramSectionData.Trays;
				int value = num2;
				for (int i = 0; i < trays.Count; i++)
				{
					DiagramTray diagramTray = trays[i];
					if (diagramTray != null && diagramTray.ReturnData != null && diagramTray.ReturnData.SummaryInfo != null && diagramTray.ReturnData.SummaryInfo.Count > 67)
					{
						double num3 = trays[i].ReturnData.SummaryInfo[67];
						if (double.IsNaN(num))
						{
							num = num3;
							value = num2 + i;
						}
						else if (num3 > num)
						{
							num = num3;
							value = num2 + i;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DataTable GetSectionTrayStateConditions(SectionContext context, StageType st)
		{
			if (!(context.SectionResult is TraySectionResultData { HydraulicResults: not null } traySectionResultData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = st == StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine || st == StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidTemperature);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData2 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporTemperature);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData3 = null;
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData4 = null;
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData5 = null;
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData6 = null;
			if (!flag)
			{
				hydraulicTableColumnData3 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidMassFlow);
				hydraulicTableColumnData4 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporMassFlow);
				hydraulicTableColumnData5 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidVolumnFlow);
				hydraulicTableColumnData6 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporVolumnFlow);
			}
			foreach (int key in traySectionResultData.HydraulicResults.Keys)
			{
				TrayHydraulicPerformance trayHydraulicPerformance = traySectionResultData.HydraulicResults[key];
				list.Add(GetDisplayStage(context.ColumnData, trayHydraulicPerformance.TrayNumber.Value));
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData, trayHydraulicPerformance.TemperatureLiquid);
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData2, trayHydraulicPerformance.TemperatureVapor);
				if (!flag)
				{
					TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData3, trayHydraulicPerformance.MassLiquidRate);
					TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData4, trayHydraulicPerformance.MassVaporRate);
					TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData5, trayHydraulicPerformance.VolumetricLiquidRate);
					TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData6, trayHydraulicPerformance.VolumetricVaporRate);
				}
			}
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			List<HydraulicTableColumnData> list2 = new List<HydraulicTableColumnData>();
			IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Detail_TrayNumber);
			}
			else
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Detail_Stage);
			}
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData2);
			if (!flag)
			{
				TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData3);
				TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData4);
				TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData5);
				TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData6);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
				try
				{
					dataRow[0] = list[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
					{
						string value = string.Empty;
						try
						{
							if (list2[j].CellTexts.Count > i)
							{
								value = list2[j].CellTexts[i];
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						dataRow[j + 1] = value;
					}
					dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		public DataTable GetSectionTrayPhysicalProperties(SectionContext context)
		{
			if (!(context.SectionResult is TraySectionResultData { HydraulicResults: not null } traySectionResultData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_LiquidMoleWeight);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData2 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(Resources.Report_Profile_CH_VaporMoleWeight);

			}
			else
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Detail_Stage);
			}
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData2);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData3);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData4);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData5);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData6);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData7);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
				try

					for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)

						try
						{

							{

							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						dataRow[j + 1] = value;
					}
					dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private void TryAppendHydraulicColumn(DataTable table, List<HydraulicTableColumnData> data, HydraulicTableColumnData cd)
		{
			if (cd.HasData)
			{
				string columnName = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cd.Units) ? cd.Header : $"{cd.Header} ({cd.Units})");
				table.Columns.Add(columnName);
				data.Add(cd);
			}
		}

		protected void AppendValuesIntoTable(DataTable table, params object[] values)
		{
			DataRow dataRow = table.NewRow();
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
				{
					dataRow[i] = values[i];
				}
			}
			table.Rows.Add(dataRow);
		}

		protected void AppendVariablesIntoTable(DataTable table, string propertyName, params object[] variables)
		{
			DataRow dataRow = table.NewRow();
			dataRow[0] = propertyName;
			if (variables != null && variables.Length != 0)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < variables.Length; i++)
				{
					object obj = variables[i];
					if (!flag && obj is CARealVariable)
					{
						dataRow[1] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayUnits(((CARealVariable)obj).QuantityType);
						flag = true;
					}
					if (obj is CARealVariable)
					{
						dataRow[i + 2] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(obj as CARealVariable);
					}
					else if (obj is CAIntegerVariable)
					{
						CAIntegerVariable cAIntegerVariable = obj as CAIntegerVariable;
						if (cAIntegerVariable.IsEnum)
						{
							dataRow[i + 2] = cAIntegerVariable.EnumString;
						}
						else
						{
							dataRow[i + 2] = cAIntegerVariable.Value;
						}
					}
					else if (obj is StringCAVariable)
					{
						dataRow[i + 2] = ((StringCAVariable)obj).Value;
					}
					else if (obj != null)
					{
						dataRow[i + 2] = obj.ToString();
					}
				}
			}
			table.Rows.Add(dataRow);
		}

		protected void AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitTypeAndUnitsAtLastColumn(DataTable table, string propertyName, QuantityTypeEnum unitType, params object[] variables)
		{
			DataRow dataRow = table.NewRow();
			dataRow[0] = propertyName;
			if (variables != null && variables.Length != 0)

				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < variables.Length; i++)
				{
					object obj = variables[i];
					if (!flag && obj is CARealVariable)
					{
						dataRow[variables.Length + 1] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayUnits(unitType);
						flag = true;
					}
					if (obj is CARealVariable)
					{
						dataRow[i + 1] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(obj as CARealVariable, unitType);
					}
					else if (obj is CAIntegerVariable)
					{
						CAIntegerVariable cAIntegerVariable = obj as CAIntegerVariable;
						if (cAIntegerVariable.IsEnum)
						{
							dataRow[i + 1] = cAIntegerVariable.EnumString;
						}
						else
						{
							dataRow[i + 1] = cAIntegerVariable.Value;
						}
					}
					else if (obj is StringCAVariable)
					{
						dataRow[i + 1] = ((StringCAVariable)obj).Value;
					}
					else if (obj != null)
					{
						dataRow[i + 1] = obj.ToString();
					}
				}
			}
			table.Rows.Add(dataRow);
		}

		protected void AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(DataTable table, string propertyName, object variable, QuantityTypeEnum typeEnum = QuantityTypeEnum.None)
		{
			DataRow dataRow = table.NewRow();
			dataRow[0] = propertyName;
			if (variable != null)
			{
				if (variable is CARealVariable)
				{
					if (typeEnum == QuantityTypeEnum.None)
					{
						dataRow[1] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(variable as CARealVariable);
					}
					else
					{
						dataRow[1] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayText(variable as CARealVariable, typeEnum);
					}
				}
				else if (variable is CAIntegerVariable)
				{
					CAIntegerVariable cAIntegerVariable = variable as CAIntegerVariable;
					if (cAIntegerVariable.IsEnum)
					{
						if (cAIntegerVariable.PropertyName == "PackingDimension" && cAIntegerVariable.Value == 33333333)
						{
							dataRow[1] = "USER";
						}
						else
						{
							dataRow[1] = cAIntegerVariable.EnumString;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dataRow[1] = cAIntegerVariable.Value;
					}
				}
				else if (variable is StringCAVariable)
				{
					dataRow[1] = ((StringCAVariable)variable).Value;
				}
				else
				{
					dataRow[1] = variable.ToString();
				}
				if (variable is CARealVariable)
				{
					if (typeEnum == QuantityTypeEnum.None)
					{
						dataRow[2] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayUnits(((CARealVariable)variable).QuantityType);
					}
					else
					{
						dataRow[2] = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayUnits(typeEnum);
					}
				}
			}
			table.Rows.Add(dataRow);
		}

		protected string GenerateColumnHeader(string header, QuantityTypeEnum quantityType)
		{
			string displayUnits = _unitsHelper.GetDisplayUnits(quantityType);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayUnits))
			{
				return $"{header} ({displayUnits})";
			}
			return header;
		}

		public static void BuildTextColumns(DataTable table, params string[] columns)
		{
			if (table == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("table");
			}
			table.Columns.Clear();
			if (columns != null)
			{
				foreach (string columnName in columns)
				{
					table.Columns.Add(columnName);
				}
			}
		}

		public static string GetEnumText<T>(int value)
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			if (typeFromHandle.IsEnum)
			{
				return Enum.GetName(typeFromHandle, value);
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Image CreateImageFromElement(FrameworkElement element, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (element.Parent is Border border)
			{
				border.Child = null;
			}
			else if (element.Parent is Grid grid)
			{
				grid.Children.Remove(element);
			}
			Border border2 = new Border
			{
				Child = element,
				Width = size.Width,
				Height = size.Height,
				Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White
			};
			border2.Measure(size);
			border2.Arrange(new Rect(size));
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Default);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(border2);
			BmpBitmapEncoder bmpBitmapEncoder = new BmpBitmapEncoder();
			bmpBitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderTargetBitmap));
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			bmpBitmapEncoder.Save(stream);
			return new Bitmap(stream);
		}

		public static DataTable CreateSampleDataTable()
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add("Column " + i);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++)
			{
				DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
				for (int k = 0; k < dataTable.Columns.Count; k++)
				{
					dataRow[k] = $"cell {j},{k}";
				}
				dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<System.Drawing.Image> CreateSampleImages()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Button button = new System.Windows.Controls.Button();
				button.Content = "Sample Image " + i;
				yield return CreateImageFromElement(button, new System.Windows.Size(600.0, 600.0));
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(force: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		{
			if (!_disposed)
			{
				_sdp.Reset();
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}
