		}

		public DataTable GetSectionTrayPicketedWeirs(SectionContext context)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			if (context.SectionInput is CATraySectionData cATraySectionData)
			{
				InitializeGeometryPicketedWeirsColumns(dataTable, cATraySectionData);
				if (context.SectionResult is TraySectionResultData rsd)
				{
					if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 1)
					{
						AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_1(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
					}
					else if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 2)
					{
						AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_2(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
					}
					else if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 3)
					{
						AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_3(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
					}
					else if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
					{
						AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_4(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
					}
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private void InitializeGeometryPicketedWeirsColumns(DataTable table, CATraySectionData sd)
		{
			switch (sd.NumberofPasses.Value)
			{
			case 1:
				table.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
				table.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Side);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
				break;
			case 2:
				table.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Side);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Offcenter_Center);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
				break;
			case 3:
				table.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Side);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Offcenter_Outside);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Offcenter_Inside);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
				break;
			case 4:
				table.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Side);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Offcenter_Outside);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Offcenter_Inside);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_Offcenter_Center);
				table.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_1(DataTable table, CATraySectionData sd, TraySectionResultData rsd)
		{
			if (sd != null && sd.Weirs != null && sd.Weirs.Count > 0)
			{
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, Resources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_WeirLength, sd.Weirs[0].Width);
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, ReportResources.Report_Geometry_PicketingFraction, sd.Weirs[0].PicketingFraction);
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, ReportResources.Report_PicketedWeirs_WeirLoading, ((CADCSideResultData)rsd.Downcomers[0]).WeirLoading);
			}
		}

		private void AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_2(DataTable table, CATraySectionData sd, TraySectionResultData rsd)
		{
			if (sd != null && sd.Weirs != null && sd.Weirs.Count > 1)
			{
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, Resources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_WeirLength, sd.Weirs[0].Width, sd.Weirs[1].Width);
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, ReportResources.Report_Geometry_PicketingFraction, sd.Weirs[0].PicketingFraction, sd.Weirs[1].PicketingFraction);
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, ReportResources.Report_PicketedWeirs_WeirLoading, ((CADCSideResultData)rsd.Downcomers[0]).WeirLoading, ((CADCCenterResultData)rsd.Downcomers[1]).WeirLoading);
			}
		}

		private void AddGeometry_PicketedWeirs_3(DataTable table, CATraySectionData sd, TraySectionResultData rsd)
		{
			if (sd != null && sd.Weirs != null && sd.Weirs.Count > 3)
			{
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, Resources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_WeirLength, sd.Weirs[0].Width, sd.Weirs[3].Width, sd.Weirs[2].Width);
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, ReportResources.Report_Geometry_PicketingFraction, sd.Weirs[0].PicketingFraction, sd.Weirs[3].PicketingFraction, sd.Weirs[2].PicketingFraction);
				AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(table, ReportResources.Report_PicketedWeirs_WeirLoading, ((CADCSideResultData)rsd.Downcomers[0]).WeirLoading, ((CADCOffCenterResultData)rsd.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading, ((CADCOffCenterResultData)rsd.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterInsideWeirLoading);
			}
		}

					else if (!(cATraySectionData.IsCustomTray ?? false))

			if (context.SectionResult is TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData)

				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_SectionResidenceTime, traySectionResultData.SectionResidenceTime);

				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Capacity_factor, cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumCapacityFactor);
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus)
				{

					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Average_PD, cAPackingSectionResults.AveragePressureDropPerHeight);

						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Average_PD_Frictional, cAPackingSectionResults.AveragePressureDropPerHeightFrictional);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_PD, cAPackingSectionResults.SectionPressureDrop, QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDrop);
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Average_PD, cAPackingSectionResults.AveragePressureDropPerHeight, QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight);

		}

		public DataTable GetSectionMessagesSummary(SectionContext context)
		{
			//IL_00d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00df: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			string secKey = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(context.OptionId, context.SectionId);
			List<CAMessage> sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ColumnAnalyzerModel>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).CAMessagesManager.GetSectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach(secKey);
			if (sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach != null && sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach.Count > 0)
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add("Status", typeof(object));
				dataTable.Columns.Add("Messages");
				foreach (CAMessage item in sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach)
				{
					ImageSource imageSource = null;
					imageSource = ((item.MessageType != MessageType.Error) ? ((item.MessageType != MessageType.Warning) ? CAImageResources.GetImageSource("Messages16.ico") : CAImageResources.GetImageSource("Warning16.ico")) : CAImageResources.GetImageSource("StatusError16.ico"));
					dataTable.Rows.Add((object)new Image((System.Drawing.Image)ImageSourceToImage(imageSource)), item.MessageDetail);
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private Bitmap ImageSourceToImage(ImageSource source)
		{
			BitmapSource bitmapSource = source as BitmapSource;
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(bitmapSource.PixelWidth, bitmapSource.PixelHeight, System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppPArgb);
			BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(new System.Drawing.Rectangle(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, bitmap.Size), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppPArgb);
			bitmapSource.CopyPixels(Int32Rect.Empty, bitmapData.Scan0, bitmapData.Height * bitmapData.Stride, bitmapData.Stride);
			bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
			return bitmap;
		}

						AppendVariablesIntoTableWithUnitsAtLastColumn(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Geometry_TrayGeometry_DCArea, traySectionResultData.TotalDCArea);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InitializeTrayGeometryColumns(dataTable, cATraySectionData);
					if (context.SectionResult is TraySectionResultData rsd)
					{
						if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 1)
						{
							AddTrayGeometryData_Downcomer_Geometry_1(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
						}
						else if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 2)
						{
							AddTrayGeometryData_Downcomer_Geometry_2(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
						}
						else if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 3)
						{
							AddTrayGeometryData_Downcomer_Geometry_3(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
						}
						else if (cATraySectionData.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
						{
							AddTrayGeometryData_Downcomer_Geometry_4(dataTable, cATraySectionData, rsd);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		public DataTable GetColumnHydraulicResultsSummary(CAColumnInternalResults results, bool calculatePressureDropAcrossSump)
		{
			if (results == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
			dataTable.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Value);
			dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
			AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_StagesNumber, results.NumberOfStage);
			AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_Height, results.TotalHeight);
			IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
			{
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TotalHeadLoss, results.TotalHeadLoss, QuantityTypeEnum.LengthShort);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TotalPD, results.TotalPressureDrop, QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDrop);
			}
			else
			{
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TotalHeadLoss, results.TotalHeadLoss);
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TotalPD, results.TotalPressureDrop);
			}
			AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_SectionsNumber, results.NumberOfSections);
			AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_DiametersNumber, results.NumberOfDiameters);
			if (calculatePressureDropAcrossSump)
			{
				AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_PDAcrossSump, results.PressureDropAcrossSump);
			}
			AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TotalResidenceTime, results.TotalResidenceTime);
			return dataTable;
		}

		public DataTable GetColumnHydraulicResultsSections(CAColumnInternalResults results, ColumnInternalsData cid)
		{
			if (results == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			bool flag = false;
			IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(flag ? ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_Start : ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_StartStage);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData2 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(flag ? ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_End : ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_EndStage);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData3 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_Diameter);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData4 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_SectionHeight);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData5 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_InternalType);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData6 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_TrayOrPackingType);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData7 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_SectionPD);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData8 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_PercentApproachToFlood);
			HydraulicTableColumnData hydraulicTableColumnData9 = CreateHydraulicDetailColumn(ReportResources.Report_ColumnHResults_LimitingStage);
			foreach (CAColumnInternalResults.SectionSimplifiedResult item in results.SectionsResult)
			{
				list.Add(item.SectionName);
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData, GetDisplayStage(cid, item.StartStage.Value));
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData2, GetDisplayStage(cid, item.EndStage.Value));
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData3, item.Diameter);
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData4, item.SectionHeight);
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData5, item.InternalType);
				if (item.TrayPackingType == "CUSTOMTRAY")
				{
					TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData6, "CUSTOM");
				}
				else
				{
					TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData6, item.TrayPackingType);
				}
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData7, item.PressureDrop);
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData8, item.ApproachToFlood);
				TryAppendHydraulicData(hydraulicTableColumnData9, GetDisplayStage(cid, item.LimitingStage.Value));
			}
			List<HydraulicTableColumnData> list2 = new List<HydraulicTableColumnData>();
			dataTable.Columns.Add(flag ? ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Section : "");
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData2);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData3);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData4);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData5);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData6);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData7);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData8);
			TryAppendHydraulicColumn(dataTable, list2, hydraulicTableColumnData9);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DataRow dataRow = dataTable.NewRow();
				try
				{
					dataRow[0] = list[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
					{
						string value = string.Empty;
						try
						{
							if (list2[j].CellTexts.Count > i)
							{
								value = list2[j].CellTexts[i];
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						dataRow[j + 1] = value;
					}
					dataTable.Rows.Add(dataRow);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		private string GetDisplayStage(ColumnInternalsData cid, int stage)
		{
			if (cid == null)
			{
				return stage.ToString();
			}
			if (_unityContainer == null)
			{
				return stage.ToString();
			}
			string text = "";
			bool flag = false;
			IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			text = ((!cid.IsTopDownNumbering) ? (cid.Stages.Count - stage + 1).ToString() : stage.ToString());
			if (flag)
			{
				text = text + "_" + cid.FullColumnName;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public DataTable GetSectionPackingGeometry(SectionContext context)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			if (context.SectionInput != null)
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Property);
				dataTable.Columns.Add(Resources.Report_TableHeader_Value);
				dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Unit);
				if (context.SectionInput is CAPackingSectionData cAPackingSectionData)
				{
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_PackingType, cAPackingSectionData.PackingType);
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_Vendor, cAPackingSectionData.PackingVendor);
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_SD, cAPackingSectionData.Diameter);
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_Material, cAPackingSectionData.PackingMaterial);
					if (!cAPackingSectionData.PackingSize.IsEmpty())
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_PackingSize, cAPackingSectionData.PackingSize);
					}
					AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_Dimension, cAPackingSectionData.PackingDimension);
					if (cAPackingSectionData.OldSulzerCorrelation.Value == 1)
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_PackingFactor, cAPackingSectionData.PackingFactor);
					}
					if (cAPackingSectionData.PackHeightType == PackHeightType.HETP)
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_PackedHeightPerStage, cAPackingSectionData.HETP);
					}
					else
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_SectionPackedHeight, cAPackingSectionData.PackingHeight);
					}
					if (cAPackingSectionData.OldSulzerCorrelation.Value == 1)
					{
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_SurfaceArea, cAPackingSectionData.StichlmairSurfaceArea);
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_Geometry_Void_fraction, cAPackingSectionData.StichlmairVoidFraction);
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_FirstConstant, cAPackingSectionData.StichlmairConstant_1);
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_SecondConstant, cAPackingSectionData.StichlmairConstant_2);
						AppendVariableIntoPVUTable(dataTable, ReportResources.Report_Packing_ThirdConstant, cAPackingSectionData.StichlmairConstant_3);
					}
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		public DataTable GetFeedDrawSummary(ColumnInternalsData data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (data.Stages == null || data.Stages.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Detail_StageNumber);
			}
			else
			{
				dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Hydraulic_Detail_Stage);
			}
			dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_Stream);
			dataTable.Columns.Add(ReportResources.Report_FeedDraw);
			IList<CAStream> feeds = data.Feeds;
			IList<CAStream> products = data.Products;
			IList<CAPumpAround> pumpArounds = data.PumpArounds;
			foreach (CAStage stage in data.Stages.OrderBy((CAStage p) => p.StageNum.Value))
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (feeds != null && feeds.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (CAStream item in feeds.Where((CAStream p) => p.Stage.Value == stage.StageNum.Value))
					{
						AppendValuesIntoTable(dataTable, (num == 0) ? GetDisplayStage(data, stage.StageNum.Value) : "", item.Name.Value, "Feed");
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (products != null && products.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (CAStream item2 in products.Where((CAStream p) => p.Stage.Value == stage.StageNum.Value))
					{
						AppendValuesIntoTable(dataTable, (num == 0) ? GetDisplayStage(data, stage.StageNum.Value) : "", item2.Name.Value, "Draw");
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (pumpArounds == null || pumpArounds.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CAPumpAround item3 in pumpArounds.Where((CAPumpAround p) => p.ReturnStage == stage.StageNum.Value.ToString()))
				{
					AppendValuesIntoTable(dataTable, (num == 0) ? GetDisplayStage(data, stage.StageNum.Value) : "", item3.Name, "Feed");
					num++;
				}
				foreach (CAPumpAround item4 in pumpArounds.Where((CAPumpAround p) => p.VaporReturnStage == stage.StageNum.Value.ToString()))
				{
					AppendValuesIntoTable(dataTable, (num == 0) ? GetDisplayStage(data, stage.StageNum.Value) : "", item4.Name, "Feed");
					num++;
				}
				foreach (CAPumpAround item5 in pumpArounds.Where((CAPumpAround p) => p.DrawStage == stage.StageNum.Value.ToString()))
				{
					AppendValuesIntoTable(dataTable, (num == 0) ? GetDisplayStage(data, stage.StageNum.Value) : "", item5.Name, "Draw");
					num++;
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}
	}

		public ReportDialog(IUnityContainer container, string columnKey, string optionKey, Dictionary<string, bool> optionReportEnabledInfo = null)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("container");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnKey))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter columnKey cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(optionKey))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Parameter optionKey cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			_container = container;
			_columnKey = columnKey;
			_optionKey = optionKey;
			_optionReportEnabledInfo = optionReportEnabledInfo;
			InitializeComponent();
			base.Loaded += ReportDialog_Loaded;
			optionsList.SelectionChanged += optionsList_SelectionChanged;
			base.Activated += ReportDialog_Activated;
		}

		private void ReportDialog_Activated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Keyboard.Focus(this);
		}

		private void optionsList_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_headerChanged && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(txtHeader.Text))
			{
				string[] array = txtHeader.Text.Split(':');
				if (array != null && array.Length != 0 && optionsList.SelectedItem is OptionItem optionItem)
				{
					txtHeader.Text = array[0] + ": " + optionItem.Name;
				}
			}
			string sConfigOptionKey = _optionKey;
			OptionItem optionItem2 = optionsList.SelectedItem as OptionItem;
			if (optionItem2 != null)
			{
				sConfigOptionKey = optionItem2.Key;
			}
			if (optionItem2 != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(optionItem2.Name) && _optionReportEnabledInfo != null && _optionReportEnabledInfo.ContainsKey(optionItem2.Name))
			{
				btnGenerate.IsEnabled = _optionReportEnabledInfo[optionItem2.Name];
			}
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			_ranges = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(sConfigOptionKey);
			if (_ranges == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (CASectionRange range in _ranges)
			{
				if (range.StageType != StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine && range.StageType != StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine && range.StageType != StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine && range.StageType != StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				chkColumnOperatingPlots.IsEnabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				chkColumnOperatingPlots.IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ReportDialog_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			txtHeader.Text = DefaultHeader;
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			IList<CAOption> columnOptions = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnOptions(_columnKey);
			List<OptionItem> list = new List<OptionItem>();
			foreach (CAOption item in columnOptions)
			{
				list.Add(new OptionItem
				{
					Name = item.OptionName,
					Key = item.OptionKey
				});
			}
			optionsList.DisplayMemberPath = "Name";
			optionsList.ItemsSource = list;
			OptionItem optionItem = list.FirstOrDefault((OptionItem p) => p.Key == _optionKey);
			if (optionItem != null)
			{
				optionsList.SelectedItem = optionItem;
			}
			string sConfigOptionKey = _optionKey;
			OptionItem optionItem2 = optionsList.SelectedItem as OptionItem;
			if (optionItem2 != null)
			{
				sConfigOptionKey = optionItem2.Key;
			}
			if (optionItem2 != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(optionItem2.Name) && _optionReportEnabledInfo != null && _optionReportEnabledInfo.ContainsKey(optionItem2.Name))
			{
				btnGenerate.IsEnabled = _optionReportEnabledInfo[optionItem2.Name];
			}
			_ranges = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(sConfigOptionKey);
			if (_ranges == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (CASectionRange range in _ranges)
			{
				if (range.StageType != StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine && range.StageType != StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine && range.StageType != StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine && range.StageType != StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				chkColumnOperatingPlots.IsEnabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				chkColumnOperatingPlots.IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void btnGenerate_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ReportSettings reportSettings = new ReportSettings
			{
				ProjectName = txtProjectName.Text.Trim(),
				CompanyName = txtCompanyName.Text.Trim(),
				JobCode = txtJobCode.Text.Trim(),
				Header = txtHeader.Text.Trim(),
				Description = txtDescription.Text.Trim(),
				BlackAndWhiteTables = (chkBlackWhiteTables.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesProfiles = (chkProfile.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesColumnInternalsSummary = (chkColumnHydraulicResults.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesGeometry = (chkGeometry.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesDPCM = (chkDesignParamter.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesResultsSummary = (chkResultsSummary.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesByTrayStageResults = (chkHydraulic.IsChecked == true),
				IncludesOperatingPlots = (chkColumnOperatingPlots.IsChecked == true),
				SubHeader1 = SubHeader1,
				SubHeader2 = SubHeader2
			};
			string text = _optionKey;
			if (optionsList.SelectedItem is OptionItem optionItem)
			{
				text = optionItem.Key;
			}
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (simulatorCADataProvider != null)
			{
				CAOption columnOption = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnOption(text);
				if (columnOption != null)
				{
					reportSettings.CalculatePressureDropAcrossSump = columnOption.MakeBottomStageSump;
					reportSettings.IncludeStaticVaporHead = columnOption.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc;
				}
			}
			if (new PdfReporter(_container, _columnKey, text, _ranges).DoReport(reportSettings))
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		}

		public static EngineMessage GeTrayEngineMessage(int index, int messageVal)
		{
			string text = string.Format("IMESSAGES{0}_{1}_{2}", index, messageVal, "Section");
			string text2 = string.Format("IMESSAGES{0}_{1}_{2}", index, messageVal, "Tray");
			EngineMessage engineMessage = new EngineMessage();
			string text3 = TrayRatingResources.ResourceManager.GetString(text);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
			{
				text3 = TrayRatingResources.ResourceManager.GetString(text2);
				engineMessage.MessageType = EngineTrayMessageType.Tray;
				engineMessage.MessageResourceKey = text2;
			}
			else
			{
				engineMessage.MessageType = EngineTrayMessageType.Section;
				engineMessage.MessageResourceKey = text;
			}
			engineMessage.Message = text3;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(engineMessage.Message))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return engineMessage;
		}

		public static EngineMessage GetPackingEngineMessage(int index, int messageVal)
		{
			string text = string.Format("PackMessage_{0}_{1}_{2}", index, messageVal, "Section");
			string text2 = string.Format("PackMessage_{0}_{1}_{2}", index, messageVal, "Tray");
			EngineMessage engineMessage = new EngineMessage();
			string text3 = PackingResources.ResourceManager.GetString(text);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
			{
				text3 = PackingResources.ResourceManager.GetString(text2);
				engineMessage.MessageType = EngineTrayMessageType.Tray;
				engineMessage.MessageResourceKey = text2;
			}
			else
			{
				engineMessage.MessageType = EngineTrayMessageType.Section;
				engineMessage.MessageResourceKey = text;
			}
			engineMessage.Message = text3;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(engineMessage.Message))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return engineMessage;
		}

		{

			_PropImageSourceMap = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();
			_uriDictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		private static void InitAppImage()
		{

			_PropImageSourceMap.Add("CarouselNoData", CarouselNoData);

			_uriDictionary.Add("ZoomIn", ZoomIn);
		}

		public static ImageSource GetResouceImageByPropertyName(string imagePropertyName)
		{
			if (_PropImageSourceMap.ContainsKey(imagePropertyName))
			{
				return _PropImageSourceMap[imagePropertyName];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static ImageSource GetImageSource(string imageFileName)
		{
			if (!_imageSources.ContainsKey(imageFileName))
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append("pack://application:,,,/");
				stringBuilder.Append(AssemblyFullName);
				stringBuilder.Append(";component/Images/");
				stringBuilder.Append(imageFileName);
				try
				{
					BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage(new Uri(stringBuilder.ToString(), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute));
					if (bitmapImage.CanFreeze)
					{
						bitmapImage.Freeze();
					}
					_imageSources.Add(imageFileName, bitmapImage);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					_ = ex.Message;
					_imageSources.Add(imageFileName, null);
				}
			}
			return _imageSources[imageFileName];
		}

		private static string GetImageUri(string imageName)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (!_uriDictionary.ContainsKey(imageName))
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append("pack://application:,,,/");
				stringBuilder.Append(AssemblyFullName);
				stringBuilder.Append(";component/Images/");
				stringBuilder.Append(imageName);
				empty = stringBuilder.ToString();
				_uriDictionary.Add(imageName, empty);
			}
			else
			{
				empty = _uriDictionary[imageName];
			}
			return empty;
		}
	}

		public string MessageDetail
		{
			get
			{
				string result = string.Empty;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_MessageDetail))
				{
					result = "";
				}
				else
				{
					string text = string.Empty;
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					if (ShowTrayNumber)
					{
						if (StageNumber > 0 && StageNumber != 99999999)
						{
							text = GetDisplayStageNumber(StageNumber).ToString();
						}
						else if (_MessageDetail.Contains("{0}") && StageNumber == 99999999)
						{
							text = GetTrayNumberString();
						}
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						list.Add(text);
					}
					if (SimulatorDataProvider != null && SourceRealData != null && SourceRealData.Count > 0)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < SourceRealData.Count; i++)
						{
							string format = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Format)) ? Format : "g4");
							list.Add(SourceRealData[i].GetDisplayValueWithUnit(SimulatorDataProvider, format, ApplicationType));
						}
					}
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						try
						{
							string messageDetail = _MessageDetail;
							object[] args = list.ToArray();
							result = string.Format(messageDetail, args);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
					else
					{
						result = _MessageDetail;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private string GetTrayNumberString()
		{
			if (StageNumbers == null || StageNumbers.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (StageNumbers.Count == 1)
			{
				return GetDisplayStageNumber(StageNumbers[0]).ToString();
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			SortedList<int, int> sortedList = new SortedList<int, int>();
			foreach (int stageNumber in StageNumbers)
			{
				int displayStageNumber = GetDisplayStageNumber(stageNumber);
				sortedList.Add(displayStageNumber, displayStageNumber);
			}
			List<int> list = sortedList.Keys.ToList();
			List<List<int>> list2 = new List<List<int>>();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			do
			{
				List<int> list3 = new List<int>();
				list2.Add(list3);
				for (int i = num; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (num == i)
					{
						list3.Add(list[i]);
						num2++;
						continue;
					}
					if (list[i] - list[i - 1] == 1)
					{
						list3.Add(list[i]);
						num2++;
						continue;
					}
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			while (num2 != list.Count);
			for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
			{
				List<int> list4 = list2[j];
				if (j > 0 && list4.Count > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text = ((list4.Count != 1) ? ((list4.Count != 2) ? (text + list4[0] + " - " + list4[list4.Count - 1]) : (text + list4[0] + ", " + list4[1])) : (text + list4[0]));
			}
			return text;
		}

		public int GetDisplayStageNumber(int stageNumber)
		{
			if (_IsTopDownNumbering)
			{
				return stageNumber;
			}
			return ColumnStartStage + ColumnEndStage - stageNumber;
		}

		public void UpdateMessage()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("MessageDetail");
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

	public class CAMessagesManager
	{
		private XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>> _MsgColl = new XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>>();

		private Dictionary<string, XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>>> _MsgDictionary = new Dictionary<string, XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>>>();

		private IUnityContainer _Container;

		private bool logFileCreated;

		private string path = string.Empty;

		public bool ShowErroMessage { get; set; }

		internal CAMessagesManager(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			_Container = container;
		}

		internal void AddMessage(string sConfigOption, string sectionKey, MessageType messageType, MessageCatalog catalog, string description)
		{
			AddMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, messageType, catalog, description, 99999999);
		}

		internal void AddMessage(string sConfigOption, string sectionKey, MessageType messageType, MessageCatalog catalog, string description, int trayNumber)
		{
			CAMessage msg = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, messageType, catalog, description, trayNumber);
			AddMessage(msg);
		}

		internal void AddMessage(CAMessage msg)
		{
			string configOptionKey = msg.ConfigOptionKey;
			string sectionKey = msg.SectionKey;
			_ = msg.MessageType;
			string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(configOptionKey, sectionKey);
			if (_MsgColl.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				_MsgColl[key].Add(msg);
				return;
			}
			_MsgColl[key] = new List<CAMessage>();
			_MsgColl[key].Add(msg);
		}

		internal List<CAMessage> GetSectionMessages(string secKey)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(secKey))
			{
				if (_MsgColl.ContainsKey(secKey))
				{
					return _MsgColl[secKey];
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal List<CAMessage> GetSectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach(string secKey)
		{
			List<CAMessage> list = new List<CAMessage>();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(secKey))
			{
				if (_MsgColl.ContainsKey(secKey))
				{
					foreach (CAMessage item in _MsgColl[secKey])
					{
						if (item.StageNumber == 99999999 && item.MessageCatalog != MessageCatalog.CAComponent)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					return list;
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal List<CAMessage> GetSectionMessages(string secKey, MessageType messageType, MessageCatalog catalog)
		{
			List<CAMessage> sectionMessages = GetSectionMessages(secKey);
			List<CAMessage> result = null;
			if (sectionMessages != null)
			{
				result = ((catalog == MessageCatalog.All) ? sectionMessages.Where((CAMessage o) => o.MessageType == messageType).ToList() : sectionMessages.Where((CAMessage o) => o.MessageType == messageType && o.MessageCatalog == catalog).ToList());
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void CleanSectionMessage(string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			if (_MsgColl.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				_MsgColl.Remove(key);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateCAMessageWhenColumnNumberingChanged(bool isTopDownNumbering)
		{
			if (_MsgColl == null || _MsgColl.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<CAMessage>> item in _MsgColl)
			{
				if (item.Value == null || _MsgColl.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CAMessage item2 in item.Value)
				{
					item2.IsTopDownNumbering = isTopDownNumbering;
				}
				PublishEvent();
			}
		}

		internal void TriggerUpdateMessageEvent()
		{
			PublishEvent();
		}

		private void PublishEvent()
		{
			IEventAggregator val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<CAMessage>> item in _MsgColl)
			{
				List<CAMessage> sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach = GetSectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach(item.Key);
				if (sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach != null && sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach.Count > 0)
				{
					CAMessageEventArgs e = new CAMessageEventArgs();
					e.OptionKey = sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach[0].ConfigOptionKey;
					e.SectionKey = sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach[0].SectionKey;
					e.AllSectionMessages = sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach;
					((CompositePresentationEvent<CAMessageEventArgs>)(object)val.GetEvent<CAMessageEvent>()).Publish(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public void PublishMessage(string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			string secKey = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			List<CAMessage> sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach = GetSectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach(secKey);
			CAMessageEventArgs e = new CAMessageEventArgs
			{
				OptionKey = sConfigOption,
				SectionKey = sectionKey,
				AllSectionMessages = sectionMessagesWithoutTraysAndAppoach
			};
			((CompositePresentationEvent<CAMessageEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<CAMessageEvent>()).Publish(e);
		}

		public void LogMessage(string message)
		{
		}

		private void WriteMessageToLog(string message)
		{
			FileStream fileStream;
			if (logFileCreated)
			{
				fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Append);
			}
			else
			{
				path = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(Process.GetCurrentProcess().MainModule.FileName);
				path = path + "\\CallSteps" + DateTime.Now.Month + DateTime.Now.Day + DateTime.Now.Minute + DateTime.Now.Second + ".txt";
				if (File.Exists(path))
				{
					File.Delete(path);
				}
				fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.CreateNew);
				logFileCreated = true;
			}
			StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(fileStream);
			streamWriter.WriteLine(message);
			streamWriter.Close();
			fileStream.Close();
		}

		public string GetMessageXmlStr()
		{
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = CADataHelper.SerializeToXml(_MsgColl);
			if (xmlDocument != null)
			{
				return xmlDocument.InnerXml;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public void RestoreMessage(string xmlMessages, ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorDataProvider, ApplicationType applicationType)
		{
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			xmlDocument.LoadXml(xmlMessages);
			XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>> xmlSerializableDictionary = null;
			try
			{
				using TextReader textReader = new StringReader(xmlDocument.InnerXml);
				xmlSerializableDictionary = new XmlSerializer(typeof(XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>>)).Deserialize(textReader) as XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>>;
			}
			catch
			{
				xmlSerializableDictionary = null;
			}
			if (xmlSerializableDictionary == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_MsgColl = xmlSerializableDictionary;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<CAMessage>> item in _MsgColl)
			{
				foreach (CAMessage item2 in item.Value)
				{
					item2.SimulatorDataProvider = simulatorDataProvider;
					item2.ApplicationType = applicationType;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateMessagesWhenActiveDocumentChanged(string currentCaseFilePath, string lastCaseFilePath)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastCaseFilePath))
			{
				_MsgDictionary[lastCaseFilePath] = _MsgColl;
			}
			if (_MsgDictionary.ContainsKey(currentCaseFilePath))
			{
				_MsgColl = _MsgDictionary[currentCaseFilePath];
			}
			else
			{
				_MsgColl = new XmlSerializableDictionary<string, List<CAMessage>>();
			}
		}

		internal void CleanMessageDicionaryWhenDocumentClosed(string CaseFilePath)
		{
			if (_MsgDictionary.ContainsKey(CaseFilePath))
			{
				_MsgDictionary.Remove(CaseFilePath);
			}
			else if (CaseFilePath == "")
			{
				_MsgDictionary.Clear();
			}
			_MsgColl.Clear();
		}
	}

	public class CAExportEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public string CaseName { get; set; }

		public string ExportType { get; set; }

	public class ExportToKGTowerDialogViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private IUnityContainer _container;

		private CAOption _cAOption;

		private IList<CASectionRange> _sectionRangeList;

		private IList<int> _feedStages = new List<int>();

		private IList<int> _drawStages = new List<int>();

		private IList<string> _sections;

		private string _selectSection = Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_All;

		private string _SelectUptoFiveToExport = "Select up to five trays to export";

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider _simulatorCADataProvider;

		private Dictionary<string, SimSectionDataBase> _sectionRangeAndSectionDataDic;

		private SectionEqualityComparer _sectionEqualityComparer = new SectionEqualityComparer();

		private ObservableCollection<ExportStageInfo> _exportStageInfos;

		private string _exportKGTowerButtonTooltip;

		private ICommand _exportKGTowerCommand;

		private IList<CASectionRange> SectionRangeList
		{
			get
			{
				if (_sectionRangeList == null)
				{
					_sectionRangeList = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_cAOption.OptionKey);
				}
				return _sectionRangeList;
			}
		}

		public ColumnInternalsData ColumnInternalsData { get; set; }

		{

				NotifyPropertyChanged("SelectedSection");

		}

				{

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ExportToKGTowerDialogViewModel(IUnityContainer container, CAOption cAOption)
		{
			_container = container;
			_exportStageInfos = new ObservableCollection<ExportStageInfo>();
			_cAOption = cAOption;
			_sectionRangeAndSectionDataDic = new Dictionary<string, SimSectionDataBase>();
			_simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
		}

		public void InitializeData()
		{
			if (ColumnInternalsData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			InitializeFeedAndDrawStageCollections();
			if (ExportStageInfos.Count > 0)
			{
				ExportStageInfos.Clear();
			}
			UpdateDataGridData();
			if (Sections != null && Sections.Count > 0)
			{
				Sections.Clear();
			}
			IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(_cAOption.OptionKey);
			IList<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (CASectionRange item in sectionsRange)
			{
				list.Add(item.SectionName);
			}
			Sections = list;
			SelectedSection = list[0];
		}

		private bool IsStageInOneOption(int stageNumber)
		{
			if (SectionRangeList != null && SectionRangeList.Count > 0)
			{
				if (SelectedSection == Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_All)
				{
					foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange in SectionRangeList)
					{
						if (stageNumber >= sectionRange.StartStageNumber && stageNumber <= sectionRange.EndStageNumber)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CASectionRange cASectionRange = null;
					foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange2 in SectionRangeList)
					{
						if (SelectedSection == sectionRange2.SectionName)
						{
							cASectionRange = sectionRange2;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (stageNumber >= cASectionRange.StartStageNumber && stageNumber <= cASectionRange.EndStageNumber)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsStageFeedOrDraw(int stageNumber)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (_feedStages.Contains(stageNumber))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			else if (_drawStages.Contains(stageNumber))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void InitializeFeedAndDrawStageCollections()
		{
			if (_feedStages.Count > 0)
			{
				_feedStages.Clear();
			}
			if (_drawStages.Count > 0)
			{
				_drawStages.Clear();
			}
			foreach (CAStream feed in ColumnInternalsData.Feeds)
			{
				_feedStages.Add(feed.Stage.Value);
			}
			foreach (CAStream product in ColumnInternalsData.Products)
			{
				_drawStages.Add(product.Stage.Value);
			}
		}

		private CASectionRange GetStageSectionRange(int stageNumber)
		{
			CASectionRange result = null;
			foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange in SectionRangeList)
			{
				if (stageNumber >= sectionRange.StartStageNumber && stageNumber <= sectionRange.EndStageNumber)
				{
					result = sectionRange;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateDataGridData()
		{
			if (ExportStageInfos.Count > 0)
			{
				ExportStageInfos.Clear();
			}
			new List<int>();
			foreach (CAStage stage in ColumnInternalsData.Stages)
			{
				if (IsStageInOneOption(stage.StageNum.Value))
				{
					ExportStageInfo exportStageInfo = new ExportStageInfo();
					exportStageInfo.StageNumber = stage.StageNum.Value;
					exportStageInfo.IsFeedOrDraw = (IsStageFeedOrDraw(exportStageInfo.StageNumber) ? Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Yes : Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_No);
					CASectionRange stageSectionRange = GetStageSectionRange(stage.StageNum.Value);
					bool flag = stageSectionRange.StageType == StageType.TrayRating || stageSectionRange.StageType == StageType.TraySizing || stageSectionRange.StageType == StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine || stageSectionRange.StageType == StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine;
					exportStageInfo.InternalType = (flag ? Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Tray : Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Packing);
					if (!flag)
					{
						SelectUptoFiveToExport = Resources.SelectUpToFiveStages;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectUptoFiveToExport = Resources.SelectUpToFiveTrays;
					}
					exportStageInfo.IsExport = false;
					ExportStageInfos.Add(exportStageInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		private SimSectionDataBase GetStageSection(int stageNumber, CAOption cAOption)
		{
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionDataBase = null;
			if (_sectionRangeList == null)
			{
				_sectionRangeList = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(cAOption.OptionKey);
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange in _sectionRangeList)
			{
				if (stageNumber >= sectionRange.StartStageNumber && stageNumber <= sectionRange.EndStageNumber)
				{
					text = sectionRange.SectionKey;
					break;
				}
			}
			_simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaults(cAOption.OptionKey, text, RunOption.No);
			if (!_sectionRangeAndSectionDataDic.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				simSectionDataBase = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(cAOption.OptionKey, text);
				_sectionRangeAndSectionDataDic.Add(text, simSectionDataBase);
			}
			else
			{
				simSectionDataBase = _sectionRangeAndSectionDataDic[text];
			}
			return simSectionDataBase;
		}

		private bool CanDoExport(object arg)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void DoExport(object obj)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int bContinue = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (ExportStageInfo exportStageInfo in ExportStageInfos)
			{
				if (exportStageInfo.IsExport)
				{
					num++;
					list.Add(exportStageInfo.StageNumber);
				}
			}
			if (num > 5)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_5StagesLimit, Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Error, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				return;
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_0StagesSelected, Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Error, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				return;
			}
			KGTowerExport kGTowerExport = new KGTowerExport(_container);
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			string sectionKey = string.Empty;
			foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange in SectionRangeList)
			{
				if (SelectedSection == sectionRange.SectionName)
				{
					sectionKey = sectionRange.SectionKey;
					break;
				}
			}
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(_cAOption.OptionKey, sectionKey);
			if (simSectionData != null && simSectionData is CATraySectionData)
			{
				if (((CATraySectionData)simSectionData).IsMDTray == true)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (((CATraySectionData)simSectionData).IsCustomTray == true)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_MDTrayWarning, SelectedSection), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_CustomTrayWarning, SelectedSection), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
				return;
			}
			flag = kGTowerExport.ValidateExportToKGFile(ColumnInternalsData, _cAOption, list, list2, flag2, flag3, ref bContinue);
			if (bContinue == 2)
			{
				AssociateWindow.Close();
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Forms.SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new System.Windows.Forms.SaveFileDialog();
			saveFileDialog.Title = Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Export;
			saveFileDialog.AddExtension = true;
			saveFileDialog.DefaultExt = "kgt";
			saveFileDialog.Filter = "KGTower files (*.kgt)|*.kgt";
			saveFileDialog.FileName = VendorExportHelper.GenerateDefaultFileName(_simulatorCADataProvider.GetCurrentCaseName(), ColumnInternalsData.FullColumnName, _cAOption.OptionName);
			DialogResult dialogResult = saveFileDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK || dialogResult == DialogResult.Yes)
			{
				string fileName = saveFileDialog.FileName;
				VendorExportHelper.ExportDataToTxt(saveFileDialog.FileName, list2);
				if (flag)
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Success, Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_Success, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Asterisk);
				}
				else
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Warning, Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_Success, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Asterisk);
				}
				AssociateWindow.DialogResult = true;
				AssociateWindow.Close();
				NativeHelper.OpenFileInWindowsExplorerWithSelection(fileName);
			}
		}

		public void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

			foreach (CAOption columnCAOption in ColumnCAOptionList)

					break;
