		private bool CanDoRadioButton_Command(object arg)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void DoRadioButton_Command(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is System.Windows.Controls.RadioButton radioButton))
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnVendorName num = (ColumnVendorName)radioButton.Tag;
			IsFri = 0;
			if (num == ColumnVendorName.FRI)
			{
				IsOptionSelectComboBoxCanbeUsed = false;
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo != null)
				{
					if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
					{
						IsFri = 1;
						IsOptionSelectComboBoxCanbeUsed = true;
					}
					else
					{
						IsFri = 2;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IsOptionSelectComboBoxCanbeUsed = true;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged("SelectOptionsVisible");
		}

		private bool CanDoExport(object arg)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void DoExport(object obj)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedOption))
			{
				return;
			}
			CAOption cAOption = ColumnCAOptionList.First((CAOption o) => o.OptionName == SelectedOption);
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(cAOption.OptionKey);
			if (columnInternalsData == null)
			{
				System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.Export_NO_Data, cAOption.OptionKey), Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToSulCol_Error, MessageBoxButton.OK);
				return;
			}
			ColumnVendorName columnVendorName = (ColumnVendorName)obj;
			System.Windows.Forms.SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new System.Windows.Forms.SaveFileDialog();
			saveFileDialog.Title = Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_Export;
			saveFileDialog.AddExtension = true;
			string defaultExportFilePath = SimulatorCADataProvider.GetDefaultExportFilePath();
			saveFileDialog.InitialDirectory = defaultExportFilePath;
			switch (columnVendorName)
			{
			case ColumnVendorName.KGTower:
			{
				ExportToKGTowerDialogViewModel exportToKGTowerDialogViewModel = new ExportToKGTowerDialogViewModel(_unityContainer, cAOption);
				exportToKGTowerDialogViewModel.ColumnInternalsData = columnInternalsData;
				exportToKGTowerDialogViewModel.InitializeData();
				ExportToKGTowerDialog exportToKGTowerDialog = new ExportToKGTowerDialog(_unityContainer);
				ICAHelp iCAHelp = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ICAHelp>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (iCAHelp != null)
				{
					iCAHelp.SetHelpFile(exportToKGTowerDialog, HelpFile);
					iCAHelp.SetHelpId(exportToKGTowerDialog, KGTowerHelpID);
				}
				exportToKGTowerDialog.DataContext = exportToKGTowerDialogViewModel;
				exportToKGTowerDialog.Owner = AssociateWindow;
				exportToKGTowerDialogViewModel.AssociateWindow = exportToKGTowerDialog;
				bool? flag2 = exportToKGTowerDialog.ShowDialog();
				if (flag2.HasValue && flag2.Value)
				{
					AssociateWindow.Close();
				}
				break;
			}
			case ColumnVendorName.FRI:
				foreach (string sectionsKey in simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsKeys(cAOption.OptionKey))
				{
					SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(cAOption.OptionKey, sectionsKey);
					if (simSectionData != null && simSectionData is CATraySectionData && ((CATraySectionData)simSectionData).IsMDTray == true)
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_MDTrayWarning, simSectionData.Name), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
						return;
					}
					if (simSectionData != null && simSectionData is CATraySectionData && ((CATraySectionData)simSectionData).IsCustomTray == true)
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_CustomTrayWarning, simSectionData.Name), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
						return;
					}
				}
				saveFileDialog.DefaultExt = "xml";
				saveFileDialog.Filter = "XML files (*.xml)|*.xml";
				saveFileDialog.FileName = VendorExportHelper.GenerateDefaultFileName(SimulatorCADataProvider.GetCurrentCaseName(), columnInternalsData.FullColumnName);
				if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.OK)
				{
					IEventAggregator obj2 = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					CAExportEventArgs e = new CAExportEventArgs(saveFileDialog.FileName)
					{
						ColumnOption = SelectedOption,
						OpenFileInWindowsExplorerWithSelectionAfterExportAction = NativeHelper.OpenFileInWindowsExplorerWithSelection,
						CloseExportDialogue = CloseExportDialogue
					};
					((CompositePresentationEvent<CAExportEventArgs>)(object)obj2.GetEvent<CAExportEvent>()).Publish(e);
				}
				break;
			case ColumnVendorName.SulCol:
			{
				SulColExport sulColExport = new SulColExport(_unityContainer);
				int bContinue = 0;
				bool flag = false;
				flag = sulColExport.ValidateExportToSulColFile(columnInternalsData, cAOption, ref bContinue);
				if (!flag && bContinue == 2)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (bContinue == 2)
				{
					AssociateWindow.Close();
					break;
				}
				saveFileDialog.DefaultExt = "sulcol";
				saveFileDialog.Filter = "SulCol files (*.sulcol)|*.sulcol";
				saveFileDialog.FileName = VendorExportHelper.GenerateDefaultFileName(SimulatorCADataProvider.GetCurrentCaseName(), columnInternalsData.FullColumnName, SelectedOption);
				DialogResult dialogResult = saveFileDialog.ShowDialog();
				if (dialogResult != DialogResult.OK && dialogResult != DialogResult.Yes)
				{
					break;
				}
				string fileName = saveFileDialog.FileName;
				sulColExport.ExportToSulColFile(fileName);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedOption))
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToSulCol_Success, Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_Success, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Asterisk);
					}
					else
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToSulcol_Warning, Resources.ColumnAnalysisExport_Success, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Asterisk);
					}
					AssociateWindow.Close();
					NativeHelper.OpenFileInWindowsExplorerWithSelection(fileName);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void CloseExportDialogue()
		{
			if (AssociateWindow != null)
			{
				AssociateWindow.Close();
			}
		}

		public void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	public class KGTowerExport
	{
		private const double CF_KGM3TOKGDM3 = 0.001;

		private IUnityContainer _container;

		private Dictionary<SimSectionDataBase, List<int>> _sectionStagesDic;

		private SectionEqualityComparer _sectionEqualityComparer = new SectionEqualityComparer();

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider _simulatorCADataProvider;

		private IList<CASectionRange> _sectionRangeList;

		private int _zoneCount;

		private Dictionary<CAPackingType, KGTOWERPackingType> _packingTypeMap = new Dictionary<CAPackingType, KGTOWERPackingType>();

		private Dictionary<string, int> _packingINDXMap = new Dictionary<string, int>(_stringEqualityComparer);

		private Dictionary<string, string> _packingDimensionSizeMap = new Dictionary<string, string>(_stringEqualityComparer);

		private static StringEqualityComparer _stringEqualityComparer = new StringEqualityComparer();

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider SimulatorCADataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (_simulatorCADataProvider == null)
				{
					_simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				return _simulatorCADataProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				_simulatorCADataProvider = value;
			}
		}

		public KGTowerExport(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			_container = container;
			_sectionStagesDic = new Dictionary<SimSectionDataBase, List<int>>(_sectionEqualityComparer);
			BuildPackingTypeMap();
			BuildPackingINDXMap();
			BuildPackingDimensionSizeMap();
		}

		public bool ValidateExportToKGFile(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption cAOption, List<int> selectedTrays, List<string> strsKGTower, bool isMDTray, bool isCustomTray, ref int bContinue)
		{
			int bWarning = 0;
			WriteHeader(strsKGTower);
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (int selectedTray in selectedTrays)
			{
				SimSectionDataBase stageSection = GetStageSection(selectedTray, cAOption);
				if (stageSection != null)
				{
					if (!_sectionStagesDic.ContainsKey(stageSection))
					{
						list.Add(selectedTray);
						_sectionStagesDic.Add(stageSection, list);
						list = new List<int>();
					}
					else
					{
						_sectionStagesDic[stageSection].Add(selectedTray);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SimSectionDataBase, List<int>> item in _sectionStagesDic)
			{
				SimSectionDataBase key = item.Key;
				if (key is CAPackingSectionData)
				{
					if (!WritePakcingSection(strsKGTower, columnData, key as CAPackingSectionData, item.Value, ref bContinue))
					{
						bWarning = 1;
						if (bContinue == 2)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					WriteTraySection(strsKGTower, columnData, key as CATraySectionData, isMDTray, isCustomTray, item.Value, ref bWarning, ref bContinue);
					if (bContinue == 2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			strsKGTower.Add("$ENDF");
			if (bWarning == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SimSectionDataBase GetStageSection(int stageNumber, CAOption cAOption)
		{
			if (_sectionRangeList == null)
			{
				_sectionRangeList = SimulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(cAOption.OptionKey);
			}
			string sectionKey = string.Empty;
			foreach (CASectionRange sectionRange in _sectionRangeList)
			{
				if (stageNumber >= sectionRange.StartStageNumber && stageNumber <= sectionRange.EndStageNumber)
				{
					sectionKey = sectionRange.SectionKey;
					break;
				}
			}
			SimulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaults(cAOption.OptionKey, sectionKey, RunOption.Always);
			return _simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(cAOption.OptionKey, sectionKey);
		}

		private void WriteHeader(List<string> strsKGTower)
		{
			strsKGTower.Add("VERSION = KG-TOWER(4.0)");
			strsKGTower.Add("MRUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("DSUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("DSLI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("VVUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("LVUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("SPUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("SRUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("TMUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("PRUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("PHUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("MDUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("ARUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("TLUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("THUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("VDUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("TDUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("BKUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("PDUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("WLUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("CFUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("EVUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("FSUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("CVUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("QLUI = 0");
			strsKGTower.Add("PPUI = 3");
			strsKGTower.Add("GIDX(0) = 47");
		}

		private bool WritePakcingSection(List<string> strsKGTower, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAPackingSectionData caPackingSec, List<int> selectedTrays, ref int bContinue)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (columnData == null || strsKGTower == null || caPackingSec == null || selectedTrays == null || selectedTrays.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedTrays.Count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = selectedTrays[i];
				CAStage stageInfo = columnData.Stages[num2 - 1];
				strsKGTower.Add($"ZONE =  {_zoneCount}");
				if (!columnData.IsTopDownNumbering)
				{
					num2 = columnData.Stages.Count - num2 + 1;
				}
				strsKGTower.Add($"ZTBN = Stage {num2}");
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("TDPX = {0}", caPackingSec.Diameter.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("PKHT = {0}", (caPackingSec.GetSectionHeight().Value / (double)(caPackingSec.EndingStage.Value - caPackingSec.StartStage.Value + 1)).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				CAPackingType cAPackingType = (CAPackingType)Enum.ToObject(typeof(CAPackingType), caPackingSec.PackingType.Value);
				if ((cAPackingType == CAPackingType.CMR || cAPackingType == CAPackingType.SNOWFLAKE) && !caPackingSec.PackingVendor.EnumString.Equals("KOCH", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					if (num == 0)
					{
						bContinue = (int)System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_VendorNotSupported, caPackingSec.PackingVendor.EnumString), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
						num = 1;
						if (bContinue == 2)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (_packingTypeMap.ContainsKey(cAPackingType))
				{
					KGTOWERPackingType kgTowerPackingType = _packingTypeMap[cAPackingType];
					strsKGTower.Add($"ZDSC = {kgTowerPackingType.ToString()}");
					KGTowerMaterialType kGTowerMaterialType = GetKGTowerMaterialType(caPackingSec.PackingMaterial.EnumString);
					if (kGTowerMaterialType != KGTowerMaterialType.NotSupported)
					{
						if (_packingDimensionSizeMap.ContainsKey(caPackingSec.PackingDimension.EnumString))
						{
							string kgTowerPackingSize = _packingDimensionSizeMap[caPackingSec.PackingDimension.EnumString];
							if (!MapINDXFromPackingSize(strsKGTower, kgTowerPackingSize, kgTowerPackingType, kGTowerMaterialType) && num == 0)
							{
								bContinue = (int)System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_MappingNotSupportedByKGTower, cAPackingType, caPackingSec.PackingMaterial.EnumString, caPackingSec.PackingDimension.EnumString), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
								num = 1;
								if (bContinue == 2)
								{
									break;
								}
							}
						}
						else if (num == 0)
						{
							bContinue = (int)System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_PackingSizeNotSupportedByKGTower, caPackingSec.PackingDimension.EnumString), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
							num = 1;
							if (bContinue == 2)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (num == 0)
				{
					bContinue = (int)System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.ColumnAnalysisExportToKGTower_PackingTypeNotSupported, cAPackingType), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
					num = 1;
					if (bContinue == 2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("SFXX =  {0}", caPackingSec.SystemFoamingFactor.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add("$ENDZONE");
				WriteStageInfo(strsKGTower, stageInfo);
				_zoneCount++;
			}
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool MapINDXFromPackingSize(List<string> strsKGTower, string kgTowerPackingSize, KGTOWERPackingType kgTowerPackingType, KGTowerMaterialType kgTowerPackingMaterial)
		{
			string key = GenerateMapkey(kgTowerPackingType, kgTowerPackingMaterial, kgTowerPackingSize);
			if (_packingINDXMap.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				int num = _packingINDXMap[key];
				strsKGTower.Add($"INDX = {num}");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void WriteTraySection(List<string> strsKGTower, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CATraySectionData caTraySection, bool isMDTray, bool isCustomTray, List<int> selectedTrays, ref int bWarning, ref int bContinue)
		{
			if (bWarning == 0 && !(caTraySection is CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection) && !(caTraySection is CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection) && !(caTraySection is CASieveTraySectionData))
			{
				string arg = caTraySection.CombinedInternalType.ToString().Replace('_', '-');
				bContinue = (int)System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(string.Format(Resources.CA_TrayTypeIncompatibleWithKGTower, arg), Resources.CA_Warning, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
				bWarning = 1;
				if (bContinue == 2)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (caTraySection.Diameter.Value < 1E+35)
			{
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("TDXX =  {0}", caTraySection.Diameter.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
			}
			if (!isMDTray && !isCustomTray)
			{
				strsKGTower.Add($"PASS =  {caTraySection.NumberofPasses.Value}");
				if (caTraySection.NumberofPasses.Value >= 3)
				{
					strsKGTower.Add("OCRL = 3");
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("OCWD =  {0}", (caTraySection.Downcomers[2] as OffCenterDowncomer).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				}
				else
				{
					strsKGTower.Add("OCRL = 0");
				}
				int trayType = 0;
				int valveType = 0;
				if (caTraySection is CASieveTraySectionData)
				{
					CASieveTraySectionData cASieveTraySectionData = caTraySection as CASieveTraySectionData;
					trayType = 11;
					valveType = 11;
					strsKGTower.Add($"VLVT =  {trayType}");
					strsKGTower.Add($"VLVN =  {valveType}");
					double value = cASieveTraySectionData.TrayLayout.HoleDiameter.Value;
					_ = cASieveTraySectionData.TrayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction.Value / (3.1415926 * value * value / 4.0);
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DVCX =  {0}", value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
					strsKGTower.Add($"PSUP =  {0}");
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("POPA =  {0}", (cASieveTraySectionData.TrayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction.Value * 100.0).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				}
				else if (caTraySection is CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection || caTraySection is CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)
				{
					ValveTrayLayout valveTrayLayout = null;
					if (caTraySection is CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)
					{
						valveTrayLayout = (caTraySection as CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection).TrayLayout;
					}
					else if (caTraySection is CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)
					{
						valveTrayLayout = (caTraySection as CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection).TrayLayout;
					}
					_ = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
					GetTrayTypeAndValveTypeIntValueForValveTray(caTraySection, ref trayType, ref valveType);
					strsKGTower.Add($"VLVT =  {trayType}");
					strsKGTower.Add($"VLVN =  {valveType}");
					strsKGTower.Add($"LUGA =  {valveTrayLayout.ValveThickness.Value switch
					{
						5 => 12, 
						4 => 14, 
						3 => 16, 
						2 => 18, 
						1 => 20, 
						_ => 10, 
					}}");
					int num = 29;
					double num2;
					switch (valveTrayLayout.ValveMaterial.Value)
					{
					case 2:
						num2 = 8009.23;
						break;
					case 3:
						num2 = 8858.2;
						break;
					case 4:
						num2 = 8810.15;
						break;
					case 5:
						num2 = 4533.22;
						break;
					case 6:
						num2 = 8970.33;
						break;
					case 7:
						num2 = 2691.1;
						break;
					case 8:
						num2 = 8970.33;
						break;
					case 9:
						num2 = 11341.0;
						break;
					case 1:
						num2 = 7849.0;
						num = 2;
						break;
					default:
						num2 = 0.0;
						break;
					}
					strsKGTower.Add($"MDNI =  {num}");
					double num3 = num2 * 0.001;
					strsKGTower.Add($"MDNV =  {num3}");
					strsKGTower.Add($"UNIT =  {valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value}");
					int kGTowerValveLegLength = GetKGTowerValveLegLength(valveTrayLayout.ValveLift.Value);
					strsKGTower.Add($"UCOD = {kGTowerValveLegLength}");
				}
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCWT(1) =  {0}", caTraySection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCWB(1) =  {0}", caTraySection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("HWOT(1) =  {0}", caTraySection.Weirs[0].Height.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCLX(1) =  {0}", caTraySection.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				double num4 = 0.0;
				double num5 = 0.0;
				double num6 = 0.0;
				double num7 = 0.0;
				if (caTraySection.NumberofPasses.Value == 2 || caTraySection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					num4 = caTraySection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
					num5 = caTraySection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				if (caTraySection.NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || caTraySection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					num6 = caTraySection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
					num7 = caTraySection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCWT(3) =  {0}", num4.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCWB(3) =  {0}", num5.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCWT(2) =  {0}", num6.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DCWB(2) =  {0}", num7.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				if (caTraySection.SweptBackENAB.Value != 0)
				{
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("RWSB =  {0}", caTraySection.SweptBackDimensionS.IsEmpty() ? "0.0" : caTraySection.SweptBackDimensionS.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				}
				if (caTraySection.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTraysIntValue.Value == 1)
				{
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WLOR(1) =  {0}", ((1.0 - caTraySection.Weirs[0].PicketingFraction.Value) * caTraySection.Weirs[0].Width.Value).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WLOR(4) =  {0}", ((1.0 - caTraySection.Weirs[3].PicketingFraction.Value) * caTraySection.Weirs[3].Width.Value).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WLOR(2) =  {0}", ((1.0 - caTraySection.Weirs[2].PicketingFraction.Value) * caTraySection.Weirs[2].Width.Value).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
					strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WLOR(3) =  {0}", ((1.0 - caTraySection.Weirs[1].PicketingFraction.Value) * caTraySection.Weirs[1].Width.Value).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				}
			}
			if (caTraySection.DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value != 5)
			{
				strsKGTower.Add($"TTHG =  {caTraySection.DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value switch
				{
					4 => 3, 
					2 => 12, 
					1 => 14, 
					_ => 10, 
				}}");
			}
			else
			{
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("THKN =  {0}", caTraySection.DeckThicknessRealValue.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
			}
			WriteTrays(strsKGTower, columnData, caTraySection, selectedTrays);
		}

		private int GetKGTowerValveLegLength(int p)
		{
			ValveLiftEnum valveLiftEnum = (ValveLiftEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(ValveLiftEnum), p);
			if ((uint)(valveLiftEnum - 1) <= 2u || valveLiftEnum != ValveLiftEnum.Z500IN)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 2;
		}

		private void GetTrayTypeAndValveTypeIntValueForValveTray(CATraySectionData cATraySectionData, ref int trayType, ref int valveType)
		{
			if (cATraySectionData is CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)
			{
				int value = (cATraySectionData as CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection).TrayLayout.GlitschValveType.Value;
				if ((uint)(value - 1) <= 1u)
				{
					trayType = 0;
					valveType = 0;
				}
			}
			else if (cATraySectionData is CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)
			{
				switch ((cATraySectionData as CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection).TrayLayout.KochValveType.Value)
				{
				case 3:
				case 4:
				case 7:
				case 13:
					trayType = 0;
					valveType = 0;
					break;
				case 5:
				case 6:
				case 8:
				case 14:
					trayType = 1;
					valveType = 1;
					break;
				case 9:
				case 12:
					trayType = 9;
					valveType = 24;
					break;
				case 10:
				case 11:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void WriteTrays(List<string> strsKGTower, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CATraySectionData caTraySec, List<int> selectedTrays)
		{
			if (columnData == null || strsKGTower == null || caTraySec == null || selectedTrays == null || selectedTrays.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedTrays.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = selectedTrays[i];
				CAStage stageInfo = columnData.Stages[num - 1];
				strsKGTower.Add($"ZONE =  {_zoneCount}");
				if (!columnData.IsTopDownNumbering)
				{
					num = columnData.Stages.Count - num + 1;
				}
				strsKGTower.Add($"ZDSC = {caTraySec.CombinedInternalType.ToString().Replace('_', '-')}");
				strsKGTower.Add($"ZTBN = {Resources.CA_Tray} {num}");
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("TSXX =  {0}", caTraySec.TraySpacing.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				WriteStageInfo(strsKGTower, stageInfo);
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("SFXX =  {0}", caTraySec.SystemFoamingFactor.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add("$ENDZONE");
				_zoneCount++;
			}
		}

		private void WriteStageInfo(List<string> strsKGTower, CAStage stageInfo)
		{
			if (strsKGTower != null && stageInfo != null)
			{
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WVXX =  {0}", (stageInfo.MassFlowVapor.Value * 3600.0).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WVID =  {0}", "0"));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WLXX =  {0}", (stageInfo.MassFlowLiquid.Value * 3600.0).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("WLID =  {0}", "0"));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DVXX =  {0}", stageInfo.DensityVapor.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DVID =  {0}", "0"));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DLXX =  {0}", stageInfo.DensityLiquid.Value.ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("DLID =  {0}", "0"));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("XMUV =  {0}", (stageInfo.ViscosityVapor.Value * 1000.0).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("XMUL =  {0}", (stageInfo.ViscosityLiquid.Value * 1000.0).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				strsKGTower.Add(string.Format("TAUX =  {0}", (stageInfo.SurfaceTension.Value * 1000.0).ToString("f4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
			}
		}

		private void BuildPackingDimensionSizeMap()
		{
			string[] array = new string[81]
			{
				"500Z(standard)", "500Z(highstrength)", "1T", "1.5T", "2T", "3T", "4T", "5T", "5TX", "700YAq.",
				"2Y(29°)", "2.2Y", "500Z", "700Y", "500Y", "1Y", "350Y", "1.6Y", "250Y", "2Y",
				"2.5Y", "3Y", "3.5Y", "4Y", "1X", "350X", "1.6X", "250X", "2X", "3X",
				"3.5X", "4X", "2.5YS", "3YS", "3.5YS", "4YS", "2.5XS", "3XS", "3.5XS", "4XS",
				"BX", "AX", "2-45", "3-45", "T", "A", "L", "O", "45", "64",
				"15", "25", "40", "50", "60", "70", "122", "28", "48", "88",
				"1", "1.5", "2", "2.5", "3", "4", "5", "1A", "2A", "3A",
				"3/4-IN", "0.75-IN", "0.625-IN", "5/8-IN", "1-IN", "1.5-IN", "2-IN", "3-IN", "3.5-IN", "4-IN",
				"II"
			};
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (!_packingDimensionSizeMap.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					_packingDimensionSizeMap.Add(text, text);
				}
			}
			array = new string[11]
			{
				"0.5-IN OR 13-MM", "0.25-IN OR 6-MM", "0.75-IN OR 19-MM", "0.375-IN OR 10-MM", "3.5-IN OR 90-MM", "1.25-IN OR 30-MM", "0.6-IN OR 15-MM", "1.375-IN OR 35-MM", "1.6-IN OR 40-MM", "0.875-IN OR 20-MM",
				"4-IN OR 100-MM"
			};
			foreach (string text2 in array)
			{
				if (!_packingDimensionSizeMap.ContainsKey(text2))
				{
					int length = text2.IndexOf(" ");
					string value = text2.Substring(0, length);
					_packingDimensionSizeMap.Add(text2, value);
				}
			}
			array = new string[6] { "NO-1", "NO-2", "NO-3", "NO-1A", "NO-2A", "NO-3A" };
			foreach (string text3 in array)
			{
				if (!_packingDimensionSizeMap.ContainsKey(text3))
				{
					string[] array2 = text3.Split('-');
					_packingDimensionSizeMap.Add(text3, array2[1]);
				}
			}
			string[] array3 = new string[10] { "1YHC", "2YHC", "Style-2", "Style-3", "40-MM", "0.625-IN OR 16-MM", "1-IN OR 25-MM", "1.5-IN OR 38-MM", "2-IN OR 50-MM", "3-IN OR 75-MM" };
			string[] array4 = new string[10] { "1Y", "2Y(29°)", "2-45", "3-45", "A", "15", "25", "40", "50", "70" };
			int num = -1;
			array = array3;
			foreach (string key in array)
			{
				num++;
				if (!_packingDimensionSizeMap.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					_packingDimensionSizeMap.Add(key, array4[num]);
				}
			}
		}

		private KGTowerMaterialType GetKGTowerMaterialType(string p)
		{
			if (p.Equals("PLASTIC"))
			{
				return KGTowerMaterialType.Plastic;
			}
			if (p.Equals("CERAMIC"))
			{
				return KGTowerMaterialType.Ceramic;
			}
			if (p.Equals("METAL"))
			{
				return KGTowerMaterialType.Metal;
			}
			return KGTowerMaterialType.NotSupported;
		}

		private string GenerateMapkey(KGTOWERPackingType kgTOWERPackingType, KGTowerMaterialType materialType, string packingSize)
		{
			return $"{kgTOWERPackingType}_{materialType}_{packingSize}";
		}

		public static void OpenFileInWindowsExplorerWithSelection(string fileFullPath)
		{
			IntPtr ppv = IntPtr.Zero;
			CoCreateInstance(ref CLSID_ShellLink, IntPtr.Zero, CLSCTX.INPROC_SERVER, ref IID_IShellLink, out ppv);
			IShellLinkW obj = Marshal.GetObjectForIUnknown(ppv) as IShellLinkW;
			obj.SetPath(fileFullPath);
			IntPtr ppidl = IntPtr.Zero;
			obj.GetIDList(out ppidl);
			SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems(ppidl, 0u, null, 0u);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(ppidl);
			Marshal.Release(ppv);
		}
	}

	internal class StringEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<string>
	{
		public bool Equals(string x, string y)
		{
			if (string.Equals(x, y, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(string obj)
		{
			return obj.ToLowerInvariant().GetHashCode();
		}

		private bool WriteContentToRecords(string content, bool wrap)
		{
			if (wrap)
			{
				_recordsBuilder.Append(content + "\r\n");
			}
			else
			{
				_recordsBuilder.Append(content);
			}
			_lines++;
			return true;
		}

		private string GetTrayType(CATraySectionData traySectionData)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (traySectionData is CANutterFloatValveTraySection)
			{
				switch ((traySectionData as CANutterFloatValveTraySection).TrayLayout.NutterValveType.Value)
				{
				case 11:
					result = "BDH";
					break;
				case 10:
					result = "BDP";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetValveThickness(int p)
		{
			return EnumHeper.GetDoubleOfValveThicknessEnum((GlitschBallastValveThicknessEnum)Enum.Parse(typeof(GlitschBallastValveThicknessEnum), p.ToString(), ignoreCase: true));
		}

		private string GetValveMaterial(int p)
		{
			return (ValveMaterialEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(ValveMaterialEnum), p) switch
			{
				ValveMaterialEnum.ALUMINUM => "Aluminum", 
				ValveMaterialEnum.MONEL => "Monel", 
				ValveMaterialEnum.COPPER => "Copper", 
				ValveMaterialEnum.CS => "Carbon Steel", 
				ValveMaterialEnum.TI => "Titanium Gr. 1", 
				_ => "Other...", 
			};
		}

		private double GetValveLiftDoubleValue(int p)
		{
			return (NutterFloatValveLiftEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(NutterFloatValveLiftEnum), p) switch
			{
				NutterFloatValveLiftEnum.Z375IN => 0.375, 
				NutterFloatValveLiftEnum.Z438IN => 0.4375, 
				NutterFloatValveLiftEnum.Z500IN => 0.5, 
				_ => 0.3125, 
			};
		}

		private bool IsSulColInstalled()
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void MakeSureSectionType(SimSectionDataBase section, out CATraySectionData traySectionData, out CAPackingSectionData packingSectionData)
		{
			if (section is CATraySectionData)
			{
				_sectionType = SectionType.Tray;
				traySectionData = section as CATraySectionData;
				packingSectionData = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_sectionType = SectionType.Packing;
				traySectionData = null;
				packingSectionData = section as CAPackingSectionData;
			}
		}
	}
	public enum SectionType
	{
		Tray,
		Packing
	}
	public class VendorExportHelper
	{
		private IUnityContainer _container;

		private ISimulatorCADataProvider _simulatorCADataProvider;

		public IUnityContainer Container
		{
			get
			{
				return _container;
			}
			set
			{
				_container = value;
			}
		}

		public ISimulatorCADataProvider SimulatorCADataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (_container == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_simulatorCADataProvider == null)
				{
					_simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				return _simulatorCADataProvider;
			}
		}

		public static bool ExportDataToTxt(string fileName, List<string> sourceStrs)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName) || sourceStrs == null || sourceStrs.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (File.Exists(fileName))
			{
				try
				{
					File.Delete(fileName);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				using FileStream stream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
				using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream, Encoding.Default);
				foreach (string sourceStr in sourceStrs)
				{
					streamWriter.WriteLine(sourceStr);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static string GenerateDefaultFileName(string caseName, string ColumnName, string optionName)
		{
			return $"{caseName}_{ColumnName}_{optionName}";
		}

		public static string GenerateDefaultFileName(string caseName, string ColumnName)
		{
			return $"{caseName}_{ColumnName}";
		}

		public bool SaveExportedFile(string fileName, StringBuilder content)
		{
			if (File.Exists(fileName))
			{
				try
				{
					File.Delete(fileName);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				using FileStream stream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
				using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream, Encoding.UTF8);
				streamWriter.Write(content);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private double GetENGValueFromSIUnit(QuantityTypeEnum quantityTypeEnum, double sourcecValue, string sourcecUnitID, string targetUnitID)
		{
			return SimulatorCADataProvider.ConvertUnit(quantityTypeEnum, sourcecValue, sourcecUnitID, targetUnitID);
		}

		public double GetENGValueFromSIUnit(CARealVariable sourceVariable, string targetUnit)
		{
			string sIUnit = SimulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(sourceVariable.QuantityType);
			return GetENGValueFromSIUnit(sourceVariable.QuantityType, sourceVariable.Value, sIUnit, targetUnit);
		}
	}
}
namespace AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.ExportPlot
{
	public class PerformancePlotExport : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly System.Windows.Size DefaultDiagramSize = new System.Windows.Size(600.0, 600.0);

		private readonly System.Windows.Size DefaultScreenSize = new System.Windows.Size(1024.0, 768.0);

		private IUnityContainer _Container;

		private HydraulicPlotsViewData _HydraulicPlotsViewData;

		private PerformanceDiagramViewModel _ColPerformanceDiagramVM;

		private ColumnPerformanceDiagram _colPerforceDiagram;

		private ColumnInternalsData _columnData;

		private Window _winContainer;

		public PerformancePlotExport(IUnityContainer container, string sConfigOptionKey, bool showPlot = false)
		{
			if (container == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			_Container = container;
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			_columnData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
			List<string> list = null;
			try
			{
				list = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsKeys(sConfigOptionKey) as List<string>;
				SectionViewInfo sectionViewInfo = new SectionViewInfo();
				IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(sConfigOptionKey);
				AppendEmptySections(sectionsRange, _columnData.StartStageNumber, _columnData.EndStageNumber);
				if (_columnData.IsTopDownNumbering)
				{
					sectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage = _columnData.StartStageNumber;
					sectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage = _columnData.EndStageNumber;
				}
				else
				{
					sectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage = _columnData.EndStageNumber;
					sectionViewInfo.DisplayStartStage = _columnData.StartStageNumber;
				}
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData = new HydraulicPlotsViewData(_Container, sConfigOptionKey);
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdateHydraulicPlotsViewData(_columnData, list, sectionsRange, sectionViewInfo, -1);
				_ColPerformanceDiagramVM = new PerformanceDiagramViewModel(_Container, _HydraulicPlotsViewData, isReporting: false, sConfigOptionKey);
				_colPerforceDiagram = new ColumnPerformanceDiagram();
				_colPerforceDiagram.DataContext = _ColPerformanceDiagramVM;
				_winContainer = new Window();
				_winContainer.Content = _colPerforceDiagram;
				if (!showPlot)
				{
					_winContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				}
				_winContainer.Show();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void UpdateResultData(CAResultUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (_HydraulicPlotsViewData != null)
			{
				_HydraulicPlotsViewData.UpdateResultData(args);
			}
		}

		public System.Drawing.Image GetPlot(int stageNumber)
		{
			if (stageNumber > _columnData.EndStageNumber || stageNumber < _columnData.StartStageNumber)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("stageNumber is out of range.");
			}
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage = stageNumber;
			_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.Refresh();
			return _colPerforceDiagram.GetPlotImage(DefaultDiagramSize);
		}

		public System.Drawing.Image GetPlot(int stageNumber, double width, double height)
		{
			if (stageNumber > _columnData.EndStageNumber || stageNumber < _columnData.StartStageNumber)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("stageNumber is out of range.");
			}
			_HydraulicPlotsViewData.CurrentStage = stageNumber;
			_ColPerformanceDiagramVM.Refresh();
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			if (width <= 0.0 || height <= 0.0)
			{
				size = DefaultDiagramSize;
			}
			return _colPerforceDiagram.GetPlotImage(size);
		}

		private void AppendEmptySections(IList<CASectionRange> secRange, int colStartStage, int colEndStage)
		{
			if (secRange == null || secRange.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			new List<CASectionRange>();
			Dictionary<int, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, bool>();
			for (int i = colStartStage; i <= colEndStage; i++)
			{
				dictionary.Add(i, value: false);
			}
			foreach (CASectionRange item in secRange)
			{
				for (int j = item.StartStageNumber; j <= item.EndStageNumber; j++)
				{
					dictionary[j] = true;
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int k = colStartStage; k <= colEndStage; k++)
			{
				if (dictionary[k])
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = "Empty" + num;
				num++;
				CASectionRange cASectionRange = new CASectionRange(text, text);
				secRange.Add(cASectionRange);
				cASectionRange.StageType = StageType.None;
				cASectionRange.StartStageNumber = k;
				for (int l = k + 1; l <= colEndStage; l++)
				{
					if (dictionary[l])
					{
						cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = l;
						k = l;
						break;
					}
					if (l == colEndStage && !dictionary[l])
					{
						cASectionRange.EndStageNumber = l;
						k = l;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_winContainer.Close();
		}
	}
}
namespace AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Converters
{
	public class HeightConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return (double)value - 0.5;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class TabSizeConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.TabControl tabControl = values[0] as System.Windows.Controls.TabControl;
			double num = tabControl.ActualWidth / (double)tabControl.Items.Count;
			return (num <= 3.0) ? 0.0 : (num - 1.4);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	internal class TopPositionConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null || parameter == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value.GetType() == typeof(double) && parameter.GetType() == typeof(double))
			{
				return (double)parameter - (double)value / 2.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class VisibilityBooleanConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility visibility = ((!(bool)value) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			return visibility;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class VisibilityBooleanConverter_Opposite : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility visibility = (((bool)value) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			return visibility;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class ValueToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null && parameter != null)
			{
				return value.ToString().Equals(parameter.ToString());
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null && parameter != null && (bool)value)
			{
				return TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(targetType).ConvertFromString(parameter.ToString());
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
}
namespace AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls

	internal class CAComboBox : XamComboEditor
	{
		public CAComboBox()
		{
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).FontStyle = FontStyles.Italic;

			SweptBackWeirViewTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SweptBackWeirViewType", typeof(SweptBackWeirViewTypeEnum), typeof(SweptBackWeirDiagram), new UIPropertyMetadata(SweptBackWeirViewTypeEnum.SulCol, OnSweptBackWeirViewTypePropertyChanged));
			GeometryDataProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GeometryData", typeof(TrayGeometryData), typeof(SweptBackWeirDiagram), new UIPropertyMetadata(null, OnGeometryDataPropertyChanged));
			DataDragStartingEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DataDragStarting", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<DataDragStartingEventArgs>), typeof(SweptBackWeirDiagram));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(SweptBackWeirDiagram), GeometryInputBox.DataDragStartingEvent, new EventHandler<DataDragStartingEventArgs>(TrayTypeDiagram_DataDragStartingEvent));
		}

		public SweptBackWeirDiagram()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			UpdateSweptBackWeirView();
			InputBoxContextMenu = new System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu();
		}

		private void UpdateSweptBackWeirView()
		{
			TrayTypeBase sweptBackWeirType = GetSweptBackWeirType();
			if (sweptBackWeirType == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TrayTypeBase trayTypeBase = _innerBorder.Child as TrayTypeBase;
			if (sweptBackWeirType != trayTypeBase)
			{
				if (trayTypeBase != null)
				{
					trayTypeBase.GeometryData = null;
				}
				_innerBorder.Child = sweptBackWeirType;
				if (sweptBackWeirType != null)
				{
					sweptBackWeirType.GeometryData = GeometryData;
				}
			}
		}

		private TrayTypeBase GetSweptBackWeirType()
		{
			switch (SweptBackWeirViewType)
			{
			case SweptBackWeirViewTypeEnum.FRI:
				if (_friView == null)
				{
					_friView = new FRIView();
				}
				return _friView;
			case SweptBackWeirViewTypeEnum.KG_Tower:
				if (_kgTowerView == null)
				{
					_kgTowerView = new KGTowerView();
				}
				return _kgTowerView;
			case SweptBackWeirViewTypeEnum.SulCol:
				if (_sulcol == null)
				{
					_sulcol = new SulColView();
				}
				return _sulcol;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ContextMenu == null && InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Count > 0 && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(GeometryInputBox), true) is GeometryInputBox geometryInputBox)
			{
				LengthVariable lengthVariable = null;
				if (geometryInputBox != null)
				{
					lengthVariable = geometryInputBox.Tag as LengthVariable;
				}
				if (lengthVariable != null)
				{
					foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)InputBoxContextMenu.Items)
					{
						if (item is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem)
						{
							menuItem.CommandParameter = lengthVariable;
						}
					}
				}
				InputBoxContextMenu.IsOpen = true;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(e);
		}

		private static void TrayTypeDiagram_DataDragStartingEvent(object sender, DataDragStartingEventArgs e)

			DataDragStartingEventArgs e2 = new DataDragStartingEventArgs(DataDragStartingEvent, sweptBackWeirDiagram, e.DataObject, e.LengthVariable);
			sweptBackWeirDiagram.OnDataDragStarting(e2);
			if (e2.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDataDragStarting(DataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

			public SectionLabel()
			{
				base.Children.Add(_topLabel);
				base.Children.Add(_bottomLabel);
				Canvas.SetTop(_topLabel, 0.0);
				Canvas.SetLeft(_topLabel, 0.0);
				Canvas.SetBottom(_bottomLabel, 0.0);
				Canvas.SetLeft(_bottomLabel, 25.0);
				UpdateBindings();
			}

			protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
			{
				if (sizeInfo.HeightChanged)
				{
					if (base.ActualHeight < _bottomLabel.ActualHeight)
					{
						double length = (base.ActualHeight - _bottomLabel.ActualHeight) / 2.0;
						Canvas.SetTop(_topLabel, length);
						Canvas.SetTop(_bottomLabel, length);
						_bottomLabel.ClearValue(Canvas.BottomProperty);
					}
					else
					{
						Canvas.SetTop(_topLabel, 0.0);
						Canvas.SetBottom(_bottomLabel, 0.0);
						_bottomLabel.ClearValue(Canvas.TopProperty);
					}
				}
				base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			}

			private void UpdateBindings()
			{
				if (IsTopDownOrdering)
				{
					_topLabel.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Section.StartIndex")
					{
						Source = this,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
					_bottomLabel.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Section.EndIndex")
					{
						Source = this,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
				}
				else
				{
					_topLabel.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Section.EndIndex")
					{
						Source = this,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
					_bottomLabel.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Section.StartIndex")
					{
						Source = this,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
				}
			}

			private static void OnIsTopDownOrderingPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				(d as SectionLabel).UpdateBindings();
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateFeedStages()
		{
			if (!_invalidateFeedStagesFlag)
			{
				_invalidateFeedStagesFlag = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateFeedStages();
					_invalidateFeedStagesFlag = false;
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFeedStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(feedCanvas, FeedStages.Count, CreateFeedStreamElement);
				for (int i = 0; i < FeedStages.Count; i++)
				{
					int num = FeedStages[i];
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = feedCanvas.Children[i] as FrameworkElement;
					frameworkElement.ToolTip = CreateTooltipForStage(num, isFeed: true);
					frameworkElement.Tag = num;
					double stagePositionWithinRange = GetStagePositionWithinRange(num);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, stagePositionWithinRange - 5.0);
					UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(frameworkElement, num, feed: true);
					DrawStageNumber(num, stagePositionWithinRange);
				}
				DeleteUnnecessaryStageNumbers();
			}
		}

		private void DrawStageNumber(int stage, double top)
		{
			Grid child = null;
			if (stageNumberCanvas.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				child = stageNumberCanvas.Children.Cast<Grid>().FirstOrDefault((Grid p) => p.Tag != null && (int)p.Tag == stage);
			}
			if (child == null)
			{
				child = CreateStageNumberElement(stage) as Grid;
				stageNumberCanvas.Children.Add(child);
			}
			else if (child.Children.Count > 1 && child.Children[1] is TextBlock textBlock)
			{
				textBlock.Text = MapStageToDisplay(stage).ToString();
			}
			if (child != null)
			{
				CreateStageNumberCanvasTopBinding(child, top);
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateStageNumberHorizontalMargin(child, stage);
				});
			}
		}

		private void CreateStageNumberCanvasTopBinding(Grid grid, double top)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding b = new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.Self),
				Path = new PropertyPath("ActualHeight"),
				Converter = new TopPositionConverter(),
				ConverterParameter = top
			};
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
			{
				grid.SetBinding(Canvas.TopProperty, b);
			});
		}

		private void DeleteUnnecessaryStageNumbers()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (object child in feedCanvas.Children)
			{
				if (child is HorizontalArrow { Tag: not null } horizontalArrow && horizontalArrow.Tag.GetType() == typeof(int) && !list.Contains((int)horizontalArrow.Tag))
				{
					list.Add((int)horizontalArrow.Tag);
				}
			}
			foreach (object child2 in productCanvas.Children)
			{
				if (child2 is HorizontalArrow { Tag: not null } horizontalArrow2 && horizontalArrow2.Tag.GetType() == typeof(int) && !list.Contains((int)horizontalArrow2.Tag))
				{
					list.Add((int)horizontalArrow2.Tag);
				}
			}
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			foreach (object child3 in pumparoundCanvas.Children)
			{
				if (child3 is HorizontalArrow { Tag: not null } horizontalArrow3 && horizontalArrow3.Tag.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					if (!list.Contains((int)horizontalArrow3.Tag))
					{
						list.Add((int)horizontalArrow3.Tag);
					}
					if (!list2.Contains((int)horizontalArrow3.Tag))
					{
						list2.Add((int)horizontalArrow3.Tag);
					}
				}
			}
			List<Grid> list3 = new List<Grid>();
			for (int i = 0; i < stageNumberCanvas.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (stageNumberCanvas.Children[i] is Grid { Tag: not null } grid && grid.Tag.GetType() == typeof(int) && !list.Contains((int)grid.Tag))
				{
					list3.Add(grid);
				}
			}
			foreach (Grid item in list3)
			{
				stageNumberCanvas.Children.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (object child4 in productCanvas.Children)
			{
				if (child4 is HorizontalArrow { Tag: not null } horizontalArrow4 && horizontalArrow4.Tag.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					if (list2.Contains((int)horizontalArrow4.Tag) && (horizontalArrow4.Width == 25.0 || double.IsNaN(horizontalArrow4.Width)))
					{
						horizontalArrow4.Width = 50.0;
					}
					else if (!list2.Contains((int)horizontalArrow4.Tag) && horizontalArrow4.Width == 50.0)
					{
						horizontalArrow4.Width = 25.0;
					}
				}
			}
			double stagePositionWithinRange = GetStagePositionWithinRange(TopStageNumber);
			DrawStageNumber(TopStageNumber, stagePositionWithinRange);
			double stagePositionWithinRange2 = GetStagePositionWithinRange(BottomStageNumber);
			DrawStageNumber(BottomStageNumber, stagePositionWithinRange2);
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateStageNumberElement(int stage)
		{
			Grid obj = new Grid
			{
				ColumnDefinitions = 
				{
					new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star)
					},
					new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = GridLength.Auto
					},
					new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star)
					}
				},
				RowDefinitions = 
				{
					new RowDefinition
					{
						Height = GridLength.Auto
					}
				},
				Tag = stage,
				Height = 15.0
			};
			System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
			{
				Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black,
				Height = 1.0,
				StrokeThickness = 1.0,
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
				SnapsToDevicePixels = true,
				StrokeDashArray = new DoubleCollection(new List<double> { 3.0, 4.0 })
			};
			obj.Children.Add(element);
			Grid.SetColumn(element, 0);
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock
			{
				TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center,
				Text = MapStageToDisplay(stage).ToString()
			};
			if (TotalStages > 30)
			{
				textBlock.FontSize = 10.0;
			}
			obj.Children.Add(textBlock);
			Grid.SetColumn(textBlock, 1);
			System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element2 = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
			{
				Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black,
				Height = 1.0,
				StrokeThickness = 1.0,
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
				SnapsToDevicePixels = true,
				StrokeDashArray = new DoubleCollection(new List<double> { 3.0, 4.0 })
			};
			obj.Children.Add(element2);
			Grid.SetColumn(element2, 2);
			return obj;
		}

		private string CreateTooltipForStage(int stage, bool isFeed)
		{
			string text = "";
			if (isFeed)
			{
				if (!FeedStageStreamsMap.ContainsKey(stage))
				{
					return null;
				}
				foreach (string item in FeedStageStreamsMap[stage])
				{
					text = text + item + ", ";
				}
				if (text.EndsWith(", "))
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 2);
				}
				return "Feed stream: " + text;
			}
			if (!ProductStageStreamsMap.ContainsKey(stage))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (string item2 in ProductStageStreamsMap[stage])
			{
				text = text + item2 + ", ";
			}
			if (text.EndsWith(", "))
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 2);
			}
			return "Product stream: " + text;
		}

		public void InvalidateProductStages()
		{
			if (!_invalidateProductStagesFlag)
			{
				_invalidateProductStagesFlag = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateProductStages();
					_invalidateProductStagesFlag = false;
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateProductStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(productCanvas, ProductStages.Count, CreateProductStreamElement);
				for (int i = 0; i < ProductStages.Count; i++)
				{
					int num = ProductStages[i];
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = productCanvas.Children[i] as FrameworkElement;
					frameworkElement.ToolTip = CreateTooltipForStage(num, isFeed: false);
					frameworkElement.Tag = num;
					double stagePositionWithinRange = GetStagePositionWithinRange(num);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, stagePositionWithinRange - 5.0);
					UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(frameworkElement, num, feed: false);
					DrawStageNumber(num, stagePositionWithinRange);
				}
				DeleteUnnecessaryStageNumbers();
			}
		}

		public void InvalidatePumparoundStages()
		{
			if (!_invalidatePumparoundStagesFlag)
			{
				_invalidatePumparoundStagesFlag = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdatePumparoundStages();
					_invalidatePumparoundStagesFlag = false;
				});
			}
		}

		private void CheckPumparoundOverlapped()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (PumparoundStageInfo pumparoundStage in PumparoundStages)
			{
				if (!list.Contains(pumparoundStage.DrawStage.Value))
				{
					list.Add(pumparoundStage.DrawStage.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (PumparoundStageInfo pumparoundStage2 in PumparoundStages)
			{
				if (pumparoundStage2.ReturnStage.HasValue && list.Contains(pumparoundStage2.ReturnStage.Value))
				{
					pumparoundStage2.NotDrawReturnStage = true;
				}
				else if (pumparoundStage2.VaporReturnStage.HasValue && list.Contains(pumparoundStage2.VaporReturnStage.Value))
				{
					pumparoundStage2.NotDrawVaporReturnStage = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static int SortPumparoundStageInfo(PumparoundStageInfo psi)
		{
			int value = psi.DrawStage.Value;
			if (psi.ReturnStage.HasValue && psi.ReturnStage.Value < value)
			{
				value = psi.ReturnStage.Value;
			}
			if (psi.VaporReturnStage.HasValue && psi.VaporReturnStage.Value < value)
			{
				value = psi.VaporReturnStage.Value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void UpdatePumparoundStages()
		{
			if (!CheckValidation())
			{
				return;
			}
			_pumpAroundRanges.Clear();
			pumparoundCanvas.Children.Clear();
			CheckPumparoundOverlapped();
			Dictionary<int, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			Dictionary<int, string> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (PumparoundStageInfo item in PumparoundStages.OrderBy(SortPumparoundStageInfo))
			{
				string text = "";
				System.Windows.Point? p = null;
				System.Windows.Point? p2 = null;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = CreatePumparoundElement(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.Primitive.ArrowDirection.Right);
				pumparoundCanvas.Children.Add(frameworkElement);
				double stagePositionWithinRange = GetStagePositionWithinRange(item.DrawStage.Value);
				Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, stagePositionWithinRange - 5.0);
				UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(frameworkElement, item.DrawStage.Value, feed: false);
				DrawStageNumber(item.DrawStage.Value, stagePositionWithinRange);
				text = $"{AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.Pumparound} {item.PumparoundName}: {AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.DrawStage} {MapStageToDisplay(item.DrawStage.Value)}";
				if (item.ReturnStage.HasValue)
				{
					text += $", {AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ReturnStage} {MapStageToDisplay(item.ReturnStage.Value)}";
				}
				if (item.VaporReturnStage.HasValue)
				{
					text += $", {AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.VaporReturnStage} {MapStageToDisplay(item.VaporReturnStage.Value)}";
				}
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(item.DrawStage.Value))
				{
					Dictionary<int, string> dictionary3 = dictionary;
					int value = item.DrawStage.Value;
					dictionary3[value] = dictionary3[value] + Environment.NewLine + text;
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(item.DrawStage.Value, text);
				}
				frameworkElement.ToolTip = dictionary[item.DrawStage.Value];
				frameworkElement.Tag = item.DrawStage.Value;
				if (item.NotDrawReturnStage && item.NotDrawVaporReturnStage)
				{
					continue;
				}
				System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(27.0 + Canvas.GetLeft(frameworkElement), stagePositionWithinRange);
				if (item.ReturnStage.HasValue && !item.NotDrawReturnStage)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = CreatePumparoundElement(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.Primitive.ArrowDirection.Left);
					pumparoundCanvas.Children.Add(frameworkElement2);
					double stagePositionWithinRange2 = GetStagePositionWithinRange(item.ReturnStage.Value);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement2, stagePositionWithinRange2 - 5.0);
					UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(frameworkElement2, item.ReturnStage.Value, feed: false);
					DrawStageNumber(item.ReturnStage.Value, stagePositionWithinRange2);
					if (dictionary2.ContainsKey(item.ReturnStage.Value))
					{
						Dictionary<int, string> dictionary3 = dictionary2;
						int value = item.ReturnStage.Value;
						dictionary3[value] = dictionary3[value] + Environment.NewLine + text;
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary2.Add(item.ReturnStage.Value, text);
					}
					frameworkElement2.ToolTip = dictionary2[item.ReturnStage.Value];
					frameworkElement2.Tag = item.ReturnStage.Value;
					p = new System.Windows.Point(27.0 + Canvas.GetLeft(frameworkElement2), stagePositionWithinRange2);
				}
				if (item.VaporReturnStage.HasValue && !item.NotDrawVaporReturnStage)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement3 = CreatePumparoundElement(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.Primitive.ArrowDirection.Left);
					pumparoundCanvas.Children.Add(frameworkElement3);
					double stagePositionWithinRange3 = GetStagePositionWithinRange(item.VaporReturnStage.Value);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement3, stagePositionWithinRange3 - 5.0);
					UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(frameworkElement3, item.VaporReturnStage.Value, feed: false);
					DrawStageNumber(item.VaporReturnStage.Value, stagePositionWithinRange3);
					if (dictionary2.ContainsKey(item.VaporReturnStage.Value))
					{
						if (item.ReturnStage != item.VaporReturnStage)
						{
							Dictionary<int, string> dictionary3 = dictionary2;
							int value = item.VaporReturnStage.Value;
							dictionary3[value] = dictionary3[value] + Environment.NewLine + text;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary2.Add(item.VaporReturnStage.Value, text);
					}
					frameworkElement3.ToolTip = dictionary2[item.VaporReturnStage.Value];
					frameworkElement3.Tag = item.VaporReturnStage.Value;
					p2 = new System.Windows.Point(27.0 + Canvas.GetLeft(frameworkElement3), stagePositionWithinRange3);
				}
				int value2 = item.DrawStage.Value;
				int value3 = item.DrawStage.Value;
				if (item.ReturnStage.HasValue && item.ReturnStage.Value < value2)
				{
					value2 = item.ReturnStage.Value;
				}
				if (item.ReturnStage.HasValue && item.ReturnStage.Value > value3)
				{
					value3 = item.ReturnStage.Value;
				}
				if (item.VaporReturnStage.HasValue && item.VaporReturnStage.Value < value2)
				{
					value2 = item.VaporReturnStage.Value;
				}
				if (item.VaporReturnStage.HasValue && item.VaporReturnStage.Value > value3)
				{
					value3 = item.VaporReturnStage.Value;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (Tuple<int, int> pumpAroundRange in _pumpAroundRanges)
				{
					if (item.DrawStage.Value >= pumpAroundRange.Item1 && item.DrawStage.Value <= pumpAroundRange.Item2)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (item.ReturnStage.HasValue && item.ReturnStage.Value >= pumpAroundRange.Item1 && item.ReturnStage.Value <= pumpAroundRange.Item2)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (item.VaporReturnStage.HasValue && item.VaporReturnStage.Value >= pumpAroundRange.Item1 && item.VaporReturnStage.Value <= pumpAroundRange.Item2)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (value2 < value3)
					{
						if (value2 <= pumpAroundRange.Item1 && value3 >= pumpAroundRange.Item1)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						if (value2 >= pumpAroundRange.Item1 && value2 <= pumpAroundRange.Item2)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if ((p.HasValue || p2.HasValue) && flag)
				{
					num++;
				}
				double horizontalOffset = (num + 1) * 5;
				if (DrawConnectionLines(p3, p, p2, horizontalOffset, num + 1, text))
				{
					_pumpAroundRanges.Add(new Tuple<int, int>(value2, value3));
				}
			}
			DeleteUnnecessaryStageNumbers();
		}

		private bool DrawConnectionLines(System.Windows.Point p1, System.Windows.Point? p2, System.Windows.Point? p3, double horizontalOffset, int order, string tooltip)
		{
			if (!p2.HasValue && !p3.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			list.Add(p1);
			if (p2.HasValue)
			{
				list.Add(new System.Windows.Point(p2.Value.X, p2.Value.Y));
			}
			if (p3.HasValue)
			{
				list.Add(new System.Windows.Point(p3.Value.X, p3.Value.Y));
			}
			List<System.Windows.Point> list2 = list.OrderBy((System.Windows.Point point) => point.Y).ToList();
			for (int num = 0; num < list2.Count - 1; num++)
			{
				if (num == 0)
				{
					Line line = new Line
					{
						X1 = list2[num].X,
						Y1 = list2[num].Y,
						X2 = list2.Max((System.Windows.Point point) => point.X) + horizontalOffset,
						Y2 = list2[num].Y,
						StrokeThickness = 1.0,
						Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Blue
					};
					line.ToolTip = tooltip;
					pumparoundCanvas.Children.Add(line);
				}
				Line line2 = new Line
				{
					X1 = list2.Max((System.Windows.Point point) => point.X) + horizontalOffset,
					Y1 = list2[num].Y - 0.5,
					X2 = list2.Max((System.Windows.Point point) => point.X) + horizontalOffset,
					Y2 = list2[num + 1].Y + 0.5,
					StrokeThickness = 1.0,
					Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Blue
				};
				line2.ToolTip = tooltip;
				pumparoundCanvas.Children.Add(line2);
				Line line3 = new Line
				{
					X1 = list2[num + 1].X,
					Y1 = list2[num + 1].Y,
					X2 = list2.Max((System.Windows.Point point) => point.X) + horizontalOffset,
					Y2 = list2[num + 1].Y,
					StrokeThickness = 1.0,
					Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Blue
				};
				line3.ToolTip = tooltip;
				pumparoundCanvas.Children.Add(line3);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int MapStageToDisplay(int topDownStage)
		{
			if (IsTopDownOrdering)
			{
				return topDownStage;
			}
			return Math.Max(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber) - (topDownStage - 1);
		}

		private void UpdateSteamsHorizontalMargins()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < FeedStages.Count; i++)
			{
				int stageIn = FeedStages[i];
				FrameworkElement element = feedCanvas.Children[i] as FrameworkElement;
				UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(element, stageIn, feed: true);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < ProductStages.Count; j++)
			{
				int stageIn2 = ProductStages[j];
				FrameworkElement element2 = productCanvas.Children[j] as FrameworkElement;
				UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(element2, stageIn2, feed: false);
			}
			UpdatePumparoundStages();
		}

		private void UpdateStageNumberHorizontalMargin(FrameworkElement element, int stageIn)
		{
			int stage = MapStageToDisplay(stageIn);
			int num = Math.Min(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			int num2 = Math.Max(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			SectionBorder sectionBorder = null;
			if (stage < num)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder2 = sectionGrid.Children.Cast<SectionBorder>().FirstOrDefault((SectionBorder x) => x.Section != null && x.Section.StartIndex == stage + 1);
				if (sectionBorder2 != null)
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(element, sectionBorder2.Margin.Left);
					sectionBorder = sectionBorder2;
				}
				else
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(element, 0.0);
					element.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
					{
						Source = topBorder,
						Path = new PropertyPath("ActualWidth")
					});
				}
				if (element is Grid grid)
				{
					grid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			else if (stage > num2)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder3 = sectionGrid.Children.Cast<SectionBorder>().FirstOrDefault((SectionBorder x) => x.Section != null && x.Section.EndIndex == stage - 1);
				if (sectionBorder3 != null)
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(element, sectionBorder3.Margin.Left);
					sectionBorder = sectionBorder3;
				}
				else
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(element, 0.0);
					element.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
					{
						Source = bottomBorder,
						Path = new PropertyPath("ActualWidth")
					});
				}
				if (element is Grid grid2)
				{
					grid2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < sectionGrid.Children.Count; num3++)
				{
					SectionBorder sectionBorder4 = sectionGrid.Children[num3] as SectionBorder;
					if (sectionBorder4.Section != null && sectionBorder4.Section.StartIndex <= stage && sectionBorder4.Section.EndIndex >= stage)
					{
						Canvas.SetLeft(element, sectionBorder4.Margin.Left);
						sectionBorder = sectionBorder4;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (sectionBorder == null && Canvas.GetLeft(element) > 0.0)
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(element, 0.0);
				}
				if (element is Grid grid3)
				{
					grid3.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			if (sectionBorder != null)
			{
				element.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
				{
					Source = sectionBorder,
					Path = new PropertyPath("ActualWidth")
				});
			}
			else
			{
				element.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
				{
					Source = stageNumberCanvas,
					Path = new PropertyPath("ActualWidth")
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(FrameworkElement element, int stageIn, bool feed)
		{
			int stage = MapStageToDisplay(stageIn);
			int num = Math.Min(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			int num2 = Math.Max(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			if (feed)
			{
				Canvas.SetRight(element, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				Canvas.SetLeft(element, 0.0);
			}
			if (stage < num)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder = sectionGrid.Children.Cast<SectionBorder>().FirstOrDefault((SectionBorder x) => x.Section != null && x.Section.StartIndex == stage + 1);
				if (sectionBorder != null)
				{
					PlaceStreamsHorizontally(element, sectionBorder, feed);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (stage > num2)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder2 = sectionGrid.Children.Cast<SectionBorder>().FirstOrDefault((SectionBorder x) => x.Section != null && x.Section.EndIndex == stage - 1);
				if (sectionBorder2 != null)
				{
					PlaceStreamsHorizontally(element, sectionBorder2, feed);
				}
				return;
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < sectionGrid.Children.Count; num3++)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder3 = sectionGrid.Children[num3] as SectionBorder;
				if (sectionBorder3.Section != null && sectionBorder3.Section.StartIndex <= stage && sectionBorder3.Section.EndIndex >= stage)
				{
					PlaceStreamsHorizontally(element, sectionBorder3, feed);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PlaceStreamsHorizontally(FrameworkElement element, SectionBorder sb, bool feed)
		{
			if (feed)
			{
				Canvas.SetRight(element, 0.0 - sb.Margin.Left);
			}
			else
			{
				Canvas.SetLeft(element, 0.0 - sb.Margin.Left);
			}
		}

		private double GetElementStageDepth()
		{
			return sectionGrid.ActualHeight / (double)(Math.Abs(TopStageNumber - BottomStageNumber) + 1);
		}

		private double GetStagePosition(int stage)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			return GetElementStageDepth() * ((double)(stage - num) + 0.5);
		}

		private double GetStagePositionWithinRange(int stage)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			int num2 = Math.Max(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber);
			if (stage < num)
			{
				return topBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0 * -1.0;
			}
			if (stage >= num && stage <= num2)
			{
				double num3 = GetElementStageDepth() * ((double)(stage - num) + 0.5);
				double num4 = topBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0 * -1.0;
				if (num3 < num4)
				{
					num3 = num4;
				}
				double num5 = sectionGrid.ActualHeight + bottomBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0;
				if (num3 > num5)
				{
					num3 = num5;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return sectionGrid.ActualHeight + bottomBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0;
		}

		private bool CheckValidation()
		{
			return true;
		}

				Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Blue,

			};
