		private void EnsureChildren(Canvas container, int count, Func<UIElement> creator)
		{
			while (container.Children.Count > count)
			{
				container.Children.RemoveAt(container.Children.Count - 1);
			}
			while (container.Children.Count < count)
			{
				container.Children.Add(creator());
			}
		}

		internal void OnSectionsChanged()
		{
			UpdateCompleteState();
			InvalidateUI();
			InvalidateSectionDiameters();
		}

		internal void OnDiameterChanged()
		{
			InvalidateSectionDiameters();
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionGrid.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder = sectionGrid.Children[i] as SectionBorder;
				if (sectionBorder.Section != null)
				{
					UpdatePosition(sectionBorder, sectionBorder.Section);
				}
			}
			InvalidateSectionDiameters();
			InvalidateFeedStages();
			InvalidateProductStages();
			InvalidatePumparoundStages();
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
		}

		public void InvalidateUI()
		{
			if (!_invalidateUIFlag)
			{
				_invalidateUIFlag = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateUI();
					_invalidateUIFlag = false;
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUI()
		{
			if (Sections.Count > 0)
			{
				sectionGrid.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
				sectionRectangleBorder.BorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				sectionGrid.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.WhiteSmoke;
				sectionRectangleBorder.BorderThickness = new Thickness(2.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (!GetIsNumbersValid())
			{
				sectionGrid.Children.Clear();
				overlapGrid.Children.Clear();
				return;
			}
			int num = sectionGrid.Children.Count - Sections.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				sectionGrid.Children.RemoveAt(sectionGrid.Children.Count - 1);
			}
			int num2 = Sections.Count - sectionGrid.Children.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				sectionGrid.Children.Add(new SectionBorder());
			}
			List<StagePeriod> list = Sections.OrderBy((StagePeriod x) => x.StartIndex).ToList();
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < sectionGrid.Children.Count; num3++)
			{
				StagePeriod stagePeriod = list[num3];
				SectionBorder sectionBorder = sectionGrid.Children[num3] as SectionBorder;
				sectionBorder.Section = stagePeriod;
				UpdatePosition(sectionBorder, stagePeriod);
				sectionBorder.ToolTip = string.Format(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ColumnSectionDiagram_SectionTooltip, stagePeriod.Name, stagePeriod.StartIndex, stagePeriod.EndIndex);
				sectionBorder.Background = new SolidColorBrush(GetSectionColor(num3, sectionGrid.Children.Count))
				{
					Opacity = 0.5
				};
			}
			IList<StagePeriod> overlappedStages = GetOverlappedStages();
			int num4 = overlapGrid.Children.Count - overlappedStages.Count;
			for (int num5 = 0; num5 < num4; num5++)
			{
				overlapGrid.Children.RemoveAt(overlapGrid.Children.Count - 1);
			}
			int num6 = overlappedStages.Count - overlapGrid.Children.Count;
			for (int num7 = 0; num7 < num6; num7++)
			{
				overlapGrid.Children.Add(new SectionBorder());
			}
			List<StagePeriod> list2 = overlappedStages.OrderBy((StagePeriod x) => x.StartIndex).ToList();
			for (int num8 = 0; num8 < overlapGrid.Children.Count; num8++)
			{
				StagePeriod section = list2[num8];
				SectionBorder sectionBorder2 = overlapGrid.Children[num8] as SectionBorder;
				sectionBorder2.Section = section;
				UpdatePosition(sectionBorder2, section);
				sectionBorder2.Background = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateSectionDiameters()
		{
			if (!_invalidateSectionDiametersFlag)
			{
				_invalidateSectionDiametersFlag = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateSectionDiameters();
					_invalidateSectionDiametersFlag = false;
				}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSectionDiameters()
		{
			double actualWidth = sectionGrid.ActualWidth;
			if (actualWidth <= 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Sections.Count == 0)
			{
				topEllipse.Margin = default(Thickness);
				bottomEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, -20.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				return;
			}
			double num = Math.Max(0.0, Sections.Max((StagePeriod x) => x.Diameter));
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < sectionGrid.Children.Count; num2++)
				{
					SectionBorder sectionBorder = sectionGrid.Children[num2] as SectionBorder;
					sectionBorder.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, sectionBorder.Margin.Top, 0.0, sectionBorder.Margin.Bottom);
				}
				return;
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < sectionGrid.Children.Count; num3++)
			{
				SectionBorder sectionBorder2 = sectionGrid.Children[num3] as SectionBorder;
				if (sectionBorder2.Section != null && sectionBorder2.Section.Diameter > 0.0 && sectionBorder2.Section.Diameter < num)
				{
					double num4 = (num - sectionBorder2.Section.Diameter) * actualWidth / num / 2.0;
					sectionBorder2.Margin = new Thickness(num4, sectionBorder2.Margin.Top, num4, sectionBorder2.Margin.Bottom);
				}
				else
				{
					sectionBorder2.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, sectionBorder2.Margin.Top, 0.0, sectionBorder2.Margin.Bottom);
				}
			}
			if (sectionGrid.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				foreach (SectionBorder child in sectionGrid.Children)
				{
					if (child.Section == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (IsTopDownOrdering)
					{
						if (child.Section.StartIndex == TopStageNumber)
						{
							topEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(child.Margin.Left, 0.0, child.Margin.Right, 0.0);
							flag = true;
						}
						else if (child.Section.EndIndex == BottomStageNumber)
						{
							bottomEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(child.Margin.Left, -20.0, child.Margin.Right, 0.0);
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					else if (child.Section.EndIndex == TopStageNumber)
					{
						topEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(child.Margin.Left, 0.0, child.Margin.Right, 0.0);
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (child.Section.StartIndex == BottomStageNumber)
					{
						bottomEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(child.Margin.Left, -20.0, child.Margin.Right, 0.0);
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					topEllipse.Margin = default(Thickness);
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					bottomEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, -20.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
			}
			UpdateSteamsHorizontalMargins();
		}

		private void UpdatePosition(FrameworkElement element, StagePeriod section)
		{
			if (!section.IsValid)
			{
				element.Margin = default(Thickness);
				element.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				element.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			if (IsTopDownOrdering)
			{
				int num = BottomStageNumber - TopStageNumber + 1;
				element.Height = sectionGrid.ActualHeight * (double)section.Length / (double)num;
				element.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, sectionGrid.ActualHeight * (double)(section.StartIndex - TopStageNumber) / (double)num, 0.0, 0.0);
				element.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = TopStageNumber - BottomStageNumber + 1;
				element.Height = sectionGrid.ActualHeight * (double)section.Length / (double)num2;
				element.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, sectionGrid.ActualHeight * (double)(section.StartIndex - BottomStageNumber) / (double)num2);
				element.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom;
			}
			element.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void UpdateCompleteState()
		{
			if (!GetIsNumbersValid())
			{
				IsSectioningComplete = false;
			}
			else if (StagePeriod.GetGaps(Sections, Math.Min(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber), Math.Max(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber)).Count > 0)
			{
				IsSectioningComplete = false;
			}
			else if (StagePeriod.GetOverlaps(Sections).Count > 0)
			{
				IsSectioningComplete = false;
			}
			else
			{
				IsSectioningComplete = true;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateStageNumbers()
		{
			if (!GetIsNumbersValid())
			{
				TopStageNumber = 0;
				BottomStageNumber = 0;
			}
			else if (IsTopDownOrdering)
			{
				TopStageNumber = ((!HasCondenser) ? 1 : 2);
				BottomStageNumber = (HasReboiler ? (TotalStages - 1) : TotalStages);
			}
			else
			{
				TopStageNumber = (HasCondenser ? (TotalStages - 1) : TotalStages);
				BottomStageNumber = ((!HasReboiler) ? 1 : 2);
			}
		}

		private bool GetIsNumbersValid()
		{
			if (TotalStages <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((HasCondenser || HasReboiler) && TotalStages < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HasCondenser && HasReboiler && TotalStages < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public IList<StagePeriod> GetNoneAllocatedStages()
		{
			return StagePeriod.ConvertToPeriods(StagePeriod.GetGaps(Sections, Math.Min(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber), Math.Max(TopStageNumber, BottomStageNumber)));
		}

		public IList<StagePeriod> GetOverlappedStages()
		{
			return StagePeriod.ConvertToPeriods(StagePeriod.GetOverlaps(Sections));
		}

		{
			int num = 2;
			byte num2 = (byte)(index % 2 * (200 / num) + 20);
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(num2, num2, num2);
		}

		public static IList<int> Concat(IEnumerable<StagePeriod> periods)
		{
			if (periods == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("periods");
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (StagePeriod period in periods)
			{
				for (int i = period.StartIndex; i <= period.EndIndex; i++)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(i))
					{
						list.Add(i);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static IList<int> GetOverlaps(IEnumerable<StagePeriod> periods)
		{
			if (periods == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("periods");
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			foreach (StagePeriod period in periods)
			{
				for (int i = period.StartIndex; i <= period.EndIndex; i++)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(i))
					{
						list.Add(i);
					}
					else if (!list2.Contains(i))
					{
						list2.Add(i);
					}
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		public static IList<int> GetGaps(IEnumerable<StagePeriod> periods, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (periods == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("periods");
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			IList<int> list2 = Concat(periods);
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				if (!list2.Contains(i))
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static IList<StagePeriod> ConvertToPeriods(IEnumerable<int> numbers)
		{
			if (numbers == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("numbers");
			}
			List<StagePeriod> list = new List<StagePeriod>();
			StagePeriod stagePeriod = null;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (int item in numbers.OrderBy((int x) => x))
			{
				if (stagePeriod == null)
				{
					stagePeriod = new StagePeriod
					{
						StartIndex = item,
						EndIndex = item
					};
					list.Add(stagePeriod);
				}
				else if (item == num + 1)
				{
					stagePeriod.EndIndex = item;
				}
				else
				{
					stagePeriod = new StagePeriod
					{
						StartIndex = item,
						EndIndex = item
					};
					list.Add(stagePeriod);
				}
				num = item;
			}
			return list;
		}

		{

			{

				StartIndex = startIndex,
				EndIndex = endIndex,
				Diameter = diameter
			});

		public void AddSections(IEnumerable<Tuple<string, int, int, double>> sections)
		{
			if (sections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Tuple<string, int, int, double> section in sections)
			{
				_stageRanges.Add(new StageRange
				{
					Name = section.Item1,
					StartIndex = section.Item2,
					EndIndex = section.Item3,
					Diameter = section.Item4
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnStageClicked(int stage)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new ColumnStageClickedEventArgs(StageClickedEvent, this, stage));
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			InvalidateUI();
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
		}

		public void InvalidateUI()
		{
			if (_invalidateFlag)
			{
				return;
			}
			_invalidateFlag = true;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					UpdateBackgroundSections();
					UpdateCenterSections();
					UpdateFeedStages();
					UpdateProductStages();
					UpdateNormalStages();
					UpdateWarningStages();
					UpdateErrorStages();
					UpdateEmptyStages();
					UpdateViewportBorder();
				}
				finally
				{
					_invalidateFlag = false;
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.DataBind);
		}

		private void UpdateFeedStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(feedCanvas, FeedStages.Count, CreateFeedStreamElement);
				for (int i = 0; i < FeedStages.Count; i++)
				{
					int num = FeedStages.Keys.ToArray()[i];
					System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel = feedCanvas.Children[i] as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
					double stagePositionWithinRangeForArrow = GetStagePositionWithinRangeForArrow(num);
					Canvas.SetTop(panel, stagePositionWithinRangeForArrow - 5.0);
					UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(panel, num, feed: true);
					(panel.Children[0] as TextBlock).Text = MapStageToDisplay(num).ToString();
					(panel.Children[1] as HorizontalArrow).ToolTip = "Feed stream: " + FeedStages[num];
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateProductStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(productCanvas, ProductStages.Count, CreateProductStreamElement);
				for (int i = 0; i < ProductStages.Count; i++)
				{
					int num = ProductStages.Keys.ToArray()[i];
					System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel = productCanvas.Children[i] as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
					double stagePositionWithinRangeForArrow = GetStagePositionWithinRangeForArrow(num);
					Canvas.SetTop(panel, stagePositionWithinRangeForArrow - 5.0);
					UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(panel, num, feed: false);
					(panel.Children[0] as TextBlock).Text = MapStageToDisplay(num).ToString();
					(panel.Children[1] as HorizontalArrow).ToolTip = "Product stream: " + ProductStages[num];
				}
			}
		}

		private int MapStageToDisplay(int topDownStage)
		{
			if (IsTopDownOrdering)
			{
				return topDownStage;
			}
			return EndStage - (topDownStage - 1);
		}

		private void UpdateStreamHorizontalMargin(FrameworkElement element, int stage, bool feed)
		{
			if (feed)
			{
				Canvas.SetRight(element, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				Canvas.SetLeft(element, 0.0);
			}
			if (stage < StartStage)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = centerSectionGrid.Children.Cast<FrameworkElement>().FirstOrDefault((FrameworkElement x) => ((StageRange)x.Tag).StartIndex == stage + 1);
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					PlaceStreamsHorizontally(element, frameworkElement, feed);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (stage > EndStage)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = centerSectionGrid.Children.Cast<FrameworkElement>().FirstOrDefault((FrameworkElement x) => ((StageRange)x.Tag).EndIndex == stage - 1);
				if (frameworkElement2 != null)
				{
					PlaceStreamsHorizontally(element, frameworkElement2, feed);
				}
				return;
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < centerSectionGrid.Children.Count; num++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement3 = centerSectionGrid.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
				if (frameworkElement3.Tag != null && ((StageRange)frameworkElement3.Tag).StartIndex <= stage && ((StageRange)frameworkElement3.Tag).EndIndex >= stage)
				{
					PlaceStreamsHorizontally(element, frameworkElement3, feed);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PlaceStreamsHorizontally(FrameworkElement streamElement, FrameworkElement sectionElement, bool feed)
		{
			if (feed)
			{
				Canvas.SetRight(streamElement, (sectionElement.Width - centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth) / 2.0);
			}
			else
			{
				Canvas.SetLeft(streamElement, (sectionElement.Width - centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth) / 2.0);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNormalStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(normalCanvas, NormalStages.Count, () => new Border());
				for (int num = 0; num < NormalStages.Count; num++)
				{
					int num2 = NormalStages[num];
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = normalCanvas.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
					frameworkElement.ToolTip = CreateStageTooltip(num2);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(num2, out var borderHeight));
					frameworkElement.Height = borderHeight;
					UpdateStageWidth(frameworkElement, num2);
				}
				UpdateStagesBackground(normalBackground, NormalStages, NormalBrush);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateWarningStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(warningCanvas, WarningStages.Count, () => new Border());
				GetElementStageDepth();
				for (int num = 0; num < WarningStages.Count; num++)
				{
					int num2 = WarningStages[num];
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = warningCanvas.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
					frameworkElement.ToolTip = CreateStageTooltip(num2);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(num2, out var borderHeight));
					frameworkElement.Height = borderHeight;
					UpdateStageWidth(frameworkElement, num2);
				}
				UpdateStagesBackground(warningBackground, WarningStages, WarningBrush);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateErrorStages()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				EnsureChildren(errorCanvas, ErrorStages.Count, () => new Border());
				GetElementStageDepth();
				for (int num = 0; num < ErrorStages.Count; num++)
				{
					int num2 = ErrorStages[num];
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = errorCanvas.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
					frameworkElement.ToolTip = CreateStageTooltip(num2);
					Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(num2, out var borderHeight));
					frameworkElement.Height = borderHeight;
					UpdateStageWidth(frameworkElement, num2);
				}
				UpdateStagesBackground(errorBackground, ErrorStages, ErrorBrush);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateEmptyStages()
		{
			if (!CheckValidation())
			{
				return;
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = StartStage; i <= EndStage; i++)
			{
				if (!NormalStages.Contains(i) && !WarningStages.Contains(i) && !ErrorStages.Contains(i))
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
			}
			EnsureChildren(emptyCanvas, list.Count, () => new Border());
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				int num2 = list[num];
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = emptyCanvas.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
				frameworkElement.ToolTip = CreateStageTooltip(num2);
				Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(num2, out var borderHeight));
				frameworkElement.Height = borderHeight;
				UpdateStageWidth(frameworkElement, num2);
			}
			UpdateStagesBackground(emptyBackground, list, DefaultBrush);
		}

		private void UpdateStagesBackground(Canvas canvas, IEnumerable<int> stages, System.Windows.Media.Brush background)
		{
			IList<Tuple<int, int, double?, double?>> list = ConvertToRanges(stages);
			EnsureChildren(canvas, list.Count, () => new Border
			{
				Background = background
			});
			GetElementStageDepth();
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				Tuple<int, int, double?, double?> tuple = list[num];
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = canvas.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
				if (tuple.Item3.HasValue)
				{
					frameworkElement.Width = tuple.Item3.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkElement.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
					{
						Source = canvas,
						Path = new PropertyPath(FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty)
					});
				}
				if (tuple.Item4.HasValue)
				{
					Canvas.SetLeft(frameworkElement, tuple.Item4.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkElement.ClearValue(Canvas.LeftProperty);
				}
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int num3 = tuple.Item1; num3 <= tuple.Item2; num3++)
				{
					num2 += GetBorderHeight(num3);
				}
				frameworkElement.Height = num2;
				Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(tuple.Item1));
			}
		}

		private IList<Tuple<int, int, double?, double?>> ConvertToRanges(IEnumerable<int> numbers)
		{
			if (numbers == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("numbers");
			}
			List<Tuple<int, int, double?, double?>> list = new List<Tuple<int, int, double?, double?>>();
			int? num = null;
			int num2 = 0;
			double? num3 = null;
			double? left = null;
			foreach (int item in numbers.OrderBy((int x) => x))
			{
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					num = item;
					num3 = GetStageWidth(item, out left);
				}
				else
				{
					double? left2 = null;
					double? stageWidth = GetStageWidth(item, out left2);
					if (item > num2 + 1 || stageWidth != num3)
					{
						list.Add(new Tuple<int, int, double?, double?>(num.Value, num2, num3, left));
						num = item;
						num3 = stageWidth;
						left = left2;
					}
				}
				num2 = item;
			}
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				list.Add(new Tuple<int, int, double?, double?>(num.Value, num2, num3, left));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void UpdateStageWidth(FrameworkElement stageElement, int stageIndex)
		{
			double? left = null;
			double? stageWidth = GetStageWidth(stageIndex, out left);
			if (stageWidth.HasValue && left.HasValue)
			{
				stageElement.Width = stageWidth.Value;
				Canvas.SetLeft(stageElement, left.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				stageElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				stageElement.ClearValue(Canvas.LeftProperty);
			}
		}

		private double? GetStageWidth(int stageIndex, out double? left)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = centerSectionGrid.Children.Cast<FrameworkElement>().FirstOrDefault((FrameworkElement x) => ((StageRange)x.Tag).StartIndex <= stageIndex && ((StageRange)x.Tag).EndIndex >= stageIndex);
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				left = (centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth - frameworkElement.Width) / 2.0;
				return frameworkElement.Width;
			}
			left = null;
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdateViewportBorder()
		{
			if (CheckValidation())
			{
				int num = StageOnShow - ViewportMargin;
				int num2 = StageOnShow + ViewportMargin;
				if (num < StartStage)
				{
					num = StartStage;
					num2 = Math.Min(EndStage, StartStage + ViewportMargin * 2);
				}
				else if (num2 > EndStage)
				{
					num2 = EndStage;
					num = Math.Max(StartStage, EndStage - ViewportMargin * 2);
				}
				double stagePosition = GetStagePosition(num);
				double num3 = GetStagePosition(num2 + 1) - stagePosition;
				if (!(num3 < 0.0))
				{
					viewportBorder.Height = num3;
					viewportBorder.Margin = new Thickness(20.0, stagePosition, 20.0, 0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundSections()
		{
			if (_stageRanges.Count <= 0)
			{
				sectionBackgroundGrid.Children.Clear();
				return;
			}
			EnsureChildren(sectionBackgroundGrid, _stageRanges.Count, CreateBackgroundSectionElement);
			List<StageRange> list = _stageRanges.OrderBy((StageRange x) => x.StartIndex).ToList();
			int count = sectionBackgroundGrid.Children.Count;
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				StageRange range = list[num];
				UIElement element = sectionBackgroundGrid.Children[num];
				UpdateBackgroundSectionElement(element, range, num, count);
			}
		}

		private UIElement CreateBackgroundSectionElement()
		{
			return new Border
			{
				Child = new TextBlock
				{
					HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
					VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
					Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.0)
				}
			};
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundSectionElement(UIElement element, StageRange range, int index, int totalSectionsCount)
		{
			Border obj = element as Border;
			obj.ToolTip = string.Format(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.ColumnSectionDiagram_SectionTooltip, range.Name, MapStageToDisplay(range.StartIndex), MapStageToDisplay(range.EndIndex));
			obj.Background = new SolidColorBrush(GetBackgroundSectionColor(index, totalSectionsCount))
			{
				Opacity = 0.5
			};
			(obj.Child as TextBlock).Text = range.Name;
			UpdateBackgroundSectionElementPosition(element as FrameworkElement, range);
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundSectionElementPosition(FrameworkElement element, StageRange range)
		{
			if (StartStage == EndStage || !range.IsValid)
			{
				element.Margin = default(Thickness);
				element.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				element.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			int num = EndStage - StartStage + 1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				element.Height = sectionBackgroundGrid.ActualHeight * (double)range.Length / (double)num;
				element.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, sectionBackgroundGrid.ActualHeight * (double)(range.StartIndex - StartStage) / (double)num, 0.0, 0.0);
				element.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
				element.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color GetBackgroundSectionColor(int index, int total)
		{
			if (index % 2 == 0)
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#ededed");
			}
			return (System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#d1d1d1");
		}

		private void UpdateCenterSections()
		{
			if (_stageRanges.Count <= 0)
			{
				centerSectionGrid.Children.Clear();
				centerSectionGrid.Background = DefaultBrush;
				topEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -30.0);
				bottomEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, -30.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				return;
			}
			EnsureChildren(centerSectionGrid, _stageRanges.Count, CreateSectionElement);
			centerSectionGrid.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
			double maxDiameter = Math.Max(0.0, _stageRanges.Max((StageRange x) => x.Diameter));
			List<StageRange> list = _stageRanges.OrderBy((StageRange x) => x.StartIndex).ToList();
			int count = centerSectionGrid.Children.Count;
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				StageRange stageRange = list[num];
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = centerSectionGrid.Children[num] as FrameworkElement;
				UpdateSectionElementPosition(frameworkElement, stageRange, maxDiameter);
				frameworkElement.Tag = stageRange;
			}
			UpdateTopBottomEllipse();
		}

		private void UpdateTopBottomEllipse()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = null;
			frameworkElement = centerSectionGrid.Children.Cast<FrameworkElement>().FirstOrDefault();
			frameworkElement2 = centerSectionGrid.Children.Cast<FrameworkElement>().LastOrDefault();
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				double num = centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth - frameworkElement.Width;
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return;
				}
				topEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(num / 2.0, 0.0, num / 2.0, -30.0);
			}
			if (frameworkElement2 != null)
			{
				double num2 = centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth - frameworkElement2.Width;
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					bottomEllipse.Margin = new Thickness(num2 / 2.0, -30.0, num2 / 2.0, 0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		private UIElement CreateSectionElement()
		{
			return new Border
			{
				Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent,
				HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center
			};
		}

		private void UpdateSectionElementPosition(FrameworkElement element, StageRange range, double maxDiameter)
		{
			if (StartStage > EndStage || !range.IsValid)
			{
				element.Margin = default(Thickness);
				element.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				element.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			int num = EndStage - StartStage + 1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				element.Height = centerSectionGrid.ActualHeight * (double)range.Length / (double)num;
				if (maxDiameter == 0.0 || range.Diameter <= 0.0 || range.Diameter == maxDiameter)
				{
					element.Width = centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth;
				}
				else
				{
					element.Width = range.Diameter * centerSectionGrid.ActualWidth / maxDiameter;
				}
				element.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, centerSectionGrid.ActualHeight * (double)(range.StartIndex - StartStage) / (double)num, 0.0, 0.0);
				element.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
				element.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		private bool CheckValidation()
		{
			if (StartStage > EndStage)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateFeedStreamElement()
		{
			HorizontalArrow element = new HorizontalArrow
			{
				MinWidth = 25.0,
				Height = 10.0,
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black,
				StrokeThickness = 1.0,
				Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black
			};
			TextBlock element2 = new TextBlock
			{
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
				TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center,
				Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.0)
			};
			return new StackPanel
			{
				Orientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal,
				Children = 
				{
					(UIElement)element2,
					(UIElement)element
				}
			};
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateProductStreamElement()
		{
			HorizontalArrow element = new HorizontalArrow
			{
				MinWidth = 25.0,
				Height = 10.0,
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black,
				StrokeThickness = 1.0,
				Fill = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black
			};
			TextBlock element2 = new TextBlock
			{
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
				TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center,
				Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.0)
			};
			return new StackPanel
			{
				Orientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal,
				Children = 
				{
					(UIElement)element2,
					(UIElement)element
				}
			};
		}

		private double GetElementStageDepth()
		{
			if (StartStage > EndStage)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return centerGrid.ActualHeight / (double)(EndStage - StartStage + 1);
		}

		private double GetStagePosition(double stage)
		{
			if (StartStage > EndStage)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return GetElementStageDepth() * (stage - (double)StartStage);
		}

		private double GetStagePositionWithinRangeForArrow(int stage)
		{
			if (StartStage > EndStage)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			int startStage = StartStage;
			int endStage = EndStage;
			if (stage < startStage)
			{
				return topBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0 * -1.0;
			}
			if (stage >= startStage && stage <= endStage)
			{
				double num = GetElementStageDepth() * ((double)(stage - startStage) + 0.5);
				double num2 = topBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0 * -1.0;
				if (num < num2)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				double num3 = centerGrid.ActualHeight + bottomBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0;
				if (num > num3)
				{
					num = num3;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return centerGrid.ActualHeight + bottomBorder.ActualHeight / 2.0;
		}

		private double GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(int stage, out double borderHeight)
		{
			double num = (borderHeight = GetElementStageDepth());
			if (StartStage > EndStage)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			int startStage = StartStage;
			int endStage = EndStage;
			if (stage < startStage)
			{
				borderHeight = topBorder.ActualHeight;
				return 0.0 - topBorder.ActualHeight;
			}
			if (endStage == startStage && stage == endStage)
			{
				borderHeight = num;
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (stage >= startStage && stage <= endStage)
			{
				double num2 = num * (double)(stage - startStage);
				double num3 = topBorder.ActualHeight * -1.0;
				if (num2 < num3)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					borderHeight = topBorder.ActualHeight;
				}
				double actualHeight = centerGrid.ActualHeight;
				if (num2 > actualHeight)
				{
					num2 = actualHeight;
					borderHeight = bottomBorder.ActualHeight;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			borderHeight = bottomBorder.ActualHeight;
			return centerGrid.ActualHeight;
		}

		private double GetStagePositionWithinRangeForBorder(int stage)
		{
			if (StartStage >= EndStage)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double elementStageDepth = GetElementStageDepth();
			int startStage = StartStage;
			int endStage = EndStage;
			if (stage < startStage)
			{
				return 0.0 - topBorder.ActualHeight;
			}
			if (stage >= startStage && stage <= endStage)
			{
				double num = elementStageDepth * (double)(stage - startStage);
				double num2 = topBorder.ActualHeight * -1.0;
				if (num < num2)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				double actualHeight = centerGrid.ActualHeight;
				if (num > actualHeight)
				{
					num = actualHeight;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return centerGrid.ActualHeight;
		}

		private double GetBorderHeight(int stage)
		{
			if (StartStage > EndStage)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double elementStageDepth = GetElementStageDepth();
			int startStage = StartStage;
			int endStage = EndStage;
			if (stage < startStage)
			{
				return topBorder.ActualHeight;
			}
			if (stage >= startStage && stage <= endStage)
			{
				double num = elementStageDepth * (double)(stage - startStage);
				double num2 = topBorder.ActualHeight * -1.0;
				if (num < num2)
				{
					return topBorder.ActualHeight;
				}
				double actualHeight = centerGrid.ActualHeight;
				if (num > actualHeight)
				{
					return bottomBorder.ActualHeight;
				}
				return elementStageDepth;
			}
			return bottomBorder.ActualHeight;
		}

		private int GetStageNumberAt(double position)
		{
			if (StartStage >= EndStage)
			{
				return StartStage;
			}
			double elementStageDepth = GetElementStageDepth();
			return (int)(position / elementStageDepth) + StartStage;
		}

		private void EnsureChildren(System.Windows.Controls.Panel container, int count, Func<UIElement> creator)
		{
			while (container.Children.Count > count)
			{
				container.Children.RemoveAt(container.Children.Count - 1);
			}
			while (container.Children.Count < count)
			{
				container.Children.Add(creator());
			}
		}

		private void centerGrid_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			double y = Mouse.GetPosition(centerGrid).Y;
			int stageNumberAt = GetStageNumberAt(y);
			if (stageNumberAt <= EndStage)
			{
				OnStageClicked(stageNumberAt);
			}
		}

		private void centerGrid_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			double y = e.GetPosition(centerGrid).Y;
			double elementStageDepth = GetElementStageDepth();
			double num = y % elementStageDepth;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				double top = y - num;
				int stage = GetStageNumberAt(y);
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = centerSectionGrid.Children.Cast<FrameworkElement>().FirstOrDefault((FrameworkElement x) => ((StageRange)x.Tag).StartIndex <= stage && ((StageRange)x.Tag).EndIndex >= stage);
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					stageBorder.Width = frameworkElement.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					stageBorder.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				}
				stageBorder.Height = elementStageDepth;
				stageBorder.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, top, 0.0, 0.0);
				stageBorder.ToolTip = CreateStageTooltip(stage);
			}
		}

		private object CreateStageTooltip(int stage)
		{
			TextBlock child = new TextBlock
			{
				Text = string.Format(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.CVC_SignalStageTooltip, MapStageToDisplay(stage)),
				Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black
			};
			Border border = new Border
			{
				Child = child,
				Margin = new Thickness(-5.0),
				Padding = new Thickness(5.0)
			};
			if (!NormalStages.Contains(stage))
			{
				if (WarningStages.Contains(stage))
				{
					border.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Yellow;
				}
				else if (ErrorStages.Contains(stage))
				{
					border.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
				}
			}
			return border;
		}

		public TrayDiagram()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			UpdateInnerControl();
			InputBoxContextMenu = new System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu();
		}

		private void UpdateInnerControl()
		{
			TrayControlBase trayControl = GetTrayControl();
			TrayControlBase trayControlBase = innerBorder.Child as TrayControlBase;
			if (trayControl != trayControlBase)
			{
				if (trayControlBase != null)
				{
					trayControlBase.GeometryData = null;
				}
				innerBorder.Child = trayControl;
				if (trayControl != null)
				{
					trayControl.GeometryData = GeometryData;
				}
			}
		}

		private TrayControlBase GetTrayControl()
		{
			if (IsMDTray)
			{
				return new MDTray();
			}
			if (IsCustomTray)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (PassesCount)
			{
			case 1:
				if (IsWeirSweptBack)
				{
					if (_sweptWeirPass1 == null)
					{
						_sweptWeirPass1 = new TrayPass1SW();
					}
					return _sweptWeirPass1;
				}
				if (_pass1 == null)
				{
					_pass1 = new TrayPass1();
				}
				return _pass1;
			case 2:
				if (IsWeirSweptBack)
				{
					if (_sweptWeirPass2 == null)
					{
						_sweptWeirPass2 = new TrayPass2SW();
					}
					return _sweptWeirPass2;
				}
				if (_pass2 == null)
				{
					_pass2 = new TrayPass2();
				}
				return _pass2;
			case 3:
				if (IsWeirSweptBack)
				{
					if (_sweptWeirPass3 == null)
					{
						_sweptWeirPass3 = new TrayPass3SW();
					}
					return _sweptWeirPass3;
				}
				if (_pass3 == null)
				{
					_pass3 = new TrayPass3();
				}
				return _pass3;
			case 4:
				if (IsWeirSweptBack)
				{
					if (_sweptWeirPass4 == null)
					{
						_sweptWeirPass4 = new TrayPass4SW();
					}
					return _sweptWeirPass4;
				}
				if (_pass4 == null)
				{
					_pass4 = new TrayPass4();
				}
				return _pass4;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGeometryDataChanged(TrayGeometryData oldValue, TrayGeometryData newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.SubPropertyChanged -= OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.SubPropertyChanged += OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged;
			}
			UpdateOffCenterDowncomerToolTips();
		}

		protected virtual void OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged(object sender, SubPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GeometryData != null && (e.PropertyName == GeometryData.OffCenterDowncomerTopWidth.Name || e.PropertyName == GeometryData.OffCenterInsideWeirLength.Name || e.PropertyName == GeometryData.OffCenterOutsideWeirLength.Name || e.PropertyName == GeometryData.OffCenterDowncomerLocation.Name))
			{
				UpdateOffCenterDowncomerToolTips();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ContextMenu == null && InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Count > 0 && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(GeometryInputBox), true) is GeometryInputBox geometryInputBox)
			{
				LengthVariable lengthVariable = null;
				if (geometryInputBox != null)
				{
					lengthVariable = geometryInputBox.Tag as LengthVariable;
				}
				if (lengthVariable != null)
				{
					foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)InputBoxContextMenu.Items)
					{
						if (item is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem)
						{
							menuItem.CommandParameter = lengthVariable;
						}
					}
				}
				InputBoxContextMenu.IsOpen = true;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected override void OnGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GeometryData != null && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(GeometryInputBox), false, (DependencyObject)this) is GeometryInputBox box)
			{
				UpdateHighlightForRelatedBoxes(box, highlighted: true);
			}
			base.OnGotKeyboardFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GeometryData != null && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(GeometryInputBox), false, (DependencyObject)this) is GeometryInputBox box)
			{
				UpdateHighlightForRelatedBoxes(box, highlighted: false);
			}
			base.OnLostKeyboardFocus(e);
		}

		private void UpdateHighlightForRelatedBoxes(GeometryInputBox box, bool highlighted)
		{
			LengthVariable lengthVariable = box.Tag as LengthVariable;
			TrayGeometryData geometryData = GeometryData;
			if (lengthVariable != null && geometryData != null)
			{
				if (lengthVariable == geometryData.OffCenterDowncomerTopWidth || lengthVariable == geometryData.OffCenterInsideWeirLength || lengthVariable == geometryData.OffCenterOutsideWeirLength || lengthVariable == geometryData.OffCenterDowncomerLocation)
				{
					LengthVariable offCenterDowncomerTopWidth = geometryData.OffCenterDowncomerTopWidth;
					LengthVariable offCenterInsideWeirLength = geometryData.OffCenterInsideWeirLength;
					LengthVariable offCenterOutsideWeirLength = geometryData.OffCenterOutsideWeirLength;
					bool flag = (geometryData.OffCenterDowncomerLocation.IsHighlighted = highlighted);
					bool flag3 = (offCenterOutsideWeirLength.IsHighlighted = flag);
					bool isHighlighted = (offCenterInsideWeirLength.IsHighlighted = flag3);
					offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.IsHighlighted = isHighlighted;
					UpdateOffCenterDowncomerToolTips();
				}
				else if (lengthVariable == geometryData.SideDowncomerTopWidth || lengthVariable == geometryData.SideWeirLength)
				{
					LengthVariable sideDowncomerTopWidth = geometryData.SideDowncomerTopWidth;
					bool isHighlighted = (geometryData.SideWeirLength.IsHighlighted = highlighted);
					sideDowncomerTopWidth.IsHighlighted = isHighlighted;
				}
				else if (lengthVariable == geometryData.CenterDowncomerTopWidth || lengthVariable == geometryData.CenterWeirLength)
				{
					LengthVariable centerDowncomerTopWidth = geometryData.CenterDowncomerTopWidth;
					bool isHighlighted = (geometryData.CenterWeirLength.IsHighlighted = highlighted);
					centerDowncomerTopWidth.IsHighlighted = isHighlighted;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOffCenterDowncomerToolTips()
		{
			if (GeometryData != null)
			{
				LengthVariable offCenterDowncomerTopWidth = GeometryData.OffCenterDowncomerTopWidth;
				LengthVariable offCenterInsideWeirLength = GeometryData.OffCenterInsideWeirLength;
				LengthVariable offCenterOutsideWeirLength = GeometryData.OffCenterOutsideWeirLength;
				LengthVariable offCenterDowncomerLocation = GeometryData.OffCenterDowncomerLocation;
				if (!offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.IsDefaultValued && offCenterInsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && offCenterOutsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && offCenterDowncomerLocation.IsDefaultValued)
				{
					string text = (offCenterDowncomerLocation.ToolTip = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.TG_OffCenterInputBoxTooltip_Top);
					string toolTip = (offCenterOutsideWeirLength.ToolTip = text);
					offCenterInsideWeirLength.ToolTip = toolTip;
				}
				else if (offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.IsDefaultValued && !offCenterInsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && offCenterOutsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && offCenterDowncomerLocation.IsDefaultValued)
				{
					string text = (offCenterDowncomerLocation.ToolTip = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.TG_OffCenterInputBoxTooltip_Inside);
					string toolTip = (offCenterOutsideWeirLength.ToolTip = text);
					offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.ToolTip = toolTip;
				}
				else if (offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.IsDefaultValued && offCenterInsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && !offCenterOutsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && offCenterDowncomerLocation.IsDefaultValued)
				{
					string text = (offCenterDowncomerLocation.ToolTip = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.TG_OffCenterInputBoxTooltip_Outside);
					string toolTip = (offCenterInsideWeirLength.ToolTip = text);
					offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.ToolTip = toolTip;
				}
				else if (offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.IsDefaultValued && offCenterInsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && offCenterOutsideWeirLength.IsDefaultValued && !offCenterDowncomerLocation.IsDefaultValued)
				{
					string text = (offCenterOutsideWeirLength.ToolTip = AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.TG_OffCenterInputBoxTooltip_Location);
					string toolTip = (offCenterInsideWeirLength.ToolTip = text);
					offCenterDowncomerTopWidth.ToolTip = toolTip;
				}
			}
		}

			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(TrayTypeDiagram), GeometryInputBox.DataDragStartingEvent, new EventHandler<DataDragStartingEventArgs>(TrayTypeDiagram_DataDragStartingEvent));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(TrayTypeDiagram), GeometryComBoInputBox.ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEvent, new EventHandler<ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs>(TrayTypeDiagram_ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEvent));
		}

		public TrayTypeDiagram()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			UpdateTrayTypesDiagram();
			InputBoxContextMenu = new System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu();
		}

		private void UpdateTrayTypesDiagram()
		{
			TrayTypeBase trayType = GetTrayType();
			TrayTypeBase trayTypeBase = _innerBorder.Child as TrayTypeBase;
			if (trayType != trayTypeBase)
			{
				if (trayTypeBase != null)
				{
					trayTypeBase.GeometryData = null;
				}
				_innerBorder.Child = trayType;
				if (trayType != null)
				{
					trayType.GeometryData = GeometryData;
				}
			}
		}

		private TrayTypeBase GetTrayType()
		{
			switch (TrayType)
			{
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.SieveTray:
				if (_trayType_Sieve == null)
				{
					_trayType_Sieve = new SieveTray();
				}
				return _trayType_Sieve;
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.BubbleCapTray:
				if (_trayType_BubbleCap == null)
				{
					_trayType_BubbleCap = new BubbleCapTray();
				}
				return _trayType_BubbleCap;
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.NutterFloatValveBDPTray_61:
				if (_trayType_NutterFloatValveBDPTray_61 == null)
				{
					_trayType_NutterFloatValveBDPTray_61 = new NutterFloatValveBDPTray_61();
				}
				return _trayType_NutterFloatValveBDPTray_61;
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.NutterFloatValveBDPTray_125:
				if (_trayType_NutterFloatValveBDPTray_125 == null)
				{
					_trayType_NutterFloatValveBDPTray_125 = new NutterFloatValveBDPTray_125();
				}
				return _trayType_NutterFloatValveBDPTray_125;
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray:
				if (_trayType_KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray == null)
				{
					_trayType_KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray = new KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray();
				}
				return _trayType_KochGlistchFlexitrayAValveTray;
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitraySValveTray:
				if (_trayType_KochGlistchFlexitraySValveTray == null)
				{
					_trayType_KochGlistchFlexitraySValveTray = new KochGlistchFlexitraySValveTray();
				}
				return _trayType_KochGlistchFlexitraySValveTray;
			case AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.TrayTypes.TrayTypeEnum.KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray:
				if (_trayType_KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray == null)
				{
					_trayType_KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray = new KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray();
				}
				return _trayType_KochGlistchFlexitrayTValveTray;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ContextMenu == null && InputBoxContextMenu.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(GeometryInputBox), true) is GeometryInputBox geometryInputBox)
				{
					LengthVariable lengthVariable = null;
					if (geometryInputBox != null)
					{
						lengthVariable = geometryInputBox.Tag as LengthVariable;
					}
					if (lengthVariable != null)
					{
						foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)InputBoxContextMenu.Items)
						{
							if (item is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem)
							{
								menuItem.CommandParameter = lengthVariable;
							}
						}
					}
					InputBoxContextMenu.IsOpen = true;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(GeometryComBoInputBox), true) is GeometryComBoInputBox geometryComBoInputBox)
				{
					StringVariable stringVariable = null;
					if (((FrameworkElement)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).Tag is StringVariable commandParameter)
					{
						foreach (object item2 in (IEnumerable)InputBoxContextMenu.Items)
						{
							if (item2 is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem2)
							{
								menuItem2.CommandParameter = commandParameter;
							}
						}
					}
					InputBoxContextMenu.IsOpen = true;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(e);
		}

		private static void OnTrayTypePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as TrayTypeDiagram).UpdateTrayTypesDiagram();
		}

		private static void OnGeometryDataPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TrayTypeDiagram trayTypeDiagram = d as TrayTypeDiagram;
			if (trayTypeDiagram._innerBorder.Child is TrayTypeBase trayTypeBase)
			{
				trayTypeBase.GeometryData = trayTypeDiagram.GeometryData;
			}
		}

		private static void TrayTypeDiagram_DataDragStartingEvent(object sender, DataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			TrayTypeDiagram trayTypeDiagram = sender as TrayTypeDiagram;
			DataDragStartingEventArgs e2 = new DataDragStartingEventArgs(DataDragStartingEvent, trayTypeDiagram, e.DataObject, e.LengthVariable);
			trayTypeDiagram.OnDataDragStarting(e2);
			if (e2.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void TrayTypeDiagram_ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEvent(object sender, ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			TrayTypeDiagram trayTypeDiagram = sender as TrayTypeDiagram;
			ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs e2 = new ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs(ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEvent, trayTypeDiagram, e.DataObject, e.StringVariable);
			trayTypeDiagram.OnDataDragStarting(e2);
			if (e2.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		}

		protected virtual void OnDataDragStarting(ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

	public class TrayTypeBase : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GeometryDataProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GeometryData", typeof(TrayGeometryData), typeof(TrayTypeBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnGeometryDataPropertyChanged));

		public TrayGeometryData GeometryData
		{
			get
			{
				return (TrayGeometryData)GetValue(GeometryDataProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GeometryDataProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnGeometryDataPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TrayTypeBase obj = d as TrayTypeBase;
			obj.DataContext = obj.GeometryData;
			obj.OnGeometryDataChanged(e.OldValue as TrayGeometryData, e.NewValue as TrayGeometryData);
		}

		protected virtual void OnGeometryDataChanged(TrayGeometryData oldValue, TrayGeometryData newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.SubPropertyChanged -= GeometryData_SubPropertyChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.SubPropertyChanged += GeometryData_SubPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged(string propertyName, string subPropertyName, bool isDefaultValued)
		{
			if (GeometryData != null)
			{
				string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName);
			}
		}

		private void GeometryData_SubPropertyChanged(object sender, SubPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged(e.PropertyName, e.SubPropertyName, e.IsDefaultValued);
		}
	}

	public class TrayControlBase : ContentControl
	{
		private const double DefaultDowncomerWidthRate = 1.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GeometryDataProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GeometryData", typeof(TrayGeometryData), typeof(TrayControlBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnGeometryDataPropertyChanged));

		public TrayGeometryData GeometryData
		{
			get
			{
				return (TrayGeometryData)GetValue(GeometryDataProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GeometryDataProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGeometryDataChanged(TrayGeometryData oldValue, TrayGeometryData newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.SubPropertyChanged -= GeometryData_SubPropertyChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.SubPropertyChanged += GeometryData_SubPropertyChanged;
				OnSideDowncomerWidthRateChanged(GetDowncomerWidthRate(newValue, newValue.SideDowncomerTopWidth, newValue.SideDowncomerBottomWidth));
				OnCenterDowncomerWidthRateChanged(GetDowncomerWidthRate(newValue, newValue.CenterDowncomerTopWidth, newValue.CenterDowncomerBottomWidth));
				OnOffCenterDowncomerWidthRateChanged(GetDowncomerWidthRate(newValue, newValue.OffCenterDowncomerTopWidth, newValue.OffCenterDowncomerBottomWidth));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged(string propertyName, string subPropertyName)
		{
			TrayGeometryData geometryData = GeometryData;
			if (geometryData != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && (propertyName.Contains("DowncomerTopWidth") || propertyName.Contains("DowncomerBottomWidth")))
			{
				if (propertyName.StartsWith("Side"))
				{
					OnSideDowncomerWidthRateChanged(GetDowncomerWidthRate(geometryData, geometryData.SideDowncomerTopWidth, geometryData.SideDowncomerBottomWidth));
				}
				else if (propertyName.StartsWith("Center"))
				{
					OnCenterDowncomerWidthRateChanged(GetDowncomerWidthRate(geometryData, geometryData.CenterDowncomerTopWidth, geometryData.CenterDowncomerBottomWidth));
				}
				else if (propertyName.StartsWith("OffCenter"))
				{
					OnOffCenterDowncomerWidthRateChanged(GetDowncomerWidthRate(geometryData, geometryData.OffCenterDowncomerTopWidth, geometryData.OffCenterDowncomerBottomWidth));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSideDowncomerWidthRateChanged(double rate)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnCenterDowncomerWidthRateChanged(double rate)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnOffCenterDowncomerWidthRateChanged(double rate)
		{
		}

		private void GeometryData_SubPropertyChanged(object sender, SubPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnGeometryDataSubPropertyChanged(e.PropertyName, e.SubPropertyName);
		}

		private static double GetDowncomerWidthRate(TrayGeometryData data, LengthVariable top, LengthVariable bottom)
		{
			if (!top.Value.HasValue || !bottom.Value.HasValue)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (top.Value <= 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			double num = bottom.Value.Value;
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (data.LengthConverter != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(top.Units) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bottom.Units))
			{
				num = data.LengthConverter(bottom.Value.Value, bottom.Units, top.Units);
			}
			return num / top.Value.Value;
		}

		protected static System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment GetSlopDirection(double downcomerRate, System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment ifSlopped)
		{
			if (downcomerRate >= 1.0 || downcomerRate < 0.0)
			{
				return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
			}
			return ifSlopped;
		}

		private static void OnGeometryDataPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TrayControlBase obj = d as TrayControlBase;
			obj.DataContext = obj.GeometryData;
			obj.OnGeometryDataChanged(e.OldValue as TrayGeometryData, e.NewValue as TrayGeometryData);
		}
	}

namespace AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Controls.Trays.Elements

	public class DownLookMD : MDLook, IComponentConnector
	{
		private const double ARC_MARGIN = 40.0;

		private const double REFERENCELINE_ERROR = 10.0;

		internal Grid DowncomerGrid;

		internal Grid ReferenceLineGrid;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		private double GridDistance { get; }

		public DownLookMD()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			GridDistance = (base.Width - DowncomerGrid.Width) / 2.0;
		}

		protected override void DrawDowncomer()
		{
			DowncomerGrid.Children.Clear();
			_distance = (DowncomerGrid.Width - 10.0 * (double)base.DowncomerCount) / (double)(base.DowncomerCount * 2);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DowncomerCount; i++)
			{
				double num = _distance + (double)i * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0);
				double num2 = (double)(base.DowncomerCount - i - 1) * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + _distance;
				double num3 = ((i >= base.DowncomerCount / 2) ? (2.0 * Math.Sqrt((num2 + 5.0) * (DowncomerGrid.Width - num2 - 5.0))) : (2.0 * Math.Sqrt((num + 5.0) * (DowncomerGrid.Width - num - 5.0))));
				double num4 = (DowncomerGrid.Height - (num3 - 40.0)) / 2.0;
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
				{
					Fill = (FindResource("SolidBorderFill") as SolidColorBrush),
					Width = 10.0,
					Margin = new Thickness(num, num4, num2, num4)
				};
				System.Windows.Controls.Panel.SetZIndex(element, 1);
				DowncomerGrid.Children.Add(element);
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle();
				rectangle.Stroke = FindResource("BorderStroke") as SolidColorBrush;
				rectangle.StrokeThickness = 1.0;
				rectangle.StrokeDashArray = new DoubleCollection(new double[2] { 2.0, 4.0 });
				rectangle.Fill = FindResource("VirtualBorderFill") as SolidColorBrush;
				rectangle.Height = 10.0;
				rectangle.Margin = new Thickness(num4, num, num4, num2);
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element2 = rectangle;
				System.Windows.Controls.Panel.SetZIndex(element2, 0);
				DowncomerGrid.Children.Add(element2);
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawReferenceLine()
		{
			ReferenceLineGrid.Children.Clear();
			double num = 2.0 * Math.Sqrt((_distance + 5.0) * (DowncomerGrid.Width - _distance - 5.0));
			ReferenceLine element = new ReferenceLine
			{
				Orientation = Dock.Left,
				IsExternalMarking = true,
				Margin = new Thickness(0.0, (base.Width - num) / 2.0 - 10.0, base.Width - GridDistance - _distance - 5.0, base.Width - 40.0 - GridDistance - (DowncomerGrid.Width - num) / 2.0 + 10.0)
			};
			ReferenceLineGrid.Children.Add(element);
			Line element2 = new Line
			{
				Stroke = (FindResource("BorderStroke") as SolidColorBrush),
				StrokeThickness = 0.5,
				X1 = GridDistance + _distance + 5.0,
				Y1 = (base.Width - num) / 2.0,
				X2 = GridDistance + _distance + 5.0,
				Y2 = (base.Width - num + 40.0) / 2.0
			};
			ReferenceLineGrid.Children.Add(element2);
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces;component/controls/trays/elements/downlookmd.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		internal Delegate _CreateDelegate(Type delegateType, string handler)
		{
			return Delegate.CreateDelegate(delegateType, this, handler);
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			switch (connectionId)
			{
			case 1:
				DowncomerGrid = (Grid)target;
				break;
			case 2:
				ReferenceLineGrid = (Grid)target;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class MDLook : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl
	{
		protected const double DOWNCOMER_WIDTH = 10.0;

		protected double _distance;

		protected static readonly DependencyProperty DowncomerCountProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DowncomerCount", typeof(int), typeof(MDLook), new PropertyMetadata(0, OnDowncomerCountChnaged));

		public int DowncomerCount
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(DowncomerCountProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DowncomerCountProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected static void OnDowncomerCountChnaged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (int.Parse(e.NewValue.ToString()) != 0)
			{
				MDLook obj = d as MDLook;
				obj.DrawDowncomer();
				obj.DrawReferenceLine();
			}
		}

		protected abstract void DrawDowncomer();

		protected virtual void DrawReferenceLine()
		{
		}
	}
	public class SideLookMD : MDLook, IComponentConnector
	{
		internal Grid DowncomerGrid;

		internal Grid referenceLineGrid;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public SideLookMD()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		protected override void DrawDowncomer()
		{
			DowncomerGrid.Children.Clear();
			_distance = (DowncomerGrid.Width - 10.0 * (double)base.DowncomerCount) / (double)(base.DowncomerCount * 2);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DowncomerCount; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle element = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle
				{
					Fill = (FindResource("SolidBorderFill") as SolidColorBrush),
					Width = 10.0,
					Margin = new Thickness(_distance + (double)i * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0), 0.0, (double)(base.DowncomerCount - i - 1) * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + _distance, 55.0)
				};
				DowncomerGrid.Children.Add(element);
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawReferenceLine()
		{
			referenceLineGrid.Children.Clear();
			int num = (int)Math.Floor((double)(base.DowncomerCount - 1) / 2.0);
			ReferenceLine element = new ReferenceLine
			{
				Orientation = Dock.Top,
				IsExternalMarking = true,
				Margin = new Thickness(_distance + (double)num * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) - 5.0, 190.0, (double)(base.DowncomerCount - num - 2) * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + _distance - 5.0, 40.0)
			};
			referenceLineGrid.Children.Add(element);
			Line line = new Line();
			line.StrokeThickness = 0.5;
			line.StrokeDashArray = new DoubleCollection(new double[2] { 2.0, 2.0 });
			line.Stroke = FindResource("SolidBorderFill") as SolidColorBrush;
			line.X1 = _distance + (double)num * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + 5.0;
			line.Y1 = 130.0;
			line.X2 = _distance + (double)num * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + 5.0;
			line.Y2 = 185.0;
			Line element2 = line;
			referenceLineGrid.Children.Add(element2);
			line = new Line();
			line.StrokeThickness = 0.5;
			line.StrokeDashArray = new DoubleCollection(new double[2] { 2.0, 2.0 });
			line.Stroke = FindResource("SolidBorderFill") as SolidColorBrush;
			line.X1 = _distance * 3.0 + (double)num * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + 15.0;
			line.Y1 = 130.0;
			line.X2 = _distance * 3.0 + (double)num * (_distance * 2.0 + 10.0) + 15.0;
			line.Y2 = 185.0;
			Line element3 = line;
			referenceLineGrid.Children.Add(element3);
		}

		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces;component/controls/trays/elements/sidelookmd.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

	internal class MultiBindingConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if ((bool)values[0] && !double.IsNaN((double)values[1]))
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return Visibility.Hidden;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	{
		private double _xMinLogical;

		private double _xMax;

		private double _yLogical;

		private StageStatus _stageStatus;

		private string _parentName;

		}

				return _xMax;
			}
			set
			{
				_xMax = value;
			}
		}

		public double YLogical
		{
			get
			{
				return _yLogical;
			}
			set
			{
				_yLogical = value;
			}
		}

		public double YDrawCoordinateValue { get; set; }

		public StageStatus StageStatus
		{
			get

				return _stageStatus;

			get

				return _parentName;

				_parentName = value;

		private static void OnDisplayStartStagePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != e.NewValue && d is SectionViewDiagramCtrl sectionViewDiagramCtrl && !double.IsNaN(sectionViewDiagramCtrl.YDataMin))
			{
				sectionViewDiagramCtrl._mainScrollBar.Value = sectionViewDiagramCtrl._mainScrollBar.Minimum;
				sectionViewDiagramCtrl.Refresh();
				double num = double.NaN;
				num = ((!sectionViewDiagramCtrl.IsTopDownNumbering) ? (sectionViewDiagramCtrl.GetDrawLogicalY(sectionViewDiagramCtrl.DisplayEndStage) - sectionViewDiagramCtrl._yDrawLogicalStart) : (sectionViewDiagramCtrl.DisplayStartStage - sectionViewDiagramCtrl._yDrawLogicalStart));
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					sectionViewDiagramCtrl._mainScrollBar.Value += num;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnDisplayEndStagePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != e.NewValue && d is SectionViewDiagramCtrl sectionViewDiagramCtrl)
			{
				sectionViewDiagramCtrl._mainScrollBar.Value = sectionViewDiagramCtrl._mainScrollBar.Minimum;
				sectionViewDiagramCtrl.Refresh();
				double num = double.NaN;
				num = ((!sectionViewDiagramCtrl.IsTopDownNumbering) ? (sectionViewDiagramCtrl.GetDrawLogicalY(sectionViewDiagramCtrl.DisplayEndStage) - sectionViewDiagramCtrl._yDrawLogicalStart) : (sectionViewDiagramCtrl.DisplayStartStage - sectionViewDiagramCtrl._yDrawLogicalStart));
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					sectionViewDiagramCtrl._mainScrollBar.Value += num;
				}
			}
		}
