		public SectionViewDiagramCtrl()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		private void InitializeCtrl()
		{
			if (!CheckData())
			{
				return;
			}
			IntervalLength = 40.0;
			MajorStep = double.NaN;
			MinorStep = double.NaN;
			MakeSureXAxisDataRange();
			MakeSureYAxisDataRange();
			MakeSureXAxisActualWidth();
			if (!(_xAxisUsedWidth < 0.0))
			{
				MakeSureXAxisUnitLength();
				MakeSureYAxisActualHeight();
				MakeSureYAxisUnitLengthAndDisplayUnitLength();
				_mainScrollBar.Minimum = YDataMin;
				if (YDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePageChangedByUser)
				{
					_scrollBarScrollableRange = YDataMax - YDataMin - (DisplayEndStage - DisplayStartStage);
					_mainScrollBar.ViewportSize = _yDisplayDataRange;
				}
				else
				{
					_scrollBarScrollableRange = YDataMax - YDataMin - YDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage + 1.0;
					_mainScrollBar.ViewportSize = YDefaultDisplayDataRangesInOnePage;
				}
				if (_scrollBarScrollableRange == 0.0)
				{
					_mainScrollBar.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				}
				else
				{
					_mainScrollBar.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				_mainScrollBar.Maximum = _mainScrollBar.Minimum + _scrollBarScrollableRange;
				_trackBorderTextBlock.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
				_trackBorderToolTip.Content = _trackBorderTextBlock;
				_trackBorderToolTip.Foreground = _blackBrush;
				_trackBorder.ToolTip = _trackBorderToolTip;
				ToolTipService.SetShowDuration(_trackBorder, 1000000);
				System.Windows.Controls.Panel.SetZIndex(_trackBorder, 3);
				RectangleGeometry clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, -0.4 * SingleCharHeight, _yAxisCanvas.ActualWidth, _yAxisCanvas.ActualHeight + 0.8 * SingleCharHeight));
				_yAxisCanvasMask.Clip = clip;
			}
		}

		private void MakeSureYAxisDataRange()
		{
			_yDataRange = YDataMax - YDataMin + 1.0;
		}

		private void UpdateYAxisDisplayDataRange()
		{
		}

		private void MakeSureXAxisDataRange()
		{
			_xDataRange = XDataMax - XDataMin;
			if (_xDataRange > 10000.0)
			{
				_xAxisUsingScientificNotation = true;
				UseSuperExponentialFormat = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			Refresh();
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			if (!CheckData())
			{
				Clear();
				return;
			}
			InitializeCtrl();
			if (!(_xAxisUsedWidth < 0.0))
			{
				_xAxisCanvas.Children.Clear();
				_yAxisCanvas.Children.Clear();
				_mainCanvas.Children.Clear();
				UpdateStartAndEndPosition();
				InitializeTranslateTransform();
				PrepareDrawDataForYAxis();
				PrepareDrawData();
				DrawXAxis();
				DrawYAxis();
				DrawRectangle();
				DrawBlueRectangle();
				DrawOperationalPoints();
				DrawXAxisTitle();
				DrawYAxisTitle();
				DrawBackgroundLines();
				if (IsSectionViewInfoHasValue && !_updateMainScrollBarPositionForFirstInitialize)
				{
					UpdateMainScrollBarPosition();
					_updateMainScrollBarPositionForFirstInitialize = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Clear()
		{
			_xAxisCanvas.Children.Clear();
			_yAxisCanvas.Children.Clear();
			_yAxisCanvasMask.Children.Clear();
			_mainCanvas.Children.Clear();
			_gridForXAxis.Children.Clear();
			_gridForYAxis.Children.Clear();
		}

		private bool CheckData()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(XDataMax) || double.IsNaN(XDataMin) || double.IsNaN(YDataMin) || double.IsNaN(YDataMax) || (YDataMax == 0.0 && YDataMin == 0.0) || (XDataMax == 0.0 && XDataMin == 0.0) || DisplayStartStage > DisplayEndStage || XDataMax == XDataMin)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateDrawStartAndDrawEnd()
		{
			_yDrawLogicalStart = Math.Max(YDataMin, _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition);
			_yDrawLogicalEnd = Math.Min(YDataMax, _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition + _yAxisCanvas.ActualHeight / _yUnitLength);
		}

		private void PrepareDrawDataForYAxis()
		{
			UpdateDrawStartAndDrawEnd();
			UpdateAxisDataMaximumAndMinimum(isHorizonal: false);
			UpdateIntervals(new Rect(new System.Windows.Size(_yAxisCanvas.ActualWidth, _yAxisCanvas.ActualHeight)), isHorizontal: false, 3.0 * GetSingleCharHeight('W'));
			double num = ActualMajorStep;
			if (num < 1.0)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			IList<double> labelValueList = CreateTickValuesForYAxis(YDataMin, YDataMax, num);
			FillDataForYAxisLabelDataList(labelValueList);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
		}

		private void FillDataForYAxisLabelDataList(IList<double> labelValueList)
		{
			if (_axisLabelDataList != null && _axisLabelDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				_axisLabelDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (_backgroundLineDataList != null && _backgroundLineDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				_backgroundLineDataList.Clear();
			}
			if (IsTopDownNumbering)
			{
				foreach (double labelValue in labelValueList)
				{
					AxisLabelData item = new AxisLabelData
					{
						Label = labelValue.ToString(),
						YLogicalCoordinateValue = labelValue,
						YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue = labelValue
					};
					_axisLabelDataList.Add(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (double labelValue2 in labelValueList)
				{
					double yLogicalCoordinateValue = YDataMin + YDataMax - labelValue2;
					AxisLabelData item2 = new AxisLabelData
					{
						Label = yLogicalCoordinateValue.ToString(),
						YLogicalCoordinateValue = yLogicalCoordinateValue,
						YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue = labelValue2
					};
					_axisLabelDataList.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			for (double num = YDataMin; num <= YDataMax; num += 1.0)
			{
				BackgroundLineData item3 = new BackgroundLineData
				{
					YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue = num,
					YLogicalCoordinateValue = num
				};
				_backgroundLineDataList.Add(item3);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshDataForAxisLabelDataList()
		{
			for (double num = YDataMin; num <= YDataMax; num += 1.0)
			{
				_axisLabelDataList[(int)num].YLogicalCoordinateValue = num;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeTranslateTransform()
		{
			_translateTransformForYAxis = new TranslateTransform(_yAxisCanvas.ActualWidth, 0.0);
		}

		private void MakeSureXAxisActualWidth()
		{
			_xAxisUsedWidth = _xAxisCanvas.ActualWidth - SystemParameters.VerticalScrollBarWidth;
		}

		private void MakeSureXAxisUnitLength()
		{
			_xUnitLength = _xAxisUsedWidth / _xDataRange;
		}

		private void MakeSureYAxisActualHeight()
		{
			_yAxisUsedHeight = _yAxisCanvas.ActualHeight;
		}

		private void MakeSureYAxisUnitLengthAndDisplayUnitLength()
		{
			_yDisplayDataRange = DisplayEndStage - DisplayStartStage + 1.0;
			_yDisplayUnitLength = (_yUnitLength = _yAxisUsedHeight / _yDisplayDataRange);
		}

		private void UpdateAxisDataMaximumAndMinimum(bool isHorizonal)
		{
			if (isHorizonal)
			{
				DataMaximum = XDataMax;
				DataMinimum = XDataMin;
			}
			else
			{
				DataMaximum = _yDrawLogicalEnd;
				DataMinimum = _yDrawLogicalStart;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateStartAndEndPosition()
		{
			EndPosition = 1.0;
			StartPosition = 0.0;
		}

		private void DrawXAxis()
		{
			UpdateAxisDataMaximumAndMinimum(isHorizonal: true);
			UpdateIntervals(new Rect(new System.Windows.Size(_xAxisUsedWidth, _xAxisCanvas.ActualHeight)), isHorizontal: true, IntervalLength);
			double actualMajorStep = ActualMajorStep;
			double actualMinorStep = ActualMinorStep;
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			foreach (double item in CreateTickValues(XDataMin, XDataMax, actualMajorStep))
			{
				double xAxisDrawLocation = GetXAxisDrawLocation(item);
				if (!(xAxisDrawLocation < 0.0))
				{
					LineGeometry value = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(xAxisDrawLocation, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(xAxisDrawLocation, 9.0));
					geometryGroup.Children.Add(value);
					if (_xAxisUsingScientificNotation)
					{
						DrawXAxisLabels(item.ToString("0.#e+00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), xAxisDrawLocation);
					}
					else
					{
						DrawXAxisLabels(item.ToString(), xAxisDrawLocation);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (double item2 in CreateTickValues(XDataMin, XDataMax, actualMinorStep))
			{
				double xAxisDrawLocation2 = GetXAxisDrawLocation(item2);
				if (!(xAxisDrawLocation2 < 0.0))
				{
					LineGeometry value2 = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(xAxisDrawLocation2, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(xAxisDrawLocation2, 5.0));
					geometryGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path();
			path.Data = geometryGroup;
			path.Stroke = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			path.StrokeThickness = _lineThickness;
			_xAxisCanvas.Children.Add(path);
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path path2 = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path();
			LineGeometry data = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(GetXAxisDrawLocation(XDataMin), 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(GetXAxisDrawLocation(XDataMax) + 5.0, 0.0));
			path2.Data = data;
			path2.Stroke = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			path2.StrokeThickness = _lineThickness;
			_xAxisCanvas.Children.Add(path2);
		}

		private double GetXAxisDrawLocation(double xDatalocation)
		{
			return (xDatalocation - XDataMin) * _xUnitLength;
		}

		private double GetYAxisDrawLocation(double yDataLocation)
		{
			MakeSureYAxisUnitLengthAndDisplayUnitLength();
			return TransformYToDrawCoordinate((yDataLocation - _yDrawLogicalStart) * _yUnitLength);
		}

		private int GetActualAxisDataGap(double axisDataGap)
		{
			int num = GetFirstDigit(axisDataGap);
			if (num > 2 && num <= 5)
			{
				num = 5;
			}
			if (num > 5 && num <= 10)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(axisDataGap) + 1.0);
			if (num2 > 1)
			{
				if (GetIntArray((int)axisDataGap)[1] < 2)
				{
					return num * (int)Math.Pow(10.0, num2 - 1);
				}
				return num * (int)Math.Pow(10.0, num2);
			}
			if (axisDataGap > 5.0 && axisDataGap < 10.0)
			{
				return num * num2 * 10;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetFirstDigit(double number)
		{
			while (number >= 10.0)
			{
				number = (number - number % 10.0) / 10.0;
			}
			return (int)number;
		}

		private int[] GetIntArray(int num)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			while (num > 0)
			{
				list.Add(num % 10);
				num /= 10;
			}
			list.Reverse();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void DrawXAxisLabels(string text, double xActualLocation)
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
			textBlock.Text = text;
			textBlock.HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
			textBlock.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(FontFamily);
			_xAxisCanvas.Children.Add(textBlock);
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (char testChar in text)
			{
				num += GetSingleCharWidth(testChar);
			}
			Canvas.SetTop(textBlock, 10.0);
			Canvas.SetLeft(textBlock, xActualLocation - num / 2.0);
		}

		private void DrawYAxisLabels(string text, double yActualLocation, double yDrawLogicalCoordinateValue)
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
			textBlock.Text = text;
			textBlock.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(FontFamily);
			textBlock.Tag = yDrawLogicalCoordinateValue;
			_yAxisCanvasMask.Children.Add(textBlock);
			double length = yActualLocation - SmallAdjustValueForYAxisLabels;
			if (Math.Abs(yActualLocation - _yAxisUsedHeight) < 0.001)
			{
				length = yActualLocation - SmallAdjustValueForYAxisLabels * 1.2;
			}
			Canvas.SetTop(textBlock, length);
			double num = (double)textBlock.Text.Length * SingleCharWidth;
			Canvas.SetLeft(textBlock, (_yAxisCanvas.ActualWidth - num) / 2.0);
		}

		private double GetSingleCharWidth()
		{
			double result = -1.0;
			char key = 'W';
			new Typeface(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(FontFamily), FontStyles.Normal, FontWeights.Normal, FontStretches.Normal).TryGetGlyphTypeface(out var glyphTypeface);
			if (glyphTypeface != null)
			{
				glyphTypeface.CharacterToGlyphMap.TryGetValue(key, out var value);
				result = glyphTypeface.AdvanceWidths[value] * _fontSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetSingleCharHeight(char testChar)
		{
			double result = -1.0;
			new Typeface(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(FontFamily), FontStyles.Normal, FontWeights.Normal, FontStretches.Normal).TryGetGlyphTypeface(out var glyphTypeface);
			if (glyphTypeface != null)
			{
				glyphTypeface.CharacterToGlyphMap.TryGetValue(testChar, out var value);
				result = glyphTypeface.AdvanceHeights[value] * _fontSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetSingleCharWidth(char testChar)
		{
			double result = -1.0;
			new Typeface(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(FontFamily), FontStyles.Normal, FontWeights.Normal, FontStretches.Normal).TryGetGlyphTypeface(out var glyphTypeface);
			if (glyphTypeface != null)
			{
				glyphTypeface.CharacterToGlyphMap.TryGetValue(testChar, out var value);
				result = glyphTypeface.AdvanceWidths[value] * _fontSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void DrawYAxisTickAndLabels()
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();

				return;
			}

				LineGeometry value = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, yDrawCoordinateValue), new System.Windows.Point(-5.0, yDrawCoordinateValue));
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(value);
				DrawYAxisLabels(axisLabelData.Label, yDrawCoordinateValue, axisLabelData.YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue);
			}
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path();
			path.SnapsToDevicePixels = true;
			path.RenderTransform = _translateTransformForYAxis;
			path.Data = geometryGroup;
			path.Stroke = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			path.StrokeThickness = _lineThickness;

			_yAxisCanvas.Children.Add(path);
		}

		}

		private void DrawRectangle()
		{
			if (RectangleDataList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RectangleData rectangleData in RectangleDataList)
			{
				System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle();
				rectangle.SnapsToDevicePixels = true;
				switch (rectangleData.StageStatus)
				{
				case StageStatus.Normal:
					rectangle.Fill = _blueBrush;
					break;
				case StageStatus.Error:
					rectangle.Fill = _redBrush;
					break;
				case StageStatus.Warning:
					rectangle.Fill = _yellowBrush;
					break;
				}
				double rectangleWidth = GetRectangleWidth(rectangleData.XMaxLogical - rectangleData.XMinLogical);
				if (!(rectangleWidth <= 0.0))
				{
					rectangle.Width = rectangleWidth;
					rectangle.Height = GetRectangleHeight();
					rectangle.Tag = GetDrawLogicalY(rectangleData.YLogical);
					_mainCanvas.Children.Add(rectangle);
					Canvas.SetLeft(rectangle, GetXAxisDrawLocation(rectangleData.XMinLogical));
					Canvas.SetTop(rectangle, rectangleData.YDrawCoordinateValue);
					System.Windows.Controls.Panel.SetZIndex(rectangle, 0);
				}
			}
		}

		private void MainCanvasMask_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!CheckData())
			{
				return;
			}
			double y = e.GetPosition(_mainCanvasMask).Y;
			_trackBorder.Width = GetRectangleWidth(_xDataRange);
			_trackBorder.Height = GetRectangleHeight();

			int displaylStageNumber = GetDisplaylStageNumber(currentStage);
			if (StagesForPlot != null && StagesForPlot.Count > 0)
			{
				CAStageForPlot cAStageForPlot = StagesForPlot.FirstOrDefault((CAStageForPlot x) => x.StageNumber == currentStage);
				if (cAStageForPlot == null)
				{
					return;
				}

			}
			else
			{
				_trackBorderTextBlock.Text = string.Format(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.CA_SectionViewStagteTooltipNoSectionName, displaylStageNumber);
			}
			Canvas.SetTop(_trackBorder, y);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void SetStageTooltip(int internalStageNumber, string textContent, bool bInSection)
		{
			if (StageStatusDataList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (bInSection)
			{
				_trackBorderTextBlock.Text = textContent;
				_trackBorderToolTip.Background = _blueBrush;
				StageStatusData stageStatusData = StageStatusDataList.FirstOrDefault((StageStatusData x) => x.StateNumber == internalStageNumber);
				if (stageStatusData != null)
				{
					switch (stageStatusData.StageStatus)
					{
					case StageStatus.Warning:
						_trackBorderToolTip.Background = _yellowBrush;
						break;
					case StageStatus.Error:
						_trackBorderToolTip.Background = _redBrush;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int displaylStageNumber = GetDisplaylStageNumber(internalStageNumber);
				_trackBorderTextBlock.Text = string.Format(AspenTech.ColumnAnalysis.UserInterfaces.Properties.Resources.CA_StageDoesNotIncludedInAnySections, displaylStageNumber);
				_trackBorderToolTip.Background = _whiteBrush;
			}
		}

		protected IList<double> CreateTickValues(double min, double max, double step)
		{
			if (step <= 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Axis: Step cannot be zero.", "step");
			}
			if (max <= min && step > 0.0)
			{
				step *= -1.0;
			}
			double num = Math.Round(min / step) * step;
			int capacity = Math.Max((int)((max - min) / step), 1);
			double num2 = step * 0.001;
			List<double> list = new List<double>(capacity);
			int num3 = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				bool num4;
				if (!(step >= 0.0))
				{
					if (!(num >= max - num2))
					{
						break;
					}
					num4 = num3 < 1000;
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = num <= max + num2;
				}
				if (!num4)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3++;
				num = double.Parse(num.ToString("e8"));
				list.Add(num);
				num += step;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected IList<double> CreateTickValuesForYAxis(double min, double max, double step)
		{
			if (step <= 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Axis: Step cannot be zero.", "step");
			}
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (min == max)
			{
				list.Add(min);
			}
			else
			{
				if (max <= min && step > 0.0)
				{
					step *= -1.0;
				}
				for (double num = min; num <= max; num += step)
				{
					list.Add(num);
				}
				if (!list.Contains(max))
				{
					list.Add(max);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void MainScrollBar_Scroll(object sender, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_scrollBarLastDrawLogicalPosition == e.NewValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			_scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition = e.NewValue;
			UpdateDrawStartAndDrawEnd();
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (object child in _mainCanvas.Children)
			{
				if (child is System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle)
				{
					System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle obj = child as System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle;
					num = ((double)obj.Tag - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
					Canvas.SetTop(obj, num);
				}
				if (child is Border)
				{
					Border element = child as Border;
					double val = (double)CurrentStage - _blueBorderMargin - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition;
					double val2 = YDataMin - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition;
					double val3 = YDataMax - 2.0 * _blueBorderMargin - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition;
					val = Math.Max(val, val2);
					val = Math.Min(val, val3);
					_blueBorderTop = val * _yUnitLength;
					Canvas.SetTop(element, _blueBorderTop);
				}
				if (child is Ellipse)
				{
					Ellipse ellipse = child as Ellipse;
					Canvas.SetTop(ellipse, ((double)ellipse.Tag - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition + 0.5) * _yUnitLength - ellipse.Height / 2.0);
				}
				if (!(child is System.Windows.Shapes.Path))
				{
					continue;
				}
				System.Windows.Shapes.Path obj2 = child as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
				GeometryGroup geometryGroup = obj2.Data as GeometryGroup;
				IList<BackgroundLineData> list = obj2.Tag as IList<BackgroundLineData>;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (Geometry child2 in geometryGroup.Children)
				{
					LineGeometry obj3 = child2 as LineGeometry;
					BackgroundLineData backgroundLineData = list[num2];
					backgroundLineData.YDrawCoordinateValue = (backgroundLineData.YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
					obj3.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, backgroundLineData.YDrawCoordinateValue);
					obj3.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(GetXAxisDrawLocation(XDataMax), backgroundLineData.YDrawCoordinateValue);
					num2++;
				}
			}
			foreach (object child3 in _yAxisCanvas.Children)
			{
				if (!(child3 is System.Windows.Shapes.Path))
				{
					continue;
				}
				System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = child3 as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
				if (!(path.Data is GeometryGroup))
				{
					continue;
				}
				GeometryGroup obj4 = path.Data as GeometryGroup;
				int num3 = 0;
				IList<AxisLabelData> list2 = path.Tag as IList<AxisLabelData>;
				foreach (Geometry child4 in obj4.Children)
				{
					LineGeometry obj5 = child4 as LineGeometry;
					AxisLabelData axisLabelData = list2[num3];
					axisLabelData.YDrawCoordinateValue = (axisLabelData.YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
					obj5.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, axisLabelData.YDrawCoordinateValue);
					obj5.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(-5.0, axisLabelData.YDrawCoordinateValue);
					num3++;
				}
			}
			foreach (object child5 in _yAxisCanvasMask.Children)
			{
				if (child5 is TextBlock)
				{
					TextBlock obj6 = child5 as TextBlock;
					num = ((double)obj6.Tag - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
					num = ((!(Math.Abs(num - _yAxisUsedHeight) < 0.001)) ? (num - SmallAdjustValueForYAxisLabels) : (num - SmallAdjustValueForYAxisLabels * 1.2));
					Canvas.SetTop(obj6, num);
				}
			}
			_scrollBarLastDrawLogicalPosition = e.NewValue;
		}

		}

		private void PrepareDrawData()
		{
			if (_axisLabelDataList == null || RectangleDataList == null || _backgroundLineDataList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AxisLabelData axisLabelData in _axisLabelDataList)
			{
				axisLabelData.YDrawCoordinateValue = (axisLabelData.YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
			}
			foreach (RectangleData rectangleData in RectangleDataList)
			{
				rectangleData.YDrawCoordinateValue = (GetDrawLogicalY(rectangleData.YLogical) - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
			}
			foreach (BackgroundLineData backgroundLineData in _backgroundLineDataList)
			{
				backgroundLineData.YDrawCoordinateValue = (backgroundLineData.YDrawLogicalCoordinateValue - _scrollBarCurrentDrawLogicalPosition) * _yUnitLength;
			}
		}

		}

		internal virtual void UpdateIntervals(Rect plotArea, bool isHorizontal, double intervalLength)
		{
			if (CheckData())
			{
				double num = (isHorizontal ? plotArea.Width : plotArea.Height);
				num *= Math.Abs(EndPosition - StartPosition);
				ActualMajorStep = ((!double.IsNaN(MajorStep)) ? MajorStep : CalculateActualInterval(num, intervalLength));
				ActualMinorStep = ((!double.IsNaN(MinorStep)) ? MinorStep : CalculateMinorInterval(ActualMajorStep));
				if (double.IsNaN(ActualMinorStep))
				{
					ActualMinorStep = 2.0;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(ActualMajorStep))
				{
					ActualMajorStep = 10.0;
				}
				ActualStringFormat = StringFormat;
			}
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateActualInterval(double availableSize, double maxIntervalSize)
		{
			return CalculateActualInterval(availableSize, maxIntervalSize, DataMaximum - DataMinimum);
		}

		protected double CalculateActualInterval(double availableSize, double maxIntervalSize, double range)
		{
			if (availableSize <= 0.0 || range == 0.0)
			{
				return maxIntervalSize;
			}
			Func<double, double> exponent = (double x) => Math.Ceiling(Math.Log(x, 10.0));
			Func<double, double> func = (double x) => x / Math.Pow(10.0, exponent(x) - 1.0);
			double num = availableSize / maxIntervalSize;
			range = Math.Abs(range);
			double num2 = Math.Pow(10.0, exponent(range));
			double num3 = num2;
			Func<double, double> func2 = (double x) => double.Parse(x.ToString("e14"));
			while (true)
			{
				switch ((int)func(num3))
				{
				case 5:
					num3 = func2(num3 / 2.5);
					break;
				case 1:
				case 2:
				case 10:
					num3 = func2(num3 / 2.0);
					break;
				default:
					num3 = func2(num3 / 2.0);
					break;
				}
				if (range / num3 > num || double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsInfinity(num3))
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 = num3;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		protected double CalculateMinorInterval(double majorInterval)
		{
			return majorInterval / 5.0;
		}

		public virtual string FormatValue(double x)
		{
			if (UseSuperExponentialFormat && !x.Equals(0.0))
			{
				double num = Exponent(x);
				double num2 = Mantissa(x);
				return string.Format(format: (StringFormat != null) ? ("{0:" + StringFormat + "}·10^{{{1:0}}}") : ((Math.Abs(num2 - 1.0) < 1E-06) ? "10^{{{1:0}}}" : "{0}·10^{{{1:0}}}"), provider: ActualCulture, arg0: num2, arg1: num);
			}
			string format = "{0:" + (ActualStringFormat ?? StringFormat ?? string.Empty) + "}";
			return string.Format(ActualCulture, format, x);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(double width, double height)
		{

			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(10.0, 0.0);

		{

			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height - 10.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height - 10.0);
			return GenerateGeometry(p, p2, p3, p4, point, point2, point, Dock.Right, point2, Dock.Left);
		}

		private Geometry GenerateGeometry(System.Windows.Point p11, System.Windows.Point p12, System.Windows.Point p21, System.Windows.Point p22, System.Windows.Point p31, System.Windows.Point p32, System.Windows.Point bp1, Dock orientation1, System.Windows.Point bp2, Dock orientation2)
		{
			PathFigure item = null;
			PathFigure item2 = null;
			PathFigure pathFigure = null;
			PathFigure item3 = null;
			PathFigure item4 = null;
			if (IsFirstMarginalLineVisible)
			{
				item = new PathFigure(p11, new PathSegment[1]
				{
					new LineSegment(p12, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: false);
			}
			if (IsSecondMarginalLineVisible)
			{
				item2 = new PathFigure(p21, new PathSegment[1]
				{
					new LineSegment(p22, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: false);
			}
			pathFigure = new PathFigure(p31, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p32, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			if (IsFirstArrowVisible)
			{
				item3 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp1, orientation1);
			}
			if (IsSecondArrowVisible)
			{
				item4 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp2, orientation2);
			}
			List<PathFigure> obj = new List<PathFigure> { item, item2, pathFigure, item3, item4 };
			List<PathFigure> list = new List<PathFigure>();
			foreach (PathFigure item5 in obj)
			{
				if (item5 != null)
				{
					list.Add(item5);
				}
			}
			return new PathGeometry(list);
		}

		private PathFigure GenerateArrowFigure(System.Windows.Point basePoint, Dock orientation)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point;
			System.Windows.Point point2;
			switch (orientation)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, 7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, 7.0);
				break;
			default:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, -7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, -7.0);
				break;
			}
			return new PathFigure(basePoint, new PathSegment[2]
			{
				new LineSegment(point, isStroked: true),
				new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: true);
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				double y = ((Waist < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((Waist > height) ? height : Waist));
				double num = ((BottomWidthRate < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((BottomWidthRate > 1.0) ? 1.0 : BottomWidthRate));
				bool flag = IsLeftFolded && num < 1.0;
				bool flag2 = IsRightFolded && num < 1.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				if (flag && flag2)
				{
					num2 = width / 2.0 - width * num / 2.0;
					num3 = width / 2.0 + width * num / 2.0;
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					num2 = width * (1.0 - num);
					num3 = width;
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					num3 = width * num;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					num3 = width;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(width / 2.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width / 2.0, height);
				System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point4 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, y);
				System.Windows.Point point5 = new System.Windows.Point(num2, height);
				System.Windows.Point point6 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point7 = new System.Windows.Point(width, y);
				System.Windows.Point point8 = new System.Windows.Point(num3, height);
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure(point3, new PathSegment[5]
				{
					new LineSegment(point4, IsLeftStroked),
					new LineSegment(point5, IsLeftStroked),
					new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point3, isStroked: false)
				}, closed: true);
				PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure(point6, new PathSegment[5]
				{
					new LineSegment(point7, IsRightStroked),
					new LineSegment(point8, IsRightStroked),
					new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point6, isStroked: false)
				}, closed: true);
				return new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[2] { pathFigure, pathFigure2 });
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}

	public class EllipseProjection : Shape
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty StartingPointOffset1Property = DependencyProperty.Register("StartingPointOffset1", typeof(Vector), typeof(EllipseProjection), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Vector(0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StartingPointOffset2Property = DependencyProperty.Register("StartingPointOffset2", typeof(Vector), typeof(EllipseProjection), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Vector(0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewportRadiusProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewportRadius", typeof(double), typeof(EllipseProjection), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewportCenterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewportCenter", typeof(Vector), typeof(EllipseProjection), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Vector(0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public Vector StartingPointOffset1
		{
			get
			{
				return (Vector)GetValue(StartingPointOffset1Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StartingPointOffset1Property, value);
			}
		}

		public Vector StartingPointsOffset2
		{
			get
			{
				return (Vector)GetValue(StartingPointOffset2Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StartingPointOffset2Property, value);
			}
		}

		public double ViewportRadius
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ViewportRadiusProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewportRadiusProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Vector ViewportCenter
		{
			get
			{
				return (Vector)GetValue(ViewportCenterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewportCenterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (ViewportCenter.Length == 0.0 || ViewportRadius == 0.0)
				{
					return new PathGeometry();
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0) + StartingPointOffset1;
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0) + StartingPointsOffset2;
				System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0) + ViewportCenter;
				Vector vector = point3 - point;
				Vector vector2 = point3 - point2;
				if (vector.Length <= ViewportRadius || vector2.Length <= ViewportRadius)
				{
					return new PathGeometry();
				}
				System.Windows.Point point4 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point5 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				if (ViewportCenter.X > 0.0)
				{
					point4 = GetTangentPoint(point, point3, ViewportRadius, SweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
					point5 = GetTangentPoint(point2, point3, ViewportRadius, SweepDirection.Clockwise);
				}
				else
				{
					point4 = GetTangentPoint(point, point3, ViewportRadius, SweepDirection.Clockwise);
					point5 = GetTangentPoint(point2, point3, ViewportRadius, SweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
				}
				PathGeometry value = new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[2]
				{
					new PathFigure(point, new PathSegment[1]
					{
						new LineSegment(point4, isStroked: true)
					}, closed: true),
					new PathFigure(point2, new PathSegment[1]
					{
						new LineSegment(point5, isStroked: true)
					}, closed: true)
				});
				EllipseGeometry value2 = new EllipseGeometry(point3, ViewportRadius, ViewportRadius);
				return new GeometryGroup
				{
					Children = 
					{
						(Geometry)value,
						(Geometry)value2
					}
				};
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Point GetTangentPoint(System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point centerPoint, double radius, SweepDirection sweepDirection)
		{
			Vector vector = startPoint - centerPoint;
			double num = Math.Acos(radius / vector.Length) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			if (sweepDirection == SweepDirection.Clockwise)
			{
				num *= -1.0;
			}
			Vector vector2 = new RotateTransform(num).Value.Transform(vector) * (radius / vector.Length);
			return centerPoint + vector2;
		}
	}
	public class GeometryComBoInputBox : XamComboEditor
	{
		private class DataDragHelper
		{
			private System.Windows.Point? _startPos;

			private readonly GeometryComBoInputBox _parent;

			public DataDragHelper(GeometryComBoInputBox parent)
			{
				_parent = parent;
			}

			public void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				_startPos = e.GetPosition((IInputElement)_parent);
			}

			public void OnPreviewMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (_startPos.HasValue && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && (e.GetPosition((IInputElement)_parent) - _startPos.Value).Length > 5.0)
				{
					_startPos = null;
					e.Handled = true;
					StartDrag();
				}
			}

			private void StartDrag()
			{
				System.Windows.DataObject dataObject = new System.Windows.DataObject();
				dataObject.SetText(((XamComboEditor)_parent).SelectedText, System.Windows.TextDataFormat.Text);
				ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs e = new ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs(ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEvent, _parent, dataObject, ((FrameworkElement)(object)_parent).Tag as StringVariable);
				_parent.OnDataDragStarting(e);
				if (!e.Handled)
				{
					DragDrop.DoDragDrop((DependencyObject)(object)_parent, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
				}
			}

			public void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				_startPos = null;
			}
		}

		public static readonly RoutedEvent ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ComBoEditorDataDragStarting", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs>), typeof(GeometryComBoInputBox));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BindingPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BindingPath", typeof(string), typeof(GeometryComBoInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(OnBindingPathPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDefaultValuedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDefaultValued", typeof(bool), typeof(GeometryComBoInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsDefaultValuedPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsReadOnlyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsReadOnly", typeof(bool), typeof(GeometryComBoInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsReadOnlyPropertyChanged));

		private static void OnBindingPathPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			GeometryComBoInputBox geometryComBoInputBox = d as GeometryComBoInputBox;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(geometryComBoInputBox.BindingPath))
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).ClearValue(IsDefaultValuedProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).ClearValue(IsReadOnlyProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).ClearValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
				return;
			}
			((FrameworkElement)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).SetBinding(FrameworkElement.TagProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryComBoInputBox.BindingPath)
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			((FrameworkElement)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).SetBinding(IsDefaultValuedProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryComBoInputBox.BindingPath + ".IsDefaultValued")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			((FrameworkElement)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).SetBinding(IsReadOnlyProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryComBoInputBox.BindingPath + ".IsReadOnly")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			((FrameworkElement)(object)geometryComBoInputBox).SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryComBoInputBox.BindingPath + ".IsReadOnly")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay,
				Converter = geometryComBoInputBox.EnableReadOnlyConverter
			});
		}

		private void UpdateStyle()
		{
			if (!IsReadOnly)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Blue);
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).FontWeight = (IsDefaultValued ? FontWeights.Normal : FontWeights.Bold);
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).FontStyle = (IsDefaultValued ? FontStyles.Italic : FontStyles.Normal);
			}
			else
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).FontWeight = FontWeights.Normal;
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)this).FontStyle = FontStyles.Normal;
			}
		}

	public class ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		public System.Windows.IDataObject DataObject { get; private set; }

		public StringVariable StringVariable { get; private set; }

		public ComBoEditorDataDragStartingEventArgs(RoutedEvent routedEvent, object source, System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject, StringVariable ContextData)
			: base(routedEvent, source)
		{
			if (dataObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataObject");
			}
			if (ContextData == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ContextData");
			}
			DataObject = dataObject;
			StringVariable = ContextData;
		}
	}
	public class GeometryInputBox : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector

		private class DataDragHelper
		{
			private System.Windows.Point? _startPos;

			private readonly GeometryInputBox _parent;

			public DataDragHelper(GeometryInputBox parent)
			{
				_parent = parent;
			}

			public void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (((XamMaskedEditor)_parent.numericEditor).SelectionLength > 0)
				{
					_startPos = e.GetPosition(_parent);
				}
				else
				{
					_startPos = null;
				}
			}

			public void OnPreviewMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (_startPos.HasValue && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && ((XamMaskedEditor)_parent.numericEditor).SelectionLength > 0 && (e.GetPosition(_parent) - _startPos.Value).Length > 5.0)
				{
					_startPos = null;
					e.Handled = true;
					StartDrag();
				}
			}

			private void StartDrag()
			{
				System.Windows.DataObject dataObject = new System.Windows.DataObject();
				dataObject.SetText(((XamMaskedEditor)_parent.numericEditor).SelectedText, System.Windows.TextDataFormat.Text);
				DataDragStartingEventArgs e = new DataDragStartingEventArgs(DataDragStartingEvent, _parent, dataObject, _parent.Tag as LengthVariable);
				_parent.OnDataDragStarting(e);
				if (!e.Handled)
				{
					DragDrop.DoDragDrop(_parent, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
				}
			}

			public void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				_startPos = null;
			}
		}

		static GeometryInputBox()
		{
			PositiveDoubleMask = "{char:20:0-9eE,.+-}";
			CaptionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Caption", typeof(string), typeof(GeometryInputBox));
			CaptionDockProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CaptionDock", typeof(Dock), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(Dock.Left));
			CaptionMarginProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CaptionMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 0.0)));
			CaptionVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CaptionVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible));
			ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(double?), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(OnValuePropertyChanged));
			TooltipProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Tooltip", typeof(string), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(OnUnitsPropertyChanged));
			UnitsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Units", typeof(string), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(OnUnitsPropertyChanged));
			UnitsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UnitsSource", typeof(IEnumerable<string>), typeof(GeometryInputBox));
			UnitsVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UnitsVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible));
			IsReadOnlyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsReadOnly", typeof(bool), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsReadOnlyPropertyChanged));
			IsDefaultValuedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDefaultValued", typeof(bool), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsDefaultValuedPropertyChanged));
			BindingPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BindingPath", typeof(string), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(OnBindingPathPropertyChanged));
			ValueFormatProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueFormat", typeof(string), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata("G6", OnValueFormatPropertyChanged));
			IsHighlightedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsHighlighted", typeof(bool), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(false));
			HighlightedBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HighlightedBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(250, 250, 50))));
			AllowChangeUnitsWhenIsReadOnlyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowChangeUnitsWhenIsReadOnly", typeof(bool?), typeof(GeometryInputBox), new UIPropertyMetadata(OnAllowChangeUnitsWhenIsReadOnlyPropertyChanged));
			ValueChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ValueChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<double?>), typeof(GeometryInputBox));
			UnitsChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("UnitsChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<string>), typeof(GeometryInputBox));
			DataDragStartingEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DataDragStarting", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<DataDragStartingEventArgs>), typeof(GeometryInputBox));
			FrameworkElement.MarginProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GeometryInputBox), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)));

		public GeometryInputBox()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			UpdateStyle();
			((ValueEditor)numericEditor).TextChanged += numericEditor_TextChanged;
			((UIElement)(object)numericEditor).PreviewKeyDown += numericEditor_PreviewKeyDown;
			((ValueEditor)numericEditor).EditModeEnded += numericEditor_EditModeEnded;
			unitsComboEditor.SelectedItemChanged += unitsComboEditor_SelectedItemChanged;
			((UIElement)(object)unitsComboEditor).LostFocus += unitsComboEditor_LostFocus;
			((UIElement)(object)unitsComboEditor).PreviewKeyDown += unitsComboEditor_PreviewKeyDown;
		}

		private void numericEditor_TextChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<string> e)
		{
			_textChanged = true;
		}

		private void unitsComboEditor_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((ValueEditor)unitsComboEditor).IsFocusWithin)
			{
				if (((ValueEditor)numericEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					_canCancel = false;
					((ValueEditor)numericEditor).EndEditMode(true, false);
					_canCancel = true;
				}
				if (!_valueUpdatedToDataSource)
				{
					UpdateValue();
				}
			}
		}

		private void unitsComboEditor_SelectedItemChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			if (!(base.DataContext is TrayGeometryData trayGeometryData))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				trayGeometryData.SuppressNotifySubPropertyChanged = true;
				if (((ValueEditor)numericEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					_canCancel = false;
					((ValueEditor)numericEditor).EndEditMode(true, false);
					_canCancel = true;
				}
				if (!_valueUpdatedToDataSource)
				{
					UpdateValue();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				trayGeometryData.SuppressNotifySubPropertyChanged = null;
			}
			UpdateUnits();
		}

		private void numericEditor_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return && ((ValueEditor)numericEditor).IsInEditMode)
			{
				((ValueEditor)numericEditor).EndEditMode(true, false);
			}
		}

		private void unitsComboEditor_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				if (((ValueEditor)numericEditor).IsInEditMode)
				{
					_canCancel = false;
					((ValueEditor)numericEditor).EndEditMode(true, false);
					_canCancel = true;
				}
				if (!_valueUpdatedToDataSource)
				{
					UpdateValue();
				}
			}
		}

		private void numericEditor_EditModeStarted(object sender, EditModeStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamMaskedEditor)numericEditor).SelectAll();
			if (!IsReadOnly)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)numericEditor).Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Blue);
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)numericEditor).FontWeight = ((IsDefaultValued || ((ValueEditor)numericEditor).IsInEditMode) ? FontWeights.Normal : FontWeights.Bold);
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)numericEditor).FontStyle = (IsDefaultValued ? FontStyles.Italic : FontStyles.Normal);

				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)numericEditor).Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)numericEditor).FontWeight = FontWeights.Normal;
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)numericEditor).FontStyle = FontStyles.Normal;
			}
			_valueUpdatedToDataSource = false;
		}

		private void numericEditor_EditModeEnding(object sender, EditModeEndingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_canCancel && ((UIElement)(object)unitsComboEditor).IsMouseOver)
			{
				if (_textChanged)
				{
					_valueUpdatedToDataSource = false;
				}
				else
				{
					_valueUpdatedToDataSource = true;
				}
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
		}

		private void numericEditor_EditModeEnded(object sender, EditModeEndedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateValue();
		}

			}
		}

		private static void OnBindingPathPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			GeometryInputBox geometryInputBox = d as GeometryInputBox;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(geometryInputBox.BindingPath))
			{
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(ValueProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(UnitsProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(IsReadOnlyProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(IsDefaultValuedProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(IsHighlightedProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(UnitsSourceProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(ValueFormatProperty);
				geometryInputBox.ClearValue(AllowChangeUnitsWhenIsReadOnlyProperty);
				return;
			}
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(ValueProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".Value")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(UnitsProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".Units")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(IsReadOnlyProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".IsReadOnly")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(IsDefaultValuedProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".IsDefaultValued")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(IsHighlightedProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".IsHighlighted")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".ToolTip")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(UnitsSourceProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".Owner.UnitsSource")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.TagProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath)
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(ValueFormatProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".Format")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(AllowChangeUnitsWhenIsReadOnlyProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".AllowChangeUnitsWhenIsReadOnly")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			geometryInputBox.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(geometryInputBox.BindingPath + ".Visibility")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
		}

		public Thickness Padding
		{

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				if (width <= Padding.Left + Padding.Right || height <= Padding.Top + Padding.Bottom)
				{
					return new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(base.DesiredSize));
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
				System.Windows.Point point4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
				double width2 = (width - Padding.Left - Padding.Right) / 2.0;
				double num = (height - Padding.Top - Padding.Bottom) / 2.0;
				System.Windows.Point point5 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, Padding.Top + num);
				System.Windows.Point point6 = new System.Windows.Point(width, Padding.Top + num);
				System.Windows.Point point7 = new System.Windows.Point(Padding.Left, Padding.Top + num);
				System.Windows.Point point8 = new System.Windows.Point(width - Padding.Right, Padding.Top + num);
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure(point, new PathSegment[6]
				{
					new LineSegment(point5, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point7, isStroked: false),
					new ArcSegment(point8, new System.Windows.Size(width2, num), 180.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked: true),
					new LineSegment(point6, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point, isStroked: false)
				}, closed: true);
				PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure(point4, new PathSegment[6]
				{
					new LineSegment(point6, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point8, isStroked: false),
					new ArcSegment(point7, new System.Windows.Size(width2, num), 180.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked: true),
					new LineSegment(point5, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point3, isStroked: false),
					new LineSegment(point4, isStroked: false)
				}, closed: true);
				return new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[2] { pathFigure, pathFigure2 });
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}

			return new System.Windows.Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryForInternalLeft(double width, double height)

		}

		private static Geometry GenerateGeometry(System.Windows.Point p11, System.Windows.Point p12, System.Windows.Point p21, System.Windows.Point p22, System.Windows.Point p31, System.Windows.Point p32, System.Windows.Point bp1, Dock orientation1, System.Windows.Point bp2, Dock orientation2)
		{
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure(p11, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p12, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			PathFigure pathFigure2 = new PathFigure(p21, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p22, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			PathFigure pathFigure3 = new PathFigure(p31, new PathSegment[1]
			{
				new LineSegment(p32, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: false);
			PathFigure pathFigure4 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp1, orientation1);
			PathFigure pathFigure5 = GenerateArrowFigure(bp2, orientation2);
			return new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[5] { pathFigure, pathFigure2, pathFigure3, pathFigure4, pathFigure5 });
		}

		private static PathFigure GenerateArrowFigure(System.Windows.Point basePoint, Dock orientation)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point;
			System.Windows.Point point2;
			switch (orientation)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, -2.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(-7.0, 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, 7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, 7.0);
				break;
			default:
				point = basePoint + new Vector(-2.0, -7.0);
				point2 = basePoint + new Vector(2.0, -7.0);
				break;
			}
			return new PathFigure(basePoint, new PathSegment[2]
			{
				new LineSegment(point, isStroked: true),
				new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true)
			}, closed: true);
		}
	}
	public class RoundCornerRectangle : Shape
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CornerRadiusProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CornerRadius", typeof(double), typeof(RoundCornerRectangle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public double CornerRadius
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(CornerRadiusProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CornerRadiusProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				System.Windows.Point start = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height / 2.0);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure(start, new PathSegment[3]
				{
					new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true),
					new LineSegment(point3, isStroked: true),
					new ArcSegment(point, new System.Windows.Size(CornerRadius, CornerRadius), 10.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked: true)
				}, closed: true);
				return new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[1] { pathFigure });
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}
	}
	public class SideLookSketch : Shape
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TopLineOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TopLineOffset", typeof(double), typeof(SideLookSketch), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BottomLineOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BottomLineOffset", typeof(double), typeof(SideLookSketch), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public double TopLineOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(TopLineOffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TopLineOffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double BottomLineOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(BottomLineOffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BottomLineOffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Geometry DefiningGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				double width = base.RenderSize.Width;
				double height = base.RenderSize.Height;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point start = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, TopLineOffset);
				System.Windows.Point start2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height - BottomLineOffset);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, height);
				System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(width, 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point4 = new System.Windows.Point(width, TopLineOffset);
				System.Windows.Point point5 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height - BottomLineOffset);
				System.Windows.Point point6 = new System.Windows.Point(width, height);
				return new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[3]
				{
					new PathFigure(point, new PathSegment[4]
					{
						new LineSegment(point2, isStroked: true),
						new LineSegment(point6, isStroked: false),
						new LineSegment(point3, isStroked: true),
						new LineSegment(point, isStroked: false)
					}, closed: true),
					new PathFigure(start, new PathSegment[1]
					{
						new LineSegment(point4, isStroked: true)
					}, closed: false),
					new PathFigure(start2, new PathSegment[1]
					{
						new LineSegment(point5, isStroked: true)
					}, closed: false)
				});
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size((double.IsNaN(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Width, (double.IsNaN(constraint.Height) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)) ? 0.0 : constraint.Height);
		}
	}

	public class ColumnAnalyzerModel : IColumnAnalyzerModel
	{
		internal class ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys
		{
			internal Dictionary<string, int> OptionScreenRegistered { get; set; }

			internal Dictionary<string, string> OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys { get; set; }

			internal Dictionary<string, CAHydraulicFlowBasis> OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais { get; set; }

			internal Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>> AllSectionsRegistered { get; set; }

			private Dictionary<string, SimSectionDataBase> InputData { get; set; }

			private Dictionary<string, CASectionResultDataBase> ResultData { get; set; }

			internal ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys()
			{
				AllSectionsRegistered = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>>();
				InputData = new Dictionary<string, SimSectionDataBase>();
				ResultData = new Dictionary<string, CASectionResultDataBase>();
				OptionScreenRegistered = new Dictionary<string, int>();
				OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais = new Dictionary<string, CAHydraulicFlowBasis>();
			}

			internal void UnRegisterAll()
			{
				AllSectionsRegistered.Clear();
				InputData.Clear();
				ResultData.Clear();
				OptionScreenRegistered.Clear();
				OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.Clear();
				OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais.Clear();
			}

			internal void Regist(string columnKey, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
			{
				if (!AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(columnKey))
				{
					AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey] = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
				}
				if (!AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey][sConfigOptionKey] = new List<string>();
				}
				List<string> list = AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey][sConfigOptionKey];
				if (list != null && !list.Contains(sectionKey))
				{
					AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey][sConfigOptionKey].Add(sectionKey);
				}
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (!InputData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					InputData.Add(key, null);
				}
				if (!ResultData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					ResultData.Add(key, null);
				}
			}

			internal void UnRegister(string columnKey, string sConfigOptionKey = "", string sectionKey = "")
			{
				if (!AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(columnKey))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					AllSectionsRegistered.Remove(columnKey);
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionKey))
				{
					AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].Remove(sConfigOptionKey);
					if (AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].Count() == 0)
					{
						AllSectionsRegistered.Remove(columnKey);
					}
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) && AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey][sConfigOptionKey].Remove(sectionKey);
					string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
					if (InputData.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						InputData.Remove(key);
					}
					if (ResultData.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						ResultData.Remove(key);
					}
					if (AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey][sConfigOptionKey] != null && AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey][sConfigOptionKey].Count == 0)
					{
						AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].Remove(sConfigOptionKey);
					}
					if (AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(columnKey) && AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].Count == 0)
					{
						AllSectionsRegistered.Remove(columnKey);
					}
				}
			}

			internal List<string> GetAllInternalOptions(string columnKey)
			{
				if (!AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(columnKey))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey]?.Keys.ToList();
			}

			internal List<string> GetAllSecsInOption(string columnKey, string optionKey)
			{
				if (!AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(columnKey))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey].ContainsKey(optionKey))
				{
					return null;
				}
				Dictionary<string, List<string>> dictionary = AllSectionsRegistered[columnKey];
				if (dictionary != null && dictionary.ContainsKey(optionKey))
				{
					return dictionary[optionKey];
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal void ClearResultsData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
			{
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (ResultData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					ResultData[key] = null;
				}
			}

			internal void UpdateOptionKey(string oldColumnKey, string newColumnKey, string oldOpionKey, string newOptionKey, IList<string> sectionKeys)
			{
				try
				{
					foreach (string sectionKey in sectionKeys)
					{
						string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(oldOpionKey, sectionKey);
						string key2 = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(newOptionKey, sectionKey);
						if (InputData.ContainsKey(key))
						{
							InputData.Add(key2, InputData[key]);
							InputData.Remove(key);
						}
						if (ResultData.ContainsKey(key))
						{
							ResultData.Add(key2, ResultData[key]);
							ResultData.Remove(key);
						}
					}
					if (AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(oldColumnKey) && AllSectionsRegistered[oldColumnKey][oldOpionKey] != null && AllSectionsRegistered[oldColumnKey][oldOpionKey].Count > 0)
					{
						new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
						List<string> value = AllSectionsRegistered[oldColumnKey][oldOpionKey];
						if (!AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(newColumnKey))
						{
							Dictionary<string, List<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
							dictionary.Add(newOptionKey, value);
							AllSectionsRegistered.Add(newColumnKey, dictionary);
						}
						else
						{
							AllSectionsRegistered[newColumnKey].Add(newOptionKey, value);
						}
						AllSectionsRegistered[oldColumnKey].Remove(oldOpionKey);
					}
					if (AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(oldColumnKey) && AllSectionsRegistered[oldColumnKey].Count == 0)
					{
						AllSectionsRegistered.Remove(oldColumnKey);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			internal void SaveResultData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, CASectionResultDataBase resultData)
			{
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				ResultData[key] = resultData;
			}

			internal void SaveInputData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, SimSectionDataBase inputData)
			{
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (InputData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					InputData[key] = inputData;
				}
			}

			internal SimSectionDataBase GetInputData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
			{
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (InputData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return InputData[key];
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal bool IsSectionRegistered(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
			{
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (ResultData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal string GetColumnKeyFromOptionKey(string sConfigOptionKey)
			{
				if (AllSectionsRegistered == null || AllSectionsRegistered.Count == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return AllSectionsRegistered.Where(delegate(KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>> o)
				{
					KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>> keyValuePair = o;
					return keyValuePair.Value.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey);
				}).Select(delegate(KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>> o)
				{
					KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>> keyValuePair = o;
					return keyValuePair.Key;
				}).First();
			}

			internal CASectionResultDataBase GetResultData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
			{
				string key = CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (ResultData.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return ResultData[key];
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal void ClearInputResultData()
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < InputData.Count; i++)
				{
					string key = InputData.Keys.ToList()[i];
					ResultData[key] = null;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < InputData.Count; j++)
				{
					string key2 = InputData.Keys.ToList()[j];
					InputData[key2] = null;
				}
			}

			internal void RegisterPlotScreen(string columnKey, string sConfigOptionKey)
			{
				if (OptionScreenRegistered.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					OptionScreenRegistered[sConfigOptionKey]++;
				}
				else
				{
					OptionScreenRegistered.Add(sConfigOptionKey, 1);
				}
				if (!OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.Add(sConfigOptionKey, columnKey);
				}
				if (!OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais.Add(sConfigOptionKey, new CAHydraulicFlowBasis());
				}
			}

			internal void UnRegisterPlotScreen(string columnKey, string sConfigOptionKey)
			{
				if (OptionScreenRegistered.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey) && OptionScreenRegistered[sConfigOptionKey] > 0)
				{
					OptionScreenRegistered[sConfigOptionKey]--;
				}
				if (OptionScreenRegistered.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey) && OptionScreenRegistered[sConfigOptionKey] == 0)
				{
					OptionScreenRegistered.Remove(sConfigOptionKey);
					OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.Remove(sConfigOptionKey);
					OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais.Remove(sConfigOptionKey);
				}
			}

			internal CAHydraulicFlowBasis GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(string sConfigOptionKey)
			{
				if (OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					return OptionScreenRegisteredFlowBais[sConfigOptionKey];
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal void ClearResults()
			{
				ResultData.Clear();
			}

			internal bool IsConfigOptionScreenRegistered(string sConfigOptionKey)
			{
				if (OptionScreenRegistered.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void Run(bool ensureDowncomerBalanced = false, bool onlyRunOpenedPlots = false)
		{
			try
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys == null || _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.AllSectionsRegistered.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!PartialRunFlag)
				{
					_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.ClearInputResultData();
				}
				ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered != null && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, int> item in _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered)
					{
						IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(item.Key);
						ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(item.Key);
						if (simulatorCADataProvider.IsColumnDisabled(columnInternalsData.FullColumnName))
						{
							continue;
						}
						simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateRunMode(Mode: true);
						bool flag = false;
						if (sectionsRange != null)
						{
							foreach (CASectionRange item2 in sectionsRange)
							{
								bool flag2 = simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaults(item.Key, item2.SectionKey, PartialRunFlag ? RunOption.No : RunOption.NoButForcedUpdate, ensureDowncomerBalanced);
								CASectionResultDataBase resultData = ColumnInternalRegistered.GetResultData(item.Key, item2.SectionKey);
								if (flag2 || (!flag2 && resultData == null))
								{
									bool flag3 = RunCASection(columnInternalsData, item.Key, item2.SectionKey, forceCalcPlot: false);
									flag = flag || flag3;
									num++;
									continue;
								}
								if (item2.StartStageNumber == 0 || item2.EndStageNumber == 0 || item2.StartStageNumber > item2.EndStageNumber)
								{
									string columnKey = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys[item.Key];
									RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.SectionStatusChangeToIncomplete, columnKey, item.Key, item2.SectionKey);
									continue;
								}
								SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(item.Key, item2.SectionKey);
								if (simSectionData != null && simSectionData.IsCompleteStatus == false)
								{
									string columnKeyFromOptionKey = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetColumnKeyFromOptionKey(item.Key);
									if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnKeyFromOptionKey))
									{
										RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.SectionStatusChangeToIncomplete, columnKeyFromOptionKey, item.Key, item2.SectionKey);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							CAColumnInternalResults columnInternalLevelResultData = GetColumnInternalLevelResultData(item.Key);
							PublishCAColumnInternalResults(columnInternalLevelResultData, item.Key);
						}
					}
				}
				if (!onlyRunOpenedPlots)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, List<string>>> item3 in _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.AllSectionsRegistered)
					{
						Dictionary<string, List<string>> value = item3.Value;
						if (value.Count <= 0)
						{
							continue;
						}
						ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData2 = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(value.First().Key);
						if (simulatorCADataProvider.IsColumnDisabled(columnInternalsData2.FullColumnName))
						{
							continue;
						}
						simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateRunMode(Mode: true);
						foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<string>> item4 in value)
						{
							UpdateCAModelWhenInputIncomplete(item4.Key);
							if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered != null && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered.Count > 0 && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered.ContainsKey(item4.Key))
							{
								continue;
							}
							int num2 = 0;
							foreach (string item5 in item4.Value)
							{
								if (simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaults(item4.Key, item5, PartialRunFlag ? RunOption.No : RunOption.NoButForcedUpdate, ensureDowncomerBalanced))
								{
									RunCASection(columnInternalsData2, item4.Key, item5, forceCalcPlot: false);
									num++;
									num2++;
								}
							}
							if (num2 > 0)
							{
								CAColumnInternalResults columnInternalLevelResultData2 = GetColumnInternalLevelResultData(item4.Key);
								PublishCAColumnInternalResults(columnInternalLevelResultData2, item4.Key);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(null, null, null);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public void Run(string columnKey, IDictionary<string, IList<string>> allConfigOptionsOfAColumn)
		{
			if (allConfigOptionsOfAColumn == null || allConfigOptionsOfAColumn.Count < 1 || allConfigOptionsOfAColumn.First().Value == null || allConfigOptionsOfAColumn.First().Value.Count < 1 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnKey))

			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetColumnInternalsData(key);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IList<string>> item in allConfigOptionsOfAColumn)
			{
				string key2 = item.Key;
				foreach (string item2 in item.Value)
				{
					RunCASection(columnInternalsData, key2, item2, forceCalcPlot: false);
				}
			}
		}
