		private void PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(CASectionResultDataBase sectionResult, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, bool isUserSubroutine = false, bool isOld = false)
		{
			try
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				CAResultUpdateEventArgs args = new CAResultUpdateEventArgs(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, sectionResult);
				args.IsOld = isOld;
				args.IsUserSubroutine = isUserSubroutine;
				if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS || hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus)
				{
					(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow as Window).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
					{
						((CompositePresentationEvent<CAResultUpdateEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<CAResultUpdateEvent>()).Publish(args);
					});
				}
				else if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenAnalytics)
				{
					((CompositePresentationEvent<CAResultUpdateEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<CAResultUpdateEvent>()).Publish(args);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void Run(string sConfigOptionKey, IList<string> Sections, bool forceCalcPlot = false, bool ensureDowncomerBalanced = false)
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
			foreach (string Section in Sections)
			{
				simulatorCADataProvider.UpdateDefaults(sConfigOptionKey, Section, RunOption.No, ensureDowncomerBalanced);
				RunCASection(columnInternalsData, sConfigOptionKey, Section, forceCalcPlot);
			}
		}

		private bool RunCASection(ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, bool forceCalcPlot)
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = obj.GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
			CAOption columnOption = obj.GetColumnOption(sConfigOptionKey);
			if (simSectionData == null || columnOption == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			_CAMessagesManager.CleanSectionMessage(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
			simSectionData.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc = columnOption.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (simSectionData.IsCompleteStatus.HasValue && simSectionData.IsCompleteStatus.HasValue)
			{
				flag2 = simSectionData.IsCompleteStatus.Value;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				flag2 = IsSectionComplete(simSectionData, sConfigOptionKey);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (simSectionData is CATraySectionData)
				{
					flag = RunTrayRatingSection(columnData, simSectionData as CATraySectionData, columnOption, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, forceCalcPlot);
				}
				else if (simSectionData is CAPackingSectionData)
				{
					flag = RunPackRatingSection(columnData, simSectionData as CAPackingSectionData, columnOption, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, forceCalcPlot);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (!flag && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
			{
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsSectionRegistered(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey))
				{
					UpdateCAModelWhenInputIncomplete(sConfigOptionKey);
				}
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					string columnKey = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys[sConfigOptionKey];
					RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum.SectionStatusChangeToIncomplete, columnKey, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool RunPackRatingSection(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAOption colSetting, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, bool forceCalcPlot)
		{
			if (columnData == null || columnData.Stages == null || columnData.Stages.Count == 0 || colSetting == null || sectionData == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!sectionData.PressureDropMethod.IsEmpty() && sectionData.PressureDropMethod.GetEnumStringValue() != null && sectionData.PressureDropMethod.GetEnumStringValue().Equals(PackPressureDropCalculationMethodEnum.User.ToString(), StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(null, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, isUserSubroutine: true);
				return false;
			}
			int count = columnData.Stages.Count;
			if (count < sectionData.StartStage.Value - 1 || count < sectionData.EndingStage.Value - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionData.CheckRequiredData()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
			{
				SimSectionDataBase inputData = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetInputData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetResultData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey) as CAPackingSectionResults;
				bool flag2 = IsColumnHydraulicDataChangedForPack(columnData, cAPackingSectionResults, sectionData.OverDesignFactor.Value);
				if (inputData != null && cAPackingSectionResults != null && !flag2)
				{
					if (forceCalcPlot && !cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.HasPlotData)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (inputData.Equals(sectionData))
					{
						flag = false;
						PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(cAPackingSectionResults, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, isUserSubroutine: false, isOld: true);
						_PackWrapper.PulbishEngineMessages(columnData, sectionData, cAPackingSectionResults, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bool genratePlotResults = forceCalcPlot;
				if (!forceCalcPlot && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
				{
					genratePlotResults = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsConfigOptionScreenRegistered(sConfigOptionKey);
				}
				CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults2 = _PackWrapper.CallPackingFormAndPlotRoutine(sectionData, columnData, colSetting, genratePlotResults);
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
				{
					bool flag3 = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsSectionRegistered(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
					if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsConfigOptionScreenRegistered(sConfigOptionKey) && !flag3 && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
					{
						string columnKey = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys[sConfigOptionKey];
						RegisterSection(columnKey, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
					}
					_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.SaveInputData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, sectionData);
					_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.SaveResultData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, cAPackingSectionResults2);
				}
				PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(cAPackingSectionResults2, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (cAPackingSectionResults2 != null)
				{
					_PackWrapper.PulbishEngineMessages(columnData, sectionData, cAPackingSectionResults2, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsColumnHydraulicDataChangedForPack(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAPackingSectionResults sectionResult, double overDesignFactor)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (columnData == null || sectionResult == null || sectionResult.HydraulicResults == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Dictionary<int, CAStage> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, CAStage>();
			foreach (CAStage stage in columnData.Stages)
			{
				dictionary.Add(stage.StageNum.Value, stage);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CAPackingHydraulicData> hydraulicResult in sectionResult.HydraulicResults)
			{
				if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(hydraulicResult.Value.MassLiquidRate.Value / overDesignFactor, dictionary[hydraulicResult.Key].MassFlowLiquid.Value))
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool RunTrayRatingSection(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CATraySectionData sectionData, CAOption colSetting, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, bool forceCalcPlot)
		{
			string enumStringValue = sectionData.FloodingCalculationMethod.GetEnumStringValue();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(enumStringValue) && enumStringValue.Equals(FloodingCalculationMethodSieveEnum.User.ToString()))
			{
				PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(null, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, isUserSubroutine: true);
				return false;
			}
			if (!sectionData.IsDataReady())
			{
				return false;
			}
			CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(sConfigOptionKey);
			if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis == null)
			{
				cAHydraulicFlowBasis = new CAHydraulicFlowBasis();
			}
			sectionData.VUnitIndex.Value = (int)cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis;
			sectionData.LUnitIndex.Value = (int)cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis;
			CADataHelper.KeyGeneration(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
			bool flag = true;
			if (flag)
			{
				RunNewTraySectionForPlot(columnData, sectionData, colSetting, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, forceCalcPlot);
			}
			if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
			{
				SimSectionDataBase inputData = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetInputData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetResultData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey) as TraySectionResultData;
				bool flag2 = IsColumnHydraulicDataChangedForTray(columnData, traySectionResultData, sectionData.OverdesignFactor.Value);
				if (inputData != null && traySectionResultData != null && !flag2)
				{
					if (inputData.Equals(sectionData))
					{
						if (forceCalcPlot)
						{
							if (traySectionResultData.ContainsPlotData)
							{
								flag = false;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(traySectionResultData, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, isUserSubroutine: false, isOld: true);
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsColumnHydraulicDataChangedForTray(ColumnInternalsData columnData, TraySectionResultData sectionResult, double overDesignFactor)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (sectionResult == null || columnData == null || sectionResult.HydraulicResults == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Dictionary<int, CAStage> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, CAStage>();
			foreach (CAStage stage in columnData.Stages)
			{
				dictionary.Add(stage.StageNum.Value, stage);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in sectionResult.HydraulicResults)
			{
				if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(hydraulicResult.Value.MassLiquidRate.Value / overDesignFactor, dictionary[hydraulicResult.Key].MassFlowLiquid.Value))
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void RunNewTraySectionForPlot(ColumnInternalsData columnData, SimSectionDataBase sectionData, CAOption colSetting, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, bool forceCalcPlot)
		{
			if (columnData == null || columnData.Stages == null || columnData.Stages.Count == 0 || colSetting == null || sectionData == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = columnData.Stages.Count;
			if (count < sectionData.StartStage.Value - 1 || count < sectionData.EndingStage.Value - 1 || !(sectionData is CATraySectionData) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionData.CheckRequiredData()))
			{
				return;
			}
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = null;
			lock (objLock)
			{
				bool calculateCurve = forceCalcPlot;
				if (!forceCalcPlot && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
				{
					calculateCurve = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsConfigOptionScreenRegistered(sConfigOptionKey);
				}
				try
				{
					int num = sectionData.EndingStage.Value;
					if (num > columnData.EndStageNumber)
					{
						num = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					}
					traySectionResultData = _attpsrWrapper_TR.CallEngineTrayRating(sectionData as CATraySectionData, columnData, colSetting, sectionData.StartStage.Value, num, calculateCurve, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				}
				catch (CAErrorException ex)
				{
					_CAMessagesManager.AddMessage(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, ex.CAMessageInfo.MessageType, ex.CAMessageInfo.MessageCatalog, ex.CAMessageInfo.MessageDetail);
					traySectionResultData = null;
				}
			}
			if (traySectionResultData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
			{
				bool flag = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsSectionRegistered(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.IsConfigOptionScreenRegistered(sConfigOptionKey) && !flag && _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys.ContainsKey(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					string columnKey = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegisteredColumnKeys[sConfigOptionKey];
					RegisterSection(columnKey, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				}
				_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.SaveInputData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, sectionData);
				_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.SaveResultData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, traySectionResultData);
			}
			PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(traySectionResultData, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
		}

		public CASectionDefaultValue GetDefault(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey, bool ensureDowncomerBalanced = false)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionKey))
			{
				return null;
			}
			CASectionDefaultValue result = null;
			UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
			if (columnInternalsData != null && columnInternalsData.Stages != null && columnInternalsData.Stages.Count > 0)
			{
				SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				int count = columnInternalsData.Stages.Count;
				if (columnInternalsData == null || columnInternalsData.Stages == null || columnInternalsData.Stages.Count == 0 || simSectionData == null || count < simSectionData.StartStage.Value - 1 || count < simSectionData.EndingStage.Value - 1)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (simSectionData is CATraySectionData)
				{
					CATraySectionData cATraySectionData = simSectionData as CATraySectionData;
					string value = string.Empty;
					if (cATraySectionData.TraySpacing.IsEmpty())
					{
						value = Resources.TG_TraySpacing;
					}
					else if (cATraySectionData.StartStage.IsEmpty())
					{
						value = Resources.ColumnAnslysis_StartStage;
					}
					else if (cATraySectionData.EndingStage.IsEmpty())
					{
						value = Resources.ColumnAnslysis_EndStage;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						return result;
					}
					lock (objLock)
					{
						try
						{
							result = _attpsrWrapper_TR.CallEngineToGetDefault(simSectionData as CATraySectionData, columnInternalsData, ensureDowncomerBalanced);
						}
						catch (CAErrorException ex)
						{
							_CAMessagesManager.AddMessage(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, ex.CAMessageInfo.MessageType, ex.CAMessageInfo.MessageCatalog, ex.CAMessageInfo.MessageDetail);
							result = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public CABalancedDCInputData GetBalancedDCInputData(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionKey))
			{
				return null;
			}
			CABalancedDCInputData result = null;
			IEventAggregator eventAggregator = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
			if (columnInternalsData != null && columnInternalsData.Stages != null && columnInternalsData.Stages.Count > 0)
			{
				SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				if (simSectionData is CATraySectionData && (simSectionData as CATraySectionData).NumberofPasses.Value > 1)
				{
					CABalancedData balancedData = null;
					result = GetCABalancedDCInputData(simSectionData, columnInternalsData, out balancedData);
					(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow as Window).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
					{
						CABalanceResultEventArgs e = new CABalanceResultEventArgs(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey, balancedData);
						((CompositePresentationEvent<CABalanceResultEventArgs>)(object)eventAggregator.GetEvent<CABalanceResultEvent>()).Publish(e);
					});
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private CABalancedDCInputData GetCABalancedDCInputData(SimSectionDataBase sectionData, ColumnInternalsData columnData, out CABalancedData balancedData)
		{
			balancedData = null;
			lock (objLock)
			{
				balancedData = _attpsrWrapper_TR.CallEngineToGetBalanceDowncomerValues(sectionData as CATraySectionData, columnData);
			}
			return new CABalancedDCInputData(balancedData);
		}

		public CAColumnSumpDefault GetCAColumnSumpDefault(string sConfigOptionKey)
		{
			ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
			CAOption columnOption = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnOption(sConfigOptionKey);
			IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(sConfigOptionKey);
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (CASectionRange item in sectionsRange)
			{
				if (item.EndStageNumber >= columnInternalsData.EndStageNumber - 1)
				{
					text = item.SectionKey;
					break;
				}
			}
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionDataBase = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				simSectionDataBase = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, text);
			}
			double? lastSectionDiameter = null;
			if (simSectionDataBase != null && simSectionDataBase.Diameter != null && !simSectionDataBase.Diameter.IsEmpty())
			{
				lastSectionDiameter = simSectionDataBase.Diameter.Value;
			}
			return _attpsrWrapper_TR.GetCAColumnSumpDefault(columnInternalsData, columnOption, lastSectionDiameter);
		}

		public void RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum refreshEnum, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey = "")
		{
			RefreshHydraulicPlot(refreshEnum, "", sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
		}

		public void RefreshHydraulicPlot(CARefreshEnum refreshEnum, string columnKey, string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey = "")
		{
			if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (refreshEnum == CARefreshEnum.ColumnDeleted)
			{
				List<string> allInternalOptions = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetAllInternalOptions(columnKey);
				_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.UnRegister(columnKey);
				if (allInternalOptions == null || allInternalOptions.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (string item in allInternalOptions)
					{
						CloseHydraulicsPlotScreen(item);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey) && refreshEnum != CARefreshEnum.GlobalUnitSetChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (refreshEnum == CARefreshEnum.OptionDeleted)
			{
				_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.UnRegister(columnKey, sConfigOptionKey);
				CloseHydraulicsPlotScreen(sConfigOptionKey);
				return;
			}
			if (refreshEnum == CARefreshEnum.PlotOrderingRefresh)
			{
				ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetColumnInternalsData(sConfigOptionKey);
				if (columnInternalsData != null)
				{
					_CAMessagesManager.UpdateCAMessageWhenColumnNumberingChanged(columnInternalsData.IsTopDownNumbering);
				}
			}
			else if (refreshEnum == CARefreshEnum.SectionDeleted && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnKey))
			{
				_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.UnRegister(columnKey, sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
				UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				List<string> allSecsInOption = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetAllSecsInOption(columnKey, sConfigOptionKey);
				if (allSecsInOption == null || allSecsInOption.Count == 0)
				{
					CloseHydraulicsPlotScreen(sConfigOptionKey);
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (refreshEnum)
				{
				case CARefreshEnum.SectionStatusChangeToIncomplete:
					_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.ClearResultsData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
					_CAMessagesManager.CleanSectionMessage(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
					break;
				case CARefreshEnum.GlobalUnitSetChanged:
					_CAMessagesManager.TriggerUpdateMessageEvent();
					break;
				}
			}
			RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg = new RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg();
			refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.ConfigOptionKey = sConfigOptionKey;
			refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.SectionKey = sectionKey;
			refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.ColumnKey = columnKey;
			refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.IsOptionKeyChanged = false;
			refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.RefreshEnum = refreshEnum;
			TriggerSectionRefreshWiithoutAffectResultEvent(refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg);
		}

		private void CloseHydraulicsPlotScreen(string optKey)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(optKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			IShellApplication val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			IShellMainWindow mainWin = val.ActiveWindow;
			if (mainWin == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ScreenContentControl screen = mainWin.FindScreen((Func<ScreenContentControl, bool>)((ScreenContentControl x) => string.Equals(x.ScreenFactoryKey, "HydraulicPlotsScreenFactoryKey", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && string.Equals((x.ScreenSubject as HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject).ColumnOptionKey, optKey, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)));
			if (screen != null)
			{
				(mainWin as Window).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
				{
					mainWin.CloseScreen(screen);
				});
			}
		}

		private void TriggerSectionRefreshWiithoutAffectResultEvent(RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg args)
		{
			try
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS || hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus)
				{
					(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow as Window).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
					{
						if (this.RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent != null)
						{
							this.RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent(args);
						}
					});
				}
				else if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenAnalytics && this.RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent != null)
				{
					this.RefreshHydraulicPlotEvent(args);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void RefreshPlotWhenOptionKeyChanged(string oldColumnKey, string newColumnKey, string oldOptionKey, string newOptionKey, string newPlotScreenName = "")
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldColumnKey) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(newColumnKey) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldOptionKey) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(newOptionKey))
			{
				IList<string> sectionsKeys = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSectionsKeys(newOptionKey);
				if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys != null)
				{
					_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.UpdateOptionKey(oldColumnKey, newColumnKey, oldOptionKey, newOptionKey, sectionsKeys);
				}
				RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg = new RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg();
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.ConfigOptionKey = newOptionKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.ColumnKey = newColumnKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.OldColumnKey = oldColumnKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.IsOptionKeyChanged = true;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.OldConfigOptionKey = oldOptionKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.RefreshEnum = CARefreshEnum.NotSet;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.PlotScreenHeader = newPlotScreenName;
				TriggerSectionRefreshWiithoutAffectResultEvent(refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateColumnKey(string oldColumnKey, string newColumnKey, string oldColumnBaseId, string newColumnBaseId)
		{
			if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> allInternalOptions = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetAllInternalOptions(oldColumnKey);
			if (allInternalOptions == null || allInternalOptions.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string item in allInternalOptions)
			{
				string newOptionBaseId = string.Empty;
				string text = item;
				string text2 = text.Replace(oldColumnKey, newColumnKey);
				string[] array = text2.Split('.');
				if (array.Count() > 0)
				{
					newOptionBaseId = array[array.Count() - 1];
				}
				UpdateColumnInternalData(oldColumnKey, newColumnKey, text, text2, newOptionBaseId, oldColumnBaseId, newColumnBaseId);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateColumnInternalData(string oldColumnKey, string newColumnKey, string oldOptionKey, string newOptionKey, string newOptionBaseId, string oldColumBaseid, string newColumnBaseId)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldColumnKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(newColumnKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldOptionKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(newOptionKey) || _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys == null || _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.AllSectionsRegistered == null || _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.AllSectionsRegistered.Count == 0 || !_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.AllSectionsRegistered.ContainsKey(oldColumnKey) || !_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.AllSectionsRegistered[oldColumnKey].ContainsKey(oldOptionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> allSecsInOption = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetAllSecsInOption(oldColumnKey, oldOptionKey);
			_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.UpdateOptionKey(oldColumnKey, newColumnKey, oldOptionKey, newOptionKey, allSecsInOption);
			if (_ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered == null || _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.OptionScreenRegistered.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IShellMainWindow activeWindow = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow;
			if (activeWindow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ScreenContentControl val = activeWindow.FindScreen((Func<ScreenContentControl, bool>)((ScreenContentControl x) => string.Equals(x.ScreenFactoryKey, "HydraulicPlotsScreenFactoryKey", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && string.Equals((x.ScreenSubject as HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject).ColumnOptionKey, oldOptionKey, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)));
			if (val != null && val.ScreenSubject is HydraulicPlotsScreenSubject { SuggestedScreenTitle: var suggestedScreenTitle })
			{
				string oldValue = null;
				string[] array = oldOptionKey.Split('.');
				if (array.Count() > 0)
				{
					oldValue = array[array.Count() - 1];
				}
				string text = suggestedScreenTitle.Replace(oldValue, newOptionBaseId);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldColumBaseid))
				{
					text = text.Replace(oldColumBaseid, newColumnBaseId);
				}
				RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg = new RefreshHydraulicPlotEventArg();
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.ConfigOptionKey = newOptionKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.ColumnKey = newColumnKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.OldColumnKey = oldColumnKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.IsOptionKeyChanged = true;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.OldConfigOptionKey = oldOptionKey;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.RefreshEnum = CARefreshEnum.NotSet;
				refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg.PlotScreenHeader = text;
				TriggerSectionRefreshWiithoutAffectResultEvent(refreshHydraulicPlotEventArg);
			}
		}

		private bool IsSectionComplete(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
			return IsSectionComplete(simSectionData, sConfigOptionKey);
		}

		private bool IsSectionComplete(SimSectionDataBase sectionData, string sConfigOptionKey)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (sectionData != null)
			{
				if (sectionData is CATraySectionData && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey))
				{
					CATraySectionData obj = sectionData as CATraySectionData;
					CAHydraulicFlowBasis cAHydraulicFlowBasis = null;
					if (ColumnInternalRegistered != null)
					{
						cAHydraulicFlowBasis = ColumnInternalRegistered.GetCAHydraulicFlowBasis(sConfigOptionKey);
					}
					if (cAHydraulicFlowBasis == null)
					{
						cAHydraulicFlowBasis = new CAHydraulicFlowBasis();
					}
					obj.VUnitIndex.Value = (int)cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDVaporBasis;
					obj.LUnitIndex.Value = (int)cAHydraulicFlowBasis.SDLiquidBasis;
				}
				result = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sectionData.CheckRequiredData()) ? true : false);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void UpdateColumnInternalLevelResultData(string configOptionKey)
		{
			CAColumnInternalResults columnInternalLevelResultData = GetColumnInternalLevelResultData(configOptionKey);
			PublishCAColumnInternalResults(columnInternalLevelResultData, configOptionKey);
		}

		public CAColumnInternalResults GetColumnInternalLevelResultData(string configOptionKey)
		{
			IHostApplicationInfo appInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			IList<CASectionRange> sectionsRange = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(configOptionKey);
			ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnInternalsData(configOptionKey);
			CAOption columnOption = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnOption(configOptionKey);
			if (columnInternalsData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CAColumnInternalResults cAColumnInternalResults = null;
			try
			{
				if (sectionsRange == null || sectionsRange.Count == 0)
				{
					cAColumnInternalResults = CreateEmptyCAColumnInternalResults(columnInternalsData, configOptionKey);
				}
				else
				{
					List<CASectionResultDataBase> list = new List<CASectionResultDataBase>();
					foreach (CASectionRange item in sectionsRange)
					{
						if (item.StageType == StageType.TrayRating || item.StageType == StageType.TraySizing || item.StageType == StageType.TrayRatingWithUserSubroutine || item.StageType == StageType.TraySizingWithUserSubroutine)
						{
							TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetResultData(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey) as TraySectionResultData;
							if (traySectionResultData == null)
							{
								traySectionResultData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetTraySectionResultData(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
								if (traySectionResultData == null)
								{
									Run(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
									traySectionResultData = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetResultData(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey) as TraySectionResultData;
								}
							}
							if (traySectionResultData != null)
							{
								list.Add(traySectionResultData);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (item.StageType != StageType.PackRating && item.StageType != StageType.PackSizing && item.StageType != StageType.PackRatingWithUserSubroutine && item.StageType != StageType.PackSizingWithUserSubroutine)
							{
								continue;
							}
							CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetResultData(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey) as CAPackingSectionResults;
							if (cAPackingSectionResults == null)
							{
								cAPackingSectionResults = simulatorCADataProvider.GetPackingSectionResultData(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
								if (cAPackingSectionResults == null)
								{
									Run(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
									cAPackingSectionResults = _ColumnInternalRegisteredKeys.GetResultData(configOptionKey, item.SectionKey) as CAPackingSectionResults;
								}
							}
							if (cAPackingSectionResults != null)
							{
								list.Add(cAPackingSectionResults);
							}
						}
					}
					cAColumnInternalResults = CalcualteColumnLevelResults(appInfo, columnInternalsData, list, configOptionKey, sectionsRange);
				}
				if (cAColumnInternalResults != null)
				{
					cAColumnInternalResults.IsActiveOption = columnOption.IsActiveOption;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return cAColumnInternalResults;
		}

		private bool CheckWhetherWholeInternalSpecified(IList<CASectionRange> sectionList, ColumnInternalsData columnData)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			SortedList<int, int> sortedList = new SortedList<int, int>();
			foreach (CASectionRange section in sectionList)
			{
				if (section.StartStageNumber > section.EndStageNumber)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				for (int i = section.StartStageNumber; i <= section.EndStageNumber; i++)
				{
					if (sortedList.ContainsKey(i))
					{
						sortedList[i]++;
					}
					else
					{
						sortedList.Add(i, 1);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (sortedList != null && sortedList.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<int, int> item in sortedList)
					{
						if (item.Value > 1)
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					List<int> list = sortedList.Keys.ToList();
					if (flag && (list[0] != columnData.StartStageNumber || list[list.Count - 1] != columnData.EndStageNumber))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag && sortedList.Count > 1)
					{
						for (int j = 1; j < sortedList.Count; j++)
						{
							if (list[j] > list[j - 1] + 1)
							{
								flag = false;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private CAColumnInternalResults CreateEmptyCAColumnInternalResults(ColumnInternalsData columnData, string configOptionKey)
		{
			return new CAColumnInternalResults
			{
				ColumnInternalOptionKey = configOptionKey,
				NumberOfStage = 
				{
					Value = columnData.EndStageNumber - columnData.StartStageNumber + 1
				},
				SectionsResult = new List<CAColumnInternalResults.SectionSimplifiedResult>()
			};
		}

		private CAColumnInternalResults CalcualteColumnLevelResults(IHostApplicationInfo appInfo, ColumnInternalsData columnData, List<CASectionResultDataBase> allResults, string configOptionKey, IList<CASectionRange> sectionList)
		{
			CAColumnInternalResults cAColumnInternalResults = new CAColumnInternalResults();
			cAColumnInternalResults.ColumnInternalOptionKey = configOptionKey;
			cAColumnInternalResults.NumberOfStage.Value = columnData.EndStageNumber - columnData.StartStageNumber + 1;
			cAColumnInternalResults.NumberOfSections.Value = allResults.Count;
			cAColumnInternalResults.SectionsResult = new List<CAColumnInternalResults.SectionSimplifiedResult>();
			bool flag = true;
			flag = CheckWhetherWholeInternalSpecified(sectionList, columnData);
			List<string> overLappedSections = GetOverLappedSections(sectionList);
			if (overLappedSections != null && overLappedSections.Count > 0)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (sectionList.Count != allResults.Count)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			foreach (CASectionResultDataBase allResult in allResults)
			{
				CAColumnInternalResults.SectionSimplifiedResult sectionSimplifiedResult = new CAColumnInternalResults.SectionSimplifiedResult();
				cAColumnInternalResults.SectionsResult.Add(sectionSimplifiedResult);
				sectionSimplifiedResult.SectionKey = allResult.SectionKey;
				sectionSimplifiedResult.SectionName = allResult.SectionName;
				sectionSimplifiedResult.StartStage = allResult.StartStageNumber;
				sectionSimplifiedResult.EndStage = allResult.EndtStageNumber;
				sectionSimplifiedResult.Diameter.Value = allResult.Diameter.Value;
				if (!list.Contains(allResult.Diameter.Value))
				{
					list.Add(allResult.Diameter.Value);
				}
				if (allResult is TraySectionResultData)
				{
					TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = allResult as TraySectionResultData;
					if (flag)
					{
						num += traySectionResultData.SectionTotalHeight.Value;
						num2 += traySectionResultData.TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value;
						num3 += traySectionResultData.SectionTotalPressureDrop.Value;
						num4 += traySectionResultData.SectionResidenceTime.Value;
					}
					sectionSimplifiedResult.InternalType = "Trayed";
					sectionSimplifiedResult.PressureDrop.Value = traySectionResultData.SectionTotalPressureDrop.Value;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.ApproachToFlood.Value = traySectionResultData.MaximumPercentJetFlood.Value;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.LimitingStage.Value = traySectionResultData.TrayNumberWidthMaxJetFlood.Value;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.SectionHeight.Value = traySectionResultData.SectionTotalHeight.Value;
					if (EnumHeper.CombinedTrayInternalTypeMap.ContainsKey(traySectionResultData.CombinedTrayInternalType))
					{
						if (appInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus)
						{
							sectionSimplifiedResult.TrayPackingType = EnumHeper.CombinedTrayInternalTypeMap[traySectionResultData.CombinedTrayInternalType].ToUpper();
						}
						else
						{
							sectionSimplifiedResult.TrayPackingType = EnumHeper.CombinedTrayInternalTypeMap[traySectionResultData.CombinedTrayInternalType];
						}
					}
				}
				else if (allResult is CAPackingSectionResults)
				{
					CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = allResult as CAPackingSectionResults;
					if (flag)
					{
						num += cAPackingSectionResults.PackingHeight.Value;
						num2 += cAPackingSectionResults.TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value;
						num3 += cAPackingSectionResults.SectionPressureDrop.Value;
					}
					sectionSimplifiedResult.InternalType = "Packed";
					sectionSimplifiedResult.TrayPackingType = cAPackingSectionResults.PackingType.EnumString;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.PressureDrop.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.SectionPressureDrop.Value;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.ApproachToFlood.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumFractionalCapacity.Value;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.LimitingStage.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.TrayNumberWithMaxFlooding.Value;
					sectionSimplifiedResult.SectionHeight.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.PackingHeight.Value;
				}
			}
			CAColumnSumpResults cAColumnSumpResults = GetCAColumnSumpResults(configOptionKey);
			CAOption columnOption = simulatorCADataProvider.GetColumnOption(configOptionKey);
			if (cAColumnSumpResults != null && columnOption != null && columnOption.MakeBottomStageSump)
			{
				cAColumnInternalResults.PressureDropAcrossSump.Value = cAColumnSumpResults.SumpPressureDrop.Value;
				if (!list.Contains(columnOption.SumpDiameter.Value))
				{
					list.Add(columnOption.SumpDiameter.Value);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				cAColumnInternalResults.TotalHeight.Value = num;
				cAColumnInternalResults.TotalHeadLoss.Value = num2;
				cAColumnInternalResults.TotalPressureDrop.Value = num3;
				cAColumnInternalResults.TotalResidenceTime.Value = num4;
			}
			cAColumnInternalResults.NumberOfDiameters.Value = list.Count;
			return cAColumnInternalResults;
		}

		private List<string> GetOverLappedSections(IList<CASectionRange> sections)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (sections == null || sections.Count < 2)
			{
				return list;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sections[i].StartStageNumber == 0 || sections[i].EndStageNumber == 0 || sections[i].StartStageNumber > sections[i].EndStageNumber)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < sections.Count; j++)
				{
					if (j != i && ((sections[i].StartStageNumber <= sections[j].StartStageNumber && sections[i].EndStageNumber >= sections[j].StartStageNumber) || (sections[i].StartStageNumber <= sections[j].EndStageNumber && sections[i].EndStageNumber >= sections[j].EndStageNumber)))
					{
						list.Add(sections[i].SectionKey);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void PublishCAColumnInternalResults(CAColumnInternalResults caColumnInternalResults, string sConfigOptionKey)
		{
			if (caColumnInternalResults == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sConfigOptionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				CAColumnInternalResultsEventArgs args = new CAColumnInternalResultsEventArgs(sConfigOptionKey, caColumnInternalResults);
				if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS || hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenPlus)
				{
					(UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).ActiveWindow as Window).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
					{
						((CompositePresentationEvent<CAColumnInternalResultsEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<CAColumnInternalResultsEvent>()).Publish(args);
					});
				}
				else if (hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenAnalytics)
				{
					((CompositePresentationEvent<CAColumnInternalResultsEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<CAColumnInternalResultsEvent>()).Publish(args);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCAModelWhenActiveDocumentChanged(string currentCaseFilePath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastCaseFilePath))
			{
				lastCaseFilePath = currentCaseFilePath;
				return;
			}
			CAMessagesManager.UpdateMessagesWhenActiveDocumentChanged(currentCaseFilePath, lastCaseFilePath);
			CAMessagesManager.TriggerUpdateMessageEvent();
			lastCaseFilePath = currentCaseFilePath;
			UnregisterAll();
		}

		public void UpdateCAModelWhenDocumentClosed(string CaseFilePath)
		{
			CAMessagesManager.CleanMessageDicionaryWhenDocumentClosed(CaseFilePath);
		}

		public void UpdateCAModelWhenInputIncomplete(string sConfigOptionKey)
		{
			foreach (CASectionRange item in simulatorCADataProvider.GetSectionsRange(sConfigOptionKey))
			{
				if (item.IsCompleteStatus == false)
				{
					SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
					if (simSectionData is CATraySectionData)
					{
						TraySectionResultData sectionResult = new TraySectionResultData(simSectionData as CATraySectionData);
						PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(sectionResult, sConfigOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
					}
					else if (simSectionData is CAPackingSectionData)
					{
						CAPackingSectionResults sectionResult2 = new CAPackingSectionResults(simSectionData as CAPackingSectionData);
						PublishCAResultUpdateEvent(sectionResult2, sConfigOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
					}
					CAMessagesManager.PublishMessage(sConfigOptionKey, item.SectionKey);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsColumnInternalComplete(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionData = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(_Container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetSimSectionData(sConfigOptionKey, sectionKey);
			if (simSectionData == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsSectionComplete(simSectionData, sConfigOptionKey);
		}
	}

		public int GetBaseStageForSizing(int startStageNumber, int endStageNumber, int iStep)
		{
			int num = startStageNumber;
			int num2 = endStageNumber - startStageNumber + 1;
			if (Stages != null && Stages.Count > endStageNumber - 1)
			{
				double num3 = Stages[num - 1].VolumeFlowLiquid.Value;
				double value = Stages[num - 1].MassFlowLiquid.Value;
				double value2 = Stages[num - 1].MassFlowVapor.Value;
				double value3 = Stages[num - 1].DensityLiquid.Value;
				double value4 = Stages[num - 1].DensityVapor.Value;
				double num4 = value / value2 * Math.Sqrt(value4 / value3);
				double num5 = value2 / Math.Sqrt(value4);
				for (int i = 1; i < num2; i++)
				{
					double value5 = Stages[startStageNumber + i - 1].VolumeFlowLiquid.Value;
					double value6 = Stages[startStageNumber + i - 1].MassFlowLiquid.Value;
					value2 = Stages[startStageNumber + i - 1].MassFlowVapor.Value;
					value3 = Stages[startStageNumber + i - 1].DensityLiquid.Value;
					value4 = Stages[startStageNumber + i - 1].DensityVapor.Value;
					double num6 = value6 / value2 * Math.Sqrt(value4 / value3);
					double num7 = value2 / Math.Sqrt(value4);
					switch (iStep)
					{
					case 1:
						if (value5 > num3)
						{
							num3 = value5;
							num = startStageNumber + i;
						}
						break;
					case 2:
						if (num6 < num4)
						{
							num4 = num6;
							num = startStageNumber + i;
						}
						break;
					case 3:
						if (num7 > num5)
						{
							num5 = num7;
							num = startStageNumber + i;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		private static void SetCA_To_AplusMap()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<int, int>> item in APlus_CAEnumMapDic)
			{
				Dictionary<int, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, int>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, int> item2 in item.Value)
				{
					dictionary.Add(item2.Value, item2.Key);
				}
				CA_APlusEnumMapDic.Add(item.Key, dictionary);
			}
		}

		public static int GetAPlusCAEnumValueFromCAValue(string enumType, int value)
		{
			int result = value;
			if (APlus_CAEnumMapDic.ContainsKey(enumType) && APlus_CAEnumMapDic[enumType].ContainsKey(value))
			{
				result = APlus_CAEnumMapDic[enumType][value];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static int GetCAValueFromAPlusCAEnumValue(string enumType, int value)
		{
			int result = value;
			if (CA_APlusEnumMapDic.ContainsKey(enumType) && CA_APlusEnumMapDic[enumType].ContainsKey(value))
			{
				result = CA_APlusEnumMapDic[enumType][value];
			}
			return result;
		}

			{
				_Downcomers[0] = new SideDowncomer();
				_Downcomers[1] = new CenterDowncomer();
				_Downcomers[2] = new OffCenterDowncomer();
				FillDowncomers(blanceResults);
			}
		}

		private void FillDowncomers(CABalancedData blanceResults)
		{
			if (blanceResults != null)
			{
				_Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = blanceResults.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
				_Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = blanceResults.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
				_Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = blanceResults.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
				_Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = blanceResults.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				_Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = blanceResults.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
				_Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = blanceResults.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
				((OffCenterDowncomer)Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = ((CADCOffCenterResultData)blanceResults.Downcomers[2]).CenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
				_NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = blanceResults.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
				_NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = blanceResults.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
				_SideWeirLength.Value = blanceResults.SideWeirLength.Value;
				_CenterWeirLength.Value = blanceResults.CenterWeirLength.Value;
				_Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = blanceResults.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value;
				_Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = blanceResults.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value;
			}
		}
	}

			StichlmairConstant3 = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None, theC3);

	public class CADataHelper
	{
		public const double Tol = 1E-05;

		public static XmlDocument SerializeToXml(object input)
		{
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(input.GetType());
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			xmlSerializer.Serialize(memoryStream, input);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			xmlDocument.Load(memoryStream);
			return xmlDocument;
		}

		public static DiagramSectionData DiagramSectionDataDeSerialize(XmlDocument xdoc)
		{
			DiagramSectionData result = null;
			try
			{
				using TextReader textReader = new StringReader(xdoc.InnerXml);
				result = new XmlSerializer(typeof(DiagramSectionData)).Deserialize(textReader) as DiagramSectionData;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static PackingDiagramSectionData PackDiagramSectionDataDeSerialize(XmlDocument xdoc)
		{
			PackingDiagramSectionData result = null;
			try
			{
				using TextReader textReader = new StringReader(xdoc.InnerXml);
				result = new XmlSerializer(typeof(PackingDiagramSectionData)).Deserialize(textReader) as PackingDiagramSectionData;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsALessThanB(double a, double b)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(a - b) / Math.Abs(a) < 1E-05)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a < b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsABiggerThanB(double a, double b)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(a - b) / Math.Abs(a) < 1E-05)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a > b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsABiggerEqualB(double a, double b)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(a - b) / Math.Abs(a) < 1E-05)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (a >= b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsALessEqualB(double a, double b)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(a - b) / Math.Abs(a) < 1E-05)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (a <= b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void ExportDataToXml(string fileName, object source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (File.Exists(fileName))
				{
					try
					{
						File.Delete(fileName);
					}
					catch
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				using FileStream stream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
				using StreamWriter textWriter = new StreamWriter(stream, Encoding.UTF8);
				new XmlSerializer(source.GetType()).Serialize(textWriter, source);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public static object DeSerializeExportData(string filePath, Type exportType)
		{
			object result = null;
			try
			{
				if (!File.Exists(filePath))
				{
					return null;
				}
				using FileStream stream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Open);
				result = new XmlSerializer(exportType).Deserialize(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string KeyGeneration(string sConfigOptionKey, string sectionKey)
		{
			return sConfigOptionKey + "/$" + sectionKey;
		}
	}

		public void SetDeckThicknessIntEnum(double value)
		{
			if (value == 0.00635)
			{
				DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value = 4;
			}
			else if (value == 0.0034163)
			{
				DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value = 3;
			}
			else if (value == 0.0026416)
			{
				DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value = 2;
			}
			else if (value == 0.0018796)
			{
				DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value = 5;
			}
		}
	}

	public class EnumHeper

		private static Dictionary<string, Type> EnumPropertyMap;

		private static Dictionary<string, string> EnumString;

		public static string GetDispalyTextByProppertyName(string className, string propertyName, int index)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				return result;
			}
			Type type = null;
			if (EnumPropertyMap.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				type = EnumPropertyMap[propertyName];
			}
			else if (EnumPropertyMap.ContainsKey(className + propertyName))
			{
				type = EnumPropertyMap[className + propertyName];
			}
			if (type != null)
			{
				result = Enum.GetName(type, index);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static int GetEnumIndex(string className, string propertyName, int enumValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				return 99999999;
			}
			Type enumType = GetEnum(className, propertyName);
			return Enum.GetNames(enumType).ToList().IndexOf(Enum.GetName(enumType, enumValue));
		}

		public static Type GetEnum(string className, string propertyName)
		{
			Type result = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (EnumPropertyMap.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				result = EnumPropertyMap[propertyName];
			}
			else if (EnumPropertyMap.ContainsKey(className + propertyName))
			{
				result = EnumPropertyMap[className + propertyName];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsEnum(string className, string propertyName)
		{
			Type type = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (EnumPropertyMap.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				type = EnumPropertyMap[propertyName];
			}
			else if (EnumPropertyMap.ContainsKey(className + propertyName))
			{
				type = EnumPropertyMap[className + propertyName];
			}
			if (type != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		static EnumHeper()

			EnumString = new Dictionary<string, string>();

			InitEnumMap();
			InitEnumString();
			InitCAPackingOptionPropertyList();
			InitCombinedTrayInternalTypeMap();
		}

		public static string GetEnumDisplayString(string enumString)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(enumString))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (EnumDisplayString.ContainsKey(enumString))
			{
				return EnumDisplayString[enumString];
			}
			return enumString;
		}

		public static string GetEnumString(string displayEnumString)
		{
			if (EnumString.ContainsKey(displayEnumString))
			{
				return EnumString[displayEnumString];
			}
			return displayEnumString;
		}

		public static string GetPackEnumString(string propertyName, int value)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (propertyName.Equals("PackingType", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetPackName(value);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingVendor", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetVendorName(value);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingMaterial", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetMaterialName(value);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingDimension", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetPackDimensionName(value);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PressureDropMethod", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetPressureDropName(value);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static int GetPackEnumIndex(string propertyName, string propetyEnumStringValue)
		{
			int result = 99999999;
			string text = propetyEnumStringValue.Trim();
			if (propertyName.Equals("PackingType", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingType(text);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingVendor", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingVendor(text);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingMaterial", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingMaterials(text);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PressureDropMethod", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingPressureDropMehod(text);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string GetPackEnumDescription(string propertyName, int value)
		{

			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingVendor", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))

				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetVendorDescription(value);
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PressureDropMethod", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))

				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetPressureDropDescription(value);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static List<string> GetPackEnumOptions(string propertyName)
		{
			List<string> result = null;
			if (propertyName.Equals("PackingType", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.ALLPackTypeNames.Values.ToList();
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingVendor", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.AllVendorsNames.Values.ToList();
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PackingMaterial", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.AllMaterialsNames.Values.ToList();
			}
			else if (propertyName.Equals("PressureDropMethod", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
			{
				result = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.PressurePDropMethodsNames.Values.ToList();
			}
			return result;
		}

	public class CAOption
	{
		private CARealVariable _SumpDiameter = new CARealVariable("SumpDiameter", QuantityTypeEnum.Length);

		private CARealVariable _SumpLiquidLevel = new CARealVariable("SumpLiquidLevel", QuantityTypeEnum.Length);

		private CARealVariable _SumpLiquidResidenceTime = new CARealVariable("SumpLiquidResidenceTime", QuantityTypeEnum.Time);

		private CAIntegerVariable _PackingDB = new CAIntegerVariable("PackingDB");

		public string OptionName { get; set; }

		public string OptionKey { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsActiveOption { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool MakeBottomStageSump { get; set; }

		public CARealVariable SumpDiameter
		{
			get
			{
				return _SumpDiameter;
			}
			set
			{
				_SumpDiameter = value;
			}
		}

		public CARealVariable SumpLiquidLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return _SumpLiquidLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				_SumpLiquidLevel = value;
			}
		}

		public CARealVariable SumpLiquidResidenceTime
		{
			get
			{
				return _SumpLiquidResidenceTime;
			}
			set
			{
				_SumpLiquidResidenceTime = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsSumpLiquidLevelSelected { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public bool IsSumpLiquidResidenceTimeSelected { get; set; }

		public CAIntegerVariable PackingDB => _PackingDB;

		public CAOption(string optionName, string optionKey)
		{
			OptionName = optionName;
			OptionKey = optionKey;
		}

		public CAOption(string optionName, string optionKey, bool isActiveOption)
		{
			OptionName = optionName;
			OptionKey = optionKey;
			IsActiveOption = isActiveOption;
		}
	}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public virtual CARealVariable GetSectionHeight()
		{
			CARealVariable cARealVariable = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			if (!HETP.IsEmpty())
			{
				cARealVariable.Value = HETP.Value * (double)(base.EndingStage.Value - base.StartStage.Value + 1);
			}
			else if (!PackingHeight.IsEmpty())
			{
				cARealVariable.Value = PackingHeight.Value;
			}
			return cARealVariable;
		}

		public override string CheckRequiredData()
		{
			string text = base.CheckRequiredData();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (PackingType.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "PackingType";
			}
			if (PackingVendor.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "PackingVendor";
			}
			if (PackingMaterial.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "PackingMaterial";
			}
			if (PackingDimension.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "PackingDimension";
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (base.Diameter.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "Diameter";
			}
			if (PackHeightType == PackHeightType.HETP)
			{
				if (HETP.IsEmpty())
				{
					return "HETP";
				}
			}
			else if (PackHeightType == PackHeightType.SectionPackHeight && PackingHeight.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "PackingHeight";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public void SetPackInfo(string packType, string packVendor, string packMaterial, string packDimenstion)
		{
			PackingType.Value = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingType(packType);
			PackingVendor.Value = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingVendor(packVendor);
			PackingMaterial.Value = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingMaterials(packMaterial);
			PackingDimension.Value = AttpsrPackingInfo.Instance.GetIndexOfPackingDimension(PackingType, PackingVendor, PackingMaterial, packDimenstion, out var options);
			PackingDimension.EnumOptions = options;
		}
	}

			PackingDimension.Value = inputSectionData.PackingDimension.Value;
			_StichlmairConstant_1.Value = inputSectionData.StichlmairConstant_1.Value;
			_StichlmairConstant_2.Value = inputSectionData.StichlmairConstant_2.Value;
			_StichlmairConstant_3.Value = inputSectionData.StichlmairConstant_3.Value;
			_StichlmairFFmin.Value = inputSectionData.StichlmairFFmin.Value;
			_StichlmairVoidFraction.Value = inputSectionData.StichlmairVoidFraction.Value;
			StichlmairSurfaceArea.Value = inputSectionData.StichlmairSurfaceArea.Value;
			_HETP.Value = inputSectionData.HETP.Value;
			_PackingHeight.Value = inputSectionData.PackingHeight.Value;
			InitDiagramSectionData(inputSectionData.Container);
		}

		public XmlDocument GetXmlDocument()
		{
			return CADataHelper.SerializeToXml(this);
		}

		private void InitDiagramSectionData(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			_PackingDiagramSectionData = new PackingDiagramSectionData();
			if (container != null)
			{
				ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IColumnAnalyzerModel>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()) != null && simulatorCADataProvider != null)
				{
					_PackingDiagramSectionData.LiquidUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass);
					_PackingDiagramSectionData.VaporUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass);
					_PackingDiagramSectionData.PressureDropUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(QuantityTypeEnum.PressureDropDivideHeight);
				}
			}
		}

	public abstract class SimSectionDataBase
	{
		private IUnityContainer _container;

		private bool? _IsCompleteStatus;

		private CARealVariable _Diameter = new CARealVariable("Diameter", QuantityTypeEnum.Length);

		private CAIntegerVariable _EndingStage = new CAIntegerVariable("EndingStage");

		private CAIntegerVariable _StartStage = new CAIntegerVariable("StartStage");

		private CalculationMode _CalculationMode;

		public IUnityContainer Container => _container;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string Key { get; set; }

		public bool? IsCompleteStatus
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsCompleteStatus;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsCompleteStatus = value;
			}
		}

		public CARealVariable Diameter => _Diameter;

		public CAIntegerVariable EndingStage => _EndingStage;

		public CAIntegerVariable StartStage => _StartStage;

		public CalculationMode CalculationMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _CalculationMode;
			}
			set
			{
				_CalculationMode = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsDefaultType { get; set; }

		[field: NonSerialized]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public SimSectionDataBase(IUnityContainer container)
		{
			_container = container;
		}

		public virtual bool IsDataReady()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!StartStage.IsEmpty() && !EndingStage.IsEmpty() && !Diameter.IsEmpty())
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Name.GetHashCode() ^ Key.GetHashCode() ^ Diameter.Value.GetHashCode() ^ StartStage.Value.GetHashCode() ^ EndingStage.Value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public virtual string CheckRequiredData()
		{
			if (StartStage.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "StartStage";
			}
			if (EndingStage.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "EndingStage";
			}
			if (Diameter.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "Diameter";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!(obj is SimSectionDataBase))
			{
				return result;
			}
			result = true;
			SimSectionDataBase simSectionDataBase = obj as SimSectionDataBase;
			result &= VariableHelper.IsEqualTwoStr(Name, simSectionDataBase.Name);
			if (!result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result &= VariableHelper.IsEqualTwoStr(Key, simSectionDataBase.Key);
			if (!result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result &= Diameter.Equals(simSectionDataBase.Diameter);
			if (!result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result &= StartStage.Equals(simSectionDataBase.StartStage);
			if (!result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result &= EndingStage.Equals(simSectionDataBase.EndingStage);
			if (!result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return result & IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc.Equals(simSectionDataBase.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc);
		}

		protected void NotifyPropertyChanged(string info)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(info));
			}
		}
	}

		private bool IsSweptBackParametersEquals(CATraySectionData cpt)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			flag &= SweptBackENAB.Equals(cpt.SweptBackENAB);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= SweptBackType.Equals(cpt.SweptBackType);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= SweptBackDimensionS.Equals(cpt.SweptBackDimensionS);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= SweptBackDimensionA.Equals(cpt.SweptBackDimensionA);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}

		private string CheckSweptBackParametersRequiredData()
		{
			if (SweptBackENAB.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "SweptBackENAB";
			}
			if (SweptBackENAB.Value != 0)
			{
				if (SweptBackType.IsEmpty())
				{
					return "SweptBackType";
				}
				if (SweptBackType.Value == 3)
				{
					if (SweptBackDimensionSF.IsEmpty())
					{
						return "SweptBackDimensionSF";
					}
					if (SweptBackDimensionWF.IsEmpty())
					{
						return "SweptBackDimensionWF";
					}
					if (SweptBackDimensionB.IsEmpty())
					{
						return "SweptBackDimensionB";
					}
				}
				else

					}

		public override string CheckRequiredData()
		{
			string text = base.CheckRequiredData();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (SystemFoamingFactor.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "SystemFoamingFactor";
			}
			if (DeckThicknessIntEnum.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "DeckThicknessIntEnum";
			}
			if (DeckThicknessRealValue.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "DeckThicknessRealValue";
			}
			if (MaximumFractionalEntrainment.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "MaximumFractionalEntrainment";
			}
			if (WeepCalculationMethod.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "WeepCalculationMethod";
			}
			if (WeirLoadMaximum.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "WeirLoadMaximum";
			}
			if (WeirLoadMinimum.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "WeirLoadMinimum";
			}
			if (NumberofPasses.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "NumberofPasses";
			}
			if (TraySpacing.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "TraySpacing";
			}
			if (AerationFactorMultiplier.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "AerationFactorMultiplier";
			}
			if (FloodingCalculationMethod.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "FloodingCalculationMethod";
			}
			if (MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea";
			}
			if (BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex";
			}
			if (LUnitIndex.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "LUnitIndex";
			}
			if (VUnitIndex.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "VUnitIndex";
			}
			if (IsMDTray == false)
			{
				string text2 = Downcomers[0].CheckRequiredData();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					return $"Side Donwcomer {text2}";
				}
				if (NumberofPasses.Value == 2 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					string text3 = Downcomers[1].CheckRequiredData();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						return $"Center Donwcomer {text3}";
					}
				}
				if (NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					string text4 = Downcomers[2].CheckRequiredData();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
					{
						return $"Off Center Donwcomer {text4}";
					}
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Weirs[0].CheckRequiredData()))
				{
					return $"Side Donwcomer Weir {text2}";
				}
				if (NumberofPasses.Value == 2 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					string text5 = Weirs[1].CheckRequiredData();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5))
					{
						return $"Center Donwcomer Weir {text5}";
					}
				}
				if (NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					string text6 = Weirs[2].CheckRequiredData();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text6))
					{
						return $"Off Center Donwcomer Weir inside {text6}";
					}
					string arg = Weirs[2].CheckRequiredData();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text6))
					{
						return $"Off Center Donwcomer Weir outside {arg}";
					}
				}
			}
			if (OverideDowncomerFrothDensity && DowncomerFrothDensity.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "DowncomerFrothDensity";
			}
			CheckSweptBackParametersRequiredData();
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override bool IsDataReady()
		{
			bool flag = base.IsDataReady();
			if (!TraySpacing.IsEmpty())
			{
				flag = flag;
			}
			return flag;
		}
