	public class CATimingAnalyzer
	{
		private class TimingItem
		{
			public string Tag { get; private set; }

			public DateTime Time { get; private set; }

			public bool IsEnd { get; private set; }

			public TimingItem(string tag, bool isEnd)
			{
				Tag = tag;
				IsEnd = isEnd;
				Time = DateTime.Now;
			}
		}

		private static readonly object _locker = new object();

		private static readonly string _fileSuffix = ".log";

		private static readonly string _datafolder = "AspenTech\\ColumnAnalyzer";

		private static readonly string _subfolder = "Logs";

		private static readonly string _applicationName = "ColumnAnalyzer.";

		private static readonly string _datetimeFormat = "yyyyMMdd.HHmmss.fff";

		private static string _logFilePath = string.Empty;

		private static FileStream _fileStream;

		private static bool _streamOpened;

		private static List<TimingItem> _timings;

		private static Window _dialog = null;

		private static System.Windows.Controls.TextBox _box = null;

		private static string LogFilePath => _logFilePath;

		private static string AppDataDir => System.IO.Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), _datafolder);

		private static List<TimingItem> Timings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_timings == null)
				{
					_timings = new List<TimingItem>();
				}
				return _timings;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsTurnedOn => false;

		public static void BeginTimingBlock(string tag)
		{
			if (IsTurnedOn)
			{
				Timings.Add(new TimingItem(tag, isEnd: false));
			}
		}

		public static void EndTimingBlock()
		{
			if (!IsTurnedOn)
			{
				return;
			}
			Timings.Add(new TimingItem(null, isEnd: true));
			if (_box != null)
			{
				StringBuilder timeMessage = GetTimeMessage();
				if (timeMessage != null)
				{
					_box.Text = timeMessage.ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		public static void Reset()
		{
			if (IsTurnedOn)
			{
				StringBuilder timeMessage = GetTimeMessage();
				if (timeMessage != null && timeMessage.Length > 0)
				{
					WriteLog(timeMessage.ToString());
				}
				Timings.Clear();
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterTimingReportKey(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (IsTurnedOn && element != null)
			{
				element.PreviewKeyDown += element_PreviewKeyDown;
			}
		}

		public static void UnRegisterTimingReportKey(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (IsTurnedOn && element != null)
			{
				element.PreviewKeyDown -= element_PreviewKeyDown;
			}
		}

		private static void element_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.F8 && Keyboard.Modifiers == (ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift))
			{
				_box = CreateTextbox();
				_dialog = new Window
				{
					Owner = Window.GetWindow(sender as UIElement)
				};
				if (_box != null)
				{
					_dialog.Content = _box;
				}
				_dialog.Show();
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Controls.TextBox CreateTextbox()
		{
			StringBuilder timeMessage = GetTimeMessage();
			if (timeMessage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Controls.TextBox
			{
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top,
				Text = timeMessage.ToString(),
				AcceptsReturn = true,
				VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
				HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
				IsReadOnly = true
			};
		}

		private static StringBuilder GetTimeMessage()
		{
			if (_timings == null || _timings.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			Stack<TimingItem> stack = new Stack<TimingItem>();
			foreach (TimingItem timing in _timings)
			{
				if (!timing.IsEnd)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < stack.Count; i++)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\t');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("BEGIN ").Append(timing.Tag).Append(" @ ")
						.Append(timing.Time.ToString("hh:mm:ss fff"));
					stack.Push(timing);
				}
				else if (stack.Count > 0)
				{
					TimingItem timingItem = stack.Pop();
					for (int j = 0; j < stack.Count; j++)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\t');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("End ").Append(timing.Tag).Append(" @ ")
						.Append(timing.Time.ToString("hh:mm:ss fff"))
						.Append(", Total ms: ")
						.Append((timing.Time - timingItem.Time).TotalMilliseconds);
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine();
			}
			return stringBuilder;
		}

		private static void OpenLogger()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_logFilePath))
			{
				if (GenerateLogFile(out _logFilePath))
				{
					_fileStream = File.Open(_logFilePath, FileMode.Append, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read);
					_streamOpened = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_logFilePath = null;
					_fileStream = null;
					_streamOpened = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_fileStream = File.Open(_logFilePath, FileMode.Append, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read);
				_streamOpened = true;
			}
		}

		private static bool GenerateLogFile(out string logFilePath)
		{
			string text = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDataDir, _subfolder);
			string text2 = DateTime.Now.ToString(_datetimeFormat);
			bool result = false;
			try
			{
				if (!Directory.Exists(text))
				{
					Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
				}
				logFilePath = System.IO.Path.Combine(text, _applicationName + text2 + _fileSuffix);
				if (!File.Exists(logFilePath))
				{
					File.Create(logFilePath).Close();
				}
				result = true;
			}
			catch
			{
				logFilePath = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void CloseLogger()
		{
			if (_fileStream != null)
			{
				try
				{
					_fileStream.Close();
					_fileStream = null;
				}
				catch
				{
					_fileStream = null;
				}
			}
			_streamOpened = false;
		}

		private static bool WriteLog(string message)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!_streamOpened || _fileStream == null)
			{
				OpenLogger();
			}
			lock (_locker)
			{
				if (_fileStream != null)
				{
					try
					{
						byte[] bytes = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: true).GetBytes(message);
						_fileStream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
						_fileStream.Flush();
						result = true;
					}
					catch
					{
						result = false;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CAVariable<T>
	{
		private VariableStatusEnum _VariableStatus;

		private bool _IsEnabled = true;

		[XmlIgnore]
		public abstract T Value { get; set; }

		public VariableStatusEnum VariableStatus
		{
			get
			{
				return _VariableStatus;
			}
			set
			{
				_VariableStatus = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsEnabled = value;
			}
		}

		[XmlAttribute("PropertyName")]
		public string PropertyName { get; set; }

		public abstract bool IsEmpty();

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			bool result = false;
			CAVariable<T> cAVariable = obj as CAVariable<T>;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cAVariable.PropertyName) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(PropertyName)) || ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cAVariable.PropertyName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(PropertyName)) && ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(cAVariable.PropertyName) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PropertyName)) ? true : false));
			return IsValueEqual(cAVariable.Value) && result;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsValueEqual(T val);

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal string PropertyInfomaiton()
		{
			return $"{PropertyName}   Value = {ToString()} VariableStatus = {VariableStatus.ToString()}";
		}
	}
	public class CARealVariable : CAVariable<double>
	{
		private double? _value;

		private QuantityTypeEnum _QuantityType = QuantityTypeEnum.None;

		[XmlIgnore]
		public double? NullableValue => _value;

		[XmlAttribute("Value")]
		public override double Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (_value.HasValue)
				{
					return _value.Value;
				}
				return 1E+35;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value.Equals(-32767.0))
				{
					_value = null;
				}
				else if (value >= 1E+35)
				{
					_value = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[XmlAttribute("QuantityType")]
		public QuantityTypeEnum QuantityType
		{
			get
			{
				return _QuantityType;
			}
			set
			{
				_QuantityType = value;
			}
		}

		[XmlAttribute("HYSYSSISetValue")]
		public double HYSYSSISetValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsEmpty())
				{
					return -32767.0;
				}
				return VariableHelper.ConvertCASIToHYSYSSISet(QuantityType, Value);
			}
			set
			{
				if (VariableHelper.IsEmpty(value))
				{
					Value = 1E+35;
				}
				else
				{
					Value = VariableHelper.ConvertHYSYSSISetToCASI(QuantityType, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public string StringValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsEmpty())
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return Value.ToString();
			}
		}

		private string HYSYSSISetStringValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsEmpty())
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return HYSYSSISetValue.ToString();
			}
		}

		public string HYSYSSISetValueWithUnit
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(HYSYSSISetStringValue))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return $"{HYSYSSISetStringValue} {VariableHelper.GetHYSYSSISetUnit(QuantityType)}";
			}
		}

		public CARealVariable()
		{
		}

		public CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum quantityType)
		{
			QuantityType = quantityType;
			Value = 1E+35;
		}

		public CARealVariable(string propertyName)
		{
			base.PropertyName = propertyName;
		}

		public CARealVariable(string propertyName, QuantityTypeEnum quantityType)
		{
			base.PropertyName = propertyName;
			QuantityType = quantityType;
		}

		public CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum quantityType, double dblValue)
		{
			QuantityType = quantityType;
			Value = dblValue;
		}

		public CARealVariable(string propertyName, QuantityTypeEnum quantityType, double dblValue)
		{
			base.PropertyName = propertyName;
			QuantityType = quantityType;
			Value = dblValue;
		}

		public double GetDisplayValue(Func<QuantityTypeEnum, double, double> convertFunction)
		{
			return convertFunction(_QuantityType, Value);
		}

		public double GetDisplayValue(ISimulatorCADataProvider SimulatorDataProvider, ApplicationType applicationType)
		{
			if (SimulatorDataProvider != null)
			{
				if (QuantityType != QuantityTypeEnum.None)
				{
					string sIUnit = SimulatorDataProvider.GetSIUnit(QuantityType);
					SimulatorDataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(QuantityType);
					return SimulatorDataProvider.GetDisplayValue(QuantityType, Value, sIUnit);
				}
				return Value;
			}
			return Value;
		}

		public string GetDisplayValueWithUnit(ISimulatorCADataProvider SimulatorDataProvider, string format, ApplicationType applicationType)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (SimulatorDataProvider != null)
			{
				if (QuantityType != QuantityTypeEnum.None)
				{
					empty = SimulatorDataProvider.GetDisplayUnit(QuantityType);
					return GetDisplayValue(SimulatorDataProvider, applicationType).ToString(format) + " " + empty;
				}
				return Value.ToString(format);
			}
			return Value.ToString(format);
		}

		public override bool IsEmpty()
		{
			return VariableHelper.IsEmpty(Value);
		}

		protected override bool IsValueEqual(double val)
		{
			if (Value == val)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Math.Abs(Value - val) < 1E-10)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public XmlSchema GetSchema()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void ReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("CARealVariable");
			writer.WriteElementString("Value", Value.ToString());
			writer.WriteElementString("QuantityType", QuantityType.ToString());
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return HYSYSSISetValueWithUnit;
		}
	}
	public class CAIntegerVariable : CAVariable<int>
	{
		private int? _value;

		private List<string> _EnumOptions;

		[XmlAttribute("Value")]
		public override int Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (_value.HasValue)
				{
					return _value.Value;
				}
				return 99999999;
			}
			set
			{
				int obj = -32767;
				if (value.Equals(obj))
				{
					_value = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int AspenPlusValue
		{
			get
			{
				Type type = EnumHeper.GetEnum(string.Empty, base.PropertyName);
				if (type != null)
				{
					return APlusCAEnumMap.GetAPlusCAEnumValueFromCAValue(type.Name, Value);
				}
				return Value;
			}
			set
			{
				Type type = EnumHeper.GetEnum(string.Empty, base.PropertyName);
				if (type != null)
				{
					Value = APlusCAEnumMap.GetCAValueFromAPlusCAEnumValue(type.Name, value);
				}
				else
				{
					Value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[XmlAttribute("IsEnum")]
		public bool IsEnum
		{
			get
			{
				if (EnumHeper.CAPackingOptionPropertyList.Contains(base.PropertyName))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return EnumHeper.IsEnum(string.Empty, base.PropertyName);
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[XmlAttribute("EnumString")]
		public string EnumString
		{
			get
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				if (EnumHeper.CAPackingOptionPropertyList.Contains(base.PropertyName))
				{
					return EnumHeper.GetPackEnumString(base.PropertyName, Value);
				}
				return EnumHeper.GetEnumDisplayString(EnumHeper.GetDispalyTextByProppertyName(string.Empty, base.PropertyName, Value));
			}
			set
			{
				if (EnumHeper.CAPackingOptionPropertyList.Contains(base.PropertyName))
				{
					Value = EnumHeper.GetPackEnumIndex(base.PropertyName, value);
					return;
				}
				Type type = EnumHeper.GetEnum(string.Empty, base.PropertyName);
				if (!(type != null))
				{
					return;
				}
				string enumString = EnumHeper.GetEnumString(value);
				try
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						Value = (int)Enum.Parse(type, enumString, ignoreCase: true);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		public string EnumDescription
		{
			get
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				if (EnumHeper.CAPackingOptionPropertyList.Contains(base.PropertyName))
				{
					text = EnumHeper.GetPackEnumDescription(base.PropertyName, Value);
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = EnumString;
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public Type EnumType => EnumHeper.GetEnum(string.Empty, base.PropertyName);

		public List<string> EnumOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EnumOptions == null)
				{
					if (EnumHeper.CAPackingOptionPropertyList.Contains(base.PropertyName))
					{
						_EnumOptions = EnumHeper.GetPackEnumOptions(base.PropertyName);
					}
					else if (EnumType != null)
					{
						_EnumOptions = Enum.GetNames(EnumType).ToList();
					}
				}
				return _EnumOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				_EnumOptions = value;
			}
		}

		public CAIntegerVariable()
		{
		}

		public CAIntegerVariable(int val)
		{
			Value = val;
		}

		public CAIntegerVariable(string propertyName)
		{
			Value = 99999999;
			base.PropertyName = propertyName;
		}

		public CAIntegerVariable(string propertyName, int val)
		{
			Value = 99999999;
			base.PropertyName = propertyName;
		}

		public override bool IsEmpty()
		{
			return VariableHelper.IsIntegerEmpty(Value);
		}

		public string GetEnumStringValue()
		{
			return Enum.GetName(EnumHeper.GetEnum(string.Empty, base.PropertyName), Value);
		}

		protected override bool IsValueEqual(int val)
		{
			return Value == val;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(EnumString))
			{
				return Value.ToString();
			}
			return EnumString;
		}
	}

	public class VariableHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string> SIUnitForAspenPlus;

		private static Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string> SIUnitForForAspenHYSYS;

		private static Dictionary<int, QuantityTypeEnum> QuantityTypeForAspenPlus;

		private static Dictionary<int, QuantityTypeEnum> QuantityTypeForAspenHYSYS;

		private static Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, int> QuantityTypeIntForAspenPlus;

		private static Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string> HYSYS_SISetUnits;

		private static Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, double> HYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient;

		private const int tpsr_imiss = 99999999;

		private const double tpsr_rmiss = 1E+35;

		public const double Tpsr_rmiss_engine = 1E+35;

		public const double Empty = 1E+35;

		public const int IntegerEmpty = 99999999;

		public const double HYSYSDoulbeEmpty = -32767.0;

		public const double Tol = 1E-05;

		static VariableHelper()
		{
			SIUnitForAspenPlus = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string>();
			SIUnitForForAspenHYSYS = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string>();
			QuantityTypeForAspenPlus = new Dictionary<int, QuantityTypeEnum>();
			QuantityTypeForAspenHYSYS = new Dictionary<int, QuantityTypeEnum>();
			QuantityTypeIntForAspenPlus = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, int>();
			HYSYS_SISetUnits = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, string>();
			HYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient = new Dictionary<QuantityTypeEnum, double>();
			InitAspenPlusSIMap();
			InitAspenPlusQTMap();
			InitAspenHYSYSMap();
			InitAspenHYSYSQTMap();
			InitAspenHYSYS_SISetUnits();
			InitHYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient();
		}

		public static string GetSimulatorSIUnit(SimulatorType simulatorType, QuantityTypeEnum quantityType)
		{
			string value = string.Empty;
			switch (simulatorType)
			{
			case SimulatorType.AspenPlus:
				SIUnitForAspenPlus.TryGetValue(quantityType, out value);
				break;
			case SimulatorType.AspenHYSYS:
				SIUnitForForAspenHYSYS.TryGetValue(quantityType, out value);
				break;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static string GetPlusUnitFromAPlusQtIndex(int aPlusQtID, out QuantityTypeEnum qt)
		{
			qt = QuantityTypeEnum.None;
			if (QuantityTypeForAspenPlus.ContainsKey(aPlusQtID))
			{
				qt = QuantityTypeForAspenPlus[aPlusQtID];
			}
			string value = string.Empty;
			SIUnitForAspenPlus.TryGetValue(qt, out value);
			return value;
		}

		public static int GetPlusDimensionRow(QuantityTypeEnum qt)
		{
			int result = 0;
			if (QuantityTypeIntForAspenPlus.ContainsKey(qt))
			{
				result = QuantityTypeIntForAspenPlus[qt];
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void InitAspenPlusQTMap()

		internal static double ConvertHYSYSSISetToCASI(QuantityTypeEnum qt, double hysysSIVal)
		{
			if (HYSYS_SISetUnits.ContainsKey(qt) && HYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient.ContainsKey(qt))
			{
				if (qt == QuantityTypeEnum.Temperature)
				{
					return hysysSIVal + 273.15;
				}
				return hysysSIVal * HYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient[qt];
			}
			return hysysSIVal;
		}

		internal static double ConvertCASIToHYSYSSISet(QuantityTypeEnum qt, double caVal)
		{
			if (HYSYS_SISetUnits.ContainsKey(qt) && HYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient.ContainsKey(qt))
			{
				if (qt == QuantityTypeEnum.Temperature)
				{
					return caVal - 273.15;
				}
				return caVal / HYSYS_SISetUnitsCoeficient[qt];
			}
			return caVal;
		}

		internal static string GetHYSYSSISetUnit(QuantityTypeEnum qt)
		{
			if (HYSYS_SISetUnits.ContainsKey(qt))
			{
				return HYSYS_SISetUnits[qt];
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static bool IsIntegerEmpty(int val)
		{
			return val.Equals(99999999);
		}

		public static bool IsEmpty(double val)
		{
			if (val == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = Math.Abs(val - 1E+35) / Math.Abs(val) <= 1E-05;
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = Math.Abs(val - 1E+35) / Math.Abs(val) <= 1E-05;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = Math.Abs(val - -32767.0) / Math.Abs(val) <= 1E-05;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static bool IsDoubleEqual(double val1, double val2)
		{
			return IsDoubleEqual(val1, val2, 1E-05);
		}

		public static bool IsDoubleEqual(double val1, double val2, double tolerance)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (double.IsNaN(val1) || double.IsNaN(val2))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			else if (IsEmpty(val1) && IsEmpty(val2))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			else if (IsEmpty(val1) || IsEmpty(val2))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			else if (Math.Abs(val1) > Math.Abs(val2) && val1 != 0.0)
			{
				result = Math.Abs(val1 - val2) / Math.Abs(val1) <= tolerance;
			}
			else if (Math.Abs(val2) > Math.Abs(val1) && val2 != 0.0)
			{
				result = Math.Abs(val1 - val2) / Math.Abs(val2) <= tolerance;
			}
			else if (val1.Equals(val2))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsEqualTwoStr(string str1, string str2)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str1) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(str2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str1) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(str2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return str1.Equals(str2);
		}

				LiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidVolumeTArea => QuantityTypeEnum.DownComerLoad, 
				LiquidBasisEnum.FlowBasisLiquidMassFluxTArea => QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMassPerArea, 
				_ => QuantityTypeEnum.None, 
			};
		}

				VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporVolume => QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateGasVol,

				VapordBasisEnum.FlowBasisVaporNetArea => QuantityTypeEnum.Fs,

				_ => QuantityTypeEnum.None,

		}

		internal static double ConvertSignificantFigure(double d, int significantFigure)
		{
			double num = Math.Floor(Math.Log10(Math.Abs(d)));
			double num2 = Math.Pow(10.0, num + 1.0);
			return num2 * Math.Round(d / num2, significantFigure);
		}

		public XmlDocument GetXmlDocument()
		{
			return CADataHelper.SerializeToXml(this);
		}
	}

				{
					return true;

			}

		internal void ConvertValueToCurrentUnitSet(double lquidCoef, double vaporCoef)
		{
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, MinimumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, OperatingPointsLiquidFlow);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, OperatingPointsVaporFlow);
			ActualOperationPoint[0] *= lquidCoef;
			ActualOperationPoint[1] *= vaporCoef;
		}

		private void ConvertValue(double coef, List<double> source)
		{
			if (source == null || source.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					source[i] *= coef;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private OperatingStatus GetWarningStatus()
		{
			OperatingStatus operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Normal;
			if (HasErrorMessageForStage())
			{
				operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Error;
			}
			else if (CADataHelper.IsABiggerEqualB(ActualOperationPoint[1], MinVaporFlow) && CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(ActualOperationPoint[1], MaxVaporFlow))
			{
				if (WarningStatusLimit.Value > 0.5)
				{
					WarningStatusLimit = 0.5;
				}
				double num = OperatingPointsLiquidFlow[1];
				if (MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints != null && MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count > 0 && MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < num)
				{
					num = MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0];
				}
				double num2 = (num - MinLiquidFlow) * WarningStatusLimit.Value;
				double b = num - num2;
				double b2 = MinLiquidFlow + num2;
				if (CADataHelper.IsABiggerEqualB(ActualOperationPoint[0], b2) && CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(ActualOperationPoint[0], b))
				{
					operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Normal;
				}
				else
				{
					operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Warning;
					if (CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(ActualOperationPoint[0], b2))
					{
						_ClosedToLimiterType = ClosedToLimiterType.BelowOperatingPoint;
					}
					else
					{
						_ClosedToLimiterType = ClosedToLimiterType.UpperOperationPoint;
					}
				}
			}
			if (operatingStatus == OperatingStatus.Normal && HasEngineWarningMessageForStage())
			{
				operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Warning;
			}
			return operatingStatus;
		}

		private bool HasErrorMessageForStage()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (Messages == null || Messages.Count == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Messages.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = Messages[i];
				int num2 = i + 1;
				if (num <= 99999 && num > 0)
				{
					_ = $"Message{num2}_{num}";
					EngineMessage engineMessage = ResourceHelper.GeTrayEngineMessage(num2, num);
					if (engineMessage != null && engineMessage.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Tray && CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(engineMessage.MessageResourceKey) && CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap[engineMessage.MessageResourceKey] == MessageType.Error)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool HasEngineWarningMessageForStage()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (Messages == null || Messages.Count == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Messages.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = Messages[i];
				int num2 = i + 1;
				if (num <= 99999 && num > 0)
				{
					_ = $"Message{num2}_{num}";
					EngineMessage engineMessage = ResourceHelper.GeTrayEngineMessage(num2, num);
					if (engineMessage != null && engineMessage.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Tray && CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(engineMessage.MessageResourceKey) && CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap[engineMessage.MessageResourceKey] == MessageType.Warning)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum GetCloseToLimitWarningStatus()
		{
			TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum result = TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.NotSet;
			if (OperatingStatus != OperatingStatus.Warning)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Dictionary<TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum, double>();
			if (_ClosedToLimiterType == ClosedToLimiterType.UpperOperationPoint)
			{
				if (MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints != null && MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count > 0 && MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < OperatingPointsLiquidFlow[1])
				{
					dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxWeirLoading, MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]);
				}
				else
				{
					double? yValueOfCurve = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints, JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints, MaxLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxJetFlood, yValueOfCurve.Value);
					}
					double? yValueOfCurve2 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints, DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints, MaxLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve2.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxDownComerBackup, yValueOfCurve2.Value);
					}
					double? yValueOfCurve3 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints, MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints, MaxLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve3.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxEntrainment, yValueOfCurve3.Value);
					}
					double? yValueOfCurve4 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints, MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints, MaxLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve4.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxPressureDrop, yValueOfCurve4.Value);
					}
					double? yValueOfCurve5 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints, UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints, MaxLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve5.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.UltimateCapacity, yValueOfCurve5.Value);
					}
				}
				if (dictionary.Count > 0)
				{
					double value = dictionary.First().Value;
					result = dictionary.First().Key;
					foreach (KeyValuePair<TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum, double> item in dictionary)
					{
						if (item.Value < value)
						{
							value = item.Value;
							result = item.Key;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (_ClosedToLimiterType == ClosedToLimiterType.BelowOperatingPoint)
			{
				if (MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints != null && MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count > 0 && VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(MinLiquidFlow, MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]))
				{
					dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MinWeirLoading, MinLiquidFlow);
				}
				else
				{
					double? yValueOfCurve6 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints, WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints, MinLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve6.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.WeepPoint, yValueOfCurve6.Value);
					}
					double? yValueOfCurve7 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints, DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints, MinLiquidFlow);
					if (yValueOfCurve7.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.Dump, yValueOfCurve7.Value);
					}
				}
				if (dictionary.Count > 0)
				{
					double value2 = dictionary.First().Value;
					result = dictionary.First().Key;
					foreach (KeyValuePair<TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum, double> item2 in dictionary)
					{
						if (item2.Value > value2)
						{
							value2 = item2.Value;
							result = item2.Key;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class PointD
	{
		private double _X;

		private double _Y;

		public double X
		{
			get
			{
				return _X;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < -1E-06)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("X", "X value should not be less than 0");
				}
				_X = value;
			}
		}

		public double Y
		{
			get
			{
				return _Y;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < -1E-06)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Y", "Y point value should not be less than 0");
				}
				_Y = value;
			}
		}

		public PointD()
		{
			X = 0.0;
			Y = 0.0;
		}

		public PointD(double x, double y)
		{
			X = x;
			Y = y;
		}

		public static void SplitPointDArray(PointD[] points, out double[] X, out double[] Y)
		{
			X = new double[points.Length];
			Y = new double[points.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				X[i] = points[i].X;
				Y[i] = points[i].Y;
			}
		}
	}

	public class PackingDiagramSectionData
	{
		private List<PackingStageDiagram> _packingStageDiagramList = new List<PackingStageDiagram>();

		public string VaporUnit { get; set; }

				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("StageNumber", "StageNumber should not be less than 0");
				}
				if (_stageNumber != value)
				{
					_stageNumber = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private double[,] _VaporFlowValues;

		private Dictionary<double, Tuple<List<double>, List<double>, bool>> _AllPressureCurves;

		private PackingEnclosedAreaLines _EnclosedAreaLines;

		private PlotDataRegion _PlotDataRegion;

		private PackingCloseToLimitMessage _CloseToLimitMessage;

		internal double[] PressureDropValuesOriginal { get; set; }

		public double[] PressureDropValues { get; set; }

		public double[] LiquidFlowValues { get; set; }

		[XmlIgnore]
		public double[,] VaporFlowValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (_VaporFlowValues == null)
				{
					_VaporFlowValues = new double[NumberOfLFlowVales, NumberOfCurves];
					for (int i = 0; i < NumberOfCurves; i++)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < NumberOfLFlowVales; j++)
						{
							double num = VaporFlowValuesSource[i * NumberOfLFlowVales + j];
							if (num != 1E+35)
							{
								_VaporFlowValues[j, i] = num;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return _VaporFlowValues;
			}
		}

		[XmlIgnore]
		public Dictionary<double, Tuple<List<double>, List<double>, bool>> AllPressureCurves
		{
			get
			{
				if (_AllPressureCurves == null)
				{
					_AllPressureCurves = new Dictionary<double, Tuple<List<double>, List<double>, bool>>();
					for (int i = 0; i < PressureDropValues.Length; i++)
					{
						List<double> list = new List<double>();
						List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
						for (int j = 0; j < LiquidFlowValues.Length; j++)
						{
							if (VaporFlowValues[j, i] != 0.0 && !(VaporFlowValues[j, i] >= 1E+35))
							{
								list.Add(LiquidFlowValues[j]);
								list2.Add(VaporFlowValues[j, i]);
							}
						}
						bool item = false;
						if (list.Count > 0)
						{
							item = true;
						}
						if (!_AllPressureCurves.ContainsKey(PressureDropValues[i]))
						{
							_AllPressureCurves.Add(PressureDropValues[i], new Tuple<List<double>, List<double>, bool>(list, list2, item));
						}
					}
				}
				return _AllPressureCurves;
			}
		}

		public int NumberOfCurves { get; set; }

		public int NumberOfLFlowVales { get; set; }

		public double[] VaporFlowValuesSource { get; set; }

		public double[] UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues { get; set; }

		internal void ConvertValueToCurrentUnitSet(double lquidCoef, double vaporCoef, double pressureDropCoef)
		{
			ConvertEnclosedData(lquidCoef, vaporCoef, pressureDropCoef);
			ConvertValue(pressureDropCoef, PressureDropValues);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, LiquidFlowValues);
			ConvertVaporFlowValues(vaporCoef);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues);
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(MinimumLiquidFlow))
			{
				MinimumLiquidFlow *= lquidCoef;
			}
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(MaximumLiquidFlow))
			{
				MaximumLiquidFlow *= lquidCoef;
			}
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(OperationPointX))
			{
				OperationPointX *= lquidCoef;
			}
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(OperationPointY))
			{
				OperationPointY *= vaporCoef;
			}
		}

		private void ConvertVaporFlowValues(double coef)
		{
			if (PressureDropValues == null || LiquidFlowValues == null || VaporFlowValues == null || PressureDropValues.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < PressureDropValues.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < LiquidFlowValues.Length; j++)
				{
					try
					{
						if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(VaporFlowValues[j, i]))
						{
							VaporFlowValues[j, i] *= coef;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			ConvertValue(coef, VaporFlowValuesSource);
			if (_AllPressureCurves != null)
			{
				_AllPressureCurves = null;
			}
		}

		private void ConvertValue(double coef, double[] source)
		{
			if (source == null || source.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < source.Length; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(source[i]))
					{
						source[i] *= coef;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		public void ConvertValueToCurrentBasis(double lquidCoef, double vaporCoef, double pressureDropCoef = 1.0)
		{
			ConvertEnclosedData(lquidCoef, vaporCoef, pressureDropCoef);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, LiquidFlowValues);
			ConvertVaporFlowValues(vaporCoef);
			ConvertValue(lquidCoef, UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues);
			ConvertValue(vaporCoef, UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues);
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(MinimumLiquidFlow))
			{
				MinimumLiquidFlow *= lquidCoef;
			}
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(MaximumLiquidFlow))
			{
				MaximumLiquidFlow *= lquidCoef;
			}
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(OperationPointX))
			{
				OperationPointX *= lquidCoef;
			}
			if (!VariableHelper.IsEmpty(OperationPointY))
			{
				OperationPointY *= vaporCoef;
			}
		}

		private void ConvertEnclosedData(double lquidCoef, double vaporCoef, double pressureDropCoef)
		{
			if (_EnclosedAreaLines != null)
			{
				ConvertValue(pressureDropCoef, _EnclosedAreaLines.PressureDropValues);
				ConvertLines(lquidCoef, vaporCoef, _EnclosedAreaLines.PressureLines);
				ConvertLines(lquidCoef, vaporCoef, _EnclosedAreaLines.UltimateLines);
				_EnclosedAreaLines.MinimumLiquidFlow *= lquidCoef;
				_EnclosedAreaLines.MaximumLiquidFlow *= lquidCoef;
				_EnclosedAreaLines.OperationPointX *= lquidCoef;
				_EnclosedAreaLines.OperationPointY *= vaporCoef;
				ConvertListPoints(lquidCoef, vaporCoef, _EnclosedAreaLines.EnclosedLine);
				ConvertListPoints(lquidCoef, vaporCoef, _EnclosedAreaLines.ConstantLine);
			}
			if (_PlotDataRegion != null)
			{
				_PlotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft *= vaporCoef;
				_PlotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright *= vaporCoef;
				_PlotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft *= vaporCoef;
				_PlotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright *= vaporCoef;
			}
		}

		private void ConvertListPoints(double lquidCoef, double vaporCoef, List<PairDouble> source)
		{
			if (source == null || source.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PairDouble item in source)
			{
				item.x *= lquidCoef;
				item.y *= vaporCoef;
			}
		}

		private void ConvertLines(double lquidCoef, double vaporCoef, List<List<PairDouble>> source)
		{
			if (source == null || source.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (List<PairDouble> item in source)
			{
				foreach (PairDouble item2 in item)
				{
					item2.x *= lquidCoef;
					item2.y *= vaporCoef;
				}
			}
		}

		internal PackingEnclosedAreaLines AnalyzerEclosureData(out PlotDataRegion plotDataRegion)
		{
			PackingEnclosedAreaLines packingEnclosedAreaLines = new PackingEnclosedAreaLines();
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.OperationPointX = OperationPointX;
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.OperationPointY = OperationPointY;
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.MinimumLiquidFlow = MinimumLiquidFlow;
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.MaximumLiquidFlow = MaximumLiquidFlow;
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<List<PairDouble>> list2 = new List<List<PairDouble>>();
			List<List<PairDouble>> list3 = new List<List<PairDouble>>();
			AttpsrHelper.FoundRangeList(UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues.ToList(), toFindMax: true);
			if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.ToList(), UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues.ToList(), PackingLineType.PressureDrop))
			{
				List<double> list4 = new List<double>();
				List<List<PairDouble>> list5 = ConvertPressureOriginalLinesToPair(this, list4);
				AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine analyzedLine = new AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine();
				for (int i = 0; i < UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.Length; i++)
				{
					analyzedLine.Add(new PairDouble(UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues[i], UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues[i]));
				}
				List<AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine> lineSourceCutted = null;
				List<AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine> lineRefCutted = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < list5.Count; j++)
				{
					List<int> intersectionPointIndex;
					List<PairDouble> intersectionPoint = AttpsrHelper.GetIntersectionPoint(list5[j], analyzedLine.Line, out intersectionPointIndex, out lineSourceCutted, out lineRefCutted);
					foreach (AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine item in lineSourceCutted)
					{
						if (item.IsBelow)
						{
							list.Add(list4[j]);
							if (item.Line.Count > 1)
							{
								list2.Add(item.Line);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					if (j != list5.Count - 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (intersectionPoint != null && intersectionPoint.Count > 0)
					{
						foreach (AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine item2 in lineRefCutted)
						{
							if (item2.IsBelow)
							{
								list3.Add(item2.Clone().Line);
							}
						}
					}
					else if ((intersectionPoint != null && intersectionPoint.Count != 0) || lineSourceCutted.Count != 1 || !lineSourceCutted[0].IsBelow)
					{
						list3.Add(analyzedLine.Clone().Line);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				List<List<PairDouble>> list6 = ConvertPressureOriginalLinesToPair(this, list);
				for (int k = 0; k < list6.Count; k++)
				{
					if (list6[k].Count > 1)
					{
						list2.Add(list6[k]);
					}
				}
			}
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.PressureDropValues = list.ToArray();
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.PressureLines = list2;
			packingEnclosedAreaLines.UltimateLines = list3;
			plotDataRegion = AnalyzerPlotDataEnclosedRegion(packingEnclosedAreaLines);
			SetEnclosedDataArray(packingEnclosedAreaLines, plotDataRegion);
			SetOperatingLine(packingEnclosedAreaLines, plotDataRegion);
			return packingEnclosedAreaLines;
		}

		private void SetEnclosedDataArray(PackingEnclosedAreaLines exclosedData, PlotDataRegion plotDataRegion)
		{
			DiagramDataStore diagramDataStore = new DiagramDataStore();
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			int num = -1;
			List<PairDouble> list3 = null;
			foreach (List<PairDouble> pressureLine in exclosedData.PressureLines)
			{
				num++;
				_ = exclosedData.PressureDropValues[num];
				foreach (PairDouble item2 in pressureLine)
				{
					list.Add(item2.x);
					list2.Add(item2.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop) && num == exclosedData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1 && exclosedData.PressureDropValues[exclosedData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1] == PressureDropValues[PressureDropValues.Length - 1])
				{
					list3 = pressureLine;
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (list3 != null)
			{
				diagramDataStore.AddLine(list3);
				flag = true;
			}
			foreach (List<PairDouble> ultimateLine in exclosedData.UltimateLines)
			{
				foreach (PairDouble item3 in ultimateLine)
				{
					list.Add(item3.x);
					list2.Add(item3.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity))
				{
					diagramDataStore.AddLine(ultimateLine);
					if (!flag && list3 != null)
					{
						diagramDataStore.AddLine(list3);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			list.Clear();
			list2.Clear();
			list.Add(MaximumLiquidFlow);
			list.Add(MaximumLiquidFlow);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright);
			if (plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright >= 0.0 && plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright > 0.0 && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright, plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright) && AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.MaximumLiquidRate))
			{
				diagramDataStore.AddPoints(list, list2);
			}
			if (exclosedData.PressureLines.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int num2 = exclosedData.PressureLines[0].Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					diagramDataStore.AddPoint(exclosedData.PressureLines[0][num2].x, exclosedData.PressureLines[0][num2].y);
				}
			}
			list.Clear();
			list2.Clear();
			list.Add(MinimumLiquidFlow);
			list.Add(MinimumLiquidFlow);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft);
			if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft, plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft) && AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate))
			{
				diagramDataStore.AddPoints(list, list2);
			}
			if (exclosedData.EnclosedLine == null)
			{
				exclosedData.EnclosedLine = new List<PairDouble>();
			}
			foreach (PairDouble item4 in diagramDataStore.PointArray)
			{
				PairDouble item = new PairDouble(item4.x, item4.y);
				exclosedData.EnclosedLine.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private PlotDataRegion AnalyzerPlotDataEnclosedRegion(PackingEnclosedAreaLines exclosedData)
		{
			if (exclosedData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PlotDataRegion plotDataRegion = new PlotDataRegion();
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft = -1.0;
			plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright = -1.0;
			foreach (List<PairDouble> pressureLine in exclosedData.PressureLines)
			{
				foreach (PairDouble item in pressureLine)
				{
					list.Add(item.x);
					list2.Add(item.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop))
				{
					if (list2[0] > plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft)
					{
						plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft = list2[0];
					}
					if (plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft < 0.0 || plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft > list2[0])
					{
						plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft = list2[0];
					}
					if (list2[list2.Count - 1] > plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright && list[list.Count - 1] >= exclosedData.MaximumLiquidFlow * 0.99)
					{
						plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright = list2[list2.Count - 1];
					}
					if (plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright < 0.0 || list2[list2.Count - 1] < plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright)
					{
						plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright = list2[list2.Count - 1];
					}
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			foreach (List<PairDouble> ultimateLine in exclosedData.UltimateLines)
			{
				foreach (PairDouble item2 in ultimateLine)
				{
					list.Add(item2.x);
					list2.Add(item2.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity))
				{
					if (list2[0] > plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft)
					{
						plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft = list2[0];
					}
					if (list2[list2.Count - 1] > plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright && list[list.Count - 1] >= exclosedData.MaximumLiquidFlow * 0.99)
					{
						plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright = list2[list2.Count - 1];
					}
					if (plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright < 0.0 || list2[list2.Count - 1] < plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright)
					{
						plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright = list2[list2.Count - 1];
					}
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			return plotDataRegion;
		}

		private List<List<PairDouble>> ConvertPressureOriginalLinesToPair(PackingPlotReturnData plotData, List<double> pressureDrops)
		{
			List<List<PairDouble>> list = new List<List<PairDouble>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < plotData.PressureDropValues.Length; i++)
			{
				List<PairDouble> list2 = new List<PairDouble>();
				for (int j = 0; j < plotData.LiquidFlowValues.Length; j++)
				{
					if (plotData.VaporFlowValues[j, i] != 0.0)
					{
						list2.Add(new PairDouble(plotData.LiquidFlowValues[j], plotData.VaporFlowValues[j, i]));
					}
				}
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(list2);
					pressureDrops?.Add(plotData.PressureDropValues[i]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void SetOperatingLine(PackingEnclosedAreaLines enclosedData, PlotDataRegion plotDataRegion)
		{
			if (enclosedData == null || enclosedData.EnclosedLine == null || enclosedData.EnclosedLine.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<PairDouble> list = new List<PairDouble>();
			double num = enclosedData.OperationPointY / enclosedData.OperationPointX;
			int num2 = -1;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double x = enclosedData.EnclosedLine[0].x;
			foreach (PairDouble item in enclosedData.EnclosedLine)
			{
				num2++;
				if (item.x > num3)
				{
					num3 = item.x;
				}
				if (item.x < x)
				{
					x = item.x;
				}
			}
			num3 = MaximumLiquidFlow * 1.05;
			double num4 = num3 - x;
			int num5 = 100;
			double num6 = num4 / (double)num5;
			for (int i = 0; i < num5; i++)
			{
				double num7 = enclosedData.MinimumLiquidFlow + num6 * (double)i;
				double y = num * num7;
				list.Add(new PairDouble(num7, y));
			}
			List<PairDouble> list2 = null;
			List<AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine> lineSourceCutted = null;
			List<AttpsrHelper.AnalyzedLine> lineRefCutted = null;
			List<int> intersectionPointIndex;
			if (enclosedData.UltimateLines != null && enclosedData.UltimateLines.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (List<PairDouble> ultimateLine in enclosedData.UltimateLines)
				{
					list2 = AttpsrHelper.GetIntersectionPoint(ultimateLine, list, out intersectionPointIndex, out lineSourceCutted, out lineRefCutted);
					if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((list2 == null || list2.Count == 0) && enclosedData.PressureLines != null && enclosedData.PressureLines.Count > 1)
			{
				list2 = AttpsrHelper.GetIntersectionPoint(enclosedData.PressureLines.LastOrDefault(), list, out intersectionPointIndex, out lineSourceCutted, out lineRefCutted);
			}
			if ((list2 == null || list2.Count == 0) && plotDataRegion != null)
			{
				double maximumLiquidFlow = enclosedData.MaximumLiquidFlow;
				double num8 = num * maximumLiquidFlow;
				if (num8 > plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadright && num8 < plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadright)
				{
					list2 = new List<PairDouble>
					{
						new PairDouble(maximumLiquidFlow, num8)
					};
				}
			}
			if ((list2 == null || list2.Count == 0) && enclosedData.PressureLines != null && enclosedData.PressureLines.Count > 2)
			{
				for (int j = 2; j < enclosedData.PressureLines.Count - 1; j++)
				{
					list2 = AttpsrHelper.GetIntersectionPoint(enclosedData.PressureLines[enclosedData.PressureLines.Count - j], list, out intersectionPointIndex, out lineSourceCutted, out lineRefCutted);
					if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			PairDouble pairDouble = null;
			if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
			{
				pairDouble = list2[0];
			}
			List<PairDouble> list3 = null;
			if (enclosedData.PressureLines != null && enclosedData.PressureLines.Count > 0)
			{
				list3 = AttpsrHelper.GetIntersectionPoint(enclosedData.PressureLines[0], list, out intersectionPointIndex, out lineSourceCutted, out lineRefCutted);
			}
			PairDouble pairDouble2 = null;
			if ((list3 == null || list3.Count == 0) && plotDataRegion != null)
			{
				double minimumLiquidFlow = enclosedData.MinimumLiquidFlow;
				double num9 = num * minimumLiquidFlow;
				if (num9 > plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft && num9 < plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft)
				{
					pairDouble2 = new PairDouble(minimumLiquidFlow, num9);
				}
			}
			else if (list3 != null && list3.Count > 0)
			{
				pairDouble2 = list3[0];
			}
			if (pairDouble != null && pairDouble2 != null && (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(pairDouble.x, pairDouble2.x) || !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(pairDouble.y, pairDouble2.y)))
			{
				enclosedData.ConstantLine = new List<PairDouble>();
				enclosedData.ConstantLine.Add(pairDouble2);
				enclosedData.ConstantLine.Add(pairDouble);
			}
		}

		private OperatingStatus GetWarningStatus()
		{
			OperatingStatus operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Normal;
			if (HasErrorMessageForStage())
			{
				operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Error;
			}
			else if (!LowerVaporLimit.HasValue || !UpperVaporLimit.HasValue || !WarningStatusLimit.HasValue)
			{
				operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Normal;
				if (EngineMessages != null && EngineMessages.Length != 0)
				{
					operatingStatus = ((EngineMessages[5] == 1 || EngineMessages[6] == 1 || EngineMessages[7] == 1 || EngineMessages[8] == 1) ? OperatingStatus.Error : OperatingStatus.Normal);
				}
			}
			else if (CADataHelper.IsABiggerEqualB(OperationPointY, LowerVaporLimit.Value) && CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(OperationPointY, UpperVaporLimit.Value))
			{
				if (WarningStatusLimit.Value > 50.0)
				{
					WarningStatusLimit = 50.0;
				}
				double num = (UpperVaporLimit.Value - LowerVaporLimit.Value) * WarningStatusLimit.Value / 100.0;
				double b = UpperVaporLimit.Value - num;
				double b2 = LowerVaporLimit.Value + num;
				if (CADataHelper.IsABiggerEqualB(OperationPointY, b2) && CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(OperationPointY, b))
				{
					operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Normal;
				}
				else
				{
					operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Warning;
					if (CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(OperationPointY, b2))
					{
						_ClosedToLimiterType = ClosedToLimiterType.BelowOperatingPoint;
					}
					else
					{
						_ClosedToLimiterType = ClosedToLimiterType.UpperOperationPoint;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Error;
				if (EngineMessages != null && EngineMessages.Length != 0)
				{
					operatingStatus = ((EngineMessages[5] == 1 || EngineMessages[6] == 1 || EngineMessages[7] == 1 || EngineMessages[8] == 1) ? OperatingStatus.Error : OperatingStatus.Normal);
				}
			}
			bool num2 = IsMaxPresCalcuated();
			bool flag = IsUltimateCalcuated();
			bool flag2 = !num2 || !flag;
			List<double> xlowerArray;
			List<double> lowerYArray;
			int presIndex;
			bool minimumPressureDropCurve = GetMinimumPressureDropCurve(out xlowerArray, out lowerYArray, out presIndex);
			if (operatingStatus == OperatingStatus.Normal && (HasEngineWarningMessageForStage() || flag2 || !minimumPressureDropCurve))
			{
				operatingStatus = OperatingStatus.Warning;
			}
			return operatingStatus;
		}

		private bool HasErrorMessageForStage()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (EngineMessagesOther != null && EngineMessagesOther.Contains("PackMessage_EngineErrorTray"))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			else if (EngineMessages != null && EngineMessages.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < EngineMessages.Length; i++)
				{
					int num = EngineMessages[i];
					int num2 = i + 1;
					if (num <= 99999 && num > 0)
					{
						_ = $"PackMessage_{num2}_{num}";
						EngineMessage packingEngineMessage = ResourceHelper.GetPackingEngineMessage(num2, num);
						if (packingEngineMessage != null && packingEngineMessage.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Tray && CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey) && CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap[packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey] == MessageType.Error)
						{
							result = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool HasEngineWarningMessageForStage()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (EngineMessages == null || EngineMessages.Length == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < EngineMessages.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = EngineMessages[i];
				int num2 = i + 1;
				if (num <= 99999 && num > 0)
				{
					_ = $"PackMessage_{num2}_{num}";
					EngineMessage packingEngineMessage = ResourceHelper.GetPackingEngineMessage(num2, num);
					if (packingEngineMessage != null && packingEngineMessage.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Tray && CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey) && CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap[packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey] == MessageType.Warning)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool GetMaxPressureDropCurve(out List<double> xUpperArray, out List<double> upperYArray)
		{
			xUpperArray = new List<double>();
			upperYArray = new List<double>();
			int num = 0;
			if (PressureDropValues == null || PressureDropValues.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			num = PressureDropValues.Length - 1;
			bool result = true;
			if (AllPressureCurves.ContainsKey(PressureDropValues[num]))
			{
				xUpperArray = AllPressureCurves[PressureDropValues[num]].Item1.ToList();
				upperYArray = AllPressureCurves[PressureDropValues[num]].Item2.ToList();
				result = AllPressureCurves[PressureDropValues[num]].Item3;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool GetMinimumPressureDropCurve(out List<double> xlowerArray, out List<double> lowerYArray, out int presIndex)
		{
			xlowerArray = new List<double>();
			lowerYArray = new List<double>();
			presIndex = 0;
			if (PressureDropValues == null || PressureDropValues.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = true;
			if (AllPressureCurves.ContainsKey(PressureDropValues[presIndex]))
			{
				xlowerArray = AllPressureCurves[PressureDropValues[presIndex]].Item1.ToList();
				lowerYArray = AllPressureCurves[PressureDropValues[presIndex]].Item2.ToList();
				result = AllPressureCurves[PressureDropValues[presIndex]].Item3;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal CARealVariable GetMinPressureDrop()
		{
			if (PressureDropValuesOriginal == null || PressureDropValuesOriginal.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GetMinimumPressureDropCurve(out var _, out var _, out var presIndex);
			if (presIndex < PressureDropValuesOriginal.Length)
			{
				return new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight, PressureDropValuesOriginal[presIndex]);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool IsMaxPresCalcuated()
		{
			List<double> xUpperArray;
			List<double> upperYArray;
			return GetMaxPressureDropCurve(out xUpperArray, out upperYArray);
		}

		internal bool IsUltimateCalcuated()
		{
			return AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.ToList(), UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues.ToList());
		}

		private PackingCloseToLimitMessage GetCloseToLimitWarningStatus()
		{
			PackingCloseToLimitMessage result = PackingCloseToLimitMessage.NotSet;
			if (OperatingStatus != OperatingStatus.Warning)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Dictionary<PackingCloseToLimitMessage, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<PackingCloseToLimitMessage, double>();
			if (_ClosedToLimiterType == ClosedToLimiterType.UpperOperationPoint)
			{
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.ToList(), UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues.ToList()))
				{
					double? yValueOfCurve = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.ToList(), UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues.ToList(), UpperLiquidLimit.Value);
					if (yValueOfCurve.HasValue)
					{
						dictionary.Add(PackingCloseToLimitMessage.UltimateCurve, yValueOfCurve.Value);
					}
				}
				GetMaxPressureDropCurve(out var xUpperArray, out var upperYArray);
				double? yValueOfCurve2 = AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(xUpperArray, upperYArray, UpperLiquidLimit.Value);
				if (yValueOfCurve2.HasValue)
				{
					dictionary.Add(PackingCloseToLimitMessage.MaxPressrueDrop, yValueOfCurve2.Value);
				}
				if (dictionary.Count > 0)
				{
					double value = dictionary.First().Value;
					result = dictionary.First().Key;
					foreach (KeyValuePair<PackingCloseToLimitMessage, double> item in dictionary)
					{
						if (item.Value < value)
						{
							value = item.Value;
							result = item.Key;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (_ClosedToLimiterType == ClosedToLimiterType.BelowOperatingPoint)
			{
				List<double> xlowerArray;
				List<double> lowerYArray;
				int presIndex;
				if (VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(MinimumLiquidFlow, LowerLiquidLimit.Value))
				{
					result = PackingCloseToLimitMessage.MinLoarding;
				}
				else if (GetMinimumPressureDropCurve(out xlowerArray, out lowerYArray, out presIndex) && AttpsrHelper.GetYValueOfCurve(xlowerArray, lowerYArray, LowerLiquidLimit.Value).HasValue)
				{
					result = PackingCloseToLimitMessage.MinPressrueDrop;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		{
			if (!(obj is BubbleCap bubbleCap))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = Diameter.Equals(bubbleCap.Diameter);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= SkirtHeight.Equals(bubbleCap.SkirtHeight);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;

			flag &= Spacing.Equals(bubbleCap.Spacing);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Equals(bubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= NumberOfCaps.Equals(bubbleCap.NumberOfCaps);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			return flag & CapsDensityNumberSpec.Equals(bubbleCap.CapsDensityNumberSpec);
		}

		public CARealVariable CustomValveLift => _CustomValveLift;

		public CARealVariable OpenAreaRatio => _OpenAreaRatio;

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CustomTrayLayout customTrayLayout))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = TrayOpenType.Equals(customTrayLayout.TrayOpenType);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= ActiveAreaRatio.Equals(customTrayLayout.ActiveAreaRatio);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= HasDC.Equals(customTrayLayout.HasDC);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= TotalWeirLength.Equals(customTrayLayout.TotalWeirLength);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= TotalDCHeight.Equals(customTrayLayout.TotalDCHeight);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= DCAreaRatio.Equals(customTrayLayout.DCAreaRatio);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= LiqExitAreaRatio.Equals(customTrayLayout.LiqExitAreaRatio);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= ClearLiqHeight.Equals(customTrayLayout.ClearLiqHeight);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= ConstantBeforeLiqReynoldsNumber.Equals(customTrayLayout.ConstantBeforeLiqReynoldsNumber);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= PowerOfLiqReynoldsNumber.Equals(customTrayLayout.PowerOfLiqReynoldsNumber);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= CustomValveNumbers.Equals(customTrayLayout.CustomValveNumbers);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= CustomValveThickness.Equals(customTrayLayout.CustomValveThickness);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= CustomValveMaterial.Equals(customTrayLayout.CustomValveMaterial);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			flag &= CustomValveLift.Equals(customTrayLayout.CustomValveLift);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			return flag & OpenAreaRatio.Equals(customTrayLayout.OpenAreaRatio);
		}

		public string CheckRequiredData()
		{
			if (HasDC.Value == 1 && TotalWeirLength.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "CustomTrayLayout TotalWeirLength";
			}
			if (HasDC.Value == 0 && ClearLiqHeight.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "CustomTrayLayout ClearLiqHeight";
			}
			if (TrayOpenType.Value > 0 && CustomValveNumbers.IsEmpty())
			{
				return "CustomTrayLayout CustomValveNumbers";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		{
			InitFromInput(stageData);
		}

		private void InitFromInput(CAStage stageData)
		{
			_MassLiquidRate = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass);
			_VolumetricLiquidRate = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateVol);
			_MassVaporRate = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMass);
			_VolumetricVaporRate = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateVol);
			_MassLiquidRate.Value = stageData.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
			_VolumetricLiquidRate.Value = stageData.VolumeFlowLiquid.Value;
			_MassVaporRate.Value = stageData.MassFlowVapor.Value;
			_VolumetricVaporRate.Value = stageData.VolumeFlowVapor.Value;
			TemperatureLiquid.Value = stageData.TemperatureLiquid.Value;
			TemperatureVapor.Value = stageData.TemperatureVapor.Value;
			ViscosityLiquid.Value = stageData.ViscosityLiquid.Value;
			ViscosityVapor.Value = stageData.ViscosityVapor.Value;
			DensityLiquid.Value = stageData.DensityLiquid.Value;
			DensityVapor.Value = stageData.DensityVapor.Value;
			SurfaceTension.Value = stageData.SurfaceTension.Value;
			MoleWeightLiquid.Value = stageData.MoleWeightLiquid.Value;
			MoleWeightVapor.Value = stageData.MoleWeightVapor.Value;
		}
	}

		public TrayHydraulicPerformance()
		{
		}

		public TrayHydraulicPerformance(CAStage stageData)
			: base(stageData)
		{
			_TrayNumber = new CAIntegerVariable();
			_MassRatePerUnitColumnArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.FlowRateMassPerArea);
			_VolumeRatePerUnitColumnArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.DownComerLoad);
			_FsBasedOnNetArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Fs);
			_FsBasedOnBubblingArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Fs);
			_FsBasedOnCrossArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Fs);
			_CsBasedOnNetArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_CsBasedOnBubblingArea = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_FlowParameter = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_ApproachToJetFlood = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_DryPressureDrop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDrop);
			_TotalPressureDrop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDrop);
			_TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			_DryPressureDrop_HeadLoss = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			_DowncomerFrothDensity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_TrayLiquidFrothDensity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_DowncomerBackup = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			_UnaeratedDowncomerBackup = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			_UnaeratedHeightOverWeir = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			_UnaeratedFractionalBackup = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_FractionalDowncomerBackup = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_SideDCExitVelocity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_CenterDCExitVelocity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_OffCenterDCExitVelocity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_ApproachToSystemLimit = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_HeightOverTheWeir = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Length);
			_SideDCVolume = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Volume);
			_SideDCResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_CenterDCVolume = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Volume);
			_CenterDCResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_OffCenterDCVolume = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Volume);
			_OffCenterDCResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_SideDCVelocityTop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_SideDCVelocityBottom = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_CenterDCVelocityTop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_CenterDCVelocityBottom = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_OffCenterDCVelocityTop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_OffCenterDCVelocityBottom = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_SideDCApparentResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_CenterDCApparentResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_OffCenterDCApparentResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_SideWeirLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.WeirLoad);
			_CenterWeirLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.WeirLoad);
			OffCenterInsideWeirLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.WeirLoad);
			_OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.WeirLoad);
			_SideDowncomerLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.DownComerLoad);
			_CenterDowncomerLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.DownComerLoad);
			OffCenterDowncomerLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.DownComerLoad);
			_SideDowncomerChokeFlood = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_CenterDowncomerChokeFlood = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_OffcenterDowncomerChokeFlood = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.None);
			_MDLongestDCExitVelocity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_MDMedianDCExitVelocity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_MDShortestDCExitVelocity = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);

			_MDMedianDCVolume = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Volume);
			_MDShortestDCVolume = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Volume);
			_MDLongestDCResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_MDMedianDCResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_MDShortestDCResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_MDLongestDCApparentResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_MDMedianDCApparentResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_MDShortestDCApparentResidenceTime = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Time);
			_MDLongestDCVelocityTop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);
			_MDMedianDCVelocityTop = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.Velocity);

			_AverageDCLoading = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.DownComerLoad);

		public void InitTrayHydraulicPerformanceData(List<double> summaryInfo, TrayPressureDropUnit trayPDType, CATraySectionData curSection)
		{
			double value = curSection.SectionEfficiency.Value;
			SetValue(MassRatePerUnitColumnArea, summaryInfo[2]);
			SetValue(VolumeRatePerUnitColumnArea, summaryInfo[3]);
			SetValue(FsBasedOnNetArea, summaryInfo[6]);
			SetValue(FsBasedOnBubblingArea, summaryInfo[7]);
			SetValue(FsBasedOnCrossArea, summaryInfo[6] * summaryInfo[89] / summaryInfo[87]);
			SetValue(CsBasedOnNetArea, summaryInfo[9]);
			SetValue(CsBasedOnBubblingArea, summaryInfo[8]);
			SetValue(ApproachToJetFlood, summaryInfo[64]);
			SetValue(DryPressureDrop_HeadLoss, summaryInfo[65] / value);
			SetValue(TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss, summaryInfo[66] / value);
			SetValue(DryPressureDrop, summaryInfo[99] / value);
			SetValue(TotalPressureDrop, summaryInfo[100] / value);
			SetValue(DowncomerFrothDensity, summaryInfo[94]);
			SetValue(TrayLiquidFrothDensity, summaryInfo[101]);
			SetValue(DowncomerBackup, summaryInfo[67]);
			SetValue(FractionalDowncomerBackup, summaryInfo[68]);
			SetValue(HeightOverTheWeir, summaryInfo[73]);
			if (!DowncomerFrothDensity.IsEmpty() && !DowncomerBackup.IsEmpty())
			{
				SetValue(UnaeratedDowncomerBackup, DowncomerBackup.Value * DowncomerFrothDensity.Value);
			}
			if (!DowncomerFrothDensity.IsEmpty() && !FractionalDowncomerBackup.IsEmpty())
			{
				SetValue(UnaeratedFractionalBackup, FractionalDowncomerBackup.Value * DowncomerFrothDensity.Value);
			}
			if (!TrayLiquidFrothDensity.IsEmpty() && !HeightOverTheWeir.IsEmpty())
			{
				SetValue(UnaeratedHeightOverWeir, HeightOverTheWeir.Value * TrayLiquidFrothDensity.Value);
			}
			SetValue(ApproachToSystemLimit, summaryInfo[72]);
			if (curSection.IsMDTray == true)
			{
				IsMDTray = true;
				IsCustomTray = false;
				SetValue(MDLongestDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[69]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[70]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[71]);
				SetValue(MDLongestDCVolume, summaryInfo[74]);
				SetValue(MDLongestDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[75]);
				SetValue(MDLongestDCApparentResidenceTime, summaryInfo[116]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCVolume, summaryInfo[76]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[77]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCApparentResidenceTime, summaryInfo[115]);
				SetValue(AverageDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[77]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCVolume, summaryInfo[78]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[79]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCApparentResidenceTime, summaryInfo[114]);
				SetValue(MDLongestDCVelocityTop, summaryInfo[80]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCVelocityTop, summaryInfo[82]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCVelocityTop, summaryInfo[84]);
				SetValue(MDLongestDCLoading, summaryInfo[80]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCLoading, summaryInfo[82]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCLoading, summaryInfo[84]);
				SetValue(MDAveragedWeirLoading, summaryInfo[95]);
				SetValue(MDLongestDCChokeFlood, summaryInfo[107]);
				SetValue(MDMedianDCChokeFlood, summaryInfo[108]);
				SetValue(MDShortestDCChokeFlood, summaryInfo[109]);
				return;
			}
			if (curSection.IsCustomTray == true)
			{
				IsCustomTray = true;
				IsMDTray = false;
				if (summaryInfo[69] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(AverageDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[69]);
				}
				if (summaryInfo[74] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(TotalDCVolume, summaryInfo[74]);
				}
				if (summaryInfo[75] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(AverageDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[75]);
				}
				if (summaryInfo[80] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(AverageDCVelocity, summaryInfo[80]);
				}
				if (summaryInfo[80] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(AverageDCLoading, summaryInfo[80]);
				}
				if (summaryInfo[95] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(AverageWeirLoading, summaryInfo[95]);
				}
				if (summaryInfo[107] < 1E+35)
				{
					SetValue(AverageDCChokeFlood, summaryInfo[107]);
				}
				return;
			}
			IsMDTray = false;
			IsCustomTray = false;
			SetValue(SideDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[69]);
			SetValue(CenterDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[70]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDCExitVelocity, summaryInfo[71]);
			SetValue(SideDCVolume, summaryInfo[74]);
			SetValue(SideDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[75]);
			SetValue(CenterDCVolume, summaryInfo[76]);
			SetValue(CenterDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[77]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDCVolume, summaryInfo[78]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDCResidenceTime, summaryInfo[79]);
			SetValue(SideDCVelocityTop, summaryInfo[80]);
			SetValue(SideDCVelocityBottom, summaryInfo[81]);
			SetValue(CenterDCVelocityTop, summaryInfo[82]);
			SetValue(CenterDCVelocityBottom, summaryInfo[83]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDCVelocityTop, summaryInfo[84]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDCVelocityBottom, summaryInfo[85]);
			double num = summaryInfo[75];
			if (summaryInfo[77] > 0.0 && summaryInfo[77] < 1E+35 && (summaryInfo[79] <= 0.0 || summaryInfo[79] >= 1E+35))
			{
				num = 0.5 * (summaryInfo[77] + num);
			}
			else if (summaryInfo[79] > 0.0 && summaryInfo[79] < 1E+35 && (summaryInfo[77] <= 0.0 || summaryInfo[77] >= 1E+35))
			{
				num = 0.5 * (summaryInfo[79] + num);
			}
			else if (summaryInfo[77] > 0.0 && summaryInfo[77] < 1E+35 && summaryInfo[79] > 0.0 && summaryInfo[79] < 1E+35)
			{
				num = (summaryInfo[77] + summaryInfo[79] + num) / 3.0;
			}
			SetValue(AverageDCResidenceTime, num);
			SetValue(_SideDowncomerLoading, summaryInfo[80]);
			SetValue(_CenterDowncomerLoading, summaryInfo[82]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDowncomerLoading, summaryInfo[84]);
			SetValue(_SideWeirLoading, summaryInfo[95]);
			SetValue(_CenterWeirLoading, summaryInfo[96]);
			SetValue(OffCenterInsideWeirLoading, summaryInfo[97]);
			SetValue(_OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading, summaryInfo[98]);
			SetValue(SideDowncomerChokeFlood, summaryInfo[107]);
			SetValue(CenterDowncomerChokeFlood, summaryInfo[108]);
			SetValue(OffcenterDowncomerChokeFlood, summaryInfo[109]);
			SetValue(SideDCApparentResidenceTime, summaryInfo[114]);
			SetValue(CenterDCApparentResidenceTime, summaryInfo[115]);
			SetValue(OffCenterDCApparentResidenceTime, summaryInfo[116]);
		}

		private void SetValue(CARealVariable var, double dVal)
		{
			if (!dVal.ToString().EndsWith("E+35") && dVal > 0.0)
			{
				var.Value = dVal;
			}
			else
			{
				var.Value = double.NaN;
			}
		}
	}

		public TraySectionResultData()
