		}

		public TraySectionResultData(CATraySectionData inputSectionData)
			: base(inputSectionData)
		{
			_Downcomers[0] = new CADCSideResultData();
			_Downcomers[1] = new CADCCenterResultData();
			_Downcomers[2] = new CADCOffCenterResultData();
			_MD_Downcomers[0] = new CAMDDowncomerResultData();
			_MD_Downcomers[1] = new CAMDDowncomerResultData();
			_MD_Downcomers[2] = new CAMDDowncomerResultData();
			for (int i = 0; i < _Weirs.Length; i++)
			{
				_Weirs[i] = new CAWeirResultData();
			}
			MaxDowncomerBackupLimit.Value = inputSectionData.MaxDowncomerBackup.Value;
			_MaxPercentJetFloodLimit.Value = inputSectionData.MaxPercentJetFlood.Value;
			_PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value = inputSectionData.PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value;
			_NumberofPasses.Value = inputSectionData.NumberofPasses.Value;
			_WeirLoadMinimum.Value = inputSectionData.WeirLoadMinimum.Value;
			_WeirLoadMaximum.Value = inputSectionData.WeirLoadMaximum.Value;
			_WarningStatusLimit = inputSectionData.WarningStatusLimit;
			_MaximumFractionalEntrainmentLimit.Value = inputSectionData.MaximumFractionalEntrainment.Value;
			_MaximumPressureDropLimit.Value = inputSectionData.MaximumPressureDrop.Value;
			_TraySpacing.Value = inputSectionData.TraySpacing.Value;
			_SectionEfficiency.Value = inputSectionData.SectionEfficiency.Value;
			_TrayPDType = (TrayPressureDropUnit)inputSectionData.TrayPressureDropType.Value;
			_InternalType = inputSectionData.GetInternalType();
			_CombinedTrayInternalType = inputSectionData.GetCombinedInternalType();
			InitDiagramSectionData(inputSectionData.Container, inputSectionData.LUnitIndex.Value, inputSectionData.VUnitIndex.Value);
			if (inputSectionData.IsCompleteStatus.HasValue && inputSectionData.IsCompleteStatus.HasValue && !inputSectionData.IsCompleteStatus == true)
			{
				SetInput(inputSectionData);
			}
		}

		private void SetInput(CATraySectionData inputSectionData)
		{
			Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
			Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value;
			(Downcomers[0] as CADCSideResultData).WeirHeight.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[0].Height.Value;
			(Downcomers[0] as CADCSideResultData).WeirLength.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[0].Width.Value;
			Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
			Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value;
			(Downcomers[1] as CADCCenterResultData).WeirHeight.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[1].Height.Value;
			(Downcomers[1] as CADCCenterResultData).WeirLength.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[1].Width.Value;
			Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
			Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value = inputSectionData.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value;
			(Downcomers[2] as CADCOffCenterResultData).WeirHeightInSide.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[2].Height.Value;
			(Downcomers[2] as CADCOffCenterResultData).InsideWeirLength.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[2].Width.Value;
			(Downcomers[2] as CADCOffCenterResultData).WeirHeightOutdide.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[3].Height.Value;
			(Downcomers[2] as CADCOffCenterResultData).OutsideWeirLength.Value = inputSectionData.Weirs[3].Width.Value;
			base.Diameter.Value = inputSectionData.Diameter.Value;
			TraySpacing.Value = inputSectionData.TraySpacing.Value;
		}

		private void InitDiagramSectionData(IUnityContainer container, int LUnitIndex, int VUnitIndex)
		{
			_DiagramSectionData = new DiagramSectionData();
			LiquidBasisEnum liquidBasis = (LiquidBasisEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(LiquidBasisEnum), LUnitIndex);
			VapordBasisEnum vapordBasis = (VapordBasisEnum)Enum.ToObject(typeof(VapordBasisEnum), VUnitIndex);
			QuantityTypeEnum liquidBasis2 = VariableHelper.GetLiquidBasis(liquidBasis);
			QuantityTypeEnum vaporBasis = VariableHelper.GetVaporBasis(vapordBasis);
			if (container != null)
			{
				ISimulatorCADataProvider simulatorCADataProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<ISimulatorCADataProvider>(container, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				_DiagramSectionData.LiquidUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(liquidBasis2);
				_DiagramSectionData.VaporUnit = simulatorCADataProvider.GetSIUnit(vaporBasis);
			}
		}

		public XmlDocument GetXmlDocument()
		{
			return CADataHelper.SerializeToXml(this);
		}

		internal void AnalyzeSummaryData()
		{
			AnalyzeMaxDCLoading();
			AnalyzeMaxDCChoke();
			AnalyzeMaxWeirLoading();
			AnalyzeMaxAeratedHeightOverWeir();
			AnalyzeMaxApproachToSystemLimit();
			AnalyzeMaxCsBasedOnActiveArea();
			SetWeirLoadings();
		}

		private int FindTrayNumberWidthMaxDCBackup()
		{
			int result = base.StartStageNumber.Value;
			if (HydraulicResults != null && HydraulicResults.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in HydraulicResults)
				{
					if (hydraulicResult.Value.DowncomerBackup.Value > num)
					{
						num = hydraulicResult.Value.DowncomerBackup.Value;
						result = hydraulicResult.Key;
					}
				}
				_MaxrWidthMaxDCBackup.Value = num;
				num = 0.0;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult2 in HydraulicResults)
				{
					if (hydraulicResult2.Value.FractionalDowncomerBackup.Value > num)
					{
						num = hydraulicResult2.Value.FractionalDowncomerBackup.Value;
					}
				}
				_MaximumPercentDCBackup.Value = num;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetSectionTotalHeight()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.EndtStageNumber.Value >= base.StartStageNumber.Value)
			{
				num = _TraySpacing.Value * (double)(base.EndtStageNumber.Value - base.StartStageNumber.Value + 1);
				if (_SectionEfficiency.Value > 0.0 && _SectionEfficiency.Value <= 1.0)
				{
					num /= _SectionEfficiency.Value;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void SetSectionTotalPressureDrop()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (HydraulicResults != null && HydraulicResults.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in HydraulicResults)
				{
					num += hydraulicResult.Value.TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value;
				}
				_TotalPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value = num;
			}
			num = 0.0;
			if (HydraulicResults == null || HydraulicResults.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult2 in HydraulicResults)
			{
				num += hydraulicResult2.Value.TotalPressureDrop.Value;
			}
			_SectionTotalPressureDrop.Value = num;
		}

		private void SetSectionResidenceTime()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (HydraulicResults == null || HydraulicResults.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in HydraulicResults)
			{
				if (hydraulicResult.Value.AverageDCResidenceTime.Value < 1E+35)
				{
					num += hydraulicResult.Value.AverageDCResidenceTime.Value;
				}
			}
			if (num > 0.0 && num < 1E+35)
			{
				_SectionResidenceTime.Value = num;
			}
		}

		private void AnalyzeMaxWeirLoading()
		{
			if (IsMDTray)
			{
				AnalyzeMaxMDWeirLoading();
				return;
			}
			if (IsCustomTray)
			{
				AnalyzeMaxCustomWeirLoading();
				return;
			}
			int value = base.StartStageNumber.Value;
			int value2 = base.StartStageNumber.Value;
			int value3 = base.StartStageNumber.Value;
			int value4 = base.StartStageNumber.Value;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (HydraulicResults != null && HydraulicResults.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, TrayHydraulicPerformance> hydraulicResult in HydraulicResults)
				{
					double num5 = 0.0;
					if (!hydraulicResult.Value.SideWeirLoading.IsEmpty() && hydraulicResult.Value.SideWeirLoading.Value > 0.0)
					{
						num5 = hydraulicResult.Value.SideWeirLoading.Value;
					}
					if (num5 > num)
					{
						value = hydraulicResult.Key;
						num = num5;
					}
					if (NumberofPasses.Value == 2 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
					{
						double num6 = 0.0;
						if (!hydraulicResult.Value.CenterWeirLoading.IsEmpty() && hydraulicResult.Value.CenterWeirLoading.Value > 0.0)
						{
							num6 = hydraulicResult.Value.CenterWeirLoading.Value;
						}
						if (num6 > num2)
						{
							value2 = hydraulicResult.Key;
							num2 = num6;
						}
					}
					if (NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
					{
						double num7 = 0.0;
						if (!hydraulicResult.Value.OffCenterInsideWeirLoading.IsEmpty() && hydraulicResult.Value.OffCenterInsideWeirLoading.Value > 0.0)
						{
							num7 = hydraulicResult.Value.OffCenterInsideWeirLoading.Value;
						}
						if (num7 > num3)
						{
							value3 = hydraulicResult.Key;
							num3 = num7;
						}
					}
					if (NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
					{
						double num8 = 0.0;
						if (!hydraulicResult.Value.OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading.IsEmpty() && hydraulicResult.Value.OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading.Value > 0.0)
						{
							num8 = hydraulicResult.Value.OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading.Value;
						}
						if (num8 > num4)
						{
							value4 = hydraulicResult.Key;
							num4 = num8;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num > num2 && num > num3 && num > num4)
			{
				TrayNumberWithMaxWeirLoading.Value = value;
				WeirLocationWithMaxeWeirLoading = WeirLocation.Side;
			}
			else if (num2 > num && num2 > num3 && num2 > num4)
			{
				TrayNumberWithMaxWeirLoading.Value = value2;
				WeirLocationWithMaxeWeirLoading = WeirLocation.Center;
			}
			else if (num3 > num && num3 > num2 && num3 > num4)
			{
				TrayNumberWithMaxWeirLoading.Value = value3;
				WeirLocationWithMaxeWeirLoading = WeirLocation.OffCenterInside;
			}
			else
			{
				TrayNumberWithMaxWeirLoading.Value = value4;
				WeirLocationWithMaxeWeirLoading = WeirLocation.OffCenterOutside;
			}
			TrayNumberWithMaxSideWeirLoading.Value = value;
			MaxSideWeirLoading.Value = num;
		}

		private bool? IsDCLoadingBalanced()
		{
			if (NumberofPasses.Value == 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool value = false;
			double val = Downcomers[0].AreaTop.Value * 2.0;
			double value2 = Downcomers[1].AreaTop.Value;
			double value3 = Downcomers[2].AreaTop.Value;
			double val2 = Downcomers[0].AreaBottom.Value * 2.0;
			double value4 = Downcomers[1].AreaBottom.Value;
			double value5 = Downcomers[2].AreaBottom.Value;
			double tolerance = 0.001;
			if (NumberofPasses.Value == 3)
			{
				value = VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val, value3, tolerance) && VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val2, value5, tolerance);
			}
			else if (NumberofPasses.Value == 2)
			{
				value = VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val, value2, tolerance) && VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val2, value4, tolerance);
			}
			else if (NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
			{
				value = VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val, value3, tolerance) && VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val, value2, tolerance) && VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val2, value5, tolerance) && VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(val2, value4, tolerance);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal void AnalyzeWeeping(int columnStartStage, int columnEndStage, bool isTopDown)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (DiagramTray tray in DiagramSectionData.Trays)
			{
				if (tray.ReturnData.Messages != null && tray.ReturnData.Messages[36] == 1)
				{
					list.Add(tray.StageNumber);
				}
			}
			StagesWithWeeping = GetTrayNumberString(list, columnStartStage, columnEndStage, isTopDown);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				IsWeepingDetected = true;
			}
		}

		public int GetDisplayStageNumber(int stageNumber, int columnStartStage, int columnEndStage, bool isTopDown)
		{
			if (isTopDown)
			{
				return stageNumber;
			}
			return columnStartStage + columnEndStage - stageNumber;
		}

		private string GetTrayNumberString(List<int> StageNumbers, int columnStartStage, int columnEndStage, bool isTopDown)
		{
			if (StageNumbers == null || StageNumbers.Count == 0)
			{
				return strNone;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (int StageNumber in StageNumbers)
			{
				int displayStageNumber = GetDisplayStageNumber(StageNumber, columnStartStage, columnEndStage, isTopDown);
				list.Add(displayStageNumber);
			}
			list.Sort();
			List<List<int>> list2 = new List<List<int>>();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			do
			{
				List<int> list3 = new List<int>();
				list2.Add(list3);
				for (int i = num; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (num == i)
					{
						list3.Add(list[i]);
						num2++;
						continue;
					}
					if (list[i] - list[i - 1] == 1)
					{
						list3.Add(list[i]);
						num2++;
						continue;
					}
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			while (num2 != list.Count);
			for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
			{
				List<int> list4 = list2[j];
				if (j > 0 && list4.Count > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text = ((list4.Count != 1) ? ((list4.Count != 2) ? (text + list4[0] + " - " + list4[list4.Count - 1]) : (text + list4[0] + ", " + list4[1])) : (text + list4[0]));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = strNone;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void SetWeirLoadings()
		{
			int value = TrayNumberWithMaxWeirLoading.Value;
			if (HydraulicResults.ContainsKey(value))
			{
				((CADCSideResultData)Downcomers[0]).WeirLoading.Value = HydraulicResults[value].SideWeirLoading.Value;
				((CADCCenterResultData)Downcomers[1]).WeirLoading.Value = HydraulicResults[value].CenterWeirLoading.Value;
				((CADCOffCenterResultData)Downcomers[2]).OffCenterInsideWeirLoading.Value = HydraulicResults[value].OffCenterInsideWeirLoading.Value;
				((CADCOffCenterResultData)Downcomers[2]).OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading.Value = HydraulicResults[value].OffCenterOutsideWeirLoading.Value;
			}
		}
	}

	public class XmlDictionary : Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>, IXmlSerializable
	{
		public XmlSchema GetSchema()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void ReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			reader.Read();
			while (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
			{
				string name = reader.Name;
				base[name] = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				if (!reader.IsEmptyElement)
				{
					reader.ReadStartElement();
					while (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
					{
						base[name][reader.Name] = reader.ReadElementString();
					}
				}
				reader.Read();
			}
		}

		public void WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			foreach (string key in base.Keys)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(key);
				foreach (string key2 in base[key].Keys)
				{
					writer.WriteElementString(key2, base[key][key2]);
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}
	}
	public class XmlDictionaryIntDouble : Dictionary<int, double>, IXmlSerializable
	{
		public XmlSchema GetSchema()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void ReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!reader.IsEmptyElement)
			{
				reader.Read();
				while (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
				{
					int key = int.Parse(reader.Name);
					base[key] = reader.ReadElementContentAsDouble();
					reader.Read();
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			foreach (int key in base.Keys)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement(key.ToString());
				writer.WriteValue(base[key]);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}
	}
	[XmlRoot("XmlSerializableDictionary")]
	public class XmlSerializableDictionary<TKey, TValue> : Dictionary<TKey, TValue>, IXmlSerializable
	{
		public XmlSerializableDictionary()
		{
		}

		public XmlSerializableDictionary(IDictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary)
			: base(dictionary)
		{
		}

		public XmlSerializableDictionary(IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
			: base(comparer)
		{
		}

		public XmlSerializableDictionary(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		public XmlSerializableDictionary(int capacity, IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
			: base(capacity, comparer)
		{
		}

		protected XmlSerializableDictionary(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
		}

		public XmlSchema GetSchema()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public void ReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(TKey));
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer2 = new XmlSerializer(typeof(TValue));
			bool isEmptyElement = reader.IsEmptyElement;
			reader.Read();
			if (!isEmptyElement)
			{
				while (reader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement)
				{
					reader.ReadStartElement("item");
					reader.ReadStartElement("key");
					TKey key = (TKey)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(reader);
					reader.ReadEndElement();
					reader.ReadStartElement("value");
					TValue value = (TValue)xmlSerializer2.Deserialize(reader);
					reader.ReadEndElement();
					Add(key, value);
					reader.ReadEndElement();
					reader.MoveToContent();
				}
				reader.ReadEndElement();
			}
		}

		public void WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new XmlSerializer(typeof(TKey));
			XmlSerializer xmlSerializer2 = new XmlSerializer(typeof(TValue));
			foreach (TKey key in base.Keys)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("item");
				writer.WriteStartElement("key");
				xmlSerializer.Serialize(writer, key);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteStartElement("value");
				TValue val = base[key];
				xmlSerializer2.Serialize(writer, val);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}
	}

		public string FindLabelString(OrigialLineName originalLine)
		{
			if (!trayLabelStringDictionary.TryGetValue(originalLine, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("trayLabelStringDictionary", "The value is out of range");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color FindLineColor(OrigialLineName originalLine)
		{
			if (!trayLineColorDictionary.TryGetValue(originalLine, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("trayLineColorDictionary", "The value is out of range");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public string FindPackingLabelString(PackingLineType Linetype)
		{
			if (!packingLabelStringDictionary.TryGetValue(Linetype, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("packingLabelStringDictionary", "The value is out of range");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color FindPackingLineColor(PackingLineType Linetype)
		{
			if (!packingLineColorDictionary.TryGetValue(Linetype, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("packingLineColorDictionary", "The value is out of range");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public LineStyle GetPackingLineStyle(PackingLineType Linetype)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!packingLineStyle.TryGetValue(Linetype, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("packingLineStyle", "The value is out of range");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public LineStyle GetTrayLineStyle(OrigialLineName Linetype)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!trayLineStyle.TryGetValue(Linetype, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("originalLine", "The value is out of range");
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void ResetLabel(string percentMaxDCBackup, string percentJetFlood)
		{
			trayLabelStringDictionary[OrigialLineName.Dcb] = percentMaxDCBackup + Resources.HyPlotLabel_TrayDcb;
			trayLabelStringDictionary[OrigialLineName.JetFlood] = percentJetFlood + Resources.HyPlotLabel_TrayJetFlood;
		}
	}

	public class AttpsrHelper
	{
		public class AnalyzedLine
		{
			public bool IsBelow { get; set; }

			public List<PairDouble> Line { get; set; }

			public void Add(PairDouble point)
			{
				if (Line == null)
				{
					Line = new List<PairDouble>();
				}
				Line.Add(point);
			}

			public AnalyzedLine Clone()
			{
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine.IsBelow = IsBelow;
				if (Line != null)
				{
					analyzedLine.Line = new List<PairDouble>();
					foreach (PairDouble item in Line)
					{
						analyzedLine.Line.Add(new PairDouble(item.x, item.y));
					}
				}
				return analyzedLine;
			}

			public AnalyzedLine()
			{
				Line = new List<PairDouble>();
			}
		}

		public enum LinesRelation
		{
			Upper,
			Below
		}

		internal static void ExportDefaultInput(string filename, CADebugDefaultInputData cAAttpsrPlogDebugData)
		{

				string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
				text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
				CADataHelper.ExportDataToXml(CADebugSetting.TodefaultInputPath + "\\" + filename + text + ".xml", cAAttpsrPlogDebugData);
			}
		}

				traySectionResultData = cADebugPlotOutputData.TraySectionResultDataResult;

		public static double FoundRangeList(List<double> soure, bool toFindMax)
		{
			if (soure == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return FoundRangeList(soure, 0, soure.Count - 1, toFindMax);
		}

		public static double FoundRangeList(List<double> soure, int startIndex, int endIndex, bool toFindMax)
		{
			if (soure == null || soure.Count == 0 || soure.Count < endIndex || soure.Count < startIndex)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (endIndex == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				endIndex = soure.Count - 1;
			}
			double num = soure[startIndex];
			num = ((!toFindMax) ? soure.GetRange(startIndex, endIndex - startIndex + 1).Min() : soure.GetRange(startIndex, endIndex - startIndex + 1).Max());
			if (num > 1E+20)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static List<PairDouble> GetIntersectionPoint(List<PairDouble> lineSourceOriginal, List<PairDouble> lineRef, out List<int> intersectionPointIndex, out List<AnalyzedLine> lineSourceCutted, out List<AnalyzedLine> lineRefCutted)
		{
			intersectionPointIndex = new List<int>();
			lineSourceCutted = new List<AnalyzedLine>();
			lineRefCutted = new List<AnalyzedLine>();
			if (lineSourceOriginal == null || lineSourceOriginal.Count < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PairDouble> list = new List<PairDouble>();
			lineSourceOriginal.Sort(delegate(PairDouble var1, PairDouble var2)
			{
				if (var1.x < var2.x)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (var1.x != var2.x) ? 1 : 0;
			});
			double x = lineSourceOriginal[0].x;
			list.Add(lineSourceOriginal[0]);
			for (int num = 1; num < lineSourceOriginal.Count; num++)
			{
				if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(lineSourceOriginal[num].x, x))
				{
					list.Add(lineSourceOriginal[num]);
					x = lineSourceOriginal[num].x;
				}
			}
			if (list == null || list.Count < 2 || lineRef == null || lineRef.Count < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			List<PairDouble> list3 = new List<PairDouble>();
			bool item = true;
			List<bool> list4 = new List<bool>();
			for (int num2 = 1; num2 < list.Count; num2++)
			{
				int index;
				PairDouble pairDouble = GetNerestXValue(list[num2 - 1].x, lineRef, out index);
				int index2;
				PairDouble pairDouble2 = GetNerestXValue(list[num2].x, lineRef, out index2);
				while (VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(pairDouble.x, pairDouble2.x))
				{
					if (index2 < lineRef.Count - 2)
					{
						index2++;
						pairDouble2 = lineRef[index2];
					}
					else if (index > 0)
					{
						index--;
						pairDouble = lineRef[index];
					}
					if (index2 > lineRef.Count || index == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				item = GetInsertPoint(pairDouble, pairDouble2, list[num2 - 1].x).y > list[num2 - 1].y;
				PairDouble intersectionPoint = GetIntersectionPoint(list[num2 - 1], list[num2], pairDouble, pairDouble2);
				if (intersectionPoint != null)
				{
					list3.Add(intersectionPoint);
					list4.Add(item);
					if (!intersectionPointIndex.Contains(num2 - 1))
					{
						intersectionPointIndex.Add(num2 - 1);
					}
					if (!list2.Contains(index))
					{
						list2.Add(index);
					}
				}
			}
			list4.Add(item);
			if (intersectionPointIndex.Count == 0)
			{
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine.IsBelow = list4[0];
				analyzedLine.Line.AddRange(list.GetRange(0, list.Count));
				lineSourceCutted.Add(analyzedLine);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine2 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine2.IsBelow = !list4[0];
				analyzedLine2.Line.AddRange(lineRef.GetRange(0, lineRef.Count));
				lineRefCutted.Add(analyzedLine2);
			}
			else if (intersectionPointIndex.Count == 1)
			{
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine3 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine3.IsBelow = list4[0];
				analyzedLine3.Line.AddRange(list.GetRange(0, intersectionPointIndex[0]));
				analyzedLine3.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				lineSourceCutted.Add(analyzedLine3);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine4 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine4.IsBelow = !list4[0];
				analyzedLine4.Line.AddRange(lineRef.GetRange(0, list2[0] + 1));
				analyzedLine4.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				lineRefCutted.Add(analyzedLine4);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine5 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine5.IsBelow = list4[1];
				analyzedLine5.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				if (intersectionPointIndex[0] <= list.Count - 2)
				{
					analyzedLine5.Line.AddRange(list.GetRange(intersectionPointIndex[0] + 1, list.Count - intersectionPointIndex[0] - 1));
				}
				lineSourceCutted.Add(analyzedLine5);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine6 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine6.IsBelow = !list4[1];
				analyzedLine6.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				if (intersectionPointIndex[0] <= lineRef.Count - 2)
				{
					analyzedLine6.Line.AddRange(lineRef.GetRange(list2[0] + 1, lineRef.Count - list2[0] - 1));
				}
				lineRefCutted.Add(analyzedLine6);
			}
			else if (intersectionPointIndex.Count == 2)
			{
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine7 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine7.IsBelow = list4[0];
				analyzedLine7.Line.AddRange(list.GetRange(0, intersectionPointIndex[0]));
				analyzedLine7.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				lineSourceCutted.Add(analyzedLine7);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine8 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine8.IsBelow = !list4[0];
				analyzedLine8.Line.AddRange(lineRef.GetRange(0, list2[0] + 1));
				analyzedLine8.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				lineRefCutted.Add(analyzedLine8);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine9 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine9.IsBelow = list4[1];
				analyzedLine9.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				if (intersectionPointIndex[0] <= list.Count - 2 && intersectionPointIndex.Count > 1)
				{
					analyzedLine9.Line.AddRange(list.GetRange(intersectionPointIndex[0] + 1, intersectionPointIndex[1] - intersectionPointIndex[0] - 1));
				}
				analyzedLine9.Line.Add(list3[1]);
				lineSourceCutted.Add(analyzedLine9);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine10 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine10.IsBelow = !list4[1];
				analyzedLine10.Line.Add(list3[0]);
				if (intersectionPointIndex[0] <= lineRef.Count - 2 && list2.Count > 1)
				{
					analyzedLine10.Line.AddRange(lineRef.GetRange(list2[0] + 1, list2[1] - list2[0] - 1));
				}
				analyzedLine10.Line.Add(list3[1]);
				lineRefCutted.Add(analyzedLine10);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine11 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine11.IsBelow = list4[2];
				analyzedLine11.Line.Add(list3[1]);
				if (intersectionPointIndex[1] <= list.Count - 2 && intersectionPointIndex.Count > 1)
				{
					analyzedLine11.Line.AddRange(list.GetRange(intersectionPointIndex[1] + 1, list.Count - intersectionPointIndex[1] - 1));
				}
				lineSourceCutted.Add(analyzedLine11);
				AnalyzedLine analyzedLine12 = new AnalyzedLine();
				analyzedLine12.IsBelow = list[list.Count - 1].y > lineRef[lineRef.Count - 1].y;
				analyzedLine12.Line.Add(list3[1]);
				if (intersectionPointIndex.Count > 1 && intersectionPointIndex[1] <= lineRef.Count - 2 && list2.Count > 1)
				{
					for (int num3 = list2[1] + 1; num3 < lineRef.Count; num3++)
					{
						if (lineRef[num3].x > list3[1].x)
						{
							analyzedLine12.Line.Add(lineRef[num3]);
						}
					}
				}
				lineRefCutted.Add(analyzedLine12);
			}
			return list3;
		}

		public static PairDouble GetNerestXValue(double val, List<PairDouble> lineRef, out int index)
		{
			PairDouble result = null;
			index = 0;
			if (lineRef == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = -1.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (PairDouble item in lineRef)
			{
				double num3 = Math.Abs(val - item.x);
				if (num < 0.0 || num > num3)
				{
					num = num3;
					result = item;
					index = num2;
				}
				num2++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static PairDouble GetInsertPoint(PairDouble lineFirstStart, PairDouble lineFirstEnd, double insertX)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double y = 0.0;
			if (lineFirstStart.y == lineFirstEnd.y)
			{
				return new PairDouble(insertX, lineFirstEnd.y);
			}
			if (lineFirstStart.x != lineFirstEnd.x)
			{
				num = (lineFirstEnd.y - lineFirstStart.y) / (lineFirstEnd.x - lineFirstStart.x);
				y = num * insertX - num * lineFirstStart.x + lineFirstStart.y;
			}
			return new PairDouble(insertX, y);
		}

		public static PairDouble GetIntersectionPoint(PairDouble lineFirstStart, PairDouble lineFirstEnd, PairDouble lineSecondStart, PairDouble lineSecondEnd)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = 0;
			if (lineFirstStart.x != lineFirstEnd.x)
			{
				num = (lineFirstEnd.y - lineFirstStart.y) / (lineFirstEnd.x - lineFirstStart.x);
				num3 |= 1;
			}
			if (lineSecondStart.x != lineSecondEnd.x)
			{
				num2 = (lineSecondEnd.y - lineSecondStart.y) / (lineSecondEnd.x - lineSecondStart.x);
				num3 |= 2;
			}
			switch (num3)
			{
			case 0:
				_ = lineFirstStart.x;
				_ = lineSecondStart.x;
				return null;
			case 1:
			{
				double x = lineSecondStart.x;
				double y = (lineFirstStart.x - x) * (0.0 - num) + lineFirstStart.y;
				return new PairDouble(x, y);
			}
			case 2:
			{
				double x2 = lineFirstStart.x;
				double y2 = (lineSecondStart.x - x2) * (0.0 - num2) + lineSecondStart.y;
				return new PairDouble(x2, y2);
			}
			case 3:
			{
				if (num == num2)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double num4 = (num * lineFirstStart.x - num2 * lineSecondStart.x - lineFirstStart.y + lineSecondStart.y) / (num - num2);
				double num5 = num * num4 - num * lineFirstStart.x + lineFirstStart.y;
				double num6 = ((lineFirstStart.x > lineFirstEnd.x) ? lineFirstEnd.x : lineFirstStart.x);
				double num7 = ((lineFirstStart.x > lineFirstEnd.x) ? lineFirstStart.x : lineFirstEnd.x);
				double num8 = ((lineFirstStart.y > lineFirstEnd.y) ? lineFirstEnd.y : lineFirstStart.y);
				double num9 = ((lineFirstStart.y > lineFirstEnd.y) ? lineFirstStart.y : lineFirstEnd.y);
				if (num4 >= num6 && num4 <= num7 && num5 >= num8 && num5 <= num9)
				{
					return new PairDouble(num4, num5);
				}
				return null;
			}
			default:
				return new PairDouble(0.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		public static double GetAngle(PairDouble point1, PairDouble point2)
		{
			double d = (point2.y - point1.y) / (point2.x - point1.x);
			return 108.0 * Math.Atan(d) / Math.PI;
		}

		public static bool IsValidLine(List<double> xArray, List<double> yArray, PackingLineType linetype, bool checkCount = true)
		{
			return IsValidLine(xArray, yArray, checkCount);
		}

		public static bool IsValidLine(List<double> xArray, List<double> yArray, bool checkCount = true)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (xArray != null)
			{
				foreach (double item in xArray)
				{
					flag = !VariableHelper.IsEmpty(item);
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (item > 0.0 && !flag2)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && yArray != null)
			{
				foreach (double item2 in yArray)
				{
					flag = !VariableHelper.IsEmpty(item2);
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (item2 > 0.0 && !flag2)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (xArray == null || yArray == null || xArray.Count != yArray.Count || (checkCount && xArray.Count < 2))
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		public static double? GetYValueOfCurve(List<double> curveX, List<double> curveY, double xVal)
		{
			double? result = null;
			if (curveX == null || curveX.Count == 0 || curveY == null || curveY.Count == 0 || curveX.Count != curveY.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < curveX.Count; i++)
			{
				if (VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(xVal, curveX[i]))
				{
					num = i;
					num2 = i;
					result = curveY[i];
					break;
				}
				if (CADataHelper.IsALessEqualB(xVal, curveX[i]))
				{
					num2 = i;
					num = ((i <= 0) ? i : (i - 1));
					double num3 = (curveY[num2] - curveY[num]) / (curveX[num2] - curveX[num]);
					double num4 = curveY[num] - num3 * curveX[num];
					result = num3 * xVal + num4;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class AttpsrrPackingWrapper
	{
		internal class HydraulicPoints
		{
			internal IntPtr p_LiqMassFlowRate;

			internal IntPtr p_VapMassFlowRate;

			internal IntPtr p_LiqMassDensity;

			internal IntPtr p_VapMassDensity;

			internal IntPtr p_LiqVolFlowRate;

			internal IntPtr p_VapVolFlowRate;

			internal IntPtr p_QR;

			internal IntPtr p_LiqViscosity;

			internal IntPtr p_VapViscosity;

			internal IntPtr p_SurfaceTension;

			internal IntPtr p_FlowParameter;

			internal IntPtr p_Pressure;

			internal IntPtr p_LiqMW;

			internal IntPtr p_VapMW;

			internal void InitPoints(int totTrays)
			{
				p_LiqMassFlowRate = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_VapMassFlowRate = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_LiqMassDensity = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_VapMassDensity = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_LiqVolFlowRate = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_VapVolFlowRate = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_QR = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_LiqViscosity = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_VapViscosity = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_SurfaceTension = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_FlowParameter = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_Pressure = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_LiqMW = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
				p_VapMW = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * totTrays);
			}

			internal void FreePoints()
			{
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_LiqMassFlowRate);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_VapMassFlowRate);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_LiqMassDensity);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_VapMassDensity);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_LiqVolFlowRate);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_VapVolFlowRate);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_QR);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_LiqViscosity);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_VapViscosity);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_SurfaceTension);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_FlowParameter);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_Pressure);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_LiqMW);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p_VapMW);
				p_LiqMassFlowRate = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_VapMassFlowRate = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_LiqMassDensity = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_VapMassDensity = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_LiqVolFlowRate = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_VapVolFlowRate = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_QR = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_LiqViscosity = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_VapViscosity = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_SurfaceTension = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_FlowParameter = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_Pressure = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_LiqMW = IntPtr.Zero;
				p_VapMW = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

			{
				dest[i] = (IntPtr)source[i];
			}
		}

		public CAPackingData GetPackingDefaut(CAPackingSectionData caPackingSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption colSetting)
		{
			if (caPackingSection == null || columnData == null || colSetting == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CheckPackingRequriedData(caPackingSection))
			{
				return null;
			}
			CAPackingData packingData = null;
			try
			{
				packingData = PackingInfo.GetPackingData(caPackingSection.PackingType, caPackingSection.PackingVendor, caPackingSection.PackingMaterial, caPackingSection.PackingDimension);
				if (packingData == null && caPackingSection.PackingType.EnumString == "USER")
				{
					SetUserCAPAckingData(caPackingSection, out packingData);
				}
				if (columnData != null)
				{
					SetOtherDefautValues(caPackingSection, columnData, packingData, colSetting);
				}
				if (caPackingSection.PackHeightType == PackHeightType.HETP && caPackingSection.HETP.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					packingData.HETP.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				else if (caPackingSection.PackHeightType == PackHeightType.SectionPackHeight && caPackingSection.PackingHeight.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					packingData.PackingHeight.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				else
				{
					packingData.PackingHeight.Value = 1E+35;
					packingData.HETP.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Rating)
				{
					packingData.Diameter.Value = 1E+35;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return packingData;
		}

		private void SetUserCAPAckingData(CAPackingSectionData caPackingSection, out CAPackingData packingData)
		{
			packingData = new CAPackingData(caPackingSection.StichlmairSurfaceArea.Value, caPackingSection.StichlmairVoidFraction.Value, caPackingSection.PackingSize.Value, caPackingSection.PackingFactor.Value, caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_1.Value, caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_2.Value, caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_3.Value, caPackingSection.StichlmairFFmin.Value);
			packingData.Diameter.Value = caPackingSection.Diameter.Value;
			packingData.PackingHeight.Value = caPackingSection.PackingHeight.Value;
			packingData.CapacityFactorFlooding.Value = caPackingSection.CapacityFactorFlooding.Value;
			packingData.SystemFoamingFactor.Value = caPackingSection.SystemFoamingFactor.Value;
			packingData.OverDesignFactor.Value = caPackingSection.OverDesignFactor.Value;
			packingData.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea.Value = caPackingSection.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea.Value;
			packingData.PressureDropAtFlood.Value = caPackingSection.PressureDropAtFlood.Value;
			packingData.MaximumPressureDrop.Value = caPackingSection.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
			packingData.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value = caPackingSection.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
			packingData.NumberOfCurves.Value = caPackingSection.NumberOfCurves.Value;
			packingData.WarningStatusToLimit.Value = caPackingSection.WarningStatusToLimit.Value;
			packingData.PressureDropMethod.Value = caPackingSection.PressureDropMethod.Value;
			packingData.JetFloodingLimit.Value = caPackingSection.JetFloodingLimit.Value;
		}

		private void SetOtherDefautValues(CAPackingSectionData caPackingSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAPackingData packingData, CAOption colSetting)
		{
			if (caPackingSection != null && columnData != null && packingData != null && columnData.Stages != null && columnData.Stages.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = caPackingSection.EndingStage.Value - caPackingSection.StartStage.Value + 1;
				if (caPackingSection.SystemFoamingFactor.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.SystemFoamingFactor.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.SystemFoamingFactor.Value = packingData.SystemFoamingFactor.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.OverDesignFactor.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.OverDesignFactor.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.OverDesignFactor.Value = packingData.OverDesignFactor.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.CapacityFactorFlooding.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.CapacityFactorFlooding.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.CapacityFactorFlooding.Value = packingData.CapacityFactorFlooding.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.PackingFactor.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.PackingFactor.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.PackingFactor.Value = packingData.PackingFactor.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.StichlmairSurfaceArea.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.StichlmairSurfaceArea.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.StichlmairSurfaceArea.Value = packingData.SurfaceArea.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_1.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_1.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_1.Value = packingData.StichlmairConstant1.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_2.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_2.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_2.Value = packingData.StichlmairConstant2.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_3.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_3.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.StichlmairConstant_3.Value = packingData.StichlmairConstant3.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.StichlmairFFmin.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && caPackingSection.StichlmairFFmin.IsEmpty())
				{
					caPackingSection.StichlmairFFmin.Value = packingData.StichlmairFFmin.Value;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.Diameter.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					caPackingSection.Diameter.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				if (caPackingSection.PackHeightType == PackHeightType.HETP && caPackingSection.HETP.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					caPackingSection.HETP.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				else if (caPackingSection.PackHeightType == PackHeightType.SectionPackHeight && caPackingSection.PackingHeight.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					caPackingSection.PackingHeight.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				double value = caPackingSection.FloodingApproachToMaxCapacity.Value;
				if (caPackingSection.FloodingApproachToMaxCapacity.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					caPackingSection.FloodingApproachToMaxCapacity.Value = 1E+35;
				}
				CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = CallPackingFormAndPlotRoutine(caPackingSection, columnData, colSetting, genratePlotResults: false, forDefault: true);
				if (cAPackingSectionResults != null)
				{
					packingData.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList.First().ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef * cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.MinimumLiquidRate;
					packingData.MaximumPressureDrop.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.ApproximatePresDropPerHeight;
					packingData.PressureDropAtFlood.Value = packingData.MaximumPressureDrop.Value;
					packingData.Diameter.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.Diameter.Value;
					packingData.HETP.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.HETP.Value;
					packingData.PackingHeight.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.HETP.Value * (double)num;
					packingData.FloodingApproachToMaxCapacity.Value = cAPackingSectionResults.MaximumFractionalCapacity.Value;
				}
				packingData.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value = EngineLimits.Instance.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				caPackingSection.FloodingApproachToMaxCapacity.Value = value;
			}
		}

		public SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> GetDisplayPackTypeList()
		{
			SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> sortedList = new SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CACodeNameDescP> aLLPackType in PackingInfo.ALLPackTypes)
			{
				sortedList.Add(aLLPackType.Key, new CADisplayElementPack(aLLPackType.Value.Name, aLLPackType.Value.Desc, aLLPackType.Value.Code));
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		{
			return true;

		public CAPackingSectionResults CallPackingFormAndPlotRoutine(CAPackingSectionData caPackRatingSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption colSetting, bool genratePlotResults, bool forDefault = false)
		{
			CAPackingSectionResults cAPackingSectionResults = null;
			IntPtr intPtr = ATTPSREngine.TPSR_CreatePRMasterObj();
			Dictionary<int, int> stageNumMap = null;
			try
			{
				SetAllInputDataToEngine(caPackRatingSection, columnData, colSetting, intPtr, out stageNumMap, genratePlotResults, forDefault);
				if (stageNumMap != null && stageNumMap.Count > 0)
				{
					cAPackingSectionResults = new CAPackingSectionResults(caPackRatingSection);
					FillResult(cAPackingSectionResults, caPackRatingSection, columnData, intPtr, stageNumMap, genratePlotResults);
					if (cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList != null)
					{
						foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in cAPackingSectionResults.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
						{
							if (packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Contains("PackMessage_EngineErrorTray"))
							{
								if (packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Contains("PackMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray"))
								{
									cAPackingSectionResults.CallingEngineMessages.Add("PackMessage_LiquidFlowError");
								}
								cAPackingSectionResults.CallingEngineMessages.Add("PackMessage_EngineError");
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				if (cAPackingSectionResults != null && !cAPackingSectionResults.CallingEngineMessages.Contains("PackMessage_EngineError"))
				{
					cAPackingSectionResults.CallingEngineMessages.Add("PackMessage_EngineError");
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ATTPSREngine.TPSR_DestroyPRMasterObj(intPtr);
				intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return cAPackingSectionResults;
		}

		private bool SetAllInputDataToEngine(CAPackingSectionData caPackRatingSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption colSetting, IntPtr packObj, out Dictionary<int, int> stageNumMap, bool generatePlot, bool forDefault)
		{
			stageNumMap = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			bool result = true;
			if (caPackRatingSection == null || columnData == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int num = caPackRatingSection.EndingStage.Value - caPackRatingSection.StartStage.Value + 1;
			if (columnData.EndStageNumber < caPackRatingSection.EndingStage.Value)
			{
				num = columnData.EndStageNumber - caPackRatingSection.StartStage.Value + 1;
			}
			int baseStageForSizing = columnData.GetBaseStageForSizing(caPackRatingSection.StartStage.Value, caPackRatingSection.EndingStage.Value, 1);
			double value = columnData.Stages[baseStageForSizing - 1].MassFlowLiquid.Value;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num2 = caPackRatingSection.StartStage.Value + i;
				CAStage cAStage = columnData.Stages[num2 - 1];
				int num3 = ATTPSREngine.TPSR_CreateTrayFromPRMasterObj(packObj);
				stageNumMap.Add(num2, num3);
				Dictionary<int, string> caPropValues;
				int[] array = SetInputArrayIntegerForPackPlot(caPackRatingSection, columnData, colSetting, num3, num2, out caPropValues);
				Dictionary<int, string> caPropValues2;
				double[] array2 = SetInputArrayRealForPackPlot(caPackRatingSection, columnData, colSetting, num2, out caPropValues2);
				IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(4 * IntArrayLength_Input);
				IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(8 * RealArrayLength_Input);
				CAAttpsrTrayWrapper.copyint32To64(array, intPtr, array.Length, 4);
				Marshal.Copy(array2, 0, intPtr2, array2.Length);
				int iSECNO = 0;
				double num4 = EngineLimits.Instance.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				double num5 = 1635.0;
				int num6 = _numberOfCurves;
				double lflowl = 1E-10;
				double lflowh = 2.0 * value;
				int numberOfLFlowVales = _numberOfLFlowVales;
				int nult = 21;
				if (!caPackRatingSection.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.IsEmpty())
				{
					num4 = caPackRatingSection.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				}
				if (!caPackRatingSection.NumberOfCurves.IsEmpty())
				{
					num6 = caPackRatingSection.NumberOfCurves.Value;
				}
				if (!caPackRatingSection.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight.IsEmpty())
				{
					num5 = caPackRatingSection.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				}
				if (!caPackRatingSection.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea.IsEmpty() && !cAStage.DensityLiquid.IsEmpty() && !caPackRatingSection.Diameter.IsEmpty())
				{
					lflowl = caPackRatingSection.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea.Value * cAStage.DensityLiquid.Value * (Math.PI * caPackRatingSection.Diameter.Value * caPackRatingSection.Diameter.Value / 4.0);
				}
				UpdatePackingPlotParameters(num6, numberOfLFlowVales, nult);
				if (num4 <= 0.0)
				{
					num4 = 1E-10 * num5;
				}
				ATTPSREngine.TPSR_UpdateTrayForPRMasterObj(packObj, iSECNO, num3, intPtr, intPtr2, num4, num5, (IntPtr)num6, lflowl, lflowh, (IntPtr)numberOfLFlowVales);
				bool num7 = ATTPSREngine.TPSR_IsTrayFromPRMasterObjReady(packObj, num3);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
				if (!num7)
				{
					result = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!ATTPSREngine.TPSR_IsAllTraysFromPRMasterObjReady(packObj))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdatePackingPlotParameters(int ndph, int nlflow, int nult)
		{
			_numberOfCurves = ndph;
			_numberOfLFlowVales = nlflow;
			_numberOfUltimatePoints = nult;
		}

		private void FillResult(CAPackingSectionResults result, CAPackingSectionData caPackRatingSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, IntPtr packObj, Dictionary<int, int> stageMap, bool genratePlotResults)
		{
			if (caPackRatingSection == null || columnData == null || stageMap == null || stageMap.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IntPtr IntOutput = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr RealOutput = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr dlflow = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr dvflowMat = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr dlult = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr dvult = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr ddph = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr piTMessages = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size);
			IntPtr intPtr3 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size);
			IntPtr[] array = new IntPtr[1] { (IntPtr)_numberOfUltimatePoints };
			IntPtr[] array2 = new IntPtr[1] { (IntPtr)_numberOfCurves };
			IntPtr[] array3 = new IntPtr[1] { (IntPtr)_numberOfLFlowVales };
			Marshal.Copy(array, 0, intPtr, array.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(array2, 0, intPtr2, array2.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(array3, 0, intPtr3, array3.Length);
			Dictionary<int, int[]> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, int[]>();
			Dictionary<int, double[]> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<int, double[]>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, int> item in stageMap)
			{
				ATTPSREngine.TPSR_GetTrayInfoForPRMasterObj(packObj, item.Value, out IntOutput, out RealOutput, intPtr2, out ddph, intPtr3, out dlflow, out dvflowMat, intPtr, out dlult, out dvult, out piTMessages);
				int[] dest = new int[IntArrayLength_Output];
				double[] array4 = new double[RealArrayLength_Output];
				double[] array5 = new double[_numberOfCurves];
				double[] array6 = new double[_numberOfLFlowVales];
				double[] array7 = new double[_numberOfLFlowVales * _numberOfCurves];
				double[] array8 = new double[_numberOfUltimatePoints];
				double[] array9 = new double[_numberOfUltimatePoints];
				IntPtr[] array10 = new IntPtr[ATTPSREngine.PR_TRAY_MESSAGE_SIZE];
				if (piTMessages != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.Copy(piTMessages, array10, 0, array10.Length);
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (IntOutput != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					IntPtr[] array11 = new IntPtr[IntArrayLength_Output];
					Marshal.Copy(IntOutput, array11, 0, dest.Length);
					ArrayCopy(array11, ref dest, dest.Length);
					dictionary.Add(item.Key, dest);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (RealOutput != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.Copy(RealOutput, array4, 0, array4.Length);
					dictionary2.Add(item.Key, array4);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				result.PackingDiagramSectionData.HasPlotData = genratePlotResults;
				if (genratePlotResults && ddph != IntPtr.Zero && dlflow != IntPtr.Zero && dvflowMat != IntPtr.Zero && dlult != IntPtr.Zero && dvult != IntPtr.Zero && intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.Copy(ddph, array5, 0, array5.Length);
					Marshal.Copy(dlflow, array6, 0, array6.Length);
					Marshal.Copy(dvflowMat, array7, 0, _numberOfLFlowVales * _numberOfCurves);
					Marshal.Copy(dlult, array8, 0, array8.Length);
					Marshal.Copy(dvult, array9, 0, array9.Length);
					Marshal.Copy(intPtr, array, 0, array.Length);
				}
				PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram = new PackingStageDiagram();
				packingStageDiagram.StageNumber = item.Key;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData = new PackingPlotReturnData();
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.PressureDropValues = array5;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.PressureDropValuesOriginal = array5.ToArray();
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowValues = array6;
				int[] dest2 = new int[array10.Length];
				ArrayCopy(array10, ref dest2, array10.Length);
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages = dest2;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowValuesSource = array7;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.NumberOfCurves = _numberOfCurves;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.NumberOfLFlowVales = _numberOfLFlowVales;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues = array8;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues = array9;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.MinimumLiquidFlow = array6[0];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.MaximumLiquidFlow = array6[array6.Length - 1];
				CAStage cAStage = columnData.Stages[item.Key - 1];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.OperationPointX = cAStage.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.OperationPointY = cAStage.MassFlowVapor.Value;
				result.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList.Add(packingStageDiagram);
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidMassDensityFromStage = array4[20];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporMassDensityToStage = array4[21];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxCoef = array4[22];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToMassFluxCoef = array4[23];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.LiquidFlowToVolFluxPerAreaCoef = array4[24];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToVolFluxCoef = array4[25];
				packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.VaporFlowToMassFluxCoef = array4[26];
