		internal void PulbishEngineMessages(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>>();
			Dictionary<string, int> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			Dictionary<string, Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>> dictionary3 = new Dictionary<string, Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>>();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in secrResult.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages != null && packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Count > 0 && packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Contains("PackMessage_EngineErrorTray"))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages[4] == 1 || packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages[4] == 3 || packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages[4] == 4)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages.Length; i++)
				{
					int num = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages[i];
					int num2 = i + 1;
					if (num > 99999 || num <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = $"PackMessage_{num2}_{num}";
					EngineMessage packingEngineMessage = ResourceHelper.GetPackingEngineMessage(num2, num);
					if (packingEngineMessage == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey))
					{
						MessageType messageType = CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap[packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey];
						if ((flag && (messageType == MessageType.Error || messageType == MessageType.Warning)) || (flag2 && (messageType == MessageType.Error || messageType == MessageType.Warning) && i != 4))
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (packingEngineMessage.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Tray)
					{
						if (!dictionary3.ContainsKey(text))
						{
							dictionary3.Add(text, new Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>(new List<int>(), packingEngineMessage));
						}
						dictionary3[text].Item1.Add(packingStageDiagram.StageNumber);
						list.Add(text);
						text = text + "_" + packingStageDiagram.StageNumber;
						dictionary2.Add(text, packingStageDiagram.StageNumber);
					}
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						List<CARealVariable> sourceRealData = new List<CARealVariable>();
						string item = SetEngineMessageWithData(columnData, sectionData, secrResult, packingEngineMessage, packingStageDiagram.StageNumber, MessageTray + " {0}", sourceRealData);
						List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
						list2.Add(packingStageDiagram.StageNumber);
						if (CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(packingEngineMessage.MessageResourceKey))
						{
							packingEngineMessage.SourceRealData = sourceRealData;
							dictionary.Add(text, new Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>(item, list2, packingEngineMessage));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>> item3 in dictionary3)
			{
				if (list.Contains(item3.Key))
				{
					string messageResourceKey = item3.Value.Item2.MessageResourceKey;
					string text2 = MessageTray + " ";
					EngineMessage engineMessage = null;
					if (item3.Value.Item1.Count > 1)
					{
						text2 = MessageTrays + " ";
						engineMessage = item3.Value.Item2.Clone() as EngineMessage;
						engineMessage.MessageResourceKey += "_Multiple";
						engineMessage.Message = PackingResources.ResourceManager.GetString(engineMessage.MessageResourceKey);
					}
					if (engineMessage == null)
					{
						engineMessage = item3.Value.Item2;
					}
					List<int> list3 = new List<int>();
					for (int j = 0; j < item3.Value.Item1.Count; j++)
					{
						list3.Add(item3.Value.Item1[j]);
					}
					if (CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(messageResourceKey))
					{
						List<CARealVariable> sourceRealData2 = new List<CARealVariable>();
						string item2 = SetEngineMessageWithData(columnData, sectionData, secrResult, engineMessage, item3.Value.Item1[0], text2 + "{0}", sourceRealData2);
						engineMessage.SourceRealData = sourceRealData2;
						dictionary.Add(item3.Key, new Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>(item2, list3, engineMessage));
					}
				}
			}
			HandleMinDPFailedMessage(sectionData, secrResult, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			HandleMaxDPFailedMessage(sectionData, secrResult, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			HandleCloseToLimitMessage(sectionData, secrResult, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			HandleCallingEngineMessage(secrResult, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			SetMessageToCAManger(dictionary, dictionary2, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			_CaMessagesManager.PublishMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey);
		}

		private void SetMessageToCAManger(Dictionary<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>> messagesToMessageManager, Dictionary<string, int> trayMessagesToMessageManager, ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>> item in messagesToMessageManager)
			{
				MessageType messageType = CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap[item.Value.Item3.MessageResourceKey];
				if (trayMessagesToMessageManager.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					CAMessage cAMessage = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, messageType, MessageCatalog.Engine, item.Value.Item1, trayMessagesToMessageManager[item.Key]);
					cAMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
					cAMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
					cAMessage.SourceRealData = item.Value.Item3.SourceRealData;
					if (item.Value.Item3.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Section)
					{
						cAMessage.ShowTrayNumber = false;
					}
					else
					{
						cAMessage.ShowTrayNumber = true;
					}
					cAMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
					cAMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					cAMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
					cAMessage.StageNumbers = item.Value.Item2;
					cAMessage.MessageResourceKey = item.Value.Item3.MessageResourceKey;
					_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage);
				}
				else
				{
					CAMessage cAMessage2 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, messageType, MessageCatalog.Engine, item.Value.Item1);
					cAMessage2.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
					cAMessage2.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
					cAMessage2.SourceRealData = item.Value.Item3.SourceRealData;
					if (item.Value.Item3.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Section)
					{
						cAMessage2.ShowTrayNumber = false;
					}
					else
					{
						cAMessage2.ShowTrayNumber = true;
					}
					cAMessage2.StageNumbers = item.Value.Item2;
					cAMessage2.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
					cAMessage2.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					cAMessage2.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
					cAMessage2.MessageResourceKey = item.Value.Item3.MessageResourceKey;
					_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage2);
				}
			}
		}

		private string SetEngineMessageWithData(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, EngineMessage message, int trayNum, string trayNumString, List<CARealVariable> sourceRealData)
		{
			string result = message.Message;
			switch (message.MessageResourceKey)
			{
			case "PackMessage_1_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_1_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_2_1_Section":
				result = message.Message;
				sourceRealData.Add(EngineLimits.Instance.PackMessage_2_1_Section_10Feet);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_2_2_Section":
				result = message.Message;
				sourceRealData.Add(EngineLimits.Instance.PackMessage_2_2_Section_15Feet);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_2_3_Section":
				result = message.Message;
				sourceRealData.Add(EngineLimits.Instance.PackMessage_2_3_Section_20Feet);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_3_1_Section":
				result = message.Message;
				sourceRealData.Add(EngineLimits.Instance.PackMessage_3_1_Section_1gpmPerFt2);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_10_1_Section":
				result = message.Message;
				break;
			case "PackMessage_4_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_4_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_5_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_5_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_6_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_6_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				sourceRealData.Add(sectionData.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_7_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_7_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				sourceRealData.Add(sectionData.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_8_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_8_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_9_1_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_9_1_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				sourceRealData.Add(sectionData.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea);
				break;
			case "PackMessage_5_3_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_5_4_Tray":
			case "PackMessage_5_3_Tray_Multiple":
			case "PackMessage_5_4_Tray_Multiple":
				result = message.Message.Replace("{0}", trayNumString);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void HandleCloseToLimitMessage(CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in secrResult.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				PackingCloseToLimitMessage closeToLimitMessage = packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.CloseToLimitMessage;
				if (closeToLimitMessage != PackingCloseToLimitMessage.NotSet)
				{
					closeToLimitMessage.ToString();
					CAMessage approachToLimitMessage = GetApproachToLimitMessage(closeToLimitMessage, sectionData, secrResult, packingStageDiagram, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
					if (approachToLimitMessage != null)
					{
						approachToLimitMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
						approachToLimitMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
						approachToLimitMessage.ShowTrayNumber = true;
						approachToLimitMessage.StageNumber = packingStageDiagram.StageNumber;
						approachToLimitMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
						approachToLimitMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
						approachToLimitMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
						_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(approachToLimitMessage);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private CAMessage GetApproachToLimitMessage(PackingCloseToLimitMessage messageType, CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, PackingStageDiagram tray, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			CAMessage result = null;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			List<CARealVariable> list = new List<CARealVariable>();
			_ = string.Empty;
			string newValue = MessageTray + " {0}";
			switch (messageType)
			{
			case PackingCloseToLimitMessage.UltimateCurve:
				empty = PackingResources.PackMessage_Approach_Ultimate;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				break;
			case PackingCloseToLimitMessage.MaxPressrueDrop:
				empty = PackingResources.PackMessage_Approach_MaxPressureDrop;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(sectionData.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight);
				break;
			case PackingCloseToLimitMessage.MinLoarding:
				empty = PackingResources.PackMessage_Approach_MinLoad;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(sectionData.MinimumLiquidFlowRatePerArea);
				break;
			case PackingCloseToLimitMessage.MinPressrueDrop:
			{
				empty = PackingResources.PackMessage_Approach_MinPressureDrop;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				CARealVariable minPressureDrop = tray.ReturnData.GetMinPressureDrop();
				if (minPressureDrop != null)
				{
					list.Add(minPressureDrop);
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				empty = string.Empty;
				break;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
			{
				result = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.CAComponent, empty);
				result.SourceRealData = list;
				return result;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void HandleMinDPFailedMessage(CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in secrResult.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				CAMessage minDPFailedMessage = GetMinDPFailedMessage(sectionData, secrResult, packingStageDiagram, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
				if (minDPFailedMessage != null)
				{
					minDPFailedMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
					minDPFailedMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
					minDPFailedMessage.ShowTrayNumber = true;
					minDPFailedMessage.StageNumber = packingStageDiagram.StageNumber;
					minDPFailedMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
					minDPFailedMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					minDPFailedMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
					_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(minDPFailedMessage);
				}
			}
		}

		private CAMessage GetMinDPFailedMessage(CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, PackingStageDiagram tray, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (sectionData == null || secrResult == null || tray == null || tray.ReturnData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CAMessage result = null;
			if (!tray.ReturnData.GetMinimumPressureDropCurve(out var _, out var _, out var _))
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				List<CARealVariable> list = new List<CARealVariable>();
				_ = string.Empty;
				string newValue = MessageTray + " {0}";
				empty = PackingResources.PackMessage_CalMinPresFailed;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				CARealVariable cARealVariable = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight);
				cARealVariable.Value = sectionData.MinimumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				list.Add(cARealVariable);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
				{
					result = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.CAComponent, empty);
					result.SourceRealData = list;
					return result;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void HandleMaxDPFailedMessage(CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in secrResult.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				List<CAMessage> maxDPFailedMessage = GetMaxDPFailedMessage(sectionData, secrResult, packingStageDiagram, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
				if (maxDPFailedMessage == null || maxDPFailedMessage.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CAMessage item in maxDPFailedMessage)
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						item.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
						item.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
						item.ShowTrayNumber = true;
						item.StageNumber = packingStageDiagram.StageNumber;
						item.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
						item.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
						item.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
						_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(item);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private List<CAMessage> GetMaxDPFailedMessage(CAPackingSectionData sectionData, CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, PackingStageDiagram tray, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (sectionData == null || secrResult == null || tray == null || tray.ReturnData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<CAMessage> list = new List<CAMessage>();
			bool flag = tray.ReturnData.IsMaxPresCalcuated();
			bool flag2 = tray.ReturnData.IsUltimateCalcuated();
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				List<CARealVariable> list2 = new List<CARealVariable>();
				_ = string.Empty;
				string newValue = MessageTray + " {0}";
				empty = PackingResources.PackMessage_CalMaxPresAndUltimateFailed;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				CARealVariable cARealVariable = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight);
				cARealVariable.Value = sectionData.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
				list2.Add(cARealVariable);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
				{
					CAMessage cAMessage = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.CAComponent, empty);
					cAMessage.SourceRealData = list2;
					list.Add(cAMessage);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					string empty2 = string.Empty;
					List<CARealVariable> list3 = new List<CARealVariable>();
					_ = string.Empty;
					string newValue2 = MessageTray + " {0}";
					empty2 = PackingResources.PackMessage_CalMaxPresFailed;
					empty2 = empty2.Replace("{0}", newValue2);
					CARealVariable cARealVariable2 = new CARealVariable(QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight);
					cARealVariable2.Value = sectionData.MaximumPressureDropPerHeight.Value;
					list3.Add(cARealVariable2);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
					{
						CAMessage cAMessage2 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.CAComponent, empty2);
						cAMessage2.SourceRealData = list3;
						list.Add(cAMessage2);
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					string empty3 = string.Empty;
					List<CARealVariable> sourceRealData = new List<CARealVariable>();
					_ = string.Empty;
					string newValue3 = MessageTray + " {0}";
					empty3 = PackingResources.PackMessage_CalUtimateFailed;
					empty3 = empty3.Replace("{0}", newValue3);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty3))
					{
						CAMessage cAMessage3 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.CAComponent, empty3);
						cAMessage3.SourceRealData = sourceRealData;
						list.Add(cAMessage3);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void HandleCallingEngineMessage(CAPackingSectionResults secrResult, ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (secrResult.CallingEngineMessages == null || secrResult.CallingEngineMessages.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(secrResult.CallingEngineMessages[0]))
			{
				string packMessage_LiquidFlowError = PackingResources.PackMessage_LiquidFlowError;
				CAMessage cAMessage = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap[secrResult.CallingEngineMessages[0]], MessageCatalog.Engine, packMessage_LiquidFlowError);
				if (cAMessage != null)
				{
					cAMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
					cAMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
					cAMessage.ShowTrayNumber = false;
					cAMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
					cAMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					cAMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
					_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage);
				}
				string packMessage_EngineError = PackingResources.PackMessage_EngineError;
				CAMessage cAMessage2 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap[secrResult.CallingEngineMessages[0]], MessageCatalog.Engine, packMessage_EngineError);
				if (cAMessage2 != null)
				{
					cAMessage2.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
					cAMessage2.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
					cAMessage2.ShowTrayNumber = false;
					cAMessage2.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
					cAMessage2.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					cAMessage2.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
					_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage2);
				}
			}
			string newValue = MessageTray + " {0}";
			foreach (PackingStageDiagram packingStageDiagram in secrResult.PackingDiagramSectionData.PackingStageDiagramList)
			{
				if (packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages != null && packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Count > 0 && packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Contains("PackMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray"))
				{
					string packMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray = PackingResources.PackMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray;
					packMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray = packMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray.Replace("{0}", newValue);
					CAMessage cAMessage3 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap["PackMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray"], MessageCatalog.Engine, packMessage_LiquidFlowErrorTray);
					if (cAMessage3 != null)
					{
						cAMessage3.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
						cAMessage3.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
						cAMessage3.StageNumber = packingStageDiagram.StageNumber;
						cAMessage3.ShowTrayNumber = true;
						cAMessage3.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
						cAMessage3.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
						cAMessage3.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
						_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage3);
					}
				}
				if (packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessages != null && packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Count > 0 && packingStageDiagram.ReturnData.EngineMessagesOther.Contains("PackMessage_EngineErrorTray"))
				{
					string packMessage_EngineErrorTray = PackingResources.PackMessage_EngineErrorTray;
					packMessage_EngineErrorTray = packMessage_EngineErrorTray.Replace("{0}", newValue);
					CAMessage cAMessage4 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, CAMessageHelper.PackingMessageTypeMap["PackMessage_EngineErrorTray"], MessageCatalog.Engine, packMessage_EngineErrorTray);
					if (cAMessage4 != null)
					{
						cAMessage4.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
						cAMessage4.SimulatorDataProvider = SimulatorDataProvider;
						cAMessage4.StageNumber = packingStageDiagram.StageNumber;
						cAMessage4.ShowTrayNumber = true;
						cAMessage4.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
						cAMessage4.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
						cAMessage4.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
						_CaMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage4);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AttpsrPackingInfo
	{
		internal struct NameList
		{
			public string Name;

			public SortedList List;

			internal NameList(string theName, SortedList theList)
			{
				Name = theName;
				List = theList;
			}

			static NameList()
			{
			}
		}

		internal struct NamePackingData
		{
			public string Name;

			public CAPackingData PackData;

			internal NamePackingData(string theName, CAPackingData thePackData)
			{
				Name = theName;
				PackData = thePackData;
			}

			static NamePackingData()
			{
			}
		}

		internal const int MTLCode = 2;

		internal const int PackUserTypeCode = 33333333;

		internal const string USER = "USER";

		internal const string USERDescrption = "User";

		internal const string MTL = "MTL";

		internal const string MTLDescrption = "The Mass Transfer, Ltd. company";

		internal const string GLITSCH = "GLITSCH";

		internal const int GLITSCHCode = 3;

		private List<string> OnlyContainsMTLList;

		private static AttpsrPackingInfo _Instance;

		private SortedList<int, CACodeNameDescP> _ALLrPackTypes;

		private SortedList<int, CACodeNameDescP> _AllVendors;

		private SortedList<int, CACodeNameP> _AllMaterials;

		private SortedList<int, CACodeNameP> _AllPackDimensions;

		private SortedList<int, NameList> _AllPackingsData;

		private SortedList<string, CADisplayElementPack> _PressurePDropMethods;

		public static AttpsrPackingInfo Instance => _Instance;

		internal SortedList<int, CACodeNameDescP> ALLPackTypes => _ALLrPackTypes;

		internal SortedList<int, CACodeNameDescP> AllVendors => _AllVendors;

		internal SortedList<int, CACodeNameP> AllMaterials => _AllMaterials;

		internal SortedList<int, CACodeNameP> AllPackDimensions => _AllPackDimensions;

		private SortedList<int, NameList> AllPackingsData => _AllPackingsData;

		internal SortedList<string, CADisplayElementPack> PressurePDropMethods
		{
			get
			{
				return _PressurePDropMethods;
			}
			set
			{
				_PressurePDropMethods = value;
			}
		}

		internal SortedList<int, string> ALLPackTypeNames { get; set; }

		internal SortedList<int, string> AllVendorsNames { get; set; }

		internal SortedList<int, string> AllMaterialsNames { get; set; }

		internal SortedList<int, string> PressurePDropMethodsNames { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, int> ALLrPackTypeNamesCode { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, int> AllVendorsNamesCode { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, int> AllMaterialsNamesCode { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, int> PressurePDropMethodsNamesCode { get; set; }

		private void InitOnlyContainsMTLList()
		{
			OnlyContainsMTLList = new List<string>();
			OnlyContainsMTLList.Add("CMR");
			OnlyContainsMTLList.Add("GOODLOE");
		}

		static AttpsrPackingInfo()
		{
			_Instance = new AttpsrPackingInfo();
		}

		private AttpsrPackingInfo()
		{
			InitOnlyContainsMTLList();
			BuildLists();
			InitStringLists();
		}

		private void BuildLists()
		{
			_PressurePDropMethods = new SortedList<string, CADisplayElementPack>();
			for (int i = 0; i <= ATTPSREngine.getNumberOfDPMethodForPacking() - 1; i++)
			{
				ATTPSREngine.CodeNameDesc lpDPMethod = default(ATTPSREngine.CodeNameDesc);
				if (ATTPSREngine.getPackDPMethodByIndex(i, ref lpDPMethod) == 0 && lpDPMethod.name != "USER")
				{
					_PressurePDropMethods.Add(lpDPMethod.name, new CADisplayElementPack(lpDPMethod.name, lpDPMethod.desc, lpDPMethod.code));
				}
			}
			_ALLrPackTypes = new SortedList<int, CACodeNameDescP>();
			_AllVendors = new SortedList<int, CACodeNameDescP>();
			_AllMaterials = new SortedList<int, CACodeNameP>();
			_AllPackDimensions = new SortedList<int, CACodeNameP>();
			_AllPackingsData = new SortedList<int, NameList>();
			int num = 0;
			num = ATTPSREngine.getNumberOfPackTypes();
			int num2 = 0;
			for (num2 = 0; num2 <= num - 1; num2++)
			{
				ATTPSREngine.CodeNameDesc lpPackInfo = default(ATTPSREngine.CodeNameDesc);
				if (ATTPSREngine.getPackTypeByIndex(num2, ref lpPackInfo) != 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!_ALLrPackTypes.ContainsKey(lpPackInfo.code))
				{
					_ALLrPackTypes.Add(lpPackInfo.code, new CACodeNameDescP(lpPackInfo.code, lpPackInfo.name, lpPackInfo.desc));
				}
				int nVendors = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				if (ATTPSREngine.getNumberOfVendors(ref lpPackInfo, ref nVendors) != 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (num3 = 0; num3 <= nVendors - 1; num3++)
				{
					ATTPSREngine.CodeNameDesc lpVendorInfo = default(ATTPSREngine.CodeNameDesc);
					if (ATTPSREngine.getVendorByIndex(ref lpPackInfo, num3, ref lpVendorInfo) != 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!_AllVendors.ContainsKey(lpVendorInfo.code))
					{
						_AllVendors.Add(lpVendorInfo.code, new CACodeNameDescP(lpVendorInfo.code, lpVendorInfo.name, lpVendorInfo.desc));
					}
					int nMaterials = 0;
					int num4 = 0;
					if (ATTPSREngine.getNumberOfMaterialsC(ref lpPackInfo, ref lpVendorInfo, ref nMaterials) != 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (num4 = 0; num4 <= nMaterials - 1; num4++)
					{
						ATTPSREngine.CodeName lpMaterialInfo = default(ATTPSREngine.CodeName);
						if (ATTPSREngine.getMaterialByIndexC(ref lpPackInfo, ref lpVendorInfo, num4, ref lpMaterialInfo) != 0)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (!_AllMaterials.ContainsKey(lpMaterialInfo.code))
						{
							_AllMaterials.Add(lpMaterialInfo.code, new CACodeNameP(lpMaterialInfo.code, lpMaterialInfo.name));
						}
						int nSizes = 0;
						int num5 = 0;
						if (ATTPSREngine.getNumberOfPackSizesC(ref lpPackInfo, ref lpVendorInfo, ref lpMaterialInfo, ref nSizes) != 0)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (nSizes > 0)
						{
							for (num5 = 0; num5 <= nSizes; num5++)
							{
								ATTPSREngine.CodeName lpSizeInfo = default(ATTPSREngine.CodeName);
								if (ATTPSREngine.getPackSizeByIndexC(ref lpPackInfo, ref lpVendorInfo, ref lpMaterialInfo, num5, ref lpSizeInfo) == 0)
								{
									if (!_AllPackDimensions.ContainsKey(lpSizeInfo.code))
									{
										_AllPackDimensions.Add(lpSizeInfo.code, new CACodeNameP(lpSizeInfo.code, lpSizeInfo.name));
									}
									ATTPSREngine.PackingParam lpPackData = default(ATTPSREngine.PackingParam);
									if (ATTPSREngine.FillPackingParamsC(bInitParams: true, bInitCodes: false, ref lpPackData, ref lpPackInfo, ref lpVendorInfo, ref lpMaterialInfo, ref lpSizeInfo) == 0)
									{
										AddPackingData(lpPackInfo.code, lpPackInfo.name, lpVendorInfo.code, lpVendorInfo.name, lpMaterialInfo.code, lpMaterialInfo.name, lpSizeInfo.code, lpSizeInfo.name, new CAPackingData(lpPackData.SpecificSurfaceArea, lpPackData.VoidFraction, lpPackData.NominalDiameter, lpPackData.PackingFactor, lpPackData.StichlmairC1, lpPackData.StichlmairC2, lpPackData.StichlmairC3, lpPackData.StichlmairFFmin));
									}
									else if (lpPackInfo.name.Equals("GOODLOE", StringComparison.InvariantCulture) && lpVendorInfo.name.Equals("GLITSCH", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
									{
										AddPackingData(lpPackInfo.code, lpPackInfo.name, lpVendorInfo.code, lpVendorInfo.name, lpMaterialInfo.code, lpMaterialInfo.name, lpSizeInfo.code, lpSizeInfo.name, new CAPackingData(lpPackData.SpecificSurfaceArea, lpPackData.VoidFraction, lpPackData.NominalDiameter, lpPackData.PackingFactor, lpPackData.StichlmairC1, lpPackData.StichlmairC2, lpPackData.StichlmairC3, lpPackData.StichlmairFFmin));
									}
									else if (lpPackInfo.name.Equals("GRID", StringComparison.InvariantCulture) && lpVendorInfo.name.Equals("GLITSCH", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
									{
										AddPackingData(lpPackInfo.code, lpPackInfo.name, lpVendorInfo.code, lpVendorInfo.name, lpMaterialInfo.code, lpMaterialInfo.name, lpSizeInfo.code, lpSizeInfo.name, new CAPackingData(lpPackData.SpecificSurfaceArea, lpPackData.VoidFraction, lpPackData.NominalDiameter, lpPackData.PackingFactor, lpPackData.StichlmairC1, lpPackData.StichlmairC2, lpPackData.StichlmairC3, lpPackData.StichlmairFFmin));
									}
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (!_AllPackDimensions.ContainsKey(9999))
							{
								_AllPackDimensions.Add(9999, new CACodeNameP(9999, "STANDARD"));
							}
							AddPackingData(lpPackInfo.code, lpPackInfo.name, lpVendorInfo.code, lpVendorInfo.name, lpMaterialInfo.code, lpMaterialInfo.name, 99999, "STANDARD", new CAPackingData(1E+35, 1E+35, 1E+35, 1E+35, 3.0, 2.1, 0.31, 1.0));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			AddMTLMissingInAttpsr();
		}

		private void AddMTLMissingInAttpsr()
		{
			_ALLrPackTypes.Add(33333333, new CACodeNameDescP(33333333, "USER", "User"));
			_AllVendors.Add(2, new CACodeNameDescP(2, "MTL", "The Mass Transfer, Ltd. company"));
		}

		private void AddPackingData(int thePackingCode, string thePackingName, int theVendorCode, string theVendorName, int theMaterialCode, string theMaterialName, int thePackDimensionCode, string thePackDimensionName, CAPackingData thePackData)
		{
			if (!_AllPackingsData.ContainsKey(thePackingCode))
			{
				_AllPackingsData.Add(thePackingCode, new NameList(thePackingName, new SortedList()));
			}
			NameList nameList = _AllPackingsData[thePackingCode];
			if (!nameList.List.ContainsKey(theVendorCode))
			{
				nameList.List.Add(theVendorCode, new NameList(theVendorName, new SortedList()));
			}
			NameList nameList2 = (NameList)nameList.List[theVendorCode];
			if (!nameList2.List.ContainsKey(theMaterialCode))
			{
				nameList2.List.Add(theMaterialCode, new NameList(theMaterialName, new SortedList()));
			}
			NameList nameList3 = (NameList)nameList2.List[theMaterialCode];
			if (!nameList3.List.ContainsKey(thePackDimensionCode))
			{
				nameList3.List.Add(thePackDimensionCode, new NamePackingData(thePackDimensionName, thePackData));
			}
		}

		private void InitStringLists()
		{
			ALLPackTypeNames = new SortedList<int, string>();
			AllVendorsNames = new SortedList<int, string>();
			AllMaterialsNames = new SortedList<int, string>();
			PressurePDropMethodsNames = new SortedList<int, string>();
			ALLrPackTypeNamesCode = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			AllVendorsNamesCode = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			AllMaterialsNamesCode = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			PressurePDropMethodsNamesCode = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CACodeNameDescP> aLLPackType in ALLPackTypes)
			{
				ALLPackTypeNames.Add(aLLPackType.Key, aLLPackType.Value.Name);
				ALLrPackTypeNamesCode.Add(aLLPackType.Value.Name, aLLPackType.Key);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CACodeNameDescP> allVendor in AllVendors)
			{
				AllVendorsNames.Add(allVendor.Key, allVendor.Value.Name);
				AllVendorsNamesCode.Add(allVendor.Value.Name, allVendor.Key);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CACodeNameP> allMaterial in AllMaterials)
			{
				AllMaterialsNames.Add(allMaterial.Key, allMaterial.Value.Name);
				AllMaterialsNamesCode.Add(allMaterial.Value.Name, allMaterial.Key);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CADisplayElementPack> pressurePDropMethod in PressurePDropMethods)
			{
				PressurePDropMethodsNames.Add(pressurePDropMethod.Value.OptionValue, pressurePDropMethod.Value.DisplayText);
				PressurePDropMethodsNamesCode.Add(pressurePDropMethod.Value.DisplayText, pressurePDropMethod.Value.OptionValue);
			}
		}

		internal int GetIndexOfPackingDimension(CAIntegerVariable packingType, CAIntegerVariable packingVendor, CAIntegerVariable packingMaterial, string packingDimensionName, out List<string> options)
		{
			options = null;
			int result = 99999999;
			if (packingType == null || packingType.IsEmpty() || packingVendor == null || packingVendor.IsEmpty() || packingVendor == null || packingVendor.IsEmpty())
			{
				return result;
			}
			NameList mvarMaterialSizes;
			SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> packDimensions = GetPackDimensions(packingType, packingVendor, packingMaterial, out mvarMaterialSizes);
			options = new List<string>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CADisplayElementPack> item in packDimensions)
			{
				options.Add(item.Value.DisplayText);
			}
			if (packDimensions != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, CADisplayElementPack> item2 in packDimensions)
				{
					if (item2.Value.DisplayText.Equals(packingDimensionName, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
					{
						result = item2.Key;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> GetDisplayVendors(CAIntegerVariable packingType)
		{
			if (packingType == null || packingType.IsEmpty())
			{
				return null;
			}
			SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> sortedList = new SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack>();
			if (_AllPackingsData.ContainsKey(packingType.Value))
			{
				NameList nameList = _AllPackingsData[packingType.Value];
				foreach (int key in nameList.List.GetKeyList())
				{
					NameList nameList2 = (NameList)nameList.List[key];
					if (key == 3 && OnlyContainsMTLList.Contains(packingType.EnumString))
					{
						CADisplayElementPack value = new CADisplayElementPack("MTL", _AllVendors[2].Desc, 2);
						sortedList.Add(2, value);
					}
					else
					{
						CADisplayElementPack value2 = new CADisplayElementPack(nameList2.Name, _AllVendors[key].Desc, key);
						sortedList.Add(key, value2);
					}
				}
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		internal SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> GetDisplayMaterials(CAIntegerVariable packingType, CAIntegerVariable packingVendor)
		{
			if (packingType == null || packingType.IsEmpty() || packingVendor == null || packingVendor.IsEmpty())
			{
				return null;
			}
			NameList nameList = _AllPackingsData[packingType.Value];
			SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> sortedList = new SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack>();
			if (nameList.List.ContainsKey(packingVendor.Value))
			{
				int num = packingVendor.Value;
				if (packingVendor.Value == 2)
				{
					num = 3;
				}
				NameList nameList2 = (NameList)nameList.List[num];
				foreach (int key in nameList2.List.GetKeyList())
				{
					CADisplayElementPack value = new CADisplayElementPack(((NameList)nameList2.List[key]).Name, "", key);
					sortedList.Add(key, value);
				}
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		internal SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> GetPackDimensions(CAIntegerVariable packingType, CAIntegerVariable packingVendor, CAIntegerVariable packingMaterial, out NameList mvarMaterialSizes)
		{
			mvarMaterialSizes = default(NameList);
			if (packingType == null || packingType.IsEmpty() || packingVendor == null || packingVendor.IsEmpty() || packingVendor == null || packingVendor.IsEmpty())
			{
				return null;
			}
			SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack> sortedList = new SortedList<int, CADisplayElementPack>();
			if (packingType.Value == 33333333)
			{
				mvarMaterialSizes = new NameList("USER", new SortedList());
				sortedList.Add(33333333, new CADisplayElementPack("USER", "USER", 33333333));
				return sortedList;
			}
			NameList nameList = _AllPackingsData[packingType.Value];
			int num = packingVendor.Value;
			if (packingVendor.Value == 2)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (nameList.List.ContainsKey(num))
			{
				NameList nameList2 = (NameList)nameList.List[num];
				if (nameList2.List.ContainsKey(packingMaterial.Value))
				{
					mvarMaterialSizes = (NameList)nameList2.List[packingMaterial.Value];
					foreach (int key in mvarMaterialSizes.List.GetKeyList())
					{
						CADisplayElementPack value = new CADisplayElementPack(((NamePackingData)mvarMaterialSizes.List[key]).Name, "", key);
						sortedList.Add(key, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		internal CAPackingData GetPackingData(CAIntegerVariable packingType, CAIntegerVariable packingVendor, CAIntegerVariable packingMaterial, CAIntegerVariable packingDimenstion)
		{
			CAPackingData result = null;
			if (GetPackDimensions(packingType, packingVendor, packingMaterial, out var mvarMaterialSizes) != null && mvarMaterialSizes.List.ContainsKey(packingDimenstion.Value))
			{
				result = ((NamePackingData)mvarMaterialSizes.List[packingDimenstion.Value]).PackData;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		protected TraySectionResultData Update(CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption colSetting, int startStage, int endStage, bool calculateCurve)
		{
			InternalsTypeEnum internalType = curSection.InternalType;
			if (_TODMaster == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				_TODMaster = ATTPSREngine.CreateTODMasterObj();
			}
			CAAttpsrPlogDebugManger cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger = new CAAttpsrPlogDebugManger((int)internalType);
			TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = new TraySectionResultData(curSection);
			traySectionResultData.StartStageNumber.Value = startStage;
			traySectionResultData.EndtStageNumber.Value = endStage;
			DiagramSectionData diagramSectionData = traySectionResultData.DiagramSectionData;
			int num = endStage - startStage + 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				DiagramTray diagramTray = new DiagramTray();
				diagramTray.StageNumber = startStage + i;
				diagramTray.ReturnData.TrayID = ATTPSREngine.CreateTrayFromTODMasterObj(_TODMaster);
				diagramSectionData.Trays.Add(diagramTray);
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(140);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(800);
			if (curSection.IsMDTray == false && curSection.InternalType != InternalsTypeEnum.CustomTray)
			{
				CABalancedData cABalancedData = new CABalancedData();
				((CADCSideResultData)cABalancedData.Downcomers[0]).WeirHeight.Value = curSection.Weirs[0].Height.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value = curSection.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].StraightHeight.Value = curSection.Downcomers[0].StraightHeight.Value;
				((CADCCenterResultData)cABalancedData.Downcomers[1]).WeirHeight.Value = curSection.Weirs[1].Height.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value = curSection.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].StraightHeight.Value = curSection.Downcomers[1].StraightHeight.Value;
				((CADCOffCenterResultData)cABalancedData.Downcomers[2]).WeirHeightInSide.Value = curSection.Weirs[2].Height.Value;
				((CADCOffCenterResultData)cABalancedData.Downcomers[2]).WeirHeightOutdide.Value = curSection.Weirs[3].Height.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value = curSection.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].StraightHeight.Value = curSection.Downcomers[2].StraightHeight.Value;
				List<TrayGeometryInputData> updateTrayGeometryData = GetUpdateTrayGeometryData(curSection, columnData, 1);
				ParseInputSectionDenstityData(curSection, cABalancedData);
				UpdateTrayGeometry(curSection, columnData, cABalancedData, updateTrayGeometryData);
				for (int j = 0; j < traySectionResultData.Downcomers.Length; j++)
				{
					traySectionResultData.Downcomers[j] = cABalancedData.Downcomers[j];
				}
				traySectionResultData.FlowPathLengthPanelA.Value = cABalancedData.FlowPathLengthPanelA.Value;
				traySectionResultData.FlowPathLengthPanelB.Value = cABalancedData.FlowPathLengthPanelB.Value;
				traySectionResultData.FlowPathLengthPanelC.Value = cABalancedData.FlowPathLengthPanelC.Value;
				traySectionResultData.FlowPathLengthPanelD.Value = cABalancedData.FlowPathLengthPanelD.Value;
				traySectionResultData.DCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value = cABalancedData.DCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value;
				traySectionResultData.BubblingAreaPanelA.Value = cABalancedData.BubblingAreaPanelA.Value;
				traySectionResultData.BubblingAreaPanelB.Value = cABalancedData.BubblingAreaPanelB.Value;
				traySectionResultData.BubblingAreaPanelC.Value = cABalancedData.BubblingAreaPanelC.Value;
				traySectionResultData.BubblingAreaPanelD.Value = cABalancedData.BubblingAreaPanelD.Value;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				num2 = startStage + k;
				CAStage stage = columnData.Stages[num2 - 1];
				AttpsManrPlotInput attpsManrPlotInput = new AttpsManrPlotInput();
				if (cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut != null)
				{
					cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.InputData.Add(attpsManrPlotInput);
				}
				int iSECNO = 0;
				int trayID = diagramSectionData.Trays[k].ReturnData.TrayID;
				int trayNumber = startStage + k;
				SetInputParameters(attpsManrPlotInput, stage, curSection, columnData, colSetting, startStage, endStage, calculateCurve);
				if (cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.DebugSetting != null && cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.DebugSetting.UsingFakeData)
				{
					AttpsManrPlotInput attpsManrPlotInput2 = null;
					attpsManrPlotInput2 = ((k <= cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.CaDebugPlotInputData_FakeData.InputData.Count - 1) ? cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.CaDebugPlotInputData_FakeData.InputData[k] : cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.CaDebugPlotInputData_FakeData.InputData[0]);
					if (attpsManrPlotInput2 == null)
					{
						System.Windows.MessageBox.Show("fake data wrong, please check!");
						break;
					}
					Marshal.Copy(attpsManrPlotInput.IntParameters, 0, intPtr, attpsManrPlotInput2.IntParameters.Length);
					Marshal.Copy(attpsManrPlotInput2.RealParameters, 0, intPtr2, attpsManrPlotInput2.RealParameters.Length);
				}
				else
				{
					copyint32To64(attpsManrPlotInput.IntParameters, intPtr, attpsManrPlotInput.IntParameters.Length, 4);
					Marshal.Copy(attpsManrPlotInput.RealParameters, 0, intPtr2, attpsManrPlotInput.RealParameters.Length);
				}
				try
				{
					ATTPSREngine.TPSR_UpdateTrayForTODMasterObj(_TODMaster, iSECNO, trayID, intPtr, intPtr2);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					throw new CAErrorException($"Unexpected error happened in calling attpsr.dll!");
				}
				ATTPSREngine.TPSR_GetTrayInfoForTODMasterObj(_TODMaster, diagramSectionData.Trays[k].ReturnData.TrayID, out pdTLf, out pdTVf, out pdTL_weep, out pdTV_weep, out pdTL_ult, out pdTV_ult, out pdTL_dump, out pdTV_dump, out pdTL_ent, out pdTV_ent, out pdTL_dcb, out pdTV_dcb, out pdTL_maxdp, out pdTV_maxdp, out pdTL_comb, out pdTV_comb, out pdTL_low, out pdTV_low, out pdTL_high, out pdTV_high, out pdTL_range, out pdTV_range, out piTMechanism, out pdTOpPt, out dimension, out pdTraygeom, out piTMessages);
				try
				{
					ParseData(k, diagramSectionData, calculateCurve, curSection.WarningStatusLimit, curSection);
					SetUpdateGeometryCalculationResults(k, num2, trayNumber, stage, curSection, traySectionResultData, diagramSectionData);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(ex2.Message);
				}
			}
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
			cAAttpsrPlogDebugManger.ExportData(traySectionResultData, curSection.GetInternalType().ToString());
			ATTPSREngine.DestroyTODMasterObj(_TODMaster);
			_TODMaster = IntPtr.Zero;
			traySectionResultData.MaxeWeirLoading.Value = curSection.WeirLoadMaximum.Value;
			return traySectionResultData;
		}

		private void SetInputParameters(AttpsManrPlotInput inputMan, CAStage stage, CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption colSetting, int startStage, int endStage, bool calculateCurve)
		{
			int internalType = (int)curSection.InternalType;
			SetBaseSectionParameters(inputMan, curSection, startStage, endStage, internalType);
			inputMan.RealParameters[27] = stage.DensityLiquid.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[28] = stage.DensityVapor.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[29] = stage.ViscosityLiquid.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[30] = stage.ViscosityVapor.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[31] = stage.SurfaceTension.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[33] = stage.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[34] = stage.MassFlowVapor.Value;
			ValveTrayLayout valveTrayLayout = null;
			switch (internalType)
			{
			case 1:
				if (((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.Diameter.Value > 0)
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[13] = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.Diameter.Value;
				}
				if (inputMan.IntParameters[13] == 1)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[39] = 0.0762;
				}
				else if (inputMan.IntParameters[13] == 2)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[39] = 0.1016;
				}
				else if (inputMan.IntParameters[13] == 3)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[39] = 0.1524;
				}
				inputMan.IntParameters[14] = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.SkirtHeight.Value;
				if (((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value > 0)
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[15] = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value;
				}
				if (((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[40] = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value;
				}
				break;
			case 2:
			{
				int value = ((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.NumberOfHoles.Value;
				double value2 = ((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction.Value;
				if (((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.HoleAreaNumberSpec == 2)
				{
					if (((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.NumberOfHoles.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && value > 0 && value < 99999999)
					{
						inputMan.IntParameters[25] = value;
						inputMan.RealParameters[21] = 1E+35;
					}
					else if (((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && value2 > 0.0 && value2 < 1E+35)
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[21] = value2 * 100.0;
					}
					else
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[21] = 10.0;
						inputMan.IntParameters[25] = 99999999;
					}
				}
				else if (value2 > 0.0 && value2 < 1E+35)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[21] = value2 * 100.0;
					inputMan.IntParameters[25] = 99999999;
				}
				else if (((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.NumberOfHoles.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && value > 0 && value < 99999999)
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[25] = value;
					inputMan.RealParameters[21] = 1E+35;
				}
				else
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[21] = 10.0;
					inputMan.IntParameters[25] = 99999999;
				}
				if (((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.HoleDiameter.Value > 0.0)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[20] = ((CASieveTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.HoleDiameter.Value;
				}
				if (curSection.DowncomerArrangement.EnumString == DowncomerArrangementEnum.LATTICE.ToString())
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[27] = curSection.DowncomerArrangement.Value;
					if (curSection.NumberofDowncomers.Value > 0)
					{
						inputMan.IntParameters[28] = curSection.NumberofDowncomers.Value;
					}
					if (curSection.MDDowncomerWidth.Value > 0.0)
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[54] = curSection.MDDowncomerWidth.Value;
					}
					if (curSection.MDDowncomerEndGap.Value > 0.0)
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[55] = curSection.MDDowncomerEndGap.Value;
					}
					if (curSection.MDDowncomerSpacing.Value > 0.0)
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[56] = curSection.MDDowncomerSpacing.Value;
					}
					if (curSection.MDExitAreaRatio.Value > 0.0)
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[57] = curSection.MDExitAreaRatio.Value;
					}
					if (curSection.MDDowncomerHeight.Value > 0.0)
					{
						inputMan.RealParameters[58] = curSection.MDDowncomerHeight.Value;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case 3:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
				inputMan.IntParameters[9] = ((CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.GlitschValveType.Value;
				if (valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && valveTrayLayout.ValveDensityNumberSpec == 2)
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[16] = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value;
					inputMan.RealParameters[37] = 1E+35;
				}
				else if (valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[37] = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
					inputMan.IntParameters[16] = 99999999;
				}
				break;
			case 4:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
				inputMan.IntParameters[9] = ((KochFlexitrayValveTrayLayout)valveTrayLayout).KochValveType.Value;
				if (valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && valveTrayLayout.ValveDensityNumberSpec == 2)
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[16] = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value;
					inputMan.RealParameters[37] = 1E+35;
				}
				else if (valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[37] = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
					inputMan.IntParameters[16] = 99999999;
				}
				break;
			case 5:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CANutterFloatValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
				inputMan.IntParameters[9] = ((NutterFloatValveTrayLayout)valveTrayLayout).NutterValveType.Value;
				if (valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && valveTrayLayout.ValveDensityNumberSpec == 2)
				{
					inputMan.IntParameters[16] = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value;
					inputMan.RealParameters[37] = 1E+35;
				}
				else if (valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
				{
					inputMan.RealParameters[37] = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
					inputMan.IntParameters[16] = 99999999;
				}
				break;
			case 10:
				inputMan.IntParameters[29] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.TrayOpenType.Value;
				inputMan.IntParameters[30] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.HasDC.Value;
				inputMan.IntParameters[12] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.CustomValveMaterial.Value;
				inputMan.IntParameters[16] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.CustomValveNumbers.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[59] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.ActiveAreaRatio.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[60] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.TotalWeirLength.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[61] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.TotalDCHeight.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[62] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.DCAreaRatio.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[63] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.LiqExitAreaRatio.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[64] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.ClearLiqHeight.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[66] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.ConstantBeforeLiqReynoldsNumber.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[67] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.PowerOfLiqReynoldsNumber.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[38] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.CustomValveLift.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[42] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.CustomValveThickness.Value;
				inputMan.RealParameters[21] = ((CACustomTraySectionData)curSection).TrayLayout.OpenAreaRatio.Value * 100.0;
				inputMan.RealParameters[20] = 0.0127;
				break;
			}
			if (internalType >= 3 && internalType <= 5)
			{
				SetValveLayoutParameters(valveTrayLayout, inputMan, curSection);
			}
			else if (internalType != 10 || inputMan.IntParameters[29] <= 0)
			{
				inputMan.RealParameters[38] = 1E+35;
				inputMan.RealParameters[42] = 1E+35;
			}
			if (calculateCurve)
			{
				inputMan.IntParameters[20] = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				inputMan.IntParameters[20] = 0;
			}
			SetSweptBackAndPickingWeirParameters(inputMan, curSection);
			if (colSetting != null && colSetting.IncludeStaticVaporHeadPDCalc)
			{
				inputMan.IntParameters[23] = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				inputMan.IntParameters[23] = 0;
			}
			if (curSection.OverideDowncomerFrothDensity)
			{
				inputMan.RealParameters[43] = curSection.DowncomerFrothDensity.Value;
			}
			inputMan.IntParameters[24] = curSection.MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethod.Value;
			if (curSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
			{
				inputMan.RealParameters[53] = curSection.PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value;
			}
		}

		private void SetBaseSectionParameters(AttpsManrPlotInput inputMan, CATraySectionData curSection, int startStage, int endStage, int nTrayType)
		{
			inputMan.IntParameters[0] = 1;
			inputMan.IntParameters[1] = startStage;

			if (curSection.VUnitIndex.Value == 6)
			{
				inputMan.IntParameters[7] = 4;

			inputMan.IntParameters[8] = nTrayType;

			inputMan.RealParameters[1] = curSection.Diameter.Value;

			inputMan.RealParameters[7] = curSection.Weirs[3].Height.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[8] = curSection.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[9] = curSection.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[10] = curSection.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[11] = curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[12] = curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[13] = curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;

			{

			else

			}
			inputMan.IntParameters[17] = 1;
			inputMan.IntParameters[18] = (curSection.AreaUnderDCAsBubblingArea ? 1 : 0);
			inputMan.IntParameters[19] = (curSection.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays ? 1 : 0);
			inputMan.IntParameters[32] = curSection.OldCorrelation.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[41] = ((OffCenterDowncomer)curSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[32] = curSection.MaximumFractionalEntrainment.Value;

			inputMan.RealParameters[36] = curSection.MaxDowncomerBackup.Value;
			inputMan.RealParameters[65] = curSection.DryDPMultiplier.Value;
		}

		}

		private void SetUpdateGeometryCalculationResults(int i, int realStageNumber, int trayNumber, CAStage stage, CATraySectionData curSection, TraySectionResultData sectionResultData, DiagramSectionData diagramSec)
		{
			if (realStageNumber == curSection.StartStage.Value)
			{
				int value = curSection.NumberofPasses.Value;
				if (curSection.IsMDTray == false && curSection.InternalType != InternalsTypeEnum.CustomTray)
				{
					if (value == 1)
					{
						sectionResultData.OnePassTrayFlowPathLength.Value = SummaryInfo[59];
					}
					CADCSideResultData obj = sectionResultData.Downcomers[0] as CADCSideResultData;
					CADCCenterResultData cADCCenterResultData = sectionResultData.Downcomers[1] as CADCCenterResultData;
					CADCOffCenterResultData cADCOffCenterResultData = sectionResultData.Downcomers[2] as CADCOffCenterResultData;
					obj.WeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[54];
					obj.FractOfSideWeirLengthPicketed.Value = SummaryInfo[93];
					obj.ProjectedWeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[102];
					obj.TotalWeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[103];
					obj.FractionActiveAreaLostToSideWeir.Value = SummaryInfo[104];
					if (value == 2 || value == 4)
					{
						cADCCenterResultData.WeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[55];
						cADCCenterResultData.FractOfCenterWeirLengthPicketed.Value = SummaryInfo[90];
					}
					if (value == 3 || value == 4)
					{
						cADCOffCenterResultData.InsideWeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[56];
						cADCOffCenterResultData.OutsideWeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[57];
						cADCOffCenterResultData.CenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = SummaryInfo[58];
						cADCOffCenterResultData.FractOfInsideOffCenterWeirLengthPicketed.Value = SummaryInfo[91];
						cADCOffCenterResultData.FractOfOutsideOffCenterWeirLengthPicketed.Value = SummaryInfo[92];
					}
				}
				if (curSection is CASieveTraySectionData)
				{
					sectionResultData.NumberOfHoles.Value = (int)diagramSec.Trays[0].ReturnData.SummaryInfo[86];
					if (sectionResultData.NumberOfHoles.Value == 0)
					{
						sectionResultData.NumberOfHoles.Value = 1;
					}
				}
				sectionResultData.XSectionalArea.Value = diagramSec.Trays[0].ReturnData.SummaryInfo[87];
				sectionResultData.ActiveArea.Value = diagramSec.Trays[0].ReturnData.SummaryInfo[88];
				sectionResultData.NetArea.Value = diagramSec.Trays[0].ReturnData.SummaryInfo[89];
			}
			TrayHydraulicPerformance trayHydraulicPerformance = new TrayHydraulicPerformance(stage);
			trayHydraulicPerformance.TrayNumber.Value = trayNumber;
			TrayPressureDropUnit value2 = (TrayPressureDropUnit)curSection.TrayPressureDropType.Value;
			trayHydraulicPerformance.InitTrayHydraulicPerformanceData(diagramSec.Trays[i].ReturnData.SummaryInfo, value2, curSection);
			sectionResultData.HydraulicResults[trayNumber] = trayHydraulicPerformance;
			if (curSection.IsMDTray == true)
			{
				sectionResultData.IsMDTray = true;
				sectionResultData.MD_TotalDCArea.Value = SummaryInfo[110];
				sectionResultData.MD_LiquidExitArea.Value = SummaryInfo[111];
				sectionResultData.MD_AverageFlowPathLength.Value = SummaryInfo[106];
				sectionResultData.MD_TotalWeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[105];
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[0].DowncomerSignature = MDDowncomerSignatureEnum.Longest.ToString();
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[0].DowncomerArea.Value = SummaryInfo[42];
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[0].WeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[54];
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[1].DowncomerSignature = MDDowncomerSignatureEnum.Median.ToString();
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[1].DowncomerArea.Value = SummaryInfo[44];
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[1].WeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[55];
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[2].DowncomerSignature = MDDowncomerSignatureEnum.Shortest.ToString();
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[2].DowncomerArea.Value = SummaryInfo[46];
				sectionResultData.MD_Downcomers[2].WeirLength.Value = SummaryInfo[56];
				sectionResultData.MDDowncomerWidth.Value = curSection.MDDowncomerWidth.Value;
				sectionResultData.MDDowncomerEndGap.Value = curSection.MDDowncomerEndGap.Value;
				sectionResultData.MDDowncomerHeight.Value = curSection.MDDowncomerHeight.Value;
				sectionResultData.MDDowncomerSpacing.Value = curSection.MDDowncomerSpacing.Value;
				sectionResultData.NumberofDowncomers.Value = curSection.NumberofDowncomers.Value;
				sectionResultData.MDWeirHeight.Value = curSection.Weirs[0].Height.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				sectionResultData.IsMDTray = false;
			}
			if (curSection is CACustomTraySectionData cACustomTraySectionData)
			{
				sectionResultData.IsCustomTray = true;
				sectionResultData.OpenAreaRatio = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.OpenAreaRatio;
				sectionResultData.TotalLiquidExitArea.Value = SummaryInfo[111];
				sectionResultData.ClearLiquidHeight = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.ClearLiqHeight;
				sectionResultData.TotalDCArea.Value = SummaryInfo[110];
				sectionResultData.TotalWeirLength = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.TotalWeirLength;
				sectionResultData.DowncomerHeight = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.TotalDCHeight;
				sectionResultData.WeirHeight.Value = curSection.Weirs[0].Height.Value;
				sectionResultData.CustomValveNumbers = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveNumbers;
				sectionResultData.IsCustomTrayHasDC = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.HasDC.Value == 1;
				sectionResultData.CustomValveLift = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveLift;
				sectionResultData.CustomValveThickness = cACustomTraySectionData.TrayLayout.CustomValveThickness;
			}
			else
			{
				sectionResultData.IsCustomTray = false;
			}
		}

		private void ParseData(int index, DiagramSectionData diagramSec, bool calculateCurve, CARealVariable warningLimit, CATraySectionData curSection)
		{
			int num = 125;
			int num2 = 100;
			TrayReturnData trayReturnData = null;
			trayReturnData = (diagramSec.Trays[index].ReturnData.bInitialized ? diagramSec.Trays[index].ReturnData : new TrayReturnData());
			if (calculateCurve)
			{
				JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[dimension];
				Mechanism = new int[dimension];
				MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[2];
				MinimumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[2];
				MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new double[2];
				MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints = new double[2];
				Marshal.Copy(pdTLf, JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTVf, JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_weep, WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_weep, WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_ult, UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_ult, UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_dump, DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_dump, DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_ent, MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_ent, MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_dcb, DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_dcb, DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_maxdp, MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_maxdp, MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_comb, CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_comb, CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, dimension);
				copyint64To32(piTMechanism, ref Mechanism, dimension, 8);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_low, MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, 2);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_low, MinimumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, 2);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTL_high, MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints, 0, 2);
				Marshal.Copy(pdTV_high, MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints, 0, 2);
				trayReturnData.DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints = new List<double>();
				trayReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints = new List<double>();

		public static long GetInt64ValueAtIndex(IntPtr intLocation, int index, int sizeofitem)
		{
			return Marshal.ReadInt64(intLocation, index * sizeofitem);
		}

		public static int GetInt32ValueAtIndex(IntPtr intLocation, int index, int sizeofitem)
		{
			return Marshal.ReadInt32(intLocation, index * sizeofitem);
		}

		public static void SetInt32ValueAtIndex(IntPtr intLocation, int index, int iValue, int sizeofitem)
		{
			Marshal.WriteInt32(intLocation, index * sizeofitem, iValue);
		}

		public static void SetInt64ValueAtIndex(IntPtr intLocation, int index, long lValue, int sizeofitem)
		{
			Marshal.WriteInt64(intLocation, index * sizeofitem, lValue);
		}

		public static void copyint64To32(IntPtr int64Loc, ref int[] int32Loc, int numItems, int sizeofitem)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < numItems; i++)
			{
				long int64ValueAtIndex = GetInt64ValueAtIndex(int64Loc, i, sizeofitem);
				int32Loc[i] = (int)int64ValueAtIndex;
			}
		}

		public static void copyint32To64(int[] int32Loc, IntPtr int64Loc, int numItems, int sizeofitem)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < numItems; i++)
			{
				long lValue = int32Loc[i];
				SetInt64ValueAtIndex(int64Loc, i, lValue, sizeofitem);
			}
		}

				CASieveSectionDefaultValue cASieveSectionDefaultValue = new CASieveSectionDefaultValue();
				cASectionDefaultValue = cASieveSectionDefaultValue;
				cASieveSectionDefaultValue.WeepCalculationMethod.Value = dest[3];
				cASieveSectionDefaultValue.HoleDiameter.Value = array5[3];
				if (curSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
				{
					cASieveSectionDefaultValue.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction.Value = array5[4] / 100.0;
					cASieveSectionDefaultValue.NumberOfHoles.Value = dest[15];
				}
				break;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				CASectionDefaultValue cASectionDefaultValue4 = (cASectionDefaultValue = new CAGlitschSectionDefaultValue());
				((CAGlitschSectionDefaultValue)cASectionDefaultValue4).GlitschValveType.Value = dest[5];
				((CAValveSectionDefaultValue)cASectionDefaultValue4).ValveThickness.Value = 4;
				break;
			}
			case 4:
			{
				CAKochSectionDefaultValue cAKochSectionDefaultValue = new CAKochSectionDefaultValue();
				cASectionDefaultValue = cAKochSectionDefaultValue;
				cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value = dest[6];
				if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 3)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 4;
				}
				else if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 4)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 3;
				}
				else if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 5)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 4;
				}
				else if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 6)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 3;
				}
				else if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 7)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 2;
				}
				else if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 8)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 2;
				}
				else if (cAKochSectionDefaultValue.KochValveType.Value == 12)
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 99999999;
				}
				else
				{
					cAKochSectionDefaultValue.ValveThickness.Value = 4;
				}
				break;
			}
			case 5:
			{
				CASectionDefaultValue cASectionDefaultValue2 = (cASectionDefaultValue = new CANutterSectionDefaultValue());
				((CANutterSectionDefaultValue)cASectionDefaultValue2).NutterValveType.Value = dest[7];
				((CAValveSectionDefaultValue)cASectionDefaultValue2).ValveThickness.Value = 4;
				break;
			}
			case 10:
				cASectionDefaultValue = new CACustomSectionDefaultValue();
				break;
			}
			if (cASectionDefaultValue is CAValveSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				CAValveSectionDefaultValue cAValveSectionDefaultValue = cASectionDefaultValue as CAValveSectionDefaultValue;
				cAValveSectionDefaultValue.ValveMaterial.Value = dest[13];
				double num2 = array5[23];
				if (Math.Abs(num2 - 0.00795) < 1E-06)
				{
					cAValveSectionDefaultValue.ValveLift.Value = 1;
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(num2 - 0.00953) < 1E-06)
				{
					cAValveSectionDefaultValue.ValveLift.Value = 2;
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(num2 - 0.01113) < 1E-06)
				{
					cAValveSectionDefaultValue.ValveLift.Value = 3;
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(num2 - 0.0127) < 1E-06)
				{
					cAValveSectionDefaultValue.ValveLift.Value = 4;
				}
				cAValveSectionDefaultValue.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value = array5[21];
			}
			SetBaseDefaultValue(curSection, cASectionDefaultValue, curSection.NumberofPasses.Value, dest, array5);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr3);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr4);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr5);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
			ATTPSREngine.DestroyTODMasterObj(_TODMaster);
			_TODMaster = IntPtr.Zero;
			return cASectionDefaultValue;
		}

		private void SetBaseDefaultValue(CATraySectionData curSection, CASectionDefaultValue defaultValue, int numberofPasses, int[] defaultValues_int, double[] defaultValues_real)
		{
			if (defaultValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 1E-09;
			defaultValue.Diameter.Value = defaultValues_real[0];
			defaultValue.NumberofPasses.Value = defaultValues_int[1];
			if (!defaultValue.NumberofPasses.IsEmpty())
			{
				numberofPasses = defaultValue.NumberofPasses.Value;
			}
			defaultValue.FloodingCalculationMethod.Value = defaultValues_int[2];
			defaultValue.MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethod.Value = defaultValues_int[4];
			defaultValue.TraySpacing.Value = defaultValues_real[1];
			defaultValue.WeirHeightSide.Value = defaultValues_real[2];
			if (numberofPasses >= 2)
			{
				defaultValue.WeirHeightCenter.Value = defaultValues_real[2];
			}
			if (numberofPasses >= 3)
			{
				defaultValue.WeirHeightOffCenterInside.Value = defaultValues_real[2];
				defaultValue.WeirHeightOffCenterOutSide.Value = defaultValues_real[2];
			}
			defaultValue.DeckThickness.Value = defaultValues_real[5];
			if (!curSection.DeckThicknessIntEnum.IsEmpty())
			{
				defaultValue.DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value = curSection.DeckThicknessIntEnum.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				defaultValue.SetDeckThicknessIntEnum(defaultValue.DeckThickness.Value);
			}
			defaultValue.SystemFoamingFactor.Value = defaultValues_real[6];
			defaultValue.AerationFactorMultiplier.Value = defaultValues_real[7];
			defaultValue.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value = defaultValues_real[8];
			if (!curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.IsEmpty() && curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && Math.Abs(curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value - defaultValues_real[9]) > num)
			{
				defaultValue.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				defaultValue.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = defaultValues_real[9];
			}
			defaultValue.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = defaultValues_real[9];
			if (defaultValue.WeirHeightSide.Value < defaultValue.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value)
			{
				defaultValue.WeirHeightSide.Value = defaultValue.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value;
			}
			if (numberofPasses == 2 || numberofPasses == 4)
			{
				defaultValue.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value = defaultValues_real[8];
				if (!curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.IsEmpty() && curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && Math.Abs(curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value - defaultValue.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value) > num)
				{
					defaultValue.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultValue.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = defaultValues_real[10];
				}
				defaultValue.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = defaultValues_real[10];
				if (defaultValue.WeirHeightCenter.Value < defaultValue.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value)
				{
					defaultValue.WeirHeightCenter.Value = defaultValue.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value;
				}
			}
			if (numberofPasses == 3 || numberofPasses == 4)
			{
				defaultValue.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value = defaultValues_real[8];
				if (!curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.IsEmpty() && curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && Math.Abs(curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value - defaultValue.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value) > num)
				{
					defaultValue.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultValue.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = defaultValues_real[11];
				}
				defaultValue.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = defaultValues_real[11];
				if (defaultValue.WeirHeightOffCenterInside.Value < defaultValue.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value)
				{
					defaultValue.WeirHeightOffCenterInside.Value = defaultValue.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value;
				}
				defaultValue.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = defaultValues_real[12];
			}
			defaultValue.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value = defaultValues_real[13];
			defaultValue.MaximumPressureDrop.Value = defaultValues_real[14];
			defaultValue.MaxPercentJetFlood.Value = defaultValues_real[15];
			defaultValue.MaxDowncomerBackup.Value = defaultValues_real[16];
			defaultValue.MaximumFractionalEntrainment.Value = defaultValues_real[17];
			defaultValue.WeirLoadMaximum.Value = defaultValues_real[18];
			defaultValue.WeirLoadMinimum.Value = defaultValues_real[19];
			defaultValue.OverdesignFactor.Value = defaultValues_real[20];
			defaultValue.MinimumDiameter.Value = defaultValues_real[26];
			defaultValue.PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value = defaultValues_real[27];
		}
