		protected void CaculateCapValvetDensityForDefault(CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CASectionDefaultValue defaultValue)
		{
			CABalancedData cABalancedData = new CABalancedData();
			List<TrayGeometryInputData> updateTrayGeometryDataFromDefault = GetUpdateTrayGeometryDataFromDefault(curSection, columnData, defaultValue);
			ValveTrayLayout valveTrayLayout = null;
			CAIntegerVariable cAIntegerVariable = new CAIntegerVariable();
			switch ((int)curSection.InternalType)
			{
			case 1:
				cAIntegerVariable.Value = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value;
				cAIntegerVariable.VariableStatus = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.VariableStatus;
				break;
			case 3:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
				break;
			case 4:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
				break;
			case 5:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CANutterFloatValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
				break;
			}
			if (valveTrayLayout != null)
			{
				cAIntegerVariable.Value = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value;
				cAIntegerVariable.VariableStatus = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.VariableStatus;
			}
			if (cAIntegerVariable.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = cAIntegerVariable.Value;
			}
			if (defaultValue is CAValveSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				CAValveSectionDefaultValue cAValveSectionDefaultValue = defaultValue as CAValveSectionDefaultValue;
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = cAValveSectionDefaultValue.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
			}
			else if (defaultValue is CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue cABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue = defaultValue as CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue;
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = cABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value;
			}
			UpdateTrayGeometry(curSection, columnData, cABalancedData, updateTrayGeometryDataFromDefault);
			double tolerance = 1E-09;
			if (curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Bubble_Cap || curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Glitsch_Ballast || curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Koch_Flexitray || curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Nutter_Float_Valve)
			{
				double value = defaultValue.Diameter.Value;
				ValvesCapsNumberOrDensity valvesCapsNumberOrDensity = CalculateValvesCapsNumberOrDensity(curSection, value, tolerance, cABalancedData.DCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value, cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value, cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value);
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
			}
			if (defaultValue is CAValveSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				CAValveSectionDefaultValue obj = defaultValue as CAValveSectionDefaultValue;
				obj.NumberOfValves.Value = cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
				obj.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value = cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
			}
			else if (defaultValue is CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue obj2 = defaultValue as CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue;
				obj2.NumberOfCaps.Value = cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
				obj2.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value = cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
			}
		}

		protected void CalcuateSweptBackAndPicket(CATraySectionData curSection, CAStage maximumStage, CASectionDefaultValue defaultValue)
		{
			if (curSection == null || maximumStage == null || defaultValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_TODMaster == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				_TODMaster = ATTPSREngine.CreateTODMasterObj();
			}
			int[] array = new int[10];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = 99999999;
			}
			double[] array2 = new double[20];
			for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
			{
				array2[j] = 1E+35;
			}
			array[0] = defaultValue.NumberofPasses.Value;
			if (curSection.SweptBackENAB.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				array[1] = curSection.SweptBackENAB.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.SweptBackType.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				array[2] = curSection.SweptBackType.Value;
			}
			array[3] = (curSection.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays ? 1 : 0);
			array2[0] = defaultValue.Diameter.Value;
			array2[1] = defaultValue.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			array2[2] = defaultValue.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			array2[3] = defaultValue.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			array2[4] = defaultValue.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			array2[5] = defaultValue.WeirLoadMinimum.Value;
			array2[6] = defaultValue.WeirLoadMaximum.Value;
			if (curSection.SweptBackDimensionS.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

			}
			if (curSection.SweptBackDimensionA.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

			if (curSection.SweptBackDimensionB.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

			if (curSection.SweptBackDimensionSF.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

			if (curSection.SweptBackDimensionWF.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

			if (curSection.Weirs[0].PicketingFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				array2[12] = curSection.Weirs[0].PicketingFraction.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Weirs[1].PicketingFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				array2[13] = curSection.Weirs[1].PicketingFraction.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Weirs[2].PicketingFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				array2[14] = curSection.Weirs[2].PicketingFraction.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Weirs[3].PicketingFraction.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				array2[15] = curSection.Weirs[3].PicketingFraction.Value;
			}
			double[] array3 = new double[15];
			double value = maximumStage.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
			double value2 = maximumStage.MassFlowVapor.Value;
			double value3 = maximumStage.DensityLiquid.Value;
			double value4 = maximumStage.DensityVapor.Value;
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(120);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 10);
			IntPtr intPtr3 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(160);
			IntPtr[] dest = new IntPtr[array.Length];
			ArrayCopy(array, ref dest, array.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(dest, 0, intPtr2, array.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(array2, 0, intPtr3, array2.Length);
			ATTPSREngine.ATTPSR_TOD_SWBACK_PICKET(value, value2, value3, value4, intPtr2, intPtr3, intPtr);
			Marshal.Copy(intPtr, array3, 0, array3.Length);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr3);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			if (curSection.SweptBackENAB.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)

			else
			{
				defaultValue.SweptBackENAB.Value = 0;
			}
			if (defaultValue.SweptBackENAB.Value == 1)
			{
				if (curSection.SweptBackType.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					defaultValue.SweptBackType.Value = curSection.SweptBackType.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultValue.SweptBackType.Value = 1;
				}
			}
			defaultValue.SweptBackDimensionS.Value = array3[0];
			defaultValue.SweptBackDimensionA.Value = array3[1];
			defaultValue.SweptBackDimensionB.Value = array3[2];

			defaultValue.OffCenterInsideWeirPicketFraction.Value = array3[7];

		}

		protected void UpdateTrayDefaultWithBalancedDimension(CASectionDefaultValue rTrayDefault, CABalancedDCInputData balancedInputData)
		{
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = balancedInputData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = balancedInputData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = balancedInputData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = balancedInputData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = ((OffCenterDowncomer)balancedInputData.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			if (rTrayDefault is CAValveSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				((CAValveSectionDefaultValue)rTrayDefault).NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value = balancedInputData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
				((CAValveSectionDefaultValue)rTrayDefault).NumberOfValves.Value = balancedInputData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
			}
			else if (rTrayDefault is CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue)
			{
				((CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue)rTrayDefault).NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value = balancedInputData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
				((CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue)rTrayDefault).NumberOfCaps.Value = balancedInputData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
			}
			rTrayDefault.SideWeirLength.Value = balancedInputData.SideWeirLength.Value;
			rTrayDefault.CenterWeirLength.Value = balancedInputData.CenterWeirLength.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = balancedInputData.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value;
			rTrayDefault.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = balancedInputData.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value;
		}

		protected CABalancedData BalanceDowncomer(CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CASectionDefaultValue rDefault = null)
		{
			if (curSection == null || columnData == null || curSection.NumberofPasses.Value < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_TODMaster == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				_TODMaster = ATTPSREngine.CreateTODMasterObj();
			}
			CABalancedData cABalancedData = new CABalancedData();
			int num = 1;
			int[] intInput = new int[25];
			for (int i = 0; i < intInput.Length; i++)
			{
				intInput[i] = 99999999;
			}
			double[] realInput = new double[25];
			for (int j = 0; j < realInput.Length; j++)
			{
				realInput[j] = 1E+35;
			}
			IntPtr[] array = new IntPtr[25];
			for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
			{
				array[k] = (IntPtr)1;
			}
			if (rDefault == null)
			{
				SetBalanceInputWithSectionData(curSection, columnData, ref intInput, ref realInput);
			}
			else
			{
				SetBalanceInputWithSectionDataAndDefault(curSection, columnData, rDefault, ref intInput, ref realInput);
			}
			_ = curSection.EndingStage.Value;
			_ = curSection.StartStage.Value;
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 25);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(200);
			IntPtr intPtr3 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 25);
			IntPtr intPtr4 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(200);
			IntPtr intPtr5 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 25);
			double[] array2 = new double[25];
			IntPtr[] dest = new IntPtr[intInput.Length];
			ArrayCopy(intInput, ref dest, intInput.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(intInput, 0, intPtr3, intInput.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(realInput, 0, intPtr4, realInput.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(array, 0, intPtr5, array.Length);
			if (curSection.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.Value != 2)
			{
				CAStage cAStage = columnData.Stages[curSection.StartStage.Value - num];
				realInput[9] = cAStage.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
				realInput[10] = cAStage.MassFlowVapor.Value;
				realInput[11] = cAStage.DensityLiquid.Value;
				realInput[12] = cAStage.DensityVapor.Value;
				copyint32To64(intInput, intPtr3, intInput.Length, IntPtr.Size);
				Marshal.Copy(realInput, 0, intPtr4, realInput.Length);
				Marshal.Copy(array, 0, intPtr5, array.Length);
				ATTPSREngine.ATTPSR_TOD_DCBALANCE(intPtr3, intPtr4, intPtr, intPtr2, intPtr5);
				Marshal.Copy(intPtr2, array2, 0, array2.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				int baseStageForSizing = columnData.GetBaseStageForSizing(curSection.StartStage.Value, curSection.EndingStage.Value, 1);
				CAStage cAStage2 = columnData.Stages[baseStageForSizing - 1];
				realInput[9] = cAStage2.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
				realInput[10] = cAStage2.MassFlowVapor.Value;
				realInput[11] = cAStage2.DensityLiquid.Value;
				realInput[12] = cAStage2.DensityVapor.Value;
				copyint32To64(intInput, intPtr3, intInput.Length, IntPtr.Size);
				Marshal.Copy(realInput, 0, intPtr4, realInput.Length);
				Marshal.Copy(array, 0, intPtr5, array.Length);
				ATTPSREngine.ATTPSR_TOD_DCBALANCE(intPtr3, intPtr4, intPtr, intPtr2, intPtr5);
				Marshal.Copy(intPtr2, array2, 0, array2.Length);
			}
			double tolerance = 1E-09;
			cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = array2[0];
			cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = array2[1];
			cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].AreaTop.Value = array2[3];
			cABalancedData.Downcomers[0].AreaBottom.Value = array2[4];
			if (curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 2 || curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
			{
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = array2[5];
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = array2[6];
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].AreaTop.Value = array2[8];
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[1].AreaBottom.Value = array2[9];
			}
			if (curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
			{
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = array2[10];
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = array2[11];
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].AreaTop.Value = array2[13];
				cABalancedData.Downcomers[2].AreaBottom.Value = array2[14];
				((CADCOffCenterResultData)cABalancedData.Downcomers[2]).CenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = array2[12];
			}
			List<TrayGeometryInputData> updateTrayGeometryData_Balance = GetUpdateTrayGeometryData_Balance(curSection, columnData, cABalancedData, 1);
			if (updateTrayGeometryData_Balance != null && updateTrayGeometryData_Balance.Count > 0)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (!curSection.Diameter.IsEmpty())
				{
					num2 = curSection.Diameter.Value;
				}
				else if (rDefault != null)
				{
					num2 = rDefault.Diameter.Value;
				}
				updateTrayGeometryData_Balance[0].RealInput[0] = num2;
			}
			if (rDefault == null)
			{
				ParseInputSectionDenstityData(curSection, cABalancedData);
			}
			else
			{
				if (rDefault is CAValveSectionDefaultValue)
				{
					CAValveSectionDefaultValue cAValveSectionDefaultValue = rDefault as CAValveSectionDefaultValue;
					cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = cAValveSectionDefaultValue.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
				}
				else if (rDefault is CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue)
				{
					CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue cABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue = rDefault as CABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue;
					cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = cABubbleCapSectionDefaultValue.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value;
				}
				ValveTrayLayout valveTrayLayout = null;
				CAIntegerVariable cAIntegerVariable = new CAIntegerVariable();
				switch ((int)curSection.InternalType)
				{
				case 1:
					cAIntegerVariable.Value = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value;
					cAIntegerVariable.VariableStatus = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.VariableStatus;
					break;
				case 3:
					valveTrayLayout = ((CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
					break;
				case 4:
					valveTrayLayout = ((CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
					break;
				case 5:
					valveTrayLayout = ((CANutterFloatValveTraySection)curSection).TrayLayout;
					break;
				}
				if (valveTrayLayout != null)
				{
					cAIntegerVariable.Value = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value;
					cAIntegerVariable.VariableStatus = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.VariableStatus;
				}
				if (cAIntegerVariable.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = cAIntegerVariable.Value;
				}
			}
			UpdateTrayGeometry(curSection, columnData, cABalancedData, updateTrayGeometryData_Balance);
			if (curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Bubble_Cap || curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Glitsch_Ballast || curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Koch_Flexitray || curSection.InternalType == InternalsTypeEnum.Nutter_Float_Valve)
			{
				double diameter = 0.0;
				if (rDefault != null && rDefault.Diameter.Value > 0.0)
				{
					diameter = rDefault.Diameter.Value;
				}
				else if (!curSection.Diameter.IsEmpty())
				{
					diameter = curSection.Diameter.Value;
				}
				ValvesCapsNumberOrDensity valvesCapsNumberOrDensity = CalculateValvesCapsNumberOrDensity(curSection, diameter, tolerance, cABalancedData.DCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value, cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value, cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value);
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value;
				cABalancedData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value;
			}
			CalcuateWeirLength_Balance(curSection, cABalancedData, rDefault);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr3);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr4);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr5);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
			ATTPSREngine.DestroyTODMasterObj(_TODMaster);
			_TODMaster = IntPtr.Zero;
			return cABalancedData;
		}

		private void SetBalanceInputWithSectionData(CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, ref int[] intInput, ref double[] realInput)
		{
			if (curSection.NumberofPasses.Value > 0)
			{
				intInput[0] = curSection.NumberofPasses.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.Value == 0)
			{
				intInput[1] = 1;
				intInput[2] = 0;
				intInput[3] = 0;
				intInput[5] = (int)curSection.InternalType;
			}
			else if (curSection.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.Value == 1)
			{
				intInput[1] = 0;
				intInput[2] = 1;
				intInput[3] = 0;
				intInput[5] = (int)curSection.InternalType;
			}
			else if (curSection.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.Value == 2)
			{
				intInput[1] = 0;
				intInput[2] = 0;
				intInput[3] = 1;
				intInput[4] = curSection.MaximumDowncomerLoadingMethod.Value;
				intInput[5] = (int)curSection.InternalType;
			}
			if (curSection.DowncomerDesignBasis.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				intInput[6] = curSection.DowncomerDesignBasis.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Diameter.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[0] = curSection.Diameter.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.TraySpacing.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[1] = curSection.TraySpacing.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[2] = curSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[3] = curSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[4] = curSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[5] = curSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[6] = curSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[7] = curSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			double value = ((OffCenterDowncomer)curSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			if (value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[8] = value;
			}
			if (curSection.SystemFoamingFactor.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[13] = curSection.SystemFoamingFactor.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[14] = curSection.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value;
			}
			realInput[15] = curSection.PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value;
		}

				intInput[1] = 0;
				intInput[2] = 1;

			}

				intInput[1] = 0;

				intInput[3] = 1;

			{

			if (rDefault.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[4] = rDefault.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !curSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.IsEmpty())
			{
				realInput[5] = curSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			else if (rDefault.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[5] = rDefault.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			if (rDefault.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[6] = rDefault.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (curSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !curSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.IsEmpty())
			{
				realInput[7] = curSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			else if (rDefault.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[7] = rDefault.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
			}
			double value = rDefault.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			if (value > 0.0)
			{

			}
			if (rDefault.SystemFoamingFactor.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[13] = rDefault.SystemFoamingFactor.Value;

			if (rDefault.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value > 0.0)
			{
				realInput[14] = rDefault.MinimumDCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value;

		private void UpdateTrayGeometry(CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CABalancedData resultData, List<TrayGeometryInputData> rInputDataAll)
		{
			if (curSection == null || columnData == null || resultData == null || rInputDataAll == null || rInputDataAll.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Parameters are null when calling UpdateTrayGeometry.");
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 25);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(200);
			IntPtr intPtr3 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 25);
			IntPtr intPtr4 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(200);
			IntPtr intPtr5 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size * 25);
			List<GeometryResultsData> list = new List<GeometryResultsData>();
			TrayGeometryInputData trayGeometryInputData = rInputDataAll[0];
			IntPtr[] dest = new IntPtr[trayGeometryInputData.IntInput.Length];
			IntPtr[] dest2 = new IntPtr[trayGeometryInputData.ArrayInt.Length];
			ArrayCopy(trayGeometryInputData.IntInput, ref dest, dest.Length);
			ArrayCopy(trayGeometryInputData.ArrayInt, ref dest2, dest2.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(dest, 0, intPtr3, trayGeometryInputData.IntInput.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(trayGeometryInputData.RealInput, 0, intPtr4, trayGeometryInputData.RealInput.Length);
			Marshal.Copy(dest2, 0, intPtr5, trayGeometryInputData.ArrayInt.Length);
			ATTPSREngine.ATTPSR_TOD_GEOMETRY(intPtr3, intPtr4, intPtr, intPtr2, intPtr5);
			GeometryResultsData geometryResultsData = new GeometryResultsData();
			Marshal.Copy(intPtr2, geometryResultsData.GeometryRealValues, 0, geometryResultsData.GeometryRealValues.Length);
			list.Add(geometryResultsData);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr3);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr4);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr5);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
			ParsGeometryValue(list, curSection, resultData);
		}

		private void ParseInputSectionDenstityData(CATraySectionData sourceSection, CABalancedData balanceData)
		{
			int internalType = (int)sourceSection.InternalType;
			ValveTrayLayout valveTrayLayout = null;
			switch (internalType)
			{
			case 1:
				balanceData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)sourceSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value;
				balanceData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = ((CABubbleCapTraySection)sourceSection).TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value;
				break;
			case 3:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection)sourceSection).TrayLayout;
				break;
			case 4:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection)sourceSection).TrayLayout;
				break;
			case 5:
				valveTrayLayout = ((CANutterFloatValveTraySection)sourceSection).TrayLayout;
				break;
			}
			if (valveTrayLayout != null)
			{
				balanceData.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value;
				balanceData.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = valveTrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value;
			}
		}

		internal void ParsGeometryValue(List<GeometryResultsData> allStagesGeomtryResults, CATraySectionData curSection, CABalancedData resultData)
		{
			if (allStagesGeomtryResults != null && curSection != null && allStagesGeomtryResults != null && allStagesGeomtryResults.Count != 0 && curSection.IsMDTray != true && curSection.InternalType != InternalsTypeEnum.CustomTray)
			{
				double[] geometryRealValues = allStagesGeomtryResults[0].GeometryRealValues;
				resultData.Downcomers[0].AreaTop.Value = geometryRealValues[0];
				resultData.Downcomers[0].AreaBottom.Value = geometryRealValues[1];
				resultData.Downcomers[0].LoadingTop.Value = geometryRealValues[2];
				if (curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 2 || curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					resultData.Downcomers[1].AreaTop.Value = geometryRealValues[4];
					resultData.Downcomers[1].AreaBottom.Value = geometryRealValues[5];
					resultData.Downcomers[1].LoadingTop.Value = geometryRealValues[6];
				}
				if (curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 3 || curSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4)
				{
					resultData.Downcomers[2].AreaTop.Value = geometryRealValues[8];
					resultData.Downcomers[2].AreaBottom.Value = geometryRealValues[9];
					resultData.Downcomers[2].LoadingTop.Value = geometryRealValues[10];
				}
				resultData.FlowPathLengthPanelA.Value = geometryRealValues[12];
				resultData.FlowPathLengthPanelB.Value = geometryRealValues[13];
				resultData.FlowPathLengthPanelC.Value = geometryRealValues[14];
				resultData.FlowPathLengthPanelD.Value = geometryRealValues[15];
				resultData.DCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value = geometryRealValues[16];
				resultData.BubblingAreaPanelA.Value = geometryRealValues[17];
				resultData.BubblingAreaPanelB.Value = geometryRealValues[18];
				resultData.BubblingAreaPanelC.Value = geometryRealValues[19];
				resultData.BubblingAreaPanelD.Value = geometryRealValues[20];
			}
		}

		private List<TrayGeometryInputData> GetUpdateTrayGeometryData_Balance(CATraySectionData curSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CABalancedData balancedData, int stageCounts)
		{
			int num = curSection.EndingStage.Value - curSection.StartStage.Value + 1;
			if (stageCounts > num)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = 1;
			List<TrayGeometryInputData> list = new List<TrayGeometryInputData>();
			for (int i = 0; i < stageCounts; i++)
			{
				TrayGeometryInputData trayGeometryInputData = new TrayGeometryInputData();
				list.Add(trayGeometryInputData);
				if (curSection.NumberofPasses.Value > 0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.IntInput[0] = curSection.NumberofPasses.Value;
				}
				trayGeometryInputData.IntInput[1] = (curSection.PicketOutletWeirsMultipassTrays ? 1 : 0);
				trayGeometryInputData.IntInput[2] = (curSection.AreaUnderDCAsBubblingArea ? 1 : 0);
				if (curSection.Diameter.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[0] = curSection.Diameter.Value;
				}
				if (balancedData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[1] = balancedData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (balancedData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[2] = balancedData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				if (balancedData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[3] = balancedData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (balancedData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[4] = balancedData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				if (balancedData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[5] = balancedData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (balancedData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[6] = balancedData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				double value = ((CADCOffCenterResultData)balancedData.Downcomers[2]).CenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
				if (value > 0.0)
				{
					trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[7] = value;
				}
				CAStage cAStage = columnData.Stages[curSection.StartStage.Value + i - num2];
				trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[8] = cAStage.MassFlowLiquid.Value;
				trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[9] = cAStage.MassFlowVapor.Value;
				trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[10] = cAStage.DensityLiquid.Value;
				trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[11] = cAStage.DensityVapor.Value;
				trayGeometryInputData.RealInput[12] = curSection.WeirLoadMinimum.Value;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public ValvesCapsNumberOrDensity CalculateValvesCapsNumberOrDensity(CATraySectionData sourceSection, double diameter, double tolerance, double downcomerAreaFraction, double density, int iNumber)
		{
			ValvesCapsNumberOrDensity valvesCapsNumberOrDensity = new ValvesCapsNumberOrDensity();
			int internalType = (int)sourceSection.InternalType;
			if (internalType == 0 || internalType == 2)
			{
				return valvesCapsNumberOrDensity;
			}
			int numberOrDensityOption = GetNumberOrDensityOption(sourceSection, internalType);
			if (numberOrDensityOption <= 0)
			{
				return valvesCapsNumberOrDensity;
			}
			double num = (1.0 - downcomerAreaFraction) * Math.PI * diameter * diameter * 0.25;
			if (numberOrDensityOption == 1)
			{
				iNumber = Convert.ToInt32(density * num);
			}
			else
			{
				density = (double)iNumber / num;
			}
			valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.IOption = numberOrDensityOption;
			valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.NumberOfValvesCaps.Value = iNumber;
			valvesCapsNumberOrDensity.NumberOfValvesCapsToActiveArea.Value = density;
			return valvesCapsNumberOrDensity;
		}

		private int GetNumberOrDensityOption(CATraySectionData sourceSec, int nTrayType)
		{
			int num = -1;
			switch (nTrayType)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				CABubbleCapTraySection cABubbleCapTraySection = sourceSec as CABubbleCapTraySection;
				num = ((cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value > 0 || !(cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)) ? cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.CapsDensityNumberSpec : (-1));
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					if (cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value <= 0 && cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
					{
						num = 1;
					}
					else if (cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCaps.Value > 0 && cABubbleCapTraySection.TrayLayout.BubbleCap.NumberOfCapsPerActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)
					{
						num = 2;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection = sourceSec as CAGlitschBallastValveTraySection;
				num = ((cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value > 0 || !(cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)) ? cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.ValveDensityNumberSpec : (-1));
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					if (cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value <= 0 && cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
					{
						num = 1;
					}
					else if (cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value > 0 && cAGlitschBallastValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)
					{
						num = 2;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case 4:
			{
				CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection = sourceSec as CAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection;
				num = ((cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value > 0 || !(cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)) ? cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.ValveDensityNumberSpec : (-1));
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					if (cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value <= 0 && cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
					{
						num = 1;
					}
					else if (cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value > 0 && cAKochFlexitrayValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)
					{
						num = 2;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case 5:
			{
				CANutterFloatValveTraySection cANutterFloatValveTraySection = sourceSec as CANutterFloatValveTraySection;
				num = ((cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value > 0 || !(cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)) ? cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.ValveDensityNumberSpec : (-1));
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					if (cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value <= 0 && cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value > 0.0)
					{
						num = 1;
					}
					else if (cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValves.Value > 0 && cANutterFloatValveTraySection.TrayLayout.NumberOfValvesToActiveArea.Value <= 0.0)
					{
						num = 2;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected void CalculateWeirLengthDefault(CATraySectionData colSection, CASectionDefaultValue defaultVals)
		{
			if (colSection == null || defaultVals == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_TODMaster == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				_TODMaster = ATTPSREngine.CreateTODMasterObj();
			}
			double value = colSection.Diameter.Value;
			if (colSection.Diameter.IsEmpty() || colSection.Diameter.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				value = defaultVals.Diameter.Value;
			}
			if (colSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Rating && !colSection.Diameter.IsEmpty())
			{
				value = colSection.Diameter.Value;
			}
			int value2 = colSection.NumberofPasses.Value;
			if (colSection.NumberofPasses.IsEmpty() || colSection.NumberofPasses.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				value2 = defaultVals.NumberofPasses.Value;
			}
			double dcwtopsid = defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			if (!colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.IsEmpty() && colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				dcwtopsid = colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			double dcwtopctr = defaultVals.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			if (!colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.IsEmpty() && colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				dcwtopctr = colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			double dcwtopofc = defaultVals.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			if (!colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.IsEmpty() && colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				dcwtopofc = colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			double lwtopsid = 1E+35;
			double lwtopctr = 1E+35;
			double lwtopofcin = 1E+35;
			double lwtopofcout = 1E+35;
			double ocwrlocale = defaultVals.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			if (!((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.IsEmpty() && ((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				ocwrlocale = ((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (colSection.Weirs[0].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				dcwtopsid = 1E+35;
				lwtopsid = colSection.Weirs[0].Width.Value;
				flag = true;
			}
			if ((value2 == 2 || value2 == 4) && colSection.Weirs[1].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				dcwtopctr = 1E+35;
				lwtopctr = colSection.Weirs[1].Width.Value;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (value2 == 3 || value2 == 4)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && ((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					lwtopofcin = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcout = 1E+35;
				}
				else if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					ocwrlocale = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcout = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcin = colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value;
				}
				else if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					ocwrlocale = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcin = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcout = colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value;
				}
				else if (((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					dcwtopofc = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcout = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcin = colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value;
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if (((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					dcwtopofc = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcin = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcout = colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value;
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if (colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					dcwtopofc = 1E+35;
					ocwrlocale = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcin = colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value;
					lwtopofcout = colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value;
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if ((colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !colSection.Weirs[3].Width.IsEmpty()) || (colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !colSection.Weirs[2].Width.IsEmpty()))
				{
					dcwtopofc = 1E+35;
					ocwrlocale = 1E+35;
					lwtopofcin = colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value;
					lwtopofcout = colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value;
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			ATTPSREngine.ATTPSR_TOD_WRLNGTHSNDCWIDTHS(value, value2, ref dcwtopsid, ref dcwtopctr, ref dcwtopofc, ref lwtopsid, ref lwtopctr, ref lwtopofcin, ref lwtopofcout, ref ocwrlocale);
			ATTPSREngine.DestroyTODMasterObj(_TODMaster);
			_TODMaster = IntPtr.Zero;
			defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = dcwtopsid;
			defaultVals.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = dcwtopctr;
			defaultVals.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = dcwtopofc;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					defaultVals.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultVals.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = dcwtopsid;
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					defaultVals.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultVals.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = dcwtopctr;
				}
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					defaultVals.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultVals.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = dcwtopofc;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(lwtopsid))
			{
				defaultVals.SideWeirLength.Value = lwtopsid;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(lwtopctr))
			{
				defaultVals.CenterWeirLength.Value = lwtopctr;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(lwtopofcin))
			{
				defaultVals.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = lwtopofcin;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(lwtopofcout))
			{
				defaultVals.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = lwtopofcout;
			}
			defaultVals.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = ocwrlocale;
		}

		private void CalcuateWeirLength_Balance(CATraySectionData colSection, CABalancedData balanceData, CASectionDefaultValue rDefault)
		{
			if (colSection != null && balanceData != null)
			{
				if (_TODMaster == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					_TODMaster = ATTPSREngine.CreateTODMasterObj();
				}
				double value = colSection.Diameter.Value;
				if (rDefault != null)
				{
					value = rDefault.Diameter.Value;
				}
				int value2 = colSection.NumberofPasses.Value;
				double dcwtopsid = balanceData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
				double dcwtopctr = 1E+35;
				double dcwtopofc = 1E+35;
				double lwtopsid = 1E+35;
				double lwtopctr = 1E+35;
				double lwtopofcin = 1E+35;
				double lwtopofcout = 1E+35;
				double ocwrlocale = 1E+35;
				if (value2 == 2 || value2 == 4)
				{
					dcwtopctr = balanceData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (value2 == 3 || value2 == 4)
				{
					dcwtopofc = balanceData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
					ocwrlocale = ((CADCOffCenterResultData)balanceData.Downcomers[2]).CenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
				}
				ATTPSREngine.ATTPSR_TOD_WRLNGTHSNDCWIDTHS(value, value2, ref dcwtopsid, ref dcwtopctr, ref dcwtopofc, ref lwtopsid, ref lwtopctr, ref lwtopofcin, ref lwtopofcout, ref ocwrlocale);
				balanceData.SideWeirLength.Value = lwtopsid;
				balanceData.CenterWeirLength.Value = lwtopctr;
				balanceData.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = lwtopofcin;
				balanceData.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value = lwtopofcout;
				ATTPSREngine.DestroyTODMasterObj(_TODMaster);
				_TODMaster = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		public CAColumnSumpResults GetCAColumnSumpResults(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption caColSetting)
		{
			if (columnData == null || caColSetting == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CAColumnSumpResults cAColumnSumpResults = new CAColumnSumpResults();
			CAStage cAStage = columnData.Stages[columnData.EndStageNumber - 1];
			if (cAStage != null)
			{
				double num = -1.0;
				if (!caColSetting.SumpLiquidLevel.IsEmpty())
				{
					num = caColSetting.SumpLiquidLevel.Value;
				}
				else if (!caColSetting.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.IsEmpty() && !caColSetting.SumpDiameter.IsEmpty())
				{
					double value = caColSetting.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.Value;
					double value2 = caColSetting.SumpDiameter.Value;
					num = cAStage.VolumeFlowLiquid.Value * value / (value2 * value2 * Math.PI * 0.25);
				}
				if (num > 0.0)
				{
					cAColumnSumpResults.SumpPressureDrop.Value = cAStage.DensityLiquid.Value * 9.81 * num;
					cAColumnSumpResults.SumpPressureDrop_HeadLoss.Value = num;
					cAColumnSumpResults.SumpLiquidLevel.Value = num;
				}
			}
			return cAColumnSumpResults;
		}

		public CAColumnSumpDefault GetCAColumnSumpDefault(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption caColSetting, double? lastSectionDiameter)
		{
			CAColumnSumpDefault cAColumnSumpDefault = new CAColumnSumpDefault();
			CAStage cAStage = null;
			if (columnData != null && columnData.Stages != null && columnData.Stages.Count > 0)
			{
				cAStage = columnData.Stages[columnData.EndStageNumber - 1];
			}
			cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.Value = 60.0;
			if (lastSectionDiameter.HasValue)
			{
				cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpDiameter.Value = lastSectionDiameter.Value;
			}
			if (!cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpDiameter.IsEmpty())
			{
				double value = cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpDiameter.Value;
				if (caColSetting != null && caColSetting.SumpDiameter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					value = caColSetting.SumpDiameter.Value;
				}
				double value2 = cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.Value;
				if (cAStage != null)
				{
					cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpLiquidLevel.Value = cAStage.VolumeFlowLiquid.Value * value2 / (value * value * Math.PI * 0.25);
				}
				if (caColSetting != null && cAStage != null)
				{
					if (caColSetting.IsSumpLiquidResidenceTimeSelected)
					{
						if (caColSetting.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
						{
							value2 = caColSetting.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.Value;
							cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpLiquidLevel.Value = cAStage.VolumeFlowLiquid.Value * value2 / (value * value * Math.PI * 0.25);
						}
					}
					else if (caColSetting.IsSumpLiquidLevelSelected)
					{
						double value3 = cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpLiquidLevel.Value;
						if (caColSetting.SumpLiquidLevel.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
						{
							value3 = caColSetting.SumpLiquidLevel.Value;
							cAColumnSumpDefault.SumpLiquidResidenceTime.Value = value3 * value * value * Math.PI * 0.25 / cAStage.VolumeFlowLiquid.Value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return cAColumnSumpDefault;
		}
	}

		internal void ExportData(TraySectionResultData sectionResultData, string trayType)
		{
			try
			{
				if (DebugSetting != null)
				{
					ExportInput(sectionResultData.SectionKey, trayType);
					ExportResult(sectionResultData, trayType);
					CompareInputsAndExport(sectionResultData.StartStageNumber.Value);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void ExportResult(TraySectionResultData sectionResultData, string trayType)
		{
			if (CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut != null && DebugSetting != null && DebugSetting.NeedExportPlotResults)
			{
				CADebugPlotOutputData cADebugPlotOutputData = new CADebugPlotOutputData();
				string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
				text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
				string text2 = DebugSetting.ResultsExportFolder + "\\" + sectionResultData.SectionKey + "_" + trayType + "_Result" + text + ".xml";
				cADebugPlotOutputData.TraySectionResultDataResult = sectionResultData;
				cADebugPlotOutputData.DiagramSectionData = sectionResultData.DiagramSectionData;
				CADataHelper.ExportDataToXml(text2, cADebugPlotOutputData);
				CADataHelper.ExportDataToXml(text2 + "_OneTrayPlot_", sectionResultData.DiagramSectionData.Trays[0]);
			}
		}

		private void ExportInput(string secKey, string trayType)
		{

				CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.SectionKey = secKey;
				string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
				text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
				CADataHelper.ExportDataToXml(DebugSetting.InputExportFolder + "\\" + secKey + "_" + trayType + "_Input" + text + ".xml", CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut);
			}
		}

		private void CompareInputsAndExport(int startStageNumber)
		{
			CADebugPlotInputData cADebugPlotInputData = null;
			string fileNameWithSectionKey = GetFileNameWithSectionKey(CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.SectionKey);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileNameWithSectionKey) || !(CADataHelper.DeSerializeExportData(fileNameWithSectionKey, typeof(CADebugPlotInputData)) is CADebugPlotInputData cADebugPlotInputData2) || cADebugPlotInputData2.SectionKey != CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.SectionKey || cADebugPlotInputData2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
			text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
			string path = DebugSetting.CompareResultsFolder + "\\CA_" + CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.SectionKey + "_" + text + "_CompareInputsResults.csv";
			if (File.Exists(path))
			{
				File.Delete(path);
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(path, append: false);
			string value = $"Section name: {CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.SectionKey}";
			streamWriter.WriteLine(value);
			streamWriter.WriteLine("-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------");
			for (int i = 0; i < CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.InputData.Count; i++)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				list.Add("Integer input variables");
				string item = $"Attpsr Index, Attpsr Name, Baseline Value, Current case Value, Difference(baseline - current)";
				list.Add(item);
				for (int j = 0; j < CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.InputData[i].IntParameters.Length; j++)
				{
					int num3 = j + 1;
					int num4 = cADebugPlotInputData2.InputData[i].IntParameters[j];
					int num5 = CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.InputData[i].IntParameters[j];
					string text2 = string.Empty;
					if (TagForIntParametersArray.ContainsKey(num3))
					{
						text2 = TagForIntParametersArray[j];
					}
					if (num4 != num5)
					{
						num++;
					}
					item = $"{num3},{text2},{num4},{num5},{num4 - num5}";
					list.Add(item);
				}
				list.Add("Real input variables");
				item = $"Attpsr Index, Attpsr Name, Baseline Value, Current case Value, Difference(baseline - current)";
				list.Add(item);
				for (int k = 0; k < CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.InputData[i].RealParameters.Length; k++)
				{
					int num6 = k + 1;
					double num7 = cADebugPlotInputData2.InputData[i].RealParameters[k];
					double num8 = CaDebugPlotInputData_OutPut.InputData[i].RealParameters[k];
					string text3 = string.Empty;
					if (TagForRealParametersArray.ContainsKey(k))
					{
						text3 = TagForRealParametersArray[k];
					}
					if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(num7, num8))
					{
						num2++;
					}
					item = $"{num6},{text3},{num7},{num8},{num7 - num8}";
					list.Add(item);
				}
				item = $"Stage index {i + startStageNumber}";
				streamWriter.WriteLine(item);
				string value2 = $"Totally {num} integers and {num2} reals are different in this stage.";
				streamWriter.WriteLine(value2);
				foreach (string item2 in list)
				{
					streamWriter.WriteLine(item2);
				}
				streamWriter.WriteLine("-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------");
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class CADebugManagerBase
	{
		internal CADebugSetting DebugSetting;

		public CADebugManagerBase()
		{
			InitFolder();
		}

		private void InitFolder()
		{
			string text = "C:\\CADebug\\CADebugSetting.xml";
			string todefaultInputPath = CADebugSetting.TodefaultInputPath;
			if (!File.Exists(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			DebugSetting = CADataHelper.DeSerializeExportData(text, typeof(CADebugSetting)) as CADebugSetting;
			if (DebugSetting == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (Directory.Exists("C:\\CADebug\\"))
				{
					if (!Directory.Exists(todefaultInputPath))
					{
						Directory.CreateDirectory(todefaultInputPath);
					}
					if (!Directory.Exists(DebugSetting.BaseLineFolder))
					{
						Directory.CreateDirectory(DebugSetting.BaseLineFolder);
					}
					if (!Directory.Exists(DebugSetting.CompareResultsFolder))
					{
						Directory.CreateDirectory(DebugSetting.CompareResultsFolder);
					}
					if (!Directory.Exists(DebugSetting.InputExportFolder))
					{
						Directory.CreateDirectory(DebugSetting.InputExportFolder);
					}
					if (!Directory.Exists(DebugSetting.ResultsExportFolder))
					{
						Directory.CreateDirectory(DebugSetting.ResultsExportFolder);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				DebugSetting = null;
			}
		}

		protected string GetFileNameWithSectionKey(string sectionKey)
		{
			if (DebugSetting == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			foreach (string item in Directory.EnumerateFiles(DebugSetting.BaseLineFolder))
			{
				XPathNavigator xPathNavigator = new XPathDocument(item).CreateNavigator();
				XPathNavigator xPathNavigator2 = xPathNavigator.SelectSingleNode("PackingDebugInputData");
				if (xPathNavigator2 == null)
				{
					xPathNavigator2 = xPathNavigator.SelectSingleNode("CADebugPlotInputData");
				}
				if (xPathNavigator2 != null)
				{
					xPathNavigator2.MoveToFirstChild();
					if (sectionKey == xPathNavigator2.Value.Trim())
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return empty;
		}
	}
	internal class CAPackingDebugManager : CADebugManagerBase
	{
		internal PackingDebugInputData PackingInput = new PackingDebugInputData();

		private void ExportInputData()
		{
			string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
			text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
			CADataHelper.ExportDataToXml(DebugSetting.InputExportFolder + "\\" + PackingInput.SectionKey + "_Input_" + text + ".xml", PackingInput);
		}

		private void CompareInputsAndExport()
		{
			PackingDebugInputData packingDebugInputData = null;
			string fileNameWithSectionKey = GetFileNameWithSectionKey(PackingInput.SectionKey);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileNameWithSectionKey) || !(CADataHelper.DeSerializeExportData(fileNameWithSectionKey, typeof(PackingDebugInputData)) is PackingDebugInputData packingDebugInputData2) || packingDebugInputData2.SectionKey != PackingInput.SectionKey || packingDebugInputData2 == null || !(packingDebugInputData2.SectionKey == PackingInput.SectionKey))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
			text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
			string path = DebugSetting.CompareResultsFolder + "\\CA_" + packingDebugInputData2.SectionKey + "_" + text + "_CompareInputsResults.csv";
			if (File.Exists(path))
			{
				File.Delete(path);
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(path, append: false);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string value = $"Section name: {PackingInput.SectionKey}";
			streamWriter.WriteLine(value);
			streamWriter.WriteLine("-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------");
			for (int i = 0; i < PackingInput.IntegerInputs.Count; i++)
			{
				int key = PackingInput.IntegerInputs.Keys.ToList()[i];
				int key2 = packingDebugInputData2.IntegerInputs.Keys.ToList()[i];
				list.Add("Integer inputs variables");
				string item = $"Attpsr Index, Attpsr Name, Baseline Value, Current case Value, Difference(baseline - current), CA Property Name with Value, Description";
				list.Add(item);
				for (int j = 0; j < PackingInput.IntegerInputs[key].Length; j++)
				{
					int num3 = j + 1;
					int num4 = packingDebugInputData2.IntegerInputs[key2][j];
					int num5 = PackingInput.IntegerInputs[key][j];
					string text2 = string.Empty;
					string text3 = string.Empty;
					string text4 = string.Empty;
					if (PackingInput.CaPropValuesInputIntger.ContainsKey(j))
					{
						text2 = PackingInput.CaPropValuesInputIntger[j].Trim();
					}
					if (PackingDebugInputData.IntegerInputsDescription.ContainsKey(num3))
					{
						text3 = PackingDebugInputData.IntegerInputsDescription[num3].Trim();
					}
					if (PackingDebugInputData.IntegerInputsFortranName.ContainsKey(num3))
					{
						text4 = PackingDebugInputData.IntegerInputsFortranName[num3].Trim();
					}
					if (num4 != num5)
					{
						num++;
					}
					item = $"{num3},{text4},{num4},{num5},{num4 - num5},{text2}, \"{text3}\"";
					list.Add(item);
				}
				key = PackingInput.IntegerInputs.Keys.ToList()[i];
				key2 = packingDebugInputData2.IntegerInputs.Keys.ToList()[i];
				list.Add("Real inputs variables");
				item = $"Attpsr Index, Attpsr Name, Baseline Value, Current case Value, Difference(baseline - current), CA Property Name with Value, Description";
				list.Add(item);
				for (int k = 0; k < PackingInput.DoubleInputs[key].Length; k++)
				{
					int num6 = k + 1;
					double num7 = packingDebugInputData2.DoubleInputs[key2][k];
					double num8 = PackingInput.DoubleInputs[key][k];
					string text5 = string.Empty;
					string text6 = string.Empty;
					string text7 = string.Empty;
					if (PackingInput.CaPropValuesInputReal.ContainsKey(k))
					{
						text5 = PackingInput.CaPropValuesInputReal[k].Trim();
					}
					if (PackingDebugInputData.DoubleInputsDescription.ContainsKey(num6))
					{
						text6 = PackingDebugInputData.DoubleInputsDescription[num6].Trim();
					}
					if (PackingDebugInputData.DoubleInputsFortranName.ContainsKey(num6))
					{
						text7 = PackingDebugInputData.DoubleInputsFortranName[num6].Trim();
					}
					if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(num7, num8))
					{
						num2++;
					}
					item = $"{num6},{text7},{num7},{num8},{num7 - num8},{text5}, \"{text6}\"";
					list.Add(item);
				}
				item = $"Stage number {key}";
				streamWriter.WriteLine(item);
				item = $"Totally {num} integers and {num2} reals are different in this stage.";
				streamWriter.WriteLine(item);
				foreach (string item2 in list)
				{
					streamWriter.WriteLine(item2);
				}
				streamWriter.WriteLine("-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------");
			}
		}

		internal void Export()
		{
			try
			{
				if (DebugSetting != null)
				{
					if (DebugSetting.NeedExportInput)
					{
						ExportInputData();
					}
					if (DebugSetting.CompareInputWithBaseLine)
					{
						CompareInputsAndExport();
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal void ExportResult(CAPackingSectionResults result)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				string sectionKey = result.SectionKey;
				if (DebugSetting != null && DebugSetting.NeedExportPlotResults)
				{
					string text = DateTime.Now.ToLongTimeString().Replace(":", "");
					text = text.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
					CADataHelper.ExportDataToXml(DebugSetting.ResultsExportFolder + "\\" + sectionKey + "_Result_" + text + ".xml", result);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
	}
