	public class CAttpsrTrayRatingWrapper : CAAttpsrTrayWrapper
	{
		private string _MessageTray = string.Empty;

		private string _MessageTrays = string.Empty;

		private string MessageTray
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_MessageTray) && _unityContainer != null)
				{
					if (_ApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
					{
						_MessageTray = Resources.Message_Tray;
					}
					else
					{
						_MessageTray = Resources.Message_Stage;
					}
				}
				return _MessageTray;
			}
		}

		private ApplicationType _ApplicationType { get; } = ApplicationType.AspenPlus;

		private string MessageTrays
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_MessageTrays) && _unityContainer != null)
				{
					IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					if (hostApplicationInfo != null && hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType == ApplicationType.AspenHYSYS)
					{
						_MessageTrays = Resources.Message_Trays;
					}
					else
					{
						_MessageTrays = Resources.Message_Stages;
					}
				}
				return _MessageTrays;
			}
		}

		public CAttpsrTrayRatingWrapper(CAMessagesManager caMessagesManager, IUnityContainer unityContainer)
			: base(caMessagesManager, unityContainer)
		{
			if (unityContainer != null)
			{
				IHostApplicationInfo hostApplicationInfo = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IHostApplicationInfo>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				if (hostApplicationInfo != null)
				{
					_ApplicationType = hostApplicationInfo.HostApplicationType;
				}
			}
		}

		public TraySectionResultData CallEngineTrayRating(CATraySectionData colSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CAOption colSetting, int startStage, int endStage, bool calculateCurve, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (colSection == null || columnData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = Update(colSection, columnData, colSetting, startStage, endStage, calculateCurve);
			traySectionResultData.AnalyzeSummaryData();
			traySectionResultData.AnalyzeWeeping(columnData.StartStageNumber, columnData.EndStageNumber, columnData.IsTopDownNumbering);
			traySectionResultData.ContainsPlotData = calculateCurve;
			PulbishEngineMessages(columnData, colSection, traySectionResultData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			return traySectionResultData;
		}

		public CASectionDefaultValue CallEngineToGetDefault(CATraySectionData colSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, bool ensureDowncomerBalanced = false)
		{
			if (colSection == null || columnData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CASectionDefaultValue cASectionDefaultValue = null;
			try
			{
				int iStep = 1;
				int value = colSection.StartStage.Value;
				int value2 = colSection.EndingStage.Value;
				int baseStageForSizing = columnData.GetBaseStageForSizing(value, value2, iStep);
				CAStage maximumStage = columnData.Stages[baseStageForSizing - 1];
				cASectionDefaultValue = GetDefaultValue(colSection, maximumStage, iStep);
				if (cASectionDefaultValue == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (colSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
				{
					UpdateTraySectionData(cASectionDefaultValue, colSection);
					TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData = Update(colSection, columnData, null, value, value2, calculateCurve: false);
					iStep = 2;
					int num = traySectionResultData.FindTrayNumberWidthMaxJetFlood();
					if (num != baseStageForSizing && traySectionResultData.MaximumPercentJetFlood.Value > traySectionResultData.PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value)
					{
						CAStage maximumStage2 = columnData.Stages[num - 1];
						cASectionDefaultValue = GetDefaultValue(colSection, maximumStage2, iStep);
					}
				}
				if ((colSection.DowncomerArrangement.Value == 0 || colSection.DowncomerArrangement.Value >= 99999999) && colSection.InternalType != InternalsTypeEnum.CustomTray)
				{
					CalculateWeirLengthDefault(colSection, cASectionDefaultValue);
					CalcuateSweptBackAndPicket(colSection, maximumStage, cASectionDefaultValue);
					if (ensureDowncomerBalanced && colSection.CalculationMode != CalculationMode.Rating && cASectionDefaultValue.NumberofPasses.Value > 1)
					{
						CABalancedDCInputData balancedInputData = new CABalancedDCInputData(BalanceDowncomer(colSection, columnData, cASectionDefaultValue));
						if (NeedRefreshWithBalancedValue(colSection, balancedInputData))
						{
							UpdateTrayDefaultWithBalancedDimension(cASectionDefaultValue, balancedInputData);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						CaculateCapValvetDensityForDefault(colSection, columnData, cASectionDefaultValue);
					}
				}
				if (colSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Rating)
				{
					ClearFlowDependentDefault(colSection, cASectionDefaultValue);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return cASectionDefaultValue;
		}

		private static bool NeedRefreshWithBalancedValue(CATraySectionData colSection, CABalancedDCInputData balancedInputData)
		{
			bool result = true;
			double tolerance = 0.001;
			if (colSection.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.Value == 0)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || colSection.Weirs[0].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					if (colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Weirs[1].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.CenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[1].Width.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(((OffCenterDowncomer)balancedInputData.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value, ((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			else if (colSection.BalanceDowncomerBasisIndex.Value == 1)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input || colSection.Weirs[1].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					if (colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Weirs[0].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.SideWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[0].Width.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(((OffCenterDowncomer)balancedInputData.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value, ((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value, tolerance))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value, colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Weirs[0].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.SideWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[0].Width.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Weirs[1].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.CenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[1].Width.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Weirs[2].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Inside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[2].Width.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (colSection.Weirs[3].Width.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(balancedInputData.Outside_OffCenterWeirLength.Value, colSection.Weirs[3].Width.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus == VariableStatusEnum.Input && !VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(((OffCenterDowncomer)balancedInputData.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value, ((OffCenterDowncomer)colSection.Downcomers[2]).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value, tolerance))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public CABalancedData CallEngineToGetBalanceDowncomerValues(CATraySectionData colSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData)
		{
			if (colSection == null || columnData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return BalanceDowncomer(colSection, columnData);
		}

		private void UpdateTraySectionData(CASectionDefaultValue defaultVals, CATraySectionData colSection)
		{
			if (defaultVals.Diameter.Value <= 0.0 || defaultVals.Diameter.Value > 100.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int value = defaultVals.NumberofPasses.Value;
			if (colSection.Diameter.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				colSection.Diameter.Value = defaultVals.Diameter.Value;
			}
			if (colSection.NumberofPasses.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				colSection.NumberofPasses.Value = value;
			}
			if (colSection.TraySpacing.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				colSection.TraySpacing.Value = defaultVals.TraySpacing.Value;
			}
			if (colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				colSection.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				colSection.Downcomers[0].BottomWidth.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value;
			}
			if (colSection.Downcomers[0].Clearence.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
			{
				colSection.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[0].Clearence.Value;
			}
			if (value == 2 || value == 4)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					colSection.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					colSection.Downcomers[1].BottomWidth.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[1].Clearence.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					colSection.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[1].Clearence.Value;
				}
			}
			if (value == 3 || value == 4)
			{
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					colSection.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					colSection.Downcomers[2].BottomWidth.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value;
				}
				if ((colSection.Downcomers[2] as OffCenterDowncomer).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					(colSection.Downcomers[2] as OffCenterDowncomer).OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[2].OffCenterDistanceToTrayCenter.Value;
				}
				if (colSection.Downcomers[2].Clearence.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input)
				{
					colSection.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value = defaultVals.Downcomers[2].Clearence.Value;
				}
			}
			if (colSection is CASieveTraySectionData)
			{
				SieveTrayLayout trayLayout = ((CASieveTraySectionData)colSection).TrayLayout;
				if (trayLayout.HoleAreaNumberSpec == 2 && trayLayout.NumberOfHoles.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
				{
					trayLayout.NumberOfHoles = ((CASieveSectionDefaultValue)defaultVals).NumberOfHoles;
				}
				else if (trayLayout.HoleAreaNumberSpec != 2 && trayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction.VariableStatus != VariableStatusEnum.Input && colSection.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Sizing)
				{
					trayLayout.HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction = ((CASieveSectionDefaultValue)defaultVals).HoleAreaToActiveAreaFraction;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckDowncomerWdidth(CATraySectionData colSection, ColumnInternalsData columnData, CASectionDefaultValue defaultVals)
		{
			string message = $"Total Downcomer width cannot exceed diameter. Please check Diameter and specify a larger one.";
			if (defaultVals != null && colSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 2)
			{
				if (defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value * 2.0 + defaultVals.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value >= colSection.Diameter.Value)
				{
					throw new CAErrorException(message);
				}
			}
			else if (defaultVals != null && colSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 3)
			{
				if (defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value + defaultVals.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value >= 0.5 * colSection.Diameter.Value)
				{
					throw new CAErrorException(message);
				}
			}
			else if (defaultVals != null && colSection.NumberofPasses.Value == 4 && defaultVals.Downcomers[0].TopWidth.Value + 0.5 * defaultVals.Downcomers[1].TopWidth.Value + defaultVals.Downcomers[2].TopWidth.Value >= colSection.Diameter.Value)
			{
				throw new CAErrorException(message);
			}
		}

		internal void PulbishEngineMessages(ColumnInternalsData columnData, CATraySectionData traySectionData, TraySectionResultData secrResult, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>>();
			Dictionary<string, int> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			Dictionary<string, Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>> dictionary3 = new Dictionary<string, Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>>();
			Dictionary<string, EngineMessage> dictionary4 = new Dictionary<string, EngineMessage>();
			foreach (DiagramTray tray in secrResult.DiagramSectionData.Trays)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < tray.ReturnData.Messages.Count; i++)
				{
					int num = tray.ReturnData.Messages[i];
					int num2 = i + 1;
					if (num > 99999)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = $"Message{num2}_{num}";
					EngineMessage engineMessage = ResourceHelper.GeTrayEngineMessage(num2, num);
					if (engineMessage == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (engineMessage.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Tray)
					{
						if (!dictionary3.ContainsKey(text))
						{
							dictionary3.Add(text, new Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>(new List<int>(), engineMessage));
						}
						dictionary3[text].Item1.Add(tray.StageNumber);
						dictionary4[text] = engineMessage;
						text = text + "_" + tray.StageNumber;
						dictionary2.Add(text, tray.StageNumber);
					}
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						List<CARealVariable> sourceRealData = new List<CARealVariable>();
						string item = SetEngineMessageWithData(secrResult, engineMessage, tray.StageNumber, MessageTray + " {0}", sourceRealData);
						List<int> list = new List<int>();
						list.Add(tray.StageNumber);
						if (CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(engineMessage.MessageResourceKey))
						{
							engineMessage.SourceRealData = sourceRealData;
							dictionary.Add(text, new Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>(item, list, engineMessage));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Tuple<List<int>, EngineMessage>> item3 in dictionary3)
			{
				if (dictionary4.ContainsKey(item3.Key))
				{
					string messageResourceKey = item3.Value.Item2.MessageResourceKey;
					string text2 = MessageTray + " ";
					if (item3.Value.Item1.Count > 1)
					{
						text2 = MessageTrays + " ";
						EngineMessage engineMessage2 = dictionary4[item3.Key].Clone() as EngineMessage;
						engineMessage2.MessageResourceKey += "_Multiple";
						engineMessage2.Message = TrayRatingResources.ResourceManager.GetString(engineMessage2.MessageResourceKey);
						dictionary4[item3.Key] = engineMessage2;
					}
					List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
					for (int j = 0; j < item3.Value.Item1.Count; j++)
					{
						list2.Add(item3.Value.Item1[j]);
					}
					if (CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap.ContainsKey(messageResourceKey.Replace("_Multiple", "")))
					{
						List<CARealVariable> sourceRealData2 = new List<CARealVariable>();
						string item2 = SetEngineMessageWithData(secrResult, dictionary4[item3.Key], item3.Value.Item1[0], text2 + "{0}", sourceRealData2);
						dictionary4[item3.Key].SourceRealData = sourceRealData2;
						dictionary.Add(item3.Key, new Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>(item2, list2, dictionary4[item3.Key]));
					}
				}
			}
			HandleCloseToLimitMessage(secrResult, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			HandleDowncomerAreaMessage(secrResult, traySectionData, columnData, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			SetMessageToCAManger(dictionary, dictionary2, columnData, secrResult, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
			_CAMessagesManager.PublishMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey);
		}

		private void SetMessageToCAManger(Dictionary<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>> messagesToMessageManager, Dictionary<string, int> trayMessagesToMessageManager, ColumnInternalsData columnData, TraySectionResultData secrResult, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Tuple<string, List<int>, EngineMessage>> item in messagesToMessageManager)
			{
				MessageType messageType = CAMessageHelper.TrayMessageTypeMap[item.Value.Item3.MessageResourceKey.Replace("_Multiple", "")];
				if (trayMessagesToMessageManager.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					CAMessage cAMessage = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, messageType, MessageCatalog.Engine, item.Value.Item1, trayMessagesToMessageManager[item.Key]);
					cAMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
					cAMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = base.SimulatorDataProvider;
					cAMessage.SourceRealData = item.Value.Item3.SourceRealData;
					if (item.Value.Item3.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Section)
					{
						cAMessage.ShowTrayNumber = false;
					}
					else
					{
						cAMessage.ShowTrayNumber = true;
					}
					cAMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
					cAMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
					cAMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
					cAMessage.MessageResourceKey = item.Value.Item3.MessageResourceKey;
					_CAMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage);
					continue;
				}
				CAMessage cAMessage2 = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, messageType, MessageCatalog.Engine, item.Value.Item1);
				cAMessage2.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
				cAMessage2.SimulatorDataProvider = base.SimulatorDataProvider;
				cAMessage2.SourceRealData = item.Value.Item3.SourceRealData;
				if (item.Value.Item3.MessageType == EngineTrayMessageType.Section)
				{
					cAMessage2.ShowTrayNumber = false;
				}
				else
				{
					cAMessage2.ShowTrayNumber = true;
				}
				cAMessage2.StageNumbers = item.Value.Item2;
				cAMessage2.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
				cAMessage2.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
				cAMessage2.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
				cAMessage2.MessageResourceKey = item.Value.Item3.MessageResourceKey;
				_CAMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage2);
			}
		}

		private void HandleChokeMessage(TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData, CATraySectionData traySectionData, ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (traySectionData.PercentJetFloodForDesign.IsEmpty())
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = traySectionData.PercentJetFloodForDesign.Value / 100.0;
			double num2 = 0.95;
			double num3 = 1.0001;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			List<int> list3 = new List<int>();
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			string empty3 = string.Empty;
			foreach (DiagramTray tray in traySectionResultData.DiagramSectionData.Trays)
			{
				double num4 = tray.ReturnData.DCChoke[1].Value / 100.0;
				double num5 = tray.ReturnData.DCChoke[2].Value / 100.0;

		private void HandleCloseToLimitMessage(TraySectionResultData secrResult, ColumnInternalsData columnData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			foreach (DiagramTray tray in secrResult.DiagramSectionData.Trays)
			{
				TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum trayCloseToLimitMessage = tray.ReturnData.TrayCloseToLimitMessage;
				if (trayCloseToLimitMessage != TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.NotSet)
				{
					trayCloseToLimitMessage.ToString();
					CAMessage approachToLimitMessage = GetApproachToLimitMessage(trayCloseToLimitMessage, secrResult, sConfigOption, sectionKey);
					if (approachToLimitMessage != null)
					{
						approachToLimitMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
						approachToLimitMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = base.SimulatorDataProvider;
						approachToLimitMessage.ShowTrayNumber = true;
						approachToLimitMessage.StageNumber = tray.StageNumber;
						approachToLimitMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnData.StartStageNumber;
						approachToLimitMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnData.EndStageNumber;
						approachToLimitMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnData.IsTopDownNumbering;
						_CAMessagesManager.AddMessage(approachToLimitMessage);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void HandleDowncomerAreaMessage(TraySectionResultData traySectionResultData, CATraySectionData traySectionData, ColumnInternalsData columnInternalsData, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			if (!traySectionResultData.IsMDTray && traySectionData.InternalType != InternalsTypeEnum.CustomTray && traySectionResultData.DCAreaPercentOfTotalTrayArea.Value > 0.25)
			{
				CAMessage cAMessage = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.All, TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES43_1_Section);
				cAMessage.ApplicationType = _ApplicationType;
				cAMessage.SimulatorDataProvider = base.SimulatorDataProvider;
				cAMessage.ShowTrayNumber = true;
				cAMessage.ColumnStartStage = columnInternalsData.StartStageNumber;
				cAMessage.ColumnEndStage = columnInternalsData.EndStageNumber;
				cAMessage.IsTopDownNumbering = columnInternalsData.IsTopDownNumbering;
				_CAMessagesManager.AddMessage(cAMessage);
			}
		}

		private CAMessage GetApproachToLimitMessage(TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum messageType, TraySectionResultData secrResult, string sConfigOption, string sectionKey)
		{
			CAMessage result = null;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			List<CARealVariable> list = new List<CARealVariable>();
			_ = string.Empty;
			string newValue = MessageTray + " {0}";
			switch (messageType)
			{
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxJetFlood:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_JetFlood;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(secrResult.MaxPercentJetFloodLimit);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxDownComerBackup:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_DownComer;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(secrResult.MaxDowncomerBackupLimit);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxWeirLoading:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_MaxWeirLoad;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(secrResult.WeirLoadMaximum);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MinWeirLoading:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_MinWeirLoad;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(secrResult.WeirLoadMinimum);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxEntrainment:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_MaxEntrain;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(secrResult.MaximumFractionalEntrainmentLimit);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.WeepPoint:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_WeepPoint;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.MaxPressureDrop:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_MaxPressureDrop;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				list.Add(secrResult.MaximumPressureDropLimit);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.Dump:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_Dump;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				break;
			case TrayCloseToLimitMessageEnum.UltimateCapacity:
				empty = TrayRatingResources.IMESSAGES_Approach_UltimateCapacity;
				empty = empty.Replace("{0}", newValue);
				break;
			default:
				empty = string.Empty;
				break;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
			{
				result = new CAMessage(sConfigOption, sectionKey, MessageType.Warning, MessageCatalog.Engine, empty);
				result.SourceRealData = list;
				return result;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PackingDiagramAnalyzer
	{
		private LineLabelAndColor _DiagramLineLabelAndColor = new LineLabelAndColor();

		private int preLabelLinesSwich = 10;

		public LineLabelAndColor DiagramLineLabelAndColor => _DiagramLineLabelAndColor;

		internal abstract PackingStageDiagram PackingDiagramData { get; }

		public PackingDiagramAnalyzer()
		{
		}

		protected void PlotPackingLines(PackingPlotReturnData.PackingEnclosedAreaLines exclosedData, string title, bool bShowLabel, PackingPlotReturnData.PlotDataRegion plotDataRegion)
		{
			if (PackingDiagramData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PackingPlotReturnData returnData = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData;
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			int num = exclosedData.PressureLines.Count / preLabelLinesSwich + 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < returnData.PressureDropValues.Length; i++)
			{
				bool flag3 = i % num == 0;
				flag3 = bShowLabel && flag3;
				double value = returnData.PressureDropValues[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < returnData.LiquidFlowValues.Length; j++)
				{
					if (returnData.VaporFlowValues[j, i] != 0.0)
					{
						list.Add(returnData.LiquidFlowValues[j]);
						list2.Add(returnData.VaporFlowValues[j, i]);
					}
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop))
				{
					string formatedValueWithUnit = GetFormatedValueWithUnit(value, QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight);
					if (i == returnData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1)
					{
						flag3 = true;
						flag3 = flag3 && bShowLabel;
						PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit, bShowLegend: true, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
					}
					else if (i == num2)
					{
						PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit, bShowLegend: true, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
					}
					else if (!flag)
					{
						PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop, bShowLegend: true, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop, bShowLegend: false, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
					}
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < returnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.Length; k++)
			{
				list.Add(returnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues[k]);
				list2.Add(returnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues[k]);
			}
			if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity))
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity, bShowLegend: true, bShowLabel);
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity, bShowLegend: false, bShowLabel);
				}
			}
			list.Clear();
			list2.Clear();
			list.Add(returnData.MinimumLiquidFlow);
			list.Add(returnData.MinimumLiquidFlow);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft);
			if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft, plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft) && AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate))
			{
				PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate, bShowLegend: true, bShowLabel);
			}
			list.Clear();
			list2.Clear();
			if (exclosedData.ConstantLine != null)
			{
				foreach (PairDouble item in exclosedData.ConstantLine)
				{
					list.Add(item.x);
					list2.Add(item.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.ConstantVL))
				{
					PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.ConstantVL, bShowLegend: true, bShowLabel);
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			PlotOperatingPoint(returnData.OperationPointX, returnData.OperationPointY, _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindPackingLabelString(PackingLineType.OperatingPoint), _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindPackingLineColor(PackingLineType.OperatingPoint), bShowLabel);
		}

		protected void PlotEclosedPackingLines(PackingPlotReturnData.PackingEnclosedAreaLines exclosedData, string title, bool bShowLabel, PackingPlotReturnData.PlotDataRegion plotDataRegion)
		{
			if (PackingDiagramData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PackingPlotReturnData returnData = PackingDiagramData.ReturnData;
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			int num = -1;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			List<double> xlowerArray;
			List<double> lowerYArray;
			int presIndex;
			bool minimumPressureDropCurve = returnData.GetMinimumPressureDropCurve(out xlowerArray, out lowerYArray, out presIndex);
			int num2 = exclosedData.PressureLines.Count / preLabelLinesSwich + 1;
			if (exclosedData.PressureLines != null && exclosedData.PressureLines.Count > 1)
			{
				foreach (List<PairDouble> pressureLine in exclosedData.PressureLines)
				{
					num++;
					bool flag3 = num % num2 == 0;
					flag3 = bShowLabel && flag3;
					double value = exclosedData.PressureDropValues[num];
					foreach (PairDouble item in pressureLine)
					{
						list.Add(item.x);
						list2.Add(item.y);
					}
					if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop))
					{
						string formatedValueWithUnit = GetFormatedValueWithUnit(value, QuantityTypeEnum.SmallPressureDropDivideHeight);
						if (num == 0 && minimumPressureDropCurve)
						{
							PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.LowerPressureDropLimit, bShowLegend: true, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
						}
						else if (num == exclosedData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1 && exclosedData.PressureDropValues[exclosedData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1] == returnData.PressureDropValues[returnData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1])
						{
							flag3 = true;
							flag3 = flag3 && bShowLabel;
							PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UpperPressureDropLimit, bShowLegend: true, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num == exclosedData.PressureDropValues.Length - 1)
							{
								flag3 = true;
								flag3 = flag3 && bShowLabel;
							}
							if (!flag)
							{
								PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop, bShowLegend: true, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
								flag = true;
							}
							else
							{
								PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop, bShowLegend: false, flag3, formatedValueWithUnit);
							}
						}
					}
					list.Clear();
					list2.Clear();
				}
			}
			foreach (List<PairDouble> ultimateLine in exclosedData.UltimateLines)
			{
				foreach (PairDouble item2 in ultimateLine)
				{
					list.Add(item2.x);
					list2.Add(item2.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity))
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity, bShowLegend: true, bShowLabel);
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity, bShowLegend: false, bShowLabel);
					}
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			list.Clear();
			list2.Clear();
			list.Add(returnData.MinimumLiquidFlow);
			list.Add(returnData.MinimumLiquidFlow);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft);
			list2.Add(plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft);
			if (!VariableHelper.IsDoubleEqual(plotDataRegion.LowestVaporloadLeft, plotDataRegion.HighestVaporloadLeft) && AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate))
			{
				PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.MinimumLiquidRate, bShowLegend: true, bShowLabel);
			}
			if (exclosedData.ConstantLine != null)
			{
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
				foreach (PairDouble item3 in exclosedData.ConstantLine)
				{
					list.Add(item3.x);
					list2.Add(item3.y);
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.ConstantVL))
				{
					PlotLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.ConstantVL, bShowLegend: true, bShowLabel);
				}
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
			}
			PlotOperatingPoint(returnData.OperationPointX, returnData.OperationPointY, _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindPackingLabelString(PackingLineType.OperatingPoint), _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindPackingLineColor(PackingLineType.OperatingPoint), bShowLabel);
		}

		protected abstract void PlotLine(List<double> valL, List<double> valY, PackingLineType linetype, bool bShowLegend, bool bShowLabel);

		protected abstract void PlotLine(List<double> valL, List<double> valY, PackingLineType linetype, bool bShowLegend, bool bShowLabel, string legendName);

		protected abstract void PlotOperatingPoint(double valL, double valY, string lableName, System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, bool showLabel);

		protected abstract string GetFormatedValueWithUnit(double value, QuantityTypeEnum qt);

		internal AxesOptions GetPlotRangeData(PackingStageDiagram packing, bool isOriginalLines = true)
		{
			AxesOptions axesOptions = null;
			PackingPlotReturnData returnData = packing.ReturnData;
			AxesOptions allLinesRangeData = GetAllLinesRangeData(packing);
			if (isOriginalLines)
			{
				axesOptions = allLinesRangeData;
			}
			else
			{
				axesOptions = new AxesOptions();
				axesOptions.XMin = returnData.MinimumLiquidFlow;
				axesOptions.XMax = returnData.MaximumLiquidFlow;
				if (axesOptions.XMax > allLinesRangeData.XMax)
				{
					axesOptions.XMax = allLinesRangeData.XMax;
				}
				_ = returnData.EnclosedAreaLines;
				PackingPlotReturnData.PlotDataRegion plotDataRegionData = returnData.PlotDataRegionData;
				axesOptions.YMax = plotDataRegionData.HighestVaporloadLeft * 1.02;
				if (axesOptions.YMax > allLinesRangeData.YMax)
				{
					axesOptions.YMax = allLinesRangeData.YMax;
				}
				if (plotDataRegionData.LowestVaporloadLeft > plotDataRegionData.LowestVaporloadright)
				{
					axesOptions.YMin = plotDataRegionData.LowestVaporloadright;
				}
				else
				{
					axesOptions.YMin = plotDataRegionData.LowestVaporloadLeft;
				}
			}
			axesOptions.LogXMin = axesOptions.XMin * 0.8;
			axesOptions.LogYMin = axesOptions.YMin * 0.8;
			axesOptions.XMin -= 0.05 * (axesOptions.XMax - axesOptions.XMin);
			axesOptions.YMin -= 0.02 * (axesOptions.YMax - axesOptions.YMin);
			if (axesOptions.XMax < returnData.OperationPointX)
			{
				axesOptions.XMax = returnData.OperationPointX;
			}
			if (axesOptions.YMax < returnData.OperationPointY)
			{
				axesOptions.YMax = returnData.OperationPointY;
			}
			if (axesOptions.XMin > returnData.OperationPointX)
			{
				axesOptions.XMin = returnData.OperationPointX;
			}
			if (axesOptions.YMin > returnData.OperationPointY)
			{
				axesOptions.YMin = returnData.OperationPointY;
			}
			if (axesOptions.LogXMin > returnData.OperationPointX)
			{
				axesOptions.LogXMin = returnData.OperationPointX;
			}
			if (axesOptions.LogYMin > returnData.OperationPointY)
			{
				axesOptions.LogYMin = returnData.OperationPointY;
			}
			axesOptions.XMax *= 1.05;
			axesOptions.YMax *= 1.05;
			axesOptions.LogXMax = axesOptions.XMax * 1.1;
			axesOptions.LogYMax = axesOptions.YMax * 1.1;
			return axesOptions;
		}

		private AxesOptions GetAllLinesRangeData(PackingStageDiagram packing)
		{
			if (packing == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = 99999999.0;
			double num2 = 99999999.0;
			double num3 = -99999999.0;
			double num4 = -99999999.0;
			PackingPlotReturnData returnData = packing.ReturnData;
			for (int i = 0; i < returnData.PressureDropValues.Length; i++)
			{
				List<double> list = new List<double>();
				List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
				_ = returnData.PressureDropValues[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < returnData.LiquidFlowValues.Length; j++)
				{
					if (returnData.VaporFlowValues[j, i] != 0.0)
					{
						list.Add(returnData.LiquidFlowValues[j]);
						list2.Add(returnData.VaporFlowValues[j, i]);
					}
				}
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list, list2, PackingLineType.PressureDrop))
				{
					if (list[0] < num)
					{
						num = list[0];
					}
					if (list[list.Count - 1] > num3)
					{
						num3 = list[list.Count - 1];
					}
					if (list2[0] > num4)
					{
						num4 = list2[0];
					}
					if (list2[list2.Count - 1] < num2)
					{
						num2 = list2[list2.Count - 1];
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < returnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues.Length; k++)
			{
				List<double> list3 = new List<double>();
				List<double> list4 = new List<double>();
				list3.Add(returnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidValues[k]);
				list4.Add(returnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporValues[k]);
				if (AttpsrHelper.IsValidLine(list3, list4, PackingLineType.UltimateCapacity, checkCount: false))
				{
					if (list3[0] < num)
					{
						num = list3[0];
					}
					if (list3[list3.Count - 1] > num3)
					{
						num3 = list3[list3.Count - 1];
					}
					if (list4[0] < num2)
					{
						num2 = list4[0];
					}
					if (list4[list4.Count - 1] > num4)
					{
						num4 = list4[list4.Count - 1];
					}
				}
			}
			return new AxesOptions
			{
				XMin = num,
				XMax = num3,
				YMin = num2,
				YMax = num4
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class StabilityDiagramAnalyzer
	{
		protected Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, double>> _CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl = new Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, double>>();

		protected Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, double>> _CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl = new Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, double>>();

		protected bool _LabelCurves;

		protected int _EnclosedCurveNumber;

		protected void PlotOriginalCurves(string title, string liquidUnit, string vaporUnit)
		{
			_EnclosedAreaDataStore = new DiagramDataStore();
			_EnclosedCurveNumber = 0;
			bool bShowDumpLine = true;
			bool bShowWeepLine = true;
			InitializeEnclosedAreaData(ref bShowDumpLine, ref bShowWeepLine);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			if (bShowWeepLine && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < 1E+35 && TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint > 0 && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint] < -0.01)
			{
				double num = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1] + (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1]) / (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1]);
				_EnclosedAreaDataStore.AddPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0], num);
				list.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]);
				list2.Add(num);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]);
				list2.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints[0]);
			}
			for (int i = TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint; i < TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				_EnclosedAreaDataStore.AddPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[i], TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[i]);
			}
			if (bShowWeepLine)
			{
				for (int num2 = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 2; num2 >= TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint; num2--)
				{
					_EnclosedAreaDataStore.AddPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[num2], TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[num2]);
				}
			}
			if (bShowWeepLine && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < 1E+35 && TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint > 0 && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint] < -0.01)
			{
				double num3 = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1] + (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1]) / (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1]);
				_EnclosedAreaDataStore.AddPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0], num3);
				list.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]);
				list2.Add(num3);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[1]);
				list2.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints[1]);
			}
			PlotCombinationLines(0, bEnclosed: false);
			if (bShowWeepLine)
			{
				PlotLine(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Weep, bShowLegend: true);
			}
			if (bShowDumpLine)
			{
				PlotLine(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Dump, bShowLegend: true);
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < 1E+35)
			{
				PlotLine(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Maxswload, bShowLegend: true);
				if (!bShowWeepLine && TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMaxLiquidLoad)
				{
					_EnclosedAreaDataStore.AddPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0], TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints[0]);
					_EnclosedAreaDataStore.AddPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 1], TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1]);
				}
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < 1E+35)
			{
				PlotLine(list, list2, OrigialLineName.Minswload, bShowLegend: true);
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.OperatingPointsLiquidFlow[0] < 1E+35)
			{
				PlotLine(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.OperatingPointsLiquidFlow, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.OperatingPointsVaporFlow, OrigialLineName.OperatingLine, bShowLegend: true);
			}
			PlotOperatingPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0], TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1], _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLabelString(OrigialLineName.OperatingPoint), _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLineColor(OrigialLineName.OperatingPoint), bEnclosed: false, bShowWeepLine);
		}

		protected void PlotEnclosedArea(string title, string liquidUnit, string vaporUnit)
		{
			_EnclosedAreaDataStore = new DiagramDataStore();
			if (TrayDiagramData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Count > 0)
			{
				_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Clear();
				_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl.Clear();
			}
			_EnclosedCurveNumber = 0;
			bool bShowDumpLine = true;
			bool bShowWeepLine = true;
			InitializeEnclosedAreaData(ref bShowDumpLine, ref bShowWeepLine);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < 1E+35 && TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint > 0 && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint] > -0.01)
			{
				list.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]);
				double item = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1] + (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1]) / (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint - 1]);
				list2.Add(item);
			}
			for (int i = TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint; i < TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count; i++)
			{

				list2.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[i]);

				{
					list3.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]);
					double item2 = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1] + (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1]) / (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint - 1]);

			PlotOperatingPoint(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0], TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1], _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLabelString(OrigialLineName.OperatingPoint), _DiagramLineLabelAndColor.FindLineColor(OrigialLineName.OperatingPoint), bEnclosed: true, bShowWeepLine);
		}

		protected void PlotCombinationLines(int startIndex, bool bEnclosed)
		{
			if (bEnclosed)
			{
				AnalyzeIntersectingPoint();
			}
			List<int> AddedCurveNumber = new List<int>();
			bool bFirst = false;
			int startPoint = startIndex;
			int num = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
			while (startPoint < num - 1)
			{
				if (bEnclosed)
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_Enclosed(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, OrigialLineName.Entrain, 1, ref bFirst);
				}
				else
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_AllCurves(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Entrain, 1, ref bFirst);
				}
			}
			bFirst = false;
			startPoint = startIndex;
			num = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
			while (startPoint < num - 1)
			{
				if (bEnclosed)
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_Enclosed(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, OrigialLineName.JetFlood, 2, ref bFirst);
				}
				else
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_AllCurves(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.JetFlood, 2, ref bFirst);
				}
			}
			bFirst = false;
			startPoint = startIndex;
			num = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
			while (startPoint < num - 1)
			{
				if (bEnclosed)
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_Enclosed(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, OrigialLineName.Dcb, 3, ref bFirst);
				}
				else
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_AllCurves(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Dcb, 3, ref bFirst);
				}
			}
			bFirst = false;
			startPoint = startIndex;
			num = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
			while (startPoint < num - 1)
			{
				if (bEnclosed)
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_Enclosed(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, OrigialLineName.Ultcap, 4, ref bFirst);
				}
				else
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_AllCurves(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Ultcap, 4, ref bFirst);
				}
			}
			bFirst = false;
			startPoint = startIndex;
			num = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
			while (startPoint < num - 1)
			{
				if (bEnclosed)
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_Enclosed(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, OrigialLineName.Maxdp, 5, ref bFirst);
				}
				else
				{
					AnalyzeCombinationLine_AllCurves(ref startPoint, ref AddedCurveNumber, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints, OrigialLineName.Maxdp, 5, ref bFirst);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AnalyzeCombinationLine_Enclosed(ref int startPoint, ref List<int> AddedCurveNumber, OrigialLineName lineName, int lineNumber, ref bool bFirst)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			bool flag = false;
			if (_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Keys.Contains(lineNumber))
			{
				foreach (int key in _CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[lineNumber].Keys)
				{
					if (key == startPoint)
					{
						list.Add(_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[lineNumber][startPoint]);
						list2.Add(_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl[lineNumber][startPoint]);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = startPoint; i < TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i] == lineNumber)
				{
					if (!AddedCurveNumber.Contains(lineNumber))
					{
						AddedCurveNumber.Add(lineNumber);
						bFirst = true;
					}
					list.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints[i]);
					list2.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[i]);
					if (i < TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism.Count - 1 && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i] != TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1])
					{
						if (_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Keys.Contains(lineNumber))
						{
							foreach (int key2 in _CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[lineNumber].Keys)
							{
								if (key2 == i)
								{
									list.Add(_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[lineNumber][i]);
									list2.Add(_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl[lineNumber][i]);
								}
							}
						}
						startPoint = i + 1;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (i == TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism.Count - 1)
					{
						startPoint = i;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					continue;
				}
				startPoint = i + 1;
				break;
			}
			if (list2.Count > 1)
			{
				PlotLine(list, list2, lineName, bFirst);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bFirst = false;
			}
		}

		private void AnalyzeCombinationLine_AllCurves(ref int startPoint, ref List<int> AddedCurveNumber, List<double> inputL, List<double> inputV, OrigialLineName lineName, int lineNumber, ref bool bFirst)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			bool flag = false;
			int num = Math.Min(inputL.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
			for (int i = startPoint; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (inputV[i] == TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints[i] && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i] != lineNumber)
				{
					if (AddedCurveNumber.Contains(lineNumber) && (list2.Count > 0 || i == num - 1))
					{
						startPoint = i;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (!AddedCurveNumber.Contains(lineNumber))
				{
					AddedCurveNumber.Add(lineNumber);
					bFirst = true;
				}
				list.Add(inputL[i]);
				list2.Add(inputV[i]);
				if (i == num - 1)
				{
					startPoint = i;
				}
			}
			if (list2.Count > 1)
			{
				PlotLine(list, list2, lineName, bFirst);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bFirst = false;
			}
		}

		private void AnalyzeIntersectingPoint()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i >= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism.Count - 1 || TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i] == TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1])
				{
					continue;
				}
				double valL = 0.0;
				double valV = 0.0;
				if (FindTheValue(ref valL, ref valV, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i], i, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1], i + 1))
				{
					if (!_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Keys.Contains(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i]))
					{
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i], new Dictionary<int, double>());
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i], new Dictionary<int, double>());
					}
					if (!_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i]].Keys.Contains(i))
					{
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i]].Add(i, valL);
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i]].Add(i, valV);
					}
					if (!_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Keys.Contains(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1]))
					{
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1], new Dictionary<int, double>());
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl.Add(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1], new Dictionary<int, double>());
					}
					if (!_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1]].Keys.Contains(i + 1))
					{
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointLColl[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1]].Add(i + 1, valL);
						_CombLineTurnaroundPointVColl[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.Mechanism[i + 1]].Add(i + 1, valV);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool FindTheValue(ref double valL, ref double valV, int lineNum1, int index1, int lineNum2, int index2)
		{
			double valL2 = 0.0;
			double valV2 = 0.0;
			double valL3 = 0.0;
			double valV3 = 0.0;
			double valL4 = 0.0;
			double valV4 = 0.0;
			double valL5 = 0.0;
			double valV5 = 0.0;
			int num;
			if (GetValueFromLine(ref valL2, ref valV2, lineNum1, index1) && GetValueFromLine(ref valL3, ref valV3, lineNum1, index1 + 1) && GetValueFromLine(ref valL4, ref valV4, lineNum2, index2 - 1))
			{
				num = (GetValueFromLine(ref valL5, ref valV5, lineNum2, index2) ? 1 : 0);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					double num2 = (valV3 - valV2) / (valL3 - valL2);
					double num3 = (valV5 - valV4) / (valL5 - valL4);
					valL = (num3 * valL4 - num2 * valL2 + valV2 - valV4) / (num3 - num2);
					valV = valV2 + num2 * (valL - valL2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			return (byte)num != 0;
		}

		private bool GetValueFromLine(ref double valL, ref double valV, int lineNum, int index)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (lineNum == 1 && index <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				valL = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints[index];
				valV = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints[index];
				result = true;
			}
			else if (lineNum == 2 && index <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				valL = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints[index];
				valV = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints[index];
				result = true;
			}
			else if (lineNum == 3 && index <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				valL = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints[index];
				valV = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints[index];
				result = true;
			}
			else if (lineNum == 4 && index <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				valL = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints[index];
				valV = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints[index];
				result = true;
			}
			else if (lineNum == 5 && index <= TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				valL = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints[index];
				valV = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints[index];
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeEnclosedAreaData(ref bool bShowDumpLine, ref bool bShowWeepLine)
		{
			if (TrayDiagramData == null || TrayDiagramData.ReturnData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints != null && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count > 1)
			{
				if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints[0] == 0.0 && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1] == 0.0)
				{
					bShowDumpLine = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bShowDumpLine = false;
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints != null && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count > 1)
			{
				if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[0] == 0.0 && TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1] == 0.0)
				{
					bShowWeepLine = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bShowWeepLine = false;
			}
			if ((TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints != null) & bShowDumpLine)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DumpLineStartPoint = 0;
				int num = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < num - 1; i++)
				{
					if ((TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[i] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints[i]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints[i + 1] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints[i + 1]) <= 0.0)
					{
						TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DumpLineStartPoint = i + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints != null) & bShowWeepLine)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint = 0;
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints != null)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint = 0;
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMinLiqLoad = true;
			double num2 = FoundRangeList(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints, toFindMax: false);
			bool flag = false;
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < num2)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] >= 1E+35 || TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[1] >= 1E+35 || flag)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMinLiqLoad = false;
			}
			else if (!bShowWeepLine)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.MinLiqLoadStartPoint = 1;
			}
			else if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] < TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0])
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.MinLiqLoadStartPoint = 0;
				int num3 = Math.Min(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count, TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count);
				for (int j = 1; j < num3; j++)
				{
					if ((TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[j] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[j - 1] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0]) <= 0.0)
					{
						TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.MinLiqLoadStartPoint = j - 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMinLiqLoad = false;
			}
			TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMaxLiquidLoad = true;
			double num4 = FoundRangeList(TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints, toFindMax: true);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] > num4)
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[0] >= 1E+35 || TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[1] >= 1E+35 || flag2)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMaxLiquidLoad = false;
			}
			else if (!bShowWeepLine)
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.MaxLiqLoadStartPoint = 1;
			}
			else if (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 1] > TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[1])
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.MaxLiqLoadStartPoint = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 1;
				for (int num5 = TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 1; num5 > 1; num5--)
				{
					if ((TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[num5] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[1]) * (TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints[num5 - 1] - TrayDiagramData.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints[1]) <= 0.0)
					{
						TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.MaxLiqLoadStartPoint = num5 - 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				TrayDiagramData.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.DrawMaxLiquidLoad = false;
			}
		}

		protected List<double> GetEnclosedTrayRangeData(DiagramTray tray, bool toFindMax)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list3 = new List<double>();
			tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineEndPoint = tray.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1;
			double item = FoundRangeList(tray.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineEndPoint, toFindMax);
			list3.Add(item);
			tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineEndPoint = tray.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 1;
			double item2 = FoundRangeList(tray.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineStartPoint, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.WeepLineEndPoint, toFindMax);
			list2.Add(item2);
			tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineEndPoint = tray.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints.Count - 1;
			double item3 = FoundRangeList(tray.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineEndPoint, toFindMax);
			list3.Add(item3);
			tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineEndPoint = tray.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints.Count - 1;
			double item4 = FoundRangeList(tray.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineStartPoint, tray.EnclosedAreaLinesAndBounds.CombLineEndPoint, toFindMax);
			list2.Add(item4);
			list2.Add(tray.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0]);
			list3.Add(tray.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1]);
			double item5 = FoundRangeList(list2, toFindMax);
			list.Add(item5);
			double item6 = FoundRangeList(list3, toFindMax);
			list.Add(item6);
			return list;
		}

		protected List<double> GetAllLinesTrayRangeData(DiagramTray tray, bool toFindMax)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list3 = new List<double>();
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.JetFloodCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.WeepingCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.WeepingCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.UltimateCapacityCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.DumpCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.DumpCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MaximumEntrainmentCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.DowncomerBackupCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MaximumAcceptablePressureDropCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.CombinedCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.CombinedCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MinimumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveLiquidFlowPoints);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.MaximumWeirLoadCurveVaporFlowPoints);
			list2.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.OperatingPointsLiquidFlow);
			list3.AddRange(tray.ReturnData.OperatingPointsVaporFlow);
			list2.Add(tray.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[0]);
			list3.Add(tray.ReturnData.ActualOperationPoint[1]);
			double item;
			double item2;
			if (toFindMax)
			{
				item = list2.Where((double x) => x < 1E+20).Max();
				item2 = list3.Where((double x) => x < 1E+20).Max();
			}
			else
			{
				item = list2.Where((double x) => x > 0.0 && x < 1E+20).Min();
				item2 = list3.Where((double x) => x > 0.0 && x < 1E+20).Min();
			}
			list.Add(item);
			list.Add(item2);
			return list;
		}

		protected double FoundRangeList(List<double> soure, bool toFindMax)
		{
			return AttpsrHelper.FoundRangeList(soure, 0, soure.Count - 1, toFindMax);
		}

		protected double FoundRangeList(List<double> soure, int startIndex, int endIndex, bool toFindMax)
		{
			return AttpsrHelper.FoundRangeList(soure, startIndex, endIndex, toFindMax);
		}
	}
	public class DiagramDataStore
	{
		public List<PairDouble> PointArray { get; set; }

		public DiagramDataStore()
		{
			PointArray = new List<PairDouble>();
		}

		public void AddPoint(double x, double y)
		{
			PointArray.Add(new PairDouble(x, y));
		}

		public void AddPoints(List<double> valL, List<double> valY)
		{
			if (valL == null || valY == null || valY.Count != valY.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < valL.Count; i++)
			{
				PointArray.Add(new PairDouble(valL[i], valY[i]));
			}
		}

		public void AddLine(List<PairDouble> line)
		{
			PointArray.AddRange(line);
		}
	}
	public class PairDouble
	{
		public double x { get; set; }

		public double y { get; set; }

		public PairDouble(double x, double y)
		{
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
		}
	}
}
